ieltsWords.definition: v. 放弃，遗弃；n. 放任，放纵
ieltsWords.collocations: abandon a plan 放弃计划, abandon hope 放弃希望, abandon a project 放弃项目
ieltsWords.example: The government had to abandon the plan due to lack of funds. ||| They abandoned the old building after the earthquake. ||| She abandoned her career to raise her children.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于缺乏资金，政府不得不放弃该计划。 ||| 地震后他们遗弃了那栋旧楼。 ||| 她放弃事业来抚养孩子。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 能力，才能；才能，本领
ieltsWords.collocations: have the ability to do 有能力做某事, natural ability 天赋, leadership ability 领导能力
ieltsWords.example: She has the ability to solve complex problems quickly. ||| His natural ability in music was evident from a young age. ||| The course aims to improve students' writing ability.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她有快速解决复杂问题的能力。 ||| 他从小就在音乐方面展现出天赋。 ||| 这门课程旨在提高学生的写作能力。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 废除，废止；彻底消除
ieltsWords.collocations: abolish slavery 废除奴隶制, abolish a law 废除一项法律, abolish the death penalty 废除死刑
ieltsWords.example: Many countries have abolished the death penalty. ||| The government decided to abolish the outdated regulation. ||| Slavery was abolished in the 19th century.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多国家已经废除了死刑。 ||| 政府决定废除过时的规定。 ||| 奴隶制在19世纪被废除。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 吸收；理解，掌握；使全神贯注
ieltsWords.collocations: absorb knowledge 吸收知识, absorb information 吸收信息, absorb moisture 吸收水分
ieltsWords.example: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. ||| The new material can absorb up to 90% of the impact. ||| She was so absorbed in her book that she didn't hear the phone.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 植物从大气中吸收二氧化碳。 ||| 这种新材料能吸收高达90%的冲击力。 ||| 她全神贯注于书本，没听到电话铃声。

ieltsWords.definition: adj. 抽象的；n. 摘要，概要；v. 提取，抽取
ieltsWords.collocations: abstract concept 抽象概念, abstract art 抽象艺术, abstract noun 抽象名词
ieltsWords.example: The idea of freedom is an abstract concept. ||| He wrote an abstract of the research paper. ||| The artist's work is known for its abstract style.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 自由的概念是一个抽象概念。 ||| 他写了研究论文的摘要。 ||| 这位艺术家的作品以其抽象风格而闻名。

ieltsWords.definition: adj. 丰富的，充裕的；充足的
ieltsWords.collocations: abundant resources 丰富的资源, abundant evidence 充分的证据, abundant supply 充足的供应
ieltsWords.example: The region has abundant natural resources. ||| There is abundant evidence to support the theory. ||| The country enjoys an abundant supply of fresh water.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该地区拥有丰富的自然资源。 ||| 有充分的证据支持这一理论。 ||| 这个国家有充足的淡水供应。

ieltsWords.definition: n./v. 滥用；虐待；辱骂
ieltsWords.collocations: drug abuse 药物滥用, child abuse 虐待儿童, abuse of power 滥用权力
ieltsWords.example: The government is taking measures to prevent drug abuse. ||| He was accused of child abuse. ||| The manager was fired for abuse of power.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府正在采取措施防止药物滥用。 ||| 他被指控虐待儿童。 ||| 经理因滥用权力被解雇。

ieltsWords.definition: adj. 学术的；学院的；n. 学者
ieltsWords.collocations: academic performance 学业表现, academic research 学术研究, academic year 学年
ieltsWords.example: Her academic performance has been excellent throughout the year. ||| The university is known for its academic research. ||| He is a respected academic in the field of economics.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她整年的学业表现都很优秀。 ||| 这所大学以其学术研究而闻名。 ||| 他是经济学领域备受尊敬的学者。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 加速，促进；加快
ieltsWords.collocations: accelerate economic growth 加速经济增长, accelerate the process 加速进程, accelerate change 加速变化
ieltsWords.example: The new policy aims to accelerate economic growth. ||| The car accelerated quickly when the light turned green. ||| Technology has accelerated the pace of change in society.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新政策旨在加速经济增长。 ||| 绿灯亮时，汽车迅速加速。 ||| 技术加速了社会变化的步伐。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 进入；使用权；v. 访问，存取
ieltsWords.collocations: have access to 能够使用/获得, access information 获取信息, access the internet 访问互联网
ieltsWords.example: Students have free access to the library. ||| The software allows users to access data remotely. ||| Only authorized personnel have access to the building.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生可以免费使用图书馆。 ||| 该软件允许用户远程访问数据。 ||| 只有授权人员才能进入大楼。

ieltsWords.definition: 容纳；提供住处
ieltsWords.collocations: accommodate guests 容纳客人, accommodate changes 适应变化, accommodate needs 满足需求
ieltsWords.example: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests. ||| The new policy aims to accommodate the needs of disabled people. ||| We need to accommodate our schedule to the new requirements.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家酒店最多可容纳500位客人。 ||| 新政策旨在满足残疾人的需求。 ||| 我们需要调整日程以适应新要求。

ieltsWords.definition: 陪伴；伴随
ieltsWords.collocations: accompany someone 陪伴某人, accompany a meal 佐餐, accompany a singer 为歌手伴奏
ieltsWords.example: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult. ||| The report was accompanied by a detailed analysis. ||| She accompanied the singer on the piano.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 12岁以下儿童必须由成人陪同。 ||| 报告附有详细的分析。 ||| 她用钢琴为歌手伴奏。

ieltsWords.definition: 完成，实现
ieltsWords.collocations: accomplish a goal 实现目标, accomplish a task 完成任务, accomplish a mission 完成使命
ieltsWords.example: She accomplished her goal of running a marathon. ||| The team accomplished the project ahead of schedule. ||| He felt a sense of pride after accomplishing the difficult task.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她实现了跑马拉松的目标。 ||| 团队提前完成了项目。 ||| 完成这项艰巨任务后，他感到自豪。

ieltsWords.definition: 积累，积聚
ieltsWords.collocations: accumulate wealth 积累财富, accumulate experience 积累经验, accumulate data 积累数据
ieltsWords.example: Over the years, he accumulated a large fortune. ||| The company has accumulated valuable experience in the market. ||| Dust accumulates quickly on the shelves if not cleaned regularly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 多年来，他积累了大量财富。 ||| 该公司在市场上积累了宝贵的经验。 ||| 如果不定期清洁，架子上很快就会积灰。

ieltsWords.definition: 准确的，精确的
ieltsWords.collocations: accurate information 准确信息, accurate measurement 精确测量, accurate description 准确描述
ieltsWords.example: It is important to provide accurate information in your report. ||| The measurement needs to be accurate to within 0.1 mm. ||| Her description of the event was accurate in every detail.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在报告中提供准确信息很重要。 ||| 测量需要精确到0.1毫米以内。 ||| 她对事件的描述在每一个细节上都准确无误。

ieltsWords.definition: 实现，达到
ieltsWords.collocations: achieve success 取得成功, achieve a goal 实现目标, achieve results 取得成果
ieltsWords.example: She worked hard to achieve her dream of becoming a doctor. ||| The company achieved record profits this year. ||| With determination, you can achieve anything you set your mind to.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她努力实现了成为医生的梦想。 ||| 公司今年取得了创纪录的利润。 ||| 只要有决心，你就能实现任何目标。

ieltsWords.definition: 承认；认可
ieltsWords.collocations: acknowledge a problem 承认问题, acknowledge receipt 确认收到, acknowledge contributions 感谢贡献
ieltsWords.example: The government acknowledged the need for reform. ||| Please acknowledge receipt of this email. ||| The author acknowledged the help of her colleagues in the preface.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府承认了改革的必要性。 ||| 请确认收到此邮件。 ||| 作者在序言中感谢了同事们的帮助。

ieltsWords.definition: 获得；收购
ieltsWords.collocations: acquire knowledge 获得知识, acquire a skill 掌握技能, acquire a company 收购公司
ieltsWords.example: Children acquire language naturally through exposure. ||| The company acquired a smaller competitor last year. ||| She acquired a taste for classical music over time.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 儿童通过接触自然习得语言。 ||| 该公司去年收购了一家较小的竞争对手。 ||| 随着时间的推移，她培养了对古典音乐的爱好。

ieltsWords.definition: 适应；改编
ieltsWords.collocations: adapt to change 适应变化, adapt a novel 改编小说, adapt to new environment 适应新环境
ieltsWords.example: Animals must adapt to their environment to survive. ||| The movie was adapted from a best-selling novel. ||| It took her a while to adapt to the new job.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 动物必须适应环境才能生存。 ||| 这部电影改编自一部畅销小说。 ||| 她花了一段时间才适应新工作。

ieltsWords.definition: 足够的；适当的
ieltsWords.collocations: adequate supply 充足供应, adequate preparation 充分准备, adequate funding 足够资金
ieltsWords.example: The city has an adequate supply of clean water. ||| Make sure you get adequate sleep before the exam. ||| The funding is not adequate to complete the project.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该市有充足的清洁水供应。 ||| 考试前确保有充足的睡眠。 ||| 资金不足以完成该项目。

ieltsWords.definition: 遵守；附着
ieltsWords.collocations: adhere to 遵守, adhere to principles 坚持原则, adhere to the rules 遵守规则
ieltsWords.example: The glue must adhere to the surface for the repair to be effective. ||| All participants must adhere to the competition guidelines. ||| She adheres to a strict diet to maintain her health.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 胶水必须黏附在表面上，修复才能有效。 ||| 所有参赛者必须遵守比赛规则。 ||| 她坚持严格的饮食以保持健康。

ieltsWords.definition: 调整，适应
ieltsWords.collocations: adjust to 适应, adjust the settings 调整设置, adjust one's attitude 调整态度
ieltsWords.example: It took him a few weeks to adjust to the new time zone. ||| You can adjust the volume using the remote control. ||| The company adjusted its strategy to meet market demands.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他花了几周时间适应新的时区。 ||| 你可以用遥控器调节音量。 ||| 公司调整了策略以满足市场需求。

ieltsWords.definition: 管理；执行
ieltsWords.collocations: administer a test 主持考试, administer the law 执行法律, administer medicine 给药
ieltsWords.example: The nurse will administer the vaccine to all patients. ||| It is the duty of the court to administer justice. ||| The committee administers the funds for the project.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 护士将给所有患者接种疫苗。 ||| 法院的职责是执行司法。 ||| 委员会管理该项目的资金。

ieltsWords.definition: 采纳；收养
ieltsWords.collocations: adopt a child 收养孩子, adopt a policy 采纳政策, adopt a new approach 采用新方法
ieltsWords.example: The couple decided to adopt a child from an orphanage. ||| The school adopted a new curriculum to improve student outcomes. ||| The committee adopted the proposal unanimously.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这对夫妇决定从孤儿院收养一个孩子。 ||| 学校采用了新课程以提高学生成绩。 ||| 委员会一致通过了该提案。

ieltsWords.definition: 前进；进步
ieltsWords.collocations: in advance 提前, advance technology 先进技术, advance payment 预付款
ieltsWords.example: The army advanced towards the enemy lines. ||| You need to book tickets in advance for the concert. ||| Recent advances in medicine have saved many lives.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 军队向敌军防线推进。 ||| 你需要提前预订音乐会的门票。 ||| 医学的最新进展挽救了许多生命。

ieltsWords.definition: 优势，有利条件
ieltsWords.collocations: take advantage of 利用, have an advantage 有优势, competitive advantage 竞争优势
ieltsWords.example: Being bilingual is a great advantage in the job market. ||| He took advantage of the sale to buy a new laptop. ||| The team's experience gave them an advantage over their opponents.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 双语能力在就业市场上是一个很大的优势。 ||| 他利用促销活动买了一台新笔记本电脑。 ||| 该队的经验使他们比对手更有优势。

ieltsWords.definition: 不利的；相反的
ieltsWords.collocations: adverse effects 副作用, adverse conditions 不利条件, adverse reaction 不良反应
ieltsWords.example: The drug may cause adverse side effects in some patients. ||| The project was delayed due to adverse weather conditions. ||| Adverse criticism can sometimes be constructive.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这种药物可能会对一些患者产生不良副作用。 ||| 由于不利的天气条件，项目被推迟了。 ||| 反对的批评有时可能具有建设性。

ieltsWords.definition: 提倡；拥护者
ieltsWords.collocations: advocate for 提倡, strong advocate 坚定支持者, advocate change 倡导变革
ieltsWords.example: Many environmentalists advocate for renewable energy sources. ||| She is a strong advocate of equal rights for all. ||| The lawyer advocated on behalf of his client.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多环保主义者提倡使用可再生能源。 ||| 她是人人平等权利的坚定支持者。 ||| 律师代表他的当事人进行辩护。

ieltsWords.definition: 影响；感动
ieltsWords.collocations: affect the outcome 影响结果, be affected by 受…影响, affect one's mood 影响情绪
ieltsWords.example: The economic crisis affected millions of people worldwide. ||| Her speech deeply affected the audience. ||| He affected a British accent to impress his friends.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 经济危机影响了全球数百万人。 ||| 她的演讲深深打动了观众。 ||| 他假装英国口音以给朋友留下印象。

ieltsWords.definition: 负担得起
ieltsWords.collocations: afford to do 负担得起做, can afford 买得起, afford an opportunity 提供机会
ieltsWords.example: We cannot afford to waste any more time. ||| The scholarship enabled him to afford a university education. ||| The balcony affords a beautiful view of the city.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们不能再浪费时间了。 ||| 奖学金使他能够负担得起大学教育。 ||| 阳台提供了城市的美景。

ieltsWords.definition: 侵略的；有进取心的
ieltsWords.collocations: aggressive behavior 攻击性行为, aggressive marketing 积极营销, aggressive approach 激进方法
ieltsWords.example: The dog became aggressive when strangers approached. ||| The company adopted an aggressive marketing strategy to boost sales. ||| His aggressive style of play often leads to fouls.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 当陌生人靠近时，这只狗变得具有攻击性。 ||| 公司采取了积极的营销策略以促进销售。 ||| 他侵略性的打法经常导致犯规。

ieltsWords.definition: 减轻，缓解
ieltsWords.collocations: alleviate pain 减轻疼痛, alleviate poverty 缓解贫困, alleviate symptoms 缓解症状
ieltsWords.example: The medicine helped alleviate her headache. ||| New policies were introduced to alleviate poverty in rural areas. ||| Exercise can alleviate stress and improve mood.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这种药帮助缓解了她的头痛。 ||| 出台了新政策以缓解农村地区的贫困。 ||| 锻炼可以缓解压力并改善情绪。

ieltsWords.definition: 分配，拨出
ieltsWords.collocations: allocate resources 分配资源, allocate funds 拨出资金, allocate time 分配时间
ieltsWords.example: The government allocated funds for education reform. ||| We need to allocate our time wisely to meet the deadline. ||| Each team was allocated a specific area to work on.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府拨出资金用于教育改革。 ||| 我们需要合理分配时间以赶上截止日期。 ||| 每个团队被分配了一个特定的工作区域。

ieltsWords.definition: 替代方案；替代的
ieltsWords.collocations: alternative energy 替代能源, alternative solution 替代方案, have no alternative 别无选择
ieltsWords.example: Solar power is a clean alternative to fossil fuels. ||| We need to find an alternative route due to the road closure. ||| He had no alternative but to accept the job offer.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 太阳能是化石燃料的清洁替代品。 ||| 由于道路封闭，我们需要找到一条替代路线。 ||| 他别无选择，只能接受这份工作。

ieltsWords.definition: 雄心勃勃的
ieltsWords.collocations: ambitious plan 雄心勃勃的计划, ambitious goal 远大目标, ambitious person 有抱负的人
ieltsWords.example: She is an ambitious young woman who aims to become a CEO. ||| The company has ambitious plans for expansion overseas. ||| His ambitious project required a lot of funding and effort.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她是一个有抱负的年轻女性，目标是成为CEO。 ||| 公司有雄心勃勃的海外扩张计划。 ||| 他宏大的项目需要大量资金和努力。

ieltsWords.definition: 分析，解析
ieltsWords.collocations: analyse data 分析数据, analyse the situation 分析情况, analyse results 分析结果
ieltsWords.example: Scientists are analysing the samples to find a cure. ||| We need to analyse the market trends before making a decision. ||| The report analyses the impact of climate change on agriculture.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 科学家正在分析样本以寻找治疗方法。 ||| 在做出决定之前，我们需要分析市场趋势。 ||| 该报告分析了气候变化对农业的影响。

ieltsWords.definition: 古代的；古老的
ieltsWords.collocations: ancient civilization 古代文明, ancient history 古代史, ancient ruins 古代遗址
ieltsWords.example: The ancient ruins attract thousands of tourists every year. ||| He studied ancient Greek philosophy at university. ||| The tradition dates back to ancient times.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 古代遗址每年吸引成千上万的游客。 ||| 他在大学学习了古希腊哲学。 ||| 这一传统可以追溯到古代。

ieltsWords.definition: 每年的；年度的
ieltsWords.collocations: annual report 年度报告, annual meeting 年会, annual income 年收入
ieltsWords.example: The company publishes its annual report in March. ||| We hold an annual conference to discuss industry trends. ||| Her annual income has increased significantly this year.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司在三月份发布年度报告。 ||| 我们每年举行一次会议讨论行业趋势。 ||| 她的年收入今年显著增加。

ieltsWords.definition: 预期，预料
ieltsWords.collocations: anticipate problems 预见问题, anticipate demand 预期需求, anticipate changes 预期变化
ieltsWords.example: We anticipate a rise in sales next quarter. ||| The team anticipated the opponent's moves and won the game. ||| It is difficult to anticipate all the consequences of the new policy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们预计下个季度销售额会上升。 ||| 团队预判了对手的动作并赢得了比赛。 ||| 很难预料新政策的所有后果。

ieltsWords.definition: 显然的；表面上的
ieltsWords.collocations: apparent reason 明显原因, become apparent 变得明显, apparent contradiction 明显矛盾
ieltsWords.example: It was apparent that she was upset about the decision. ||| The apparent cause of the accident was driver error. ||| The benefits of the new system are not yet apparent.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 很明显，她对这一决定感到不安。 ||| 事故的表面原因是司机失误。 ||| 新系统的好处尚不明显。

ieltsWords.definition: 呼吁；吸引；上诉
ieltsWords.collocations: appeal to 吸引，appeal for 呼吁，make an appeal 提出上诉
ieltsWords.example: The new policy appeals to young voters. ||| The charity made an appeal for donations. ||| He decided to appeal the court's decision.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新政策吸引了年轻选民。 ||| 慈善机构呼吁捐款。 ||| 他决定对法院的判决提出上诉。

ieltsWords.definition: 申请；应用
ieltsWords.collocations: job application 求职申请，application form 申请表，practical application 实际应用
ieltsWords.example: She submitted her job application online. ||| The application of this technology is widespread. ||| This software application is user-friendly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在网上提交了求职申请。 ||| 这项技术的应用很广泛。 ||| 这个软件应用程序很用户友好。

ieltsWords.definition: 申请；应用
ieltsWords.collocations: apply for 申请，apply to 适用于，apply oneself 专心致志
ieltsWords.example: He applied for a scholarship to study abroad. ||| The rules apply to all employees. ||| You need to apply yourself to your studies.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他申请了出国留学的奖学金。 ||| 这些规则适用于所有员工。 ||| 你需要专心学习。

ieltsWords.definition: 任命；指定
ieltsWords.collocations: appoint as 任命为，appoint to 指派到，appoint a time 约定时间
ieltsWords.example: The board appointed her as the new CEO. ||| He was appointed to the committee. ||| Let's appoint a time for the meeting.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 董事会任命她为新CEO。 ||| 他被指派到委员会。 ||| 我们约定一个会议时间吧。

ieltsWords.definition: 感激；欣赏；升值
ieltsWords.collocations: appreciate the value 重视价值，appreciate your help 感谢帮助，appreciate the difference 理解差异
ieltsWords.example: I really appreciate your assistance. ||| She appreciates classical music. ||| It's important to appreciate cultural differences.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我非常感谢你的帮助。 ||| 她欣赏古典音乐。 ||| 理解文化差异很重要。

ieltsWords.definition: 接近；方法
ieltsWords.collocations: approach to 方法，new approach 新方法，approach a problem 处理问题
ieltsWords.example: We need a new approach to solving this issue. ||| The deadline is approaching quickly. ||| She approached the problem with caution.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要一种新方法来解决这个问题。 ||| 截止日期正在迅速接近。 ||| 她谨慎地处理这个问题。

ieltsWords.definition: 适当的，恰当的
ieltsWords.collocations: appropriate for 适合，appropriate time 合适的时间，appropriate behavior 适当的行为
ieltsWords.example: This dress is appropriate for the occasion. ||| We need to find an appropriate solution. ||| His comments were not appropriate.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这件裙子适合这个场合。 ||| 我们需要找到合适的解决方案。 ||| 他的评论不恰当。

ieltsWords.definition: 批准；赞成
ieltsWords.collocations: approve of 赞成，approve a plan 批准计划，approve a budget 批准预算
ieltsWords.example: The committee approved the proposal. ||| I don't approve of his behavior. ||| The budget was approved by the board.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 委员会批准了提案。 ||| 我不赞成他的行为。 ||| 预算得到了董事会的批准。

ieltsWords.definition: 人工的；虚伪的
ieltsWords.collocations: artificial intelligence 人工智能，artificial light 人造光，artificial flavor 人工香料
ieltsWords.example: Artificial intelligence is transforming industries. ||| The flowers are artificial, not real. ||| The smile seemed artificial.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 人工智能正在改变各行各业。 ||| 这些花是人造的，不是真的。 ||| 那个微笑看起来很假。

ieltsWords.definition: 评估，评价
ieltsWords.collocations: assess the situation 评估情况，assess risk 评估风险，assess performance 评估表现
ieltsWords.example: We need to assess the damage after the storm. ||| Teachers assess students' progress regularly. ||| It's difficult to assess the long-term effects.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要评估暴风雨后的损失。 ||| 老师定期评估学生的进步。 ||| 很难评估长期影响。

ieltsWords.definition: 分配；指定
ieltsWords.collocations: assign to 分配给，assign a task 分配任务，assign homework 布置作业
ieltsWords.example: The teacher assigned a new project to the class. ||| He was assigned to the marketing team. ||| Each student was assigned a different topic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师给班级分配了一个新项目。 ||| 他被指派到市场团队。 ||| 每个学生被分配了不同的主题。

ieltsWords.definition: 帮助，协助
ieltsWords.collocations: assist with 帮助，assist in 协助，assist someone 帮助某人
ieltsWords.example: Can you assist me with this task? ||| The software assists in data analysis. ||| She assisted the elderly woman across the street.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你能帮我完成这个任务吗？ ||| 这个软件辅助数据分析。 ||| 她帮助那位老妇人过马路。

ieltsWords.definition: 联想；联系；同事
ieltsWords.collocations: associate with 与…联系，business associate 商业伙伴，associate degree 副学士学位
ieltsWords.example: I associate this smell with my childhood. ||| He is a close associate of the CEO. ||| We should not associate with dishonest people.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我把这种气味与童年联系起来。 ||| 他是CEO的亲密同事。 ||| 我们不应该与不诚实的人交往。

ieltsWords.definition: 假设；承担
ieltsWords.collocations: assume responsibility 承担责任，assume that 假设，assume a role 担任角色
ieltsWords.example: I assume you have read the instructions. ||| She assumed the role of team leader. ||| He assumed responsibility for the mistake.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我假设你已经阅读了说明。 ||| 她担任了团队领导的角色。 ||| 他承担了错误的责任。

ieltsWords.definition: 大气；氛围
ieltsWords.collocations: atmosphere of 氛围，friendly atmosphere 友好的氛围，atmospheric pressure 大气压力
ieltsWords.example: The restaurant has a cozy atmosphere. ||| The Earth's atmosphere protects us from radiation. ||| A tense atmosphere filled the room.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家餐厅有舒适的氛围。 ||| 地球的大气层保护我们免受辐射。 ||| 房间里充满了紧张的气氛。

ieltsWords.definition: 附上；连接
ieltsWords.collocations: attach to 附属于，attach importance to 重视，attach a file 附上文件
ieltsWords.example: Please attach your resume to the email. ||| He is very attached to his family. ||| We attach great importance to education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请将简历附在邮件中。 ||| 他非常依恋他的家庭。 ||| 我们非常重视教育。

ieltsWords.definition: 尝试，企图
ieltsWords.collocations: attempt to 尝试，make an attempt 尝试，attempt at 企图
ieltsWords.example: She attempted to solve the puzzle. ||| His first attempt was unsuccessful. ||| They made an attempt to climb the mountain.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她尝试解开这个谜题。 ||| 他的第一次尝试没有成功。 ||| 他们尝试攀登那座山。

ieltsWords.definition: 态度；看法
ieltsWords.collocations: attitude towards 对…的态度，positive attitude 积极态度，change attitude 改变态度
ieltsWords.example: She has a positive attitude towards life. ||| His attitude towards work is very professional. ||| We need to change our attitude about failure.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对生活有积极的态度。 ||| 他对工作的态度非常专业。 ||| 我们需要改变对失败的态度。

ieltsWords.definition: 吸引；引起
ieltsWords.collocations: attract attention 吸引注意，attract tourists 吸引游客，attract investment 吸引投资
ieltsWords.example: The bright colors attract children. ||| The city attracts many tourists every year. ||| His speech attracted a lot of attention.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 鲜艳的颜色吸引孩子。 ||| 这个城市每年吸引许多游客。 ||| 他的演讲引起了很多关注。

ieltsWords.definition: 权威；权力；当局
ieltsWords.collocations: authority over 对…的权威，local authority 地方当局，have authority 有权威
ieltsWords.example: The government has the authority to enforce laws. ||| She is an authority on ancient history. ||| You need permission from the local authority.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府有权执行法律。 ||| 她是古代史的权威。 ||| 你需要得到地方当局的许可。

ieltsWords.definition: 可用的；有效的
ieltsWords.collocations: available resources 可用资源, available information 可用信息, readily available 容易获得
ieltsWords.example: The report is now available online for all students. ||| We must make the best use of the available resources. ||| Are there any available seats on the next flight?
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这份报告现在可供所有学生在线查阅。 ||| 我们必须充分利用可用的资源。 ||| 下一班航班还有空位吗？

ieltsWords.definition: 意识到的；知道的
ieltsWords.collocations: become aware of 意识到, fully aware 充分意识到, raise awareness 提高意识
ieltsWords.example: People are becoming more aware of environmental issues. ||| She was fully aware of the risks involved in the project. ||| The campaign aims to raise awareness about mental health.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 人们越来越意识到环境问题。 ||| 她完全意识到项目中涉及的风险。 ||| 该运动旨在提高人们对心理健康的意识。

ieltsWords.definition: 障碍；屏障
ieltsWords.collocations: language barrier 语言障碍, trade barrier 贸易壁垒, barrier to entry 进入壁垒
ieltsWords.example: Language can be a major barrier to communication. ||| The government removed trade barriers to boost the economy. ||| Lack of education is a barrier to social mobility.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 语言可能是沟通的主要障碍。 ||| 政府取消了贸易壁垒以促进经济。 ||| 缺乏教育是社会流动的障碍。

ieltsWords.definition: 行为，举止
ieltsWords.collocations: consumer behaviour 消费者行为, social behaviour 社会行为, behaviour pattern 行为模式
ieltsWords.example: The study focuses on consumer behaviour in online shopping. ||| His behaviour at the meeting was considered inappropriate. ||| Animal behaviour can be influenced by environmental changes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这项研究关注在线购物中的消费者行为。 ||| 他在会议上的行为被认为不合适。 ||| 动物行为可能受到环境变化的影响。

ieltsWords.definition: 利益；好处；受益
ieltsWords.collocations: economic benefit 经济效益, mutual benefit 互利, benefit from 从……受益
ieltsWords.example: Regular exercise has many health benefits. ||| Both parties can benefit from this agreement. ||| The new policy will bring long-term benefits to the community.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 定期锻炼对健康有很多好处。 ||| 双方都可以从这项协议中受益。 ||| 新政策将为社区带来长期利益。

ieltsWords.definition: 预算；编入预算
ieltsWords.collocations: budget deficit 预算赤字, budget plan 预算计划, within budget 在预算内
ieltsWords.example: The project was completed within the allocated budget. ||| We need to budget carefully for the upcoming expenses. ||| The government announced a new budget for education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该项目在分配的预算内完成。 ||| 我们需要为即将到来的开支仔细预算。 ||| 政府宣布了一项新的教育预算。

ieltsWords.definition: 有能力的
ieltsWords.collocations: capable of 能够, highly capable 能力很强, capable person 能干的人
ieltsWords.example: She is a highly capable manager who leads the team effectively. ||| This machine is capable of processing large amounts of data. ||| He is capable of solving complex problems independently.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她是一位能力很强的经理，能有效领导团队。 ||| 这台机器能够处理大量数据。 ||| 他能够独立解决复杂问题。

ieltsWords.definition: 容量；能力
ieltsWords.collocations: production capacity 生产能力, carrying capacity 承载能力, capacity building 能力建设
ieltsWords.example: The stadium has a seating capacity of 50,000. ||| The factory is operating at full capacity to meet demand. ||| The course aims to improve students' analytical capacity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个体育场可容纳5万人。 ||| 工厂正满负荷运转以满足需求。 ||| 该课程旨在提高学生的分析能力。

ieltsWords.definition: 类别，种类
ieltsWords.collocations: age category 年龄类别, product category 产品类别, fall into a category 属于某一类
ieltsWords.example: The books are divided into several categories based on genre. ||| This problem falls into the category of environmental issues. ||| The survey includes questions about income category.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这些书根据体裁分为几类。 ||| 这个问题属于环境问题的范畴。 ||| 调查包括关于收入类别的问题。

ieltsWords.definition: 导致；原因；事业
ieltsWords.collocations: root cause 根本原因, cause and effect 因果, cause concern 引起关注
ieltsWords.example: The cause of the accident is still under investigation. ||| Pollution can cause serious health problems. ||| She devoted her life to the cause of education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 事故的原因仍在调查中。 ||| 污染可能导致严重的健康问题。 ||| 她一生致力于教育事业。

ieltsWords.definition: 挑战；质疑
ieltsWords.collocations: face a challenge 面临挑战, challenge the status quo 挑战现状, major challenge 重大挑战
ieltsWords.example: Climate change is one of the greatest challenges of our time. ||| She decided to challenge herself by learning a new language. ||| The new policy challenges traditional approaches to education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 气候变化是我们时代最大的挑战之一。 ||| 她决定通过学习一门新语言来挑战自己。 ||| 新政策挑战了传统的教育方法。

ieltsWords.definition: 特征；典型的
ieltsWords.collocations: distinctive characteristic 显著特征, characteristic feature 典型特征, share characteristics 共有特征
ieltsWords.example: One characteristic of urban life is the fast pace. ||| The characteristic taste of this dish comes from local spices. ||| The study identified several characteristics of successful entrepreneurs.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 城市生活的一个特点是快节奏。 ||| 这道菜的典型味道来自当地香料。 ||| 该研究确定了成功企业家的几个特征。

ieltsWords.definition: 情况；环境
ieltsWords.collocations: under no circumstances 决不, in certain circumstances 在某些情况下, financial circumstances 财务状况
ieltsWords.example: Under no circumstances should you reveal your password. ||| The decision was made based on the unique circumstances of the case. ||| His family's financial circumstances forced him to work part-time.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在任何情况下你都不应该透露密码。 ||| 这个决定是基于案件的独特情况做出的。 ||| 他的家庭财务状况迫使他做兼职。

ieltsWords.definition: 声称；要求；索赔
ieltsWords.collocations: claim responsibility 声称负责, claim compensation 索赔, make a claim 提出主张
ieltsWords.example: The company claimed that their product was environmentally friendly. ||| She filed a claim for damages after the accident. ||| The scientist's claim was supported by strong evidence.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司声称他们的产品是环保的。 ||| 事故发生后她提出了损害赔偿要求。 ||| 这位科学家的主张得到了有力证据的支持。

ieltsWords.definition: 气候；风气
ieltsWords.collocations: climate change 气候变化, economic climate 经济气候, political climate 政治气候
ieltsWords.example: Climate change is a global issue that requires immediate action. ||| The current economic climate is challenging for small businesses. ||| A positive school climate can enhance student learning.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 气候变化是一个需要立即采取行动的全球性问题。 ||| 当前的经济气候对小企业来说充满挑战。 ||| 积极的学校氛围可以促进学生学习。

ieltsWords.definition: 倒塌；崩溃
ieltsWords.collocations: building collapse 建筑倒塌, economic collapse 经济崩溃, mental collapse 精神崩溃
ieltsWords.example: The bridge collapsed due to structural failure. ||| The company's financial collapse led to massive job losses. ||| He suffered a mental collapse after years of stress.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座桥因结构故障而倒塌。 ||| 公司的财务崩溃导致了大量失业。 ||| 经过多年的压力，他精神崩溃了。

ieltsWords.definition: 结合；联合
ieltsWords.collocations: combine with 与……结合, combine efforts 共同努力, combine theory and practice 理论与实践结合
ieltsWords.example: The two companies combined to form a larger corporation. ||| This course combines theory with practical experience. ||| We need to combine our efforts to solve this problem.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两家公司合并形成了一个更大的企业。 ||| 这门课程将理论与实践相结合。 ||| 我们需要共同努力来解决这个问题。

ieltsWords.definition: 交流；传达
ieltsWords.collocations: communicate effectively 有效沟通, communicate with 与……交流, communicate ideas 传达想法
ieltsWords.example: It is important to communicate clearly in a team. ||| She communicated her concerns to the manager. ||| Animals communicate through sounds and body language.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在团队中清晰沟通很重要。 ||| 她向经理表达了自己的担忧。 ||| 动物通过声音和肢体语言交流。

ieltsWords.definition: 社区；团体
ieltsWords.collocations: local community 当地社区, community service 社区服务, international community 国际社会
ieltsWords.example: The local community organized a charity event. ||| Community service is a requirement for graduation. ||| The international community must work together to address global issues.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 当地社区组织了一场慈善活动。 ||| 社区服务是毕业的要求之一。 ||| 国际社会必须共同努力解决全球性问题。

ieltsWords.definition: 比较；对比
ieltsWords.collocations: compare with 与……比较, compare to 比作, compare and contrast 比较和对比
ieltsWords.example: The study compares the education systems of different countries. ||| Life is often compared to a journey. ||| When you compare the two products, the difference is clear.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这项研究比较了不同国家的教育体系。 ||| 人生常被比作一段旅程。 ||| 当你比较这两种产品时，差异很明显。

ieltsWords.definition: 补偿；赔偿
ieltsWords.collocations: compensate for 补偿..., compensate sb for sth 因...赔偿某人, compensate with 以...补偿
ieltsWords.example: The company must compensate workers for their injuries. ||| Hard work can compensate for a lack of talent. ||| The government compensated farmers for the loss of their crops.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司必须赔偿工人的工伤。 ||| 勤奋可以弥补天赋的不足。 ||| 政府补偿了农民的作物损失。

ieltsWords.definition: 竞争；比赛
ieltsWords.collocations: compete with 与...竞争, compete for 争夺..., compete in 参加...比赛
ieltsWords.example: Small businesses often struggle to compete with large corporations. ||| Many athletes compete for a gold medal in the Olympics. ||| Students compete in various academic contests.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 小企业常常难以与大公司竞争。 ||| 许多运动员在奥运会上争夺金牌。 ||| 学生们参加各种学术竞赛。

ieltsWords.definition: 复杂的；综合体
ieltsWords.collocations: complex system 复杂系统, complex problem 复杂问题, complex structure 复杂结构
ieltsWords.example: The human brain is an incredibly complex organ. ||| Solving this complex equation requires advanced math skills. ||| The company has a complex organizational structure.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 人类大脑是一个极其复杂的器官。 ||| 解这个复杂方程需要高级数学技能。 ||| 这家公司有复杂的组织结构。

ieltsWords.definition: 组成部分；成分
ieltsWords.collocations: key component 关键组成部分, essential component 必要成分, electronic component 电子元件
ieltsWords.example: Trust is a key component of any successful relationship. ||| The engine consists of many different components. ||| Each component of the system must be tested individually.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 信任是任何成功关系的关键组成部分。 ||| 发动机由许多不同的部件组成。 ||| 系统的每个组件都必须单独测试。

ieltsWords.definition: 全面的；综合的
ieltsWords.collocations: comprehensive review 全面审查, comprehensive plan 综合计划, comprehensive education 全面教育
ieltsWords.example: The report provides a comprehensive analysis of the market. ||| A comprehensive health check-up is recommended annually. ||| The university offers a comprehensive range of courses.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该报告对市场进行了全面分析。 ||| 建议每年进行一次全面的健康检查。 ||| 这所大学提供广泛的课程。

ieltsWords.definition: 集中；专注
ieltsWords.collocations: concentrate on 专注于..., concentrate effort 集中精力, concentrate attention 集中注意力
ieltsWords.example: I need to concentrate on my studies for the exam. ||| The government should concentrate its efforts on reducing poverty. ||| The orange juice is concentrated to save shipping costs.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我需要集中精力准备考试。 ||| 政府应集中精力减少贫困。 ||| 橙汁被浓缩以节省运输成本。

ieltsWords.definition: 概念；观念
ieltsWords.collocations: basic concept 基本概念, key concept 关键概念, marketing concept 营销理念
ieltsWords.example: The concept of democracy originated in ancient Greece. ||| Students must understand the basic concepts of physics. ||| The new marketing concept boosted sales significantly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 民主的概念起源于古希腊。 ||| 学生必须理解物理的基本概念。 ||| 新的营销理念显著提升了销售额。

ieltsWords.definition: 关心；担忧；涉及
ieltsWords.collocations: concern about 对...的担忧, concern with 与...有关, express concern 表达关切
ieltsWords.example: There is growing concern about climate change. ||| This matter concerns the safety of all employees. ||| The government expressed concern over the rising unemployment rate.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 人们对气候变化的担忧日益增加。 ||| 这件事关系到所有员工的安全。 ||| 政府对失业率上升表示关切。

ieltsWords.definition: 总结；得出结论
ieltsWords.collocations: conclude that 得出结论..., conclude with 以...结束, conclude an agreement 缔结协议
ieltsWords.example: The study concluded that exercise improves mental health. ||| The meeting concluded with a vote on the proposal. ||| The two countries concluded a trade agreement.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 研究得出结论，锻炼能改善心理健康。 ||| 会议以对该提案的投票结束。 ||| 两国缔结了一项贸易协定。

ieltsWords.definition: 实施；行为；指挥
ieltsWords.collocations: conduct research 进行研究, conduct an experiment 进行实验, code of conduct 行为准则
ieltsWords.example: Scientists conduct experiments to test their hypotheses. ||| The company has a strict code of conduct for employees. ||| He conducted himself with dignity during the crisis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 科学家进行实验来检验假设。 ||| 公司有严格的员工行为准则。 ||| 他在危机中表现得很有尊严。

ieltsWords.definition: 会议；讨论会
ieltsWords.collocations: press conference 记者招待会, attend a conference 参加会议, international conference 国际会议
ieltsWords.example: The professor is attending a conference on climate change. ||| The company held a press conference to announce the new product. ||| The conference will bring together experts from around the world.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 教授正在参加一个关于气候变化的会议。 ||| 公司召开记者招待会宣布新产品。 ||| 这次会议将汇集来自世界各地的专家。

ieltsWords.definition: 自信的；确信的
ieltsWords.collocations: confident in 对...有信心, confident about 对...有信心, feel confident 感到自信
ieltsWords.example: She is confident in her ability to succeed. ||| The team is confident about winning the championship. ||| He spoke in a confident tone during the presentation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对自己成功的能力充满信心。 ||| 球队对赢得冠军充满信心。 ||| 他在演讲中语气自信。

ieltsWords.definition: 确认；证实
ieltsWords.collocations: confirm that 确认..., confirm a booking 确认预订, confirm a theory 证实理论
ieltsWords.example: Please confirm your attendance by email. ||| The test results confirmed the doctor's diagnosis. ||| The committee confirmed his appointment as director.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请通过电子邮件确认您的出席。 ||| 测试结果证实了医生的诊断。 ||| 委员会批准了他担任主任的任命。

ieltsWords.definition: 冲突；矛盾
ieltsWords.collocations: conflict of interest 利益冲突, armed conflict 武装冲突, resolve a conflict 解决冲突
ieltsWords.example: There is a conflict between work and family responsibilities. ||| The two countries have been in armed conflict for years. ||| Mediation can help resolve conflicts in the workplace.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 工作和家庭责任之间存在冲突。 ||| 两国多年来一直处于武装冲突中。 ||| 调解有助于解决工作场所的冲突。

ieltsWords.definition: 结果；后果
ieltsWords.collocations: as a consequence 因此, negative consequence 负面后果, face the consequences 承担后果
ieltsWords.example: As a consequence of the storm, many flights were cancelled. ||| Every action has a consequence, good or bad. ||| He must face the consequences of his reckless behavior.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于暴风雨，许多航班被取消。 ||| 每个行为都有后果，无论好坏。 ||| 他必须为自己的鲁莽行为承担后果。

ieltsWords.definition: 保存；节约；保护
ieltsWords.collocations: conserve energy 节约能源, conserve resources 保护资源, conserve wildlife 保护野生动物
ieltsWords.example: We should conserve water during the drought. ||| The organization works to conserve endangered species. ||| Turning off lights helps conserve electricity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 干旱期间我们应该节约用水。 ||| 该组织致力于保护濒危物种。 ||| 关灯有助于节约电力。

ieltsWords.definition: 考虑；认为
ieltsWords.collocations: consider doing 考虑做..., consider as 视为..., take into consideration 考虑到
ieltsWords.example: You should consider studying abroad for a year. ||| She is considered an expert in her field. ||| We must consider the needs of all stakeholders.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你应该考虑出国留学一年。 ||| 她被认为是她所在领域的专家。 ||| 我们必须考虑所有利益相关者的需求。

ieltsWords.definition: 一致的；始终如一的
ieltsWords.collocations: consistent with 与...一致, consistent performance 稳定的表现, consistent policy 一贯的政策
ieltsWords.example: His actions are not consistent with his words. ||| The team has shown consistent performance throughout the season. ||| The government needs a consistent policy on education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他的言行不一致。 ||| 球队在整个赛季中表现稳定。 ||| 政府需要一项连贯的教育政策。

ieltsWords.definition: 不断的；持续的
ieltsWords.collocations: constant change 不断变化, constant pressure 持续压力, constant temperature 恒温
ieltsWords.example: The city is in a state of constant change. ||| He works under constant pressure to meet deadlines. ||| The laboratory maintains a constant temperature for experiments.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座城市处于不断变化之中。 ||| 他在持续的压力下工作以赶上截止日期。 ||| 实验室保持恒温以进行实验。

ieltsWords.definition: 构成；组成
ieltsWords.collocations: constitute a threat 构成威胁, constitute a part 构成一部分, constitute an offense 构成犯罪
ieltsWords.example: Women constitute a large proportion of the workforce. ||| This behavior constitutes a serious breach of trust. ||| The twelve months constitute a year.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 女性构成了劳动力的一大部分。 ||| 这种行为构成了严重的失信。 ||| 十二个月构成一年。

ieltsWords.definition: 消费；消耗
ieltsWords.collocations: consume energy 消耗能源, consume resources 消耗资源, consume food 消费食物
ieltsWords.example: Households consume a significant amount of electricity each month. ||| It is important to consume a balanced diet for good health. ||| The fire quickly consumed the entire building.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 家庭每月消耗大量电力。 ||| 摄入均衡饮食对健康很重要。 ||| 大火迅速吞噬了整栋建筑。

ieltsWords.definition: 接触；联系
ieltsWords.collocations: make contact 取得联系, contact information 联系方式, physical contact 身体接触
ieltsWords.example: Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any questions. ||| The two companies established contact through a trade fair. ||| Avoid direct contact with the chemical to prevent injury.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 如有任何问题，请随时联系我。 ||| 这两家公司通过贸易博览会建立了联系。 ||| 避免直接接触该化学品以防受伤。

ieltsWords.definition: 当代的；同时代的
ieltsWords.collocations: contemporary art 当代艺术, contemporary society 当代社会, contemporary issues 当代问题
ieltsWords.example: Contemporary architecture often emphasizes sustainability and minimalism. ||| Shakespeare was a contemporary of Queen Elizabeth I. ||| The museum displays both classical and contemporary works.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 当代建筑通常强调可持续性和极简主义。 ||| 莎士比亚是伊丽莎白一世的同时代人。 ||| 博物馆展出古典和当代作品。

ieltsWords.definition: 贡献；捐助；导致
ieltsWords.collocations: contribute to 有助于，促成, contribute money 捐款, contribute ideas 贡献想法
ieltsWords.example: Regular exercise contributes to better physical and mental health. ||| Many volunteers contributed their time to the community project. ||| She contributes articles to a popular science magazine.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 定期锻炼有助于改善身心健康。 ||| 许多志愿者为社区项目贡献了时间。 ||| 她为一家流行科学杂志撰稿。

ieltsWords.definition: 争议；争论
ieltsWords.collocations: cause controversy 引起争议, heated controversy 激烈的争论, political controversy 政治争议
ieltsWords.example: The new policy sparked a heated controversy among citizens. ||| There is ongoing controversy over the use of genetically modified crops. ||| The artist's work often generates controversy due to its provocative nature.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新政策在公民中引发了激烈的争论。 ||| 关于转基因作物的使用存在持续的争议。 ||| 这位艺术家的作品因其挑衅性常常引发争议。

ieltsWords.definition: 方便的；便利的
ieltsWords.collocations: convenient location 便利的位置, convenient transportation 便利的交通, convenient for 对…方便
ieltsWords.example: Online shopping is convenient because you can buy things from home. ||| The hotel is in a convenient location near the city center. ||| Is it convenient for you to meet tomorrow afternoon?
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 网上购物很方便，因为你可以在家购物。 ||| 酒店位于市中心附近，位置便利。 ||| 你明天下午见面方便吗？

ieltsWords.definition: 惯例；常规；大会
ieltsWords.collocations: social convention 社会习俗, international convention 国际公约, annual convention 年会
ieltsWords.example: It is a social convention to shake hands when meeting someone. ||| The United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child is widely recognized. ||| Thousands of people attended the annual science fiction convention.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 见面握手是一种社会习俗。 ||| 联合国儿童权利公约得到广泛认可。 ||| 数千人参加了年度科幻大会。

ieltsWords.definition: 说服；使确信
ieltsWords.collocations: convince sb of sth 使某人相信某事, convince sb to do sth 说服某人做某事, be convinced that 确信
ieltsWords.example: She convinced her parents to let her study abroad. ||| The evidence convinced the jury of his innocence. ||| I am convinced that hard work leads to success.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她说服父母让她出国留学。 ||| 证据使陪审团相信他是清白的。 ||| 我深信努力工作会带来成功。

ieltsWords.definition: 合作，协作
ieltsWords.collocations: cooperate with 与…合作, cooperate closely 紧密合作, cooperate on a project 合作项目
ieltsWords.example: The two countries agreed to cooperate on environmental issues. ||| Team members must cooperate to achieve the common goal. ||| The police asked the public to cooperate with the investigation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 两国同意在环境问题上合作。 ||| 团队成员必须合作以实现共同目标。 ||| 警方要求公众配合调查。

ieltsWords.definition: 协调；调整；坐标
ieltsWords.collocations: coordinate efforts 协调努力, coordinate activities 协调活动, coordinate with 与…协调
ieltsWords.example: The manager coordinates the work of different departments. ||| We need to coordinate our schedules to find a suitable meeting time. ||| The GPS provides the exact coordinates of the location.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 经理协调不同部门的工作。 ||| 我们需要协调日程以找到合适的会议时间。 ||| GPS提供了该地点的精确坐标。

ieltsWords.definition: 公司的；法人的
ieltsWords.collocations: corporate culture 企业文化, corporate strategy 企业战略, corporate governance 公司治理
ieltsWords.example: A strong corporate culture can improve employee satisfaction. ||| The company revised its corporate strategy to focus on innovation. ||| Corporate social responsibility is increasingly important for businesses.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 强大的企业文化可以提高员工满意度。 ||| 公司修订了企业战略，专注于创新。 ||| 企业社会责任对企业越来越重要。

ieltsWords.definition: 对应；通信
ieltsWords.collocations: correspond to 与…对应, correspond with 与…通信, correspond exactly 完全相符
ieltsWords.example: The numbers on the map correspond to the buildings in the city. ||| His actions do not correspond with his words. ||| We have corresponded by email for several years.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 地图上的数字与城市中的建筑相对应。 ||| 他的言行不一致。 ||| 我们通过电子邮件通信已有几年了。

ieltsWords.definition: 关键的；决定性的
ieltsWords.collocations: crucial role 关键作用, crucial factor 关键因素, crucial moment 关键时刻
ieltsWords.example: Education plays a crucial role in personal development. ||| Timely decision-making is crucial for business success. ||| This is a crucial moment in the negotiation process.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 教育在个人发展中起着关键作用。 ||| 及时决策对商业成功至关重要。 ||| 这是谈判过程中的关键时刻。

ieltsWords.definition: 培养；耕作；陶冶
ieltsWords.collocations: cultivate skills 培养技能, cultivate relationships 培养关系, cultivate land 耕种土地
ieltsWords.example: Students should cultivate good study habits from an early age. ||| The farmer cultivates wheat on his land. ||| Reading books can cultivate the mind.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生应该从小培养良好的学习习惯。 ||| 农民在他的土地上种植小麦。 ||| 读书可以陶冶情操。

ieltsWords.definition: 课程
ieltsWords.collocations: school curriculum 学校课程, curriculum vitae 简历, core curriculum 核心课程
ieltsWords.example: The school curriculum includes both academic and extracurricular activities. ||| The university updated its curriculum to meet industry demands. ||| Please attach your curriculum vitae to the application form.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学校课程包括学术和课外活动。 ||| 大学更新了课程以满足行业需求。 ||| 请将简历附在申请表后。

ieltsWords.definition: 数据库
ieltsWords.collocations: database management 数据库管理, database system 数据库系统, online database 在线数据库
ieltsWords.example: The company stores customer information in a secure database. ||| Researchers can access the database to find relevant studies. ||| Database management is a key skill for IT professionals.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司将客户信息存储在安全的数据库中。 ||| 研究人员可以访问数据库查找相关研究。 ||| 数据库管理是IT专业人员的关键技能。

ieltsWords.definition: 辩论；讨论
ieltsWords.collocations: heated debate 激烈的辩论, public debate 公开辩论, debate over 关于…的辩论
ieltsWords.example: There is a heated debate over the new tax policy. ||| The students debated the pros and cons of social media. ||| The issue is still under debate among experts.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 关于新税收政策存在激烈的辩论。 ||| 学生们就社交媒体的利弊进行了辩论。 ||| 这个问题仍在专家中争论。

ieltsWords.definition: 十年
ieltsWords.collocations: over the past decade 过去十年, for decades 几十年, the next decade 未来十年
ieltsWords.example: Over the past decade, technology has advanced rapidly. ||| The company has been in business for decades. ||| We need to plan for the challenges of the next decade.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 过去十年，技术飞速发展。 ||| 这家公司已经经营了几十年。 ||| 我们需要为未来十年的挑战做规划。

ieltsWords.definition: 下降；衰退；拒绝
ieltsWords.collocations: decline in 在…方面下降, economic decline 经济衰退, decline an offer 拒绝提议
ieltsWords.example: The population of the village has declined significantly. ||| She declined the invitation due to prior commitments. ||| The company is experiencing a decline in sales.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个村庄的人口显著下降。 ||| 她因已有安排而拒绝了邀请。 ||| 该公司正经历销售下滑。

ieltsWords.definition: 定义；界定
ieltsWords.collocations: define as 定义为, clearly define 明确定义, define the scope 界定范围
ieltsWords.example: Success can be defined in many different ways. ||| The contract clearly defines the responsibilities of each party. ||| We need to define the scope of the project before starting.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 成功可以用许多不同的方式来定义。 ||| 合同明确界定了各方的责任。 ||| 我们需要在开始前界定项目范围。

ieltsWords.definition: 明确的；肯定的
ieltsWords.collocations: definite answer 明确的答案, definite plan 确定的计划, definite improvement 明显的改善
ieltsWords.example: There is a definite link between smoking and lung cancer. ||| We need a definite answer by tomorrow. ||| The weather has shown a definite improvement this week.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 吸烟和肺癌之间有明确的联系。 ||| 我们明天之前需要明确的答复。 ||| 这周天气有了明显的改善。

ieltsWords.definition: 证明；演示；示范
ieltsWords.collocations: demonstrate a theory 证明理论, demonstrate a product 演示产品, demonstrate against 抗议示威
ieltsWords.example: The experiment demonstrates that the theory is correct. ||| The salesperson demonstrated how the new machine works. ||| Thousands of people demonstrated against the new law.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 实验证明了该理论是正确的。 ||| 销售人员演示了新机器如何工作。 ||| 数千人示威反对新法律。

ieltsWords.definition: 描绘；描述
ieltsWords.collocations: depict a scene 描绘场景, depict a character 刻画人物, depict accurately 准确描述
ieltsWords.example: The painting depicts a beautiful landscape. ||| The novel depicts the life of a young artist. ||| The statistics depict a worrying trend.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这幅画描绘了美丽的风景。 ||| 这部小说描述了一位年轻艺术家的生活。 ||| 这些数据描述了一个令人担忧的趋势。

ieltsWords.definition: 存放；存款；押金
ieltsWords.collocations: deposit money 存钱, deposit a check 存入支票, make a deposit 付押金, bank deposit 银行存款
ieltsWords.example: I need to deposit this check into my account. ||| The landlord asked for a deposit of one month's rent. ||| Sediment deposits at the mouth of the river.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我需要把这张支票存入我的账户。 ||| 房东要求一个月的租金作为押金。 ||| 沉积物在河口沉积。

ieltsWords.definition: 源自；获得
ieltsWords.collocations: derive from 来源于, derive benefit 获得利益, derive pleasure 获得乐趣
ieltsWords.example: Many English words derive from Latin. ||| She derives great satisfaction from her work. ||| We can derive the formula from basic principles.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多英语单词源于拉丁语。 ||| 她从工作中获得极大的满足感。 ||| 我们可以从基本原理推导出这个公式。

ieltsWords.definition: 值得；应得
ieltsWords.collocations: deserve attention 值得关注, deserve respect 值得尊重, deserve a chance 值得给一个机会
ieltsWords.example: He deserves a promotion for his hard work. ||| This issue deserves serious consideration. ||| She deserves to be happy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他工作努力，值得升职。 ||| 这个问题值得认真考虑。 ||| 她应该得到幸福。

ieltsWords.definition: 决定；确定
ieltsWords.collocations: determine the cause 确定原因, determine a policy 决定政策, determine the outcome 决定结果
ieltsWords.example: The test will determine your level of English. ||| We need to determine the exact cost of the project. ||| Your attitude determines your success.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这次测试将决定你的英语水平。 ||| 我们需要确定项目的确切成本。 ||| 你的态度决定你的成功。

ieltsWords.definition: 发展；开发；培养
ieltsWords.collocations: develop a skill 培养技能, develop a country 发展国家, develop a disease 患病, develop a product 开发产品
ieltsWords.example: The company is developing a new software. ||| She developed an interest in art at a young age. ||| He developed a cough after the trip.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家公司正在开发一款新软件。 ||| 她从小就对艺术产生了兴趣。 ||| 旅行后他咳嗽了。

ieltsWords.definition: 设备；装置
ieltsWords.collocations: electronic device 电子设备, medical device 医疗设备, literary device 文学手法
ieltsWords.example: This device can measure your heart rate. ||| The bomb was attached to a timing device. ||| Metaphor is a common literary device.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个设备可以测量你的心率。 ||| 炸弹连接了一个定时装置。 ||| 隐喻是一种常见的文学手法。

ieltsWords.definition: 致力于；奉献
ieltsWords.collocations: devote time to 投入时间于, devote oneself to 致力于, devote resources to 把资源用于
ieltsWords.example: She devotes all her free time to volunteering. ||| He devoted himself to scientific research. ||| The government should devote more funds to education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她把所有空闲时间都用于志愿服务。 ||| 他致力于科学研究。 ||| 政府应该把更多资金用于教育。

ieltsWords.definition: 维度；方面；尺寸
ieltsWords.collocations: three dimensions 三维, new dimension 新维度, political dimension 政治方面
ieltsWords.example: Time is often considered the fourth dimension. ||| We need to consider the economic dimension of the problem. ||| The dimensions of the room are 5 by 4 meters.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 时间通常被认为是第四维度。 ||| 我们需要考虑问题的经济方面。 ||| 房间的尺寸是5米乘4米。

ieltsWords.definition: 减少；减弱
ieltsWords.collocations: diminish in value 贬值, diminish the risk 降低风险, diminish someone's reputation 贬低某人的声誉
ieltsWords.example: The pain will diminish over time. ||| His influence has diminished in recent years. ||| Don't diminish her achievements by comparing them to others.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 疼痛会随着时间减轻。 ||| 近年来他的影响力减弱了。 ||| 不要通过与他人比较来贬低她的成就。

ieltsWords.definition: 纪律；学科；训练
ieltsWords.collocations: maintain discipline 维持纪律, academic discipline 学科, discipline yourself 自律, strict discipline 严格的纪律
ieltsWords.example: The teacher struggled to maintain discipline in the classroom. ||| Psychology is a fascinating discipline. ||| You need to discipline yourself to study regularly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师很难维持课堂纪律。 ||| 心理学是一门迷人的学科。 ||| 你需要自律，定期学习。

ieltsWords.definition: 发现；发觉
ieltsWords.collocations: discover a new species 发现新物种, discover the truth 发现真相, discover a talent 发现才能
ieltsWords.example: Scientists have discovered a new planet. ||| She discovered that her phone was missing. ||| He discovered his passion for music at a young age.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 科学家发现了一颗新行星。 ||| 她发现手机不见了。 ||| 他年轻时发现了对音乐的热爱。

ieltsWords.definition: 歧视；辨别
ieltsWords.collocations: racial discrimination 种族歧视, gender discrimination 性别歧视, price discrimination 价格歧视
ieltsWords.example: Laws prohibit discrimination based on race or gender. ||| He showed great discrimination in choosing the right wine. ||| Price discrimination is common in the airline industry.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 法律禁止基于种族或性别的歧视。 ||| 他在选择合适葡萄酒时表现出很好的辨别力。 ||| 价格歧视在航空业很常见。

ieltsWords.definition: 展示；陈列；显示
ieltsWords.collocations: display an item 展示物品, display emotions 表达情感, on display 展出, display screen 显示屏
ieltsWords.example: The museum displays a collection of ancient artifacts. ||| He displayed great courage during the crisis. ||| The new smartphone has a stunning display.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 博物馆展示了一批古代文物。 ||| 他在危机中表现出极大的勇气。 ||| 这款新智能手机有一个惊艳的显示屏。

ieltsWords.definition: 不同的；明显的
ieltsWords.collocations: distinct difference 明显区别, distinct advantage 明显优势, distinct possibility 明显的可能性
ieltsWords.example: There is a distinct difference between the two proposals. ||| She has a distinct accent from the north. ||| It is a distinct possibility that it will rain tomorrow.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两个提议有明显的区别。 ||| 她有明显的北方口音。 ||| 明天很可能会下雨。

ieltsWords.definition: 区分；辨别
ieltsWords.collocations: distinguish between 区分, distinguish from 区别于, distinguish oneself 使自己脱颖而出
ieltsWords.example: It is hard to distinguish between the two twins. ||| He distinguished himself as a great leader. ||| Can you distinguish the original from the copy?
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 很难区分这对双胞胎。 ||| 他作为一名伟大的领袖而脱颖而出。 ||| 你能区分原件和复印件吗？

ieltsWords.definition: 分配；分发
ieltsWords.collocations: distribute resources 分配资源, distribute leaflets 分发传单, distribute evenly 均匀分布
ieltsWords.example: The charity distributed food to the homeless. ||| The company distributes its products worldwide. ||| The population is distributed unevenly across the country.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 慈善机构向无家可归者分发食物。 ||| 这家公司向全球分销其产品。 ||| 人口在全国分布不均。

ieltsWords.definition: 多样的；不同的
ieltsWords.collocations: diverse cultures 多元文化, diverse backgrounds 不同背景, diverse range 广泛的范围
ieltsWords.example: The city has a diverse population. ||| We need diverse opinions to make a good decision. ||| The company offers a diverse range of products.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个城市有多元化的人口。 ||| 我们需要不同的意见来做出好的决定。 ||| 这家公司提供多样化的产品。

ieltsWords.definition: 国内的；家庭的
ieltsWords.collocations: domestic market 国内市场, domestic violence 家庭暴力, domestic flight 国内航班
ieltsWords.example: The company focuses on expanding its domestic market. ||| Domestic violence is a serious social issue. ||| She prefers domestic flights for short trips.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司专注于扩大其国内市场。 ||| 家庭暴力是一个严重的社会问题。 ||| 短途旅行她更喜欢国内航班。

ieltsWords.definition: 占主导地位的
ieltsWords.collocations: dominant role 主导角色, dominant species 优势物种, dominant position 主导地位
ieltsWords.example: The dominant theme of the conference was climate change. ||| In many ecosystems, a few species are dominant. ||| He played a dominant role in the negotiations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 会议的主导主题是气候变化。 ||| 在许多生态系统中，少数物种占主导地位。 ||| 他在谈判中发挥了主导作用。

ieltsWords.definition: 主导；支配
ieltsWords.collocations: dominate the market 主导市场, dominate the conversation 主导对话, dominate the game 主宰比赛
ieltsWords.example: The tech giant continues to dominate the global market. ||| She tends to dominate the conversation in meetings. ||| The team dominated the game from start to finish.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家科技巨头继续主导全球市场。 ||| 她在会议中往往主导对话。 ||| 这支球队从头到尾主宰了比赛。

ieltsWords.definition: 持续时间；期间
ieltsWords.collocations: short duration 短期, long duration 长期, duration of stay 停留时间
ieltsWords.example: The course has a duration of six months. ||| The duration of the flight is about three hours. ||| The contract is for the duration of the project.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这门课程为期六个月。 ||| 飞行时间大约三个小时。 ||| 合同在项目期间有效。

ieltsWords.definition: 动态的；有活力的
ieltsWords.collocations: dynamic economy 动态经济, dynamic system 动态系统, dynamic personality 充满活力的个性
ieltsWords.example: The city has a dynamic and growing economy. ||| The team dynamic changed after the new manager arrived. ||| She is known for her dynamic leadership style.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座城市拥有充满活力和不断增长的经济。 ||| 新经理到来后，团队动态发生了变化。 ||| 她以充满活力的领导风格而闻名。

ieltsWords.definition: 经济；节省
ieltsWords.collocations: market economy 市场经济, global economy 全球经济, fuel economy 燃油经济性
ieltsWords.example: The government is taking steps to boost the economy. ||| The country has a strong export-oriented economy. ||| Driving at a steady speed improves fuel economy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府正在采取措施刺激经济。 ||| 该国拥有强大的出口导向型经济。 ||| 以稳定速度行驶可提高燃油经济性。

ieltsWords.definition: 消除；淘汰
ieltsWords.collocations: eliminate poverty 消除贫困, eliminate waste 消除浪费, eliminate the risk 消除风险
ieltsWords.example: The new policy aims to eliminate poverty in rural areas. ||| We need to eliminate unnecessary steps in the process. ||| The team was eliminated in the first round of the competition.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新政策旨在消除农村地区的贫困。 ||| 我们需要消除流程中不必要的步骤。 ||| 该队在比赛第一轮就被淘汰了。

ieltsWords.definition: 出现；浮现
ieltsWords.collocations: emerge from 从…中出现, emerge as 作为…出现, new technologies emerge 新技术出现
ieltsWords.example: New challenges emerge as the company grows. ||| The sun emerged from behind the clouds. ||| He emerged as a leader during the crisis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 随着公司的发展，新的挑战出现了。 ||| 太阳从云层后面露出来了。 ||| 他在危机中脱颖而出成为领导者。

ieltsWords.definition: 重点；强调
ieltsWords.collocations: place emphasis on 强调, strong emphasis 重点强调, shift emphasis 转移重点
ieltsWords.example: The school places great emphasis on academic achievement. ||| There is a growing emphasis on environmental protection. ||| The emphasis of the report is on economic growth.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学校非常重视学业成绩。 ||| 人们越来越重视环境保护。 ||| 报告的重点是经济增长。

ieltsWords.definition: 雇用；使用
ieltsWords.collocations: employ workers 雇用工人, employ a method 使用一种方法, employ technology 运用技术
ieltsWords.example: The company employs over 500 people. ||| We need to employ a more efficient approach. ||| The study employed a variety of research methods.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司雇用了500多名员工。 ||| 我们需要采用更有效的方法。 ||| 这项研究使用了多种研究方法。

ieltsWords.definition: 使能够
ieltsWords.collocations: enable sb to do 使某人能够做, enable access 使能够访问, enable growth 促进增长
ieltsWords.example: Technology enables us to communicate instantly. ||| The scholarship enabled her to attend university. ||| This software enables users to edit photos easily.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 技术使我们能够即时沟通。 ||| 奖学金使她能够上大学。 ||| 这个软件使用户能够轻松编辑照片。

ieltsWords.definition: 遭遇；遇到
ieltsWords.collocations: encounter problems 遇到问题, encounter difficulties 遇到困难, encounter resistance 遇到阻力
ieltsWords.example: We encountered several problems during the project. ||| She encountered an old friend at the conference. ||| The proposal encountered strong opposition.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们在项目过程中遇到了几个问题。 ||| 她在会议上遇到了一位老朋友。 ||| 该提议遭到了强烈反对。

ieltsWords.definition: 鼓励；促进
ieltsWords.collocations: encourage sb to do 鼓励某人做, encourage innovation 鼓励创新, encourage participation 鼓励参与
ieltsWords.example: Teachers should encourage students to ask questions. ||| The government encourages the use of renewable energy. ||| Positive feedback encourages further effort.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师应该鼓励学生提问。 ||| 政府鼓励使用可再生能源。 ||| 积极的反馈鼓励进一步的努力。

ieltsWords.definition: 参与；从事；吸引
ieltsWords.collocations: engage in 从事于, engage with 与…互动, engage attention 吸引注意力
ieltsWords.example: The speaker engaged the audience with her story. ||| Students are encouraged to engage in extracurricular activities. ||| The company engages with local communities.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 演讲者用她的故事吸引了观众。 ||| 鼓励学生参加课外活动。 ||| 该公司与当地社区互动。

ieltsWords.definition: 提高；增强
ieltsWords.collocations: enhance performance 提高性能, enhance quality 提高质量, enhance understanding 增进理解
ieltsWords.example: Regular exercise can enhance your overall health. ||| The new software enhances the user experience. ||| Reading widely enhances your vocabulary.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 定期锻炼可以增强你的整体健康。 ||| 新软件改善了用户体验。 ||| 广泛阅读可以扩大词汇量。

ieltsWords.definition: 巨大的；庞大的
ieltsWords.collocations: enormous amount 大量, enormous pressure 巨大压力, enormous potential 巨大潜力
ieltsWords.example: The project requires an enormous amount of money. ||| He felt enormous pressure to succeed. ||| The region has enormous potential for tourism.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该项目需要巨额资金。 ||| 他感到成功的巨大压力。 ||| 该地区具有巨大的旅游潜力。

ieltsWords.definition: 确保；保证
ieltsWords.collocations: ensure safety 确保安全, ensure quality 保证质量, ensure success 确保成功
ieltsWords.example: Please ensure that all doors are locked before leaving. ||| The company ensures the quality of its products. ||| Proper planning ensures the success of the event.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 离开前请确保所有门都锁好。 ||| 公司保证其产品的质量。 ||| 适当的规划确保活动的成功。

ieltsWords.definition: 企业；事业
ieltsWords.collocations: small enterprise 小型企业, state-owned enterprise 国有企业, business enterprise 工商企业
ieltsWords.example: Small enterprises are the backbone of the economy. ||| He showed great enterprise in starting his own business. ||| The enterprise has expanded into international markets.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 小型企业是经济的支柱。 ||| 他在创业中表现出了极大的进取心。 ||| 该企业已扩展到国际市场。

ieltsWords.definition: 热情；热心
ieltsWords.collocations: great enthusiasm 极大的热情, show enthusiasm 表现出热情, enthusiasm for 对…的热情
ieltsWords.example: The students showed great enthusiasm for the project. ||| Her enthusiasm is contagious. ||| He pursued his hobby with enthusiasm.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生们对这个项目表现出极大的热情。 ||| 她的热情很有感染力。 ||| 他满怀热情地追求自己的爱好。

ieltsWords.definition: 环境
ieltsWords.collocations: natural environment 自然环境, working environment 工作环境, protect the environment 保护环境
ieltsWords.example: We must protect the environment for future generations. ||| A positive learning environment is essential for students. ||| The company is committed to reducing its impact on the environment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护环境。 ||| 积极的学习环境对学生至关重要。 ||| 该公司致力于减少对环境的影响。

ieltsWords.definition: 设备；装备
ieltsWords.collocations: modern equipment 现代设备, laboratory equipment 实验室设备, sports equipment 运动器材
ieltsWords.example: The laboratory is equipped with state-of-the-art equipment for scientific research. ||| Proper safety equipment is essential for workers in construction sites. ||| The company invested heavily in new manufacturing equipment to increase efficiency.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 实验室配备了用于科学研究的最先进设备。 ||| 适当的安防设备对建筑工地的工人至关重要。 ||| 公司大量投资新制造设备以提高效率。

ieltsWords.definition: 等价的；等同物
ieltsWords.collocations: equivalent to 等同于, equivalent value 等值, equivalent amount 等量
ieltsWords.example: A bachelor's degree is equivalent to four years of study in most countries. ||| The two proposals are roughly equivalent in terms of cost. ||| One dollar is equivalent to about seven yuan at the current exchange rate.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在大多数国家，学士学位等同于四年的学习。 ||| 这两个提案在成本上大致相当。 ||| 按当前汇率，一美元大约相当于七元人民币。

ieltsWords.definition: 必要的；本质的
ieltsWords.collocations: essential for 对…必不可少, essential to 对…至关重要, essential element 基本要素
ieltsWords.example: Water is essential for all living organisms. ||| It is essential to have a clear plan before starting a project. ||| Good communication skills are an essential part of effective leadership.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 水对所有生物都是必不可少的。 ||| 在开始一个项目之前，有一个清晰的计划至关重要。 ||| 良好的沟通技巧是有效领导的基本组成部分。

ieltsWords.definition: 建立；确立
ieltsWords.collocations: establish a company 成立公司, establish a relationship 建立关系, establish a fact 确认事实
ieltsWords.example: The university was established in 1890. ||| They worked hard to establish a good reputation in the industry. ||| The research aims to establish a link between diet and health.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这所大学成立于1890年。 ||| 他们努力在行业内建立良好的声誉。 ||| 这项研究旨在确立饮食与健康之间的联系。

ieltsWords.definition: 评估；评价
ieltsWords.collocations: evaluate the effectiveness 评估有效性, evaluate performance 评估表现, evaluate options 评估选项
ieltsWords.example: Teachers evaluate students' progress through regular tests. ||| We need to evaluate the risks before making a decision. ||| The project will be evaluated based on its impact on the community.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师通过定期测试评估学生的进步。 ||| 在做决定之前，我们需要评估风险。 ||| 该项目将根据其对社区的影响进行评估。

ieltsWords.definition: 明显的
ieltsWords.collocations: evident from 从…明显看出, self-evident 不言而喻的, become evident 变得明显
ieltsWords.example: It was evident that she had been crying. ||| The benefits of exercise are evident in improved health. ||| His talent was evident from a very young age.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 很明显她哭过。 ||| 锻炼的好处体现在健康的改善上。 ||| 他的才华从很小的时候就显而易见。

ieltsWords.definition: 进化；演变
ieltsWords.collocations: evolve over time 随时间演变, evolve into 演变成, evolve from 从…进化而来
ieltsWords.example: Species evolve over millions of years to adapt to their environment. ||| The company's business model has evolved significantly since its founding. ||| Language evolves constantly to reflect changes in society.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 物种经过数百万年的进化以适应环境。 ||| 自成立以来，公司的商业模式已经发生了显著演变。 ||| 语言不断演变以反映社会的变化。

ieltsWords.definition: 超过；超越
ieltsWords.collocations: exceed expectations 超出预期, exceed the limit 超过限度, exceed the budget 超出预算
ieltsWords.example: The final cost exceeded the initial estimate by 20%. ||| His performance exceeded all expectations. ||| Drivers should not exceed the speed limit.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 最终成本比最初估计高出20%。 ||| 他的表现超出了所有人的预期。 ||| 司机不应超过速度限制。

ieltsWords.definition: 例外
ieltsWords.collocations: with the exception of 除…之外, make an exception 破例, no exception 不例外
ieltsWords.example: All students must attend the meeting, with the exception of those who are ill. ||| The rule applies to everyone without exception. ||| I rarely eat dessert, but I'll make an exception for chocolate cake.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 所有学生都必须参加会议，生病的学生除外。 ||| 这条规则适用于所有人，无一例外。 ||| 我很少吃甜点，但我会为巧克力蛋糕破例。

ieltsWords.definition: 过量；过度的
ieltsWords.collocations: in excess of 超过, excess weight 超重, excess supply 供应过剩
ieltsWords.example: Eating in excess can lead to health problems. ||| The company produced an excess of goods that remained unsold. ||| You will be charged for any excess baggage.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 过量饮食会导致健康问题。 ||| 公司生产了过多的商品，未能售出。 ||| 超重行李将收费。

ieltsWords.definition: 排除；排斥
ieltsWords.collocations: exclude from 从…排除, exclude the possibility 排除可能性, exclude someone 排斥某人
ieltsWords.example: The insurance policy excludes pre-existing conditions. ||| We cannot exclude the possibility of further delays. ||| He was excluded from the team due to his behavior.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 保险单排除已有病症。 ||| 我们不能排除进一步延误的可能性。 ||| 他因行为不端被排除在团队之外。

ieltsWords.definition: 展览；展示
ieltsWords.collocations: exhibit at a museum 在博物馆展出, exhibit behavior 表现出行为, exhibit symptoms 表现出症状
ieltsWords.example: The artist will exhibit her paintings at the gallery next month. ||| The patient exhibited signs of improvement after treatment. ||| The museum exhibits a collection of ancient artifacts.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位艺术家下个月将在画廊展出她的画作。 ||| 治疗后，病人表现出好转的迹象。 ||| 博物馆展出了一批古代文物。

ieltsWords.definition: 扩展；膨胀
ieltsWords.collocations: expand business 扩大业务, expand knowledge 扩展知识, expand the scope 扩大范围
ieltsWords.example: The company plans to expand its operations into Asia. ||| Reading can expand your horizons and deepen your understanding. ||| The metal expands when heated.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司计划将业务扩展到亚洲。 ||| 阅读可以开阔视野，加深理解。 ||| 金属受热时会膨胀。

ieltsWords.definition: 专家；专业的
ieltsWords.collocations: expert in 在…方面的专家, expert opinion 专家意见, expert advice 专家建议
ieltsWords.example: She is an expert in environmental law. ||| We consulted an expert before making the decision. ||| The expert witness provided crucial testimony in court.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她是环境法方面的专家。 ||| 在做决定之前，我们咨询了一位专家。 ||| 专家证人在法庭上提供了关键证词。

ieltsWords.definition: 明确的；清楚的
ieltsWords.collocations: explicit instructions 明确的指示, explicit content 露骨内容, explicit consent 明确同意
ieltsWords.example: The teacher gave explicit instructions for the assignment. ||| The contract contains explicit terms regarding payment. ||| He was explicit about his intentions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师对作业给出了明确的指示。 ||| 合同包含关于付款的明确条款。 ||| 他明确表达了自己的意图。

ieltsWords.definition: 利用；开发；剥削
ieltsWords.collocations: exploit resources 开发资源, exploit opportunities 利用机会, exploit workers 剥削工人
ieltsWords.example: The company exploited natural resources without regard for the environment. ||| We should exploit every opportunity to learn. ||| Child labor laws prevent employers from exploiting young workers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司不顾环境开发自然资源。 ||| 我们应该利用每一个学习的机会。 ||| 童工法防止雇主剥削年轻工人。

ieltsWords.definition: 暴露；揭露
ieltsWords.collocations: expose to 暴露于, expose the truth 揭露真相, expose a scandal 揭露丑闻
ieltsWords.example: Prolonged exposure to the sun can damage your skin. ||| The journalist exposed the corruption in the government. ||| Travel exposes you to different cultures and ways of life.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 长时间暴露在阳光下会损伤皮肤。 ||| 记者揭露了政府中的腐败。 ||| 旅行让你接触不同的文化和生活方式。

ieltsWords.definition: 延长；扩展
ieltsWords.collocations: extend the deadline 延长截止日期, extend an invitation 发出邀请, extend a hand 伸出援手
ieltsWords.example: The government decided to extend the deadline for tax payments. ||| We would like to extend our warmest welcome to all guests. ||| The garden extends to the river.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府决定延长纳税截止日期。 ||| 我们想向所有客人表示最热烈的欢迎。 ||| 花园一直延伸到河边。

ieltsWords.definition: 广泛的；大量的
ieltsWords.collocations: extensive research 广泛的研究, extensive experience 丰富的经验, extensive damage 大面积损坏
ieltsWords.example: The scientist conducted extensive research on climate change. ||| She has extensive experience in project management. ||| The storm caused extensive damage to the coastal area.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位科学家对气候变化进行了广泛的研究。 ||| 她在项目管理方面拥有丰富的经验。 ||| 暴风雨对沿海地区造成了广泛的破坏。

ieltsWords.definition: 外部的；外在的
ieltsWords.collocations: external factors 外部因素, external environment 外部环境, external appearance 外观
ieltsWords.example: The company hired an external consultant to review its operations. ||| External factors such as the economy can affect business performance. ||| The medicine is for external use only.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位外部顾问来审查其运营。 ||| 经济等外部因素会影响企业绩效。 ||| 此药仅供外用。

ieltsWords.definition: 提取；摘录
ieltsWords.collocations: extract data 提取数据, extract oil 提取石油, extract information 提取信息
ieltsWords.example: Scientists extract DNA from ancient bones to study evolution. ||| The article extracts key points from the lengthy report. ||| Dentists often extract wisdom teeth to prevent crowding.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 科学家从古代骨骼中提取DNA以研究进化。 ||| 这篇文章从冗长的报告中摘录了关键点。 ||| 牙医经常拔除智齿以防止拥挤。

ieltsWords.definition: 促进；使便利
ieltsWords.collocations: facilitate communication 促进沟通, facilitate learning 促进学习, facilitate trade 促进贸易
ieltsWords.example: New technologies facilitate remote work and global collaboration. ||| The government aims to facilitate small business growth through tax cuts. ||| Clear instructions facilitate the assembly process for users.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新技术促进了远程工作和全球协作。 ||| 政府旨在通过减税促进小企业增长。 ||| 清晰的说明使用户的组装过程更加便利。

ieltsWords.definition: 因素；要素
ieltsWords.collocations: key factor 关键因素, contributing factor 促成因素, risk factor 风险因素
ieltsWords.example: Education is a crucial factor in reducing poverty. ||| Weather conditions are a major factor in crop yields. ||| Stress can be a contributing factor to heart disease.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 教育是减少贫困的关键因素。 ||| 天气条件是作物产量的主要因素。 ||| 压力可能是心脏病的促成因素。

ieltsWords.definition: 可行的；可能的
ieltsWords.collocations: feasible solution 可行的解决方案, economically feasible 经济上可行, technically feasible 技术上可行
ieltsWords.example: The committee concluded that the plan is financially feasible. ||| It is not feasible to complete the project within a month. ||| Engineers are exploring whether the design is technically feasible.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 委员会得出结论，该计划在财务上是可行的。 ||| 在一个月内完成该项目是不可行的。 ||| 工程师们正在探索该设计在技术上是否可行。

ieltsWords.definition: 特征；特色
ieltsWords.collocations: distinctive feature 显著特征, key feature 关键特征, safety feature 安全功能
ieltsWords.example: The smartphone's main feature is its high-resolution camera. ||| A distinctive feature of the building is its glass roof. ||| The software includes a new feature for data analysis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这款智能手机的主要特点是其高分辨率摄像头。 ||| 该建筑的一个显著特征是其玻璃屋顶。 ||| 该软件包含一个用于数据分析的新功能。

ieltsWords.definition: 财务；金融；提供资金
ieltsWords.collocations: public finance 公共财政, corporate finance 公司金融, personal finance 个人理财
ieltsWords.example: She works in the finance department of a multinational company. ||| The project requires additional finance from investors. ||| Understanding personal finance is essential for young adults.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在一家跨国公司的财务部门工作。 ||| 该项目需要投资者的额外资金。 ||| 了解个人理财对年轻人至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition: 灵活的；柔韧的
ieltsWords.collocations: flexible schedule 灵活的时间表, flexible approach 灵活的方法, flexible working hours 弹性工作时间
ieltsWords.example: Many companies now offer flexible working hours to employees. ||| We need a flexible plan that can adapt to changing conditions. ||| Her flexible attitude made her a great team player.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多公司现在为员工提供弹性工作时间。 ||| 我们需要一个能够适应不断变化条件的灵活计划。 ||| 她灵活的态度使她成为出色的团队成员。

ieltsWords.definition: 波动；变动
ieltsWords.collocations: fluctuate wildly 剧烈波动, prices fluctuate 价格波动, fluctuate over time 随时间波动
ieltsWords.example: Stock prices fluctuate daily based on market conditions. ||| Temperatures fluctuate greatly between seasons in this region. ||| His mood tends to fluctuate depending on his workload.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 股票价格根据市场状况每天波动。 ||| 该地区季节间温度波动很大。 ||| 他的情绪往往随工作量的变化而波动。

ieltsWords.definition: 聚焦；集中；重点
ieltsWords.collocations: focus on 专注于, focus attention 集中注意力, focus efforts 集中精力
ieltsWords.example: Students should focus on their studies during exam period. ||| The report focuses on the impact of climate change. ||| She focused her efforts on improving customer service.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生在考试期间应专注于学习。 ||| 该报告聚焦于气候变化的影响。 ||| 她集中精力改善客户服务。

ieltsWords.definition: 预测；预报
ieltsWords.collocations: weather forecast 天气预报, economic forecast 经济预测, sales forecast 销售预测
ieltsWords.example: The weather forecast predicts heavy rain for tomorrow. ||| Economic forecasts suggest a slowdown in growth next year. ||| The company revised its sales forecast upward after strong demand.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 天气预报预测明天有大雨。 ||| 经济预测表明明年增长将放缓。 ||| 公司在强劲需求后上调了销售预测。

ieltsWords.definition: 基础；基金会
ieltsWords.collocations: solid foundation 坚实的基础, lay the foundation 奠定基础, foundation course 基础课程
ieltsWords.example: A good education provides a solid foundation for future success. ||| The research laid the foundation for modern genetics. ||| The charity foundation donates millions to healthcare projects.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 良好的教育为未来的成功奠定了坚实的基础。 ||| 这项研究为现代遗传学奠定了基础。 ||| 该慈善基金会向医疗项目捐赠了数百万。

ieltsWords.definition: 框架；结构；体系
ieltsWords.collocations: legal framework 法律框架, theoretical framework 理论框架, conceptual framework 概念框架
ieltsWords.example: The government established a legal framework for data protection. ||| The study uses a theoretical framework based on social psychology. ||| A clear framework helps organize complex projects effectively.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府建立了数据保护的法律框架。 ||| 该研究使用了基于社会心理学的理论框架。 ||| 清晰的框架有助于有效组织复杂项目。

ieltsWords.definition: 功能；作用；运作
ieltsWords.collocations: main function 主要功能, perform a function 执行功能, function properly 正常运作
ieltsWords.example: The main function of the heart is to pump blood. ||| This button performs a different function in each mode. ||| The software's search function is very efficient.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 心脏的主要功能是泵血。 ||| 这个按钮在不同模式下执行不同的功能。 ||| 该软件的搜索功能非常高效。

ieltsWords.definition: 基本的；根本的
ieltsWords.collocations: fundamental principle 基本原则, fundamental change 根本变化, fundamental rights 基本权利
ieltsWords.example: Freedom of speech is a fundamental right in democracies. ||| The company underwent a fundamental change in its strategy. ||| Understanding grammar is fundamental to learning a language.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 言论自由是民主国家的基本权利。 ||| 该公司在其战略上经历了根本性的变化。 ||| 理解语法是学习语言的基础。

ieltsWords.definition: 产生；生成；发(电)
ieltsWords.collocations: generate electricity 发电, generate income 产生收入, generate ideas 产生想法
ieltsWords.example: Solar panels generate electricity from sunlight. ||| The new product is expected to generate significant revenue. ||| Brainstorming sessions help generate creative ideas.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 太阳能电池板利用阳光发电。 ||| 新产品预计将产生可观的收入。 ||| 头脑风暴会议有助于产生创意。

ieltsWords.definition: 慷慨的；大方的
ieltsWords.collocations: generous donation 慷慨捐赠, generous portion 丰盛的一份, generous offer 慷慨的提议
ieltsWords.example: The billionaire made a generous donation to the university. ||| The restaurant serves generous portions of food. ||| She is known for her generous spirit and kindness.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位亿万富翁向大学慷慨捐赠。 ||| 这家餐厅提供丰盛的食物份量。 ||| 她以慷慨的精神和善良而闻名。

ieltsWords.definition: 全球的；全面的
ieltsWords.collocations: global economy 全球经济, global warming 全球变暖, global perspective 全球视角
ieltsWords.example: Climate change is a global issue that requires international cooperation. ||| The company expanded its operations to a global scale. ||| A global perspective helps understand different cultures.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 气候变化是一个需要国际合作的全球性问题。 ||| 该公司将其业务扩展到全球范围。 ||| 全球视角有助于理解不同的文化。

ieltsWords.definition: 逐渐的；渐进的
ieltsWords.collocations: gradual change 逐渐变化, gradual increase 逐渐增加, gradual process 渐进过程
ieltsWords.example: There has been a gradual increase in global temperatures. ||| The transition to renewable energy will be a gradual process. ||| She noticed a gradual improvement in her language skills.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 全球气温逐渐上升。 ||| 向可再生能源的过渡将是一个渐进的过程。 ||| 她注意到自己的语言技能逐渐提高。

ieltsWords.definition: 保证；担保；保修
ieltsWords.collocations: guarantee quality 保证质量, guarantee success 保证成功, money-back guarantee 退款保证
ieltsWords.example: The product comes with a one-year guarantee. ||| Hard work does not guarantee success, but it increases the chances. ||| The company guarantees customer satisfaction or a full refund.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该产品附带一年保修。 ||| 努力工作不能保证成功，但会增加机会。 ||| 公司保证客户满意，否则全额退款。

ieltsWords.definition: 和谐；融洽
ieltsWords.collocations: live in harmony 和谐共处, social harmony 社会和谐, in harmony with 与...协调
ieltsWords.example: Different ethnic groups live in harmony in this city. ||| The government promotes social harmony through inclusive policies. ||| The building's design is in harmony with its natural surroundings.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 不同民族在这个城市和谐共处。 ||| 政府通过包容性政策促进社会和谐。 ||| 该建筑的设计与其自然环境相协调。

ieltsWords.definition: 等级制度
ieltsWords.collocations: social hierarchy 社会等级, corporate hierarchy 公司层级, hierarchy of needs 需求层次
ieltsWords.example: The company has a strict hierarchy, with clear lines of authority. ||| In many societies, social hierarchy determines one's status and opportunities. ||| Maslow's hierarchy of needs is a well-known psychological theory.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司有严格的等级制度，权力界限分明。 ||| 在许多社会中，社会等级决定了一个人的地位和机会。 ||| 马斯洛的需求层次理论是一个著名的心理学理论。

ieltsWords.definition: 强调；突出；亮点
ieltsWords.collocations: highlight the importance 强调重要性, highlight the problem 突出问题, highlight the difference 突出差异
ieltsWords.example: The report highlights the urgent need for environmental protection. ||| The study highlights the differences between urban and rural education. ||| The speaker highlighted the key points of the proposal.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 报告强调了环境保护的紧迫性。 ||| 这项研究突出了城乡教育的差异。 ||| 演讲者强调了提案的要点。

ieltsWords.definition: 假设；假说
ieltsWords.collocations: test a hypothesis 检验假设, formulate a hypothesis 提出假设, working hypothesis 工作假设
ieltsWords.example: The scientist formulated a hypothesis to explain the phenomenon. ||| We need to test this hypothesis through further experiments. ||| The research is based on the hypothesis that all people are equal.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 科学家提出了一个假说来解释这一现象。 ||| 我们需要通过进一步的实验来检验这个假设。 ||| 这项研究基于人人平等的假设。

ieltsWords.definition: 完全相同的
ieltsWords.collocations: identical twins 同卵双胞胎, identical results 相同的结果, identical to 与……相同
ieltsWords.example: The two samples are almost identical in composition. ||| Identical twins share the same DNA. ||| Her opinion is identical to mine.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两个样本的成分几乎完全相同。 ||| 同卵双胞胎拥有相同的DNA。 ||| 她的意见和我的完全一致。

ieltsWords.definition: 识别；确认；鉴定
ieltsWords.collocations: identify the problem 识别问题, identify with 认同, identify the cause 查明原因
ieltsWords.example: It is important to identify the root cause of the issue. ||| Many young people identify with the characters in the novel. ||| The police are trying to identify the suspect.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 识别问题的根本原因很重要。 ||| 许多年轻人认同小说中的角色。 ||| 警方正在努力确认嫌疑人的身份。

ieltsWords.definition: 无知；愚昧
