ieltsWords.collocations: ignorance of the law 对法律的无知, sheer ignorance 完全无知, ignorance is bliss 无知是福
ieltsWords.example: Ignorance of the law is not an excuse for breaking it. ||| His ignorance of modern technology is surprising. ||| The saying 'ignorance is bliss' suggests that not knowing can sometimes be better.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 对法律的无知不能成为违法的借口。 ||| 他对现代技术的无知令人惊讶。 ||| 俗话说‘无知是福’，意味着不知道有时反而更好。

ieltsWords.definition: 说明；阐明
ieltsWords.collocations: illustrate a point 说明观点, illustrate with examples 举例说明, illustrate the concept 阐明概念
ieltsWords.example: The teacher used a diagram to illustrate the process. ||| This case illustrates the importance of early diagnosis. ||| The book is beautifully illustrated with photographs.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师用图表说明了这个过程。 ||| 这个案例说明了早期诊断的重要性。 ||| 这本书配有精美的照片插图。

ieltsWords.definition: 图像；形象；印象
ieltsWords.collocations: public image 公众形象, brand image 品牌形象, mental image 脑海中的形象
ieltsWords.example: The company is trying to improve its public image. ||| She has a clear mental image of her ideal home. ||| The satellite sent back high-resolution images of the planet.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司正试图改善其公众形象。 ||| 她对自己理想的家有清晰的想象。 ||| 卫星发回了这颗行星的高分辨率图像。

ieltsWords.definition: 巨大的；无边的
ieltsWords.collocations: immense pressure 巨大的压力, immense value 巨大的价值, immense potential 巨大的潜力
ieltsWords.example: The project requires an immense amount of time and effort. ||| The ocean is immense and full of mysteries. ||| The new technology has immense potential for improving healthcare.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个项目需要大量的时间和精力。 ||| 海洋浩瀚无垠，充满神秘。 ||| 这项新技术在改善医疗保健方面具有巨大潜力。

ieltsWords.definition: 移民；侨民
ieltsWords.collocations: illegal immigrant 非法移民, immigrant community 移民社区, first-generation immigrant 第一代移民
ieltsWords.example: Many immigrants contribute significantly to the economy of their new country. ||| The city has a large immigrant population from various countries. ||| Immigrant families often face challenges in adapting to a new culture.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多移民对新国家的经济做出了重大贡献。 ||| 这个城市有来自不同国家的大量移民人口。 ||| 移民家庭在适应新文化时常常面临挑战。

ieltsWords.definition: 影响；冲击
ieltsWords.collocations: have an impact on 对……有影响, environmental impact 环境影响, significant impact 显著影响
ieltsWords.example: The new policy will have a significant impact on small businesses. ||| The environmental impact of plastic waste is a global concern. ||| The meteorite made a huge impact when it hit the ground.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新政策将对小企业产生重大影响。 ||| 塑料垃圾对环境的影响是一个全球性问题。 ||| 陨石撞击地面时产生了巨大的冲击力。

ieltsWords.definition: 实施；执行；工具
ieltsWords.collocations: implement a plan 实施计划, implement a policy 执行政策, implement changes 落实变革
ieltsWords.example: The government plans to implement the new tax system next year. ||| It is crucial to implement the safety measures immediately. ||| The company is implementing a new software system to improve efficiency.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府计划明年实施新的税收制度。 ||| 立即执行安全措施至关重要。 ||| 公司正在实施一套新的软件系统以提高效率。

ieltsWords.definition: 含义；暗示；影响
ieltsWords.collocations: have implications for 对……有影响, practical implications 实际影响, far-reaching implications 深远影响
ieltsWords.example: The discovery has important implications for cancer research. ||| The implication of his statement is that we need to change our strategy. ||| The scandal had serious implications for the politician's career.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这一发现对癌症研究具有重要意义。 ||| 他话里的含义是我们需要改变策略。 ||| 这桩丑闻对该政治家的职业生涯产生了严重影响。

ieltsWords.definition: 强加；征收(税)
ieltsWords.collocations: impose a tax 征税, impose restrictions 施加限制, impose on 强加于
ieltsWords.example: The government imposed a new tax on luxury goods. ||| Parents should not impose their own dreams on their children. ||| The new regulations impose strict limits on carbon emissions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府对奢侈品征收了一项新税。 ||| 父母不应把自己的梦想强加给孩子。 ||| 新规定对碳排放施加了严格的限制。

ieltsWords.definition: 令人印象深刻的
ieltsWords.collocations: impressive performance 令人印象深刻的表现, impressive achievement 了不起的成就, impressive view 壮观的景色
ieltsWords.example: The athlete gave an impressive performance at the competition. ||| The view from the top of the mountain was truly impressive. ||| She has an impressive collection of rare books.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位运动员在比赛中表现出色，令人印象深刻。 ||| 山顶的景色确实壮观。 ||| 她收藏了大量珍稀书籍，令人赞叹。

ieltsWords.definition: 激励；奖励
ieltsWords.collocations: financial incentive 经济激励, incentive program 激励计划, provide an incentive 提供激励
ieltsWords.example: The company offers financial incentives to employees who meet their targets. ||| Tax breaks can be an effective incentive for investment. ||| The incentive to work hard is often a combination of rewards and recognition.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司为达到目标的员工提供经济激励。 ||| 税收减免可以成为投资的有效激励。 ||| 努力工作的动力通常是奖励和认可的结合。

ieltsWords.definition: 事件；事故
ieltsWords.collocations: isolated incident 孤立事件, serious incident 严重事件, without incident 平安无事
ieltsWords.example: The police are investigating the incident that occurred last night. ||| Fortunately, the flight landed without incident. ||| The school has implemented new safety measures after the recent incident.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方正在调查昨晚发生的事件。 ||| 幸运的是，航班平安无事地降落了。 ||| 最近的事件发生后，学校实施了新的安全措施。

ieltsWords.definition: 合并；包含；吸收
ieltsWords.collocations: incorporate into 并入, incorporate feedback 吸收反馈, incorporate changes 纳入变化
ieltsWords.example: The new design incorporates elements of traditional architecture. ||| We need to incorporate the latest research findings into our report. ||| The company was incorporated in 1990.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新设计融入了传统建筑的元素。 ||| 我们需要将最新的研究成果纳入报告中。 ||| 这家公司成立于1990年。

ieltsWords.definition: 表明；指示
ieltsWords.collocations: indicate the need 表明需要, indicate a problem 显示问题, indicate direction 指示方向
ieltsWords.example: The survey results indicate a growing concern about climate change. ||| The arrow indicates the direction of the wind. ||| His silence indicated that he did not agree with the decision.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 调查结果表明人们对气候变化的担忧日益增加。 ||| 箭头指示风向。 ||| 他的沉默表明他不同意这个决定。

ieltsWords.definition: 个人的；单独的；个体
ieltsWords.collocations: individual rights 个人权利, individual differences 个体差异, individual responsibility 个人责任
ieltsWords.example: The rights of the individual must be protected by law. ||| Teachers should take into account individual differences among students. ||| Each individual has a responsibility to contribute to society.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 个人的权利必须受到法律保护。 ||| 教师应考虑学生之间的个体差异。 ||| 每个人都有责任为社会做出贡献。

ieltsWords.definition: 不可避免的
ieltsWords.collocations: inevitable consequence 必然结果, inevitable result 不可避免的结果, seem inevitable 似乎不可避免
ieltsWords.example: Climate change is an inevitable consequence of industrialization. ||| It was inevitable that the company would go bankrupt. ||| The rise of automation seems inevitable in the modern workplace.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 气候变化是工业化的必然结果。 ||| 公司破产是不可避免的。 ||| 自动化在现代工作场所的兴起似乎不可避免。

ieltsWords.definition: 推断；推论
ieltsWords.collocations: infer from 从...推断, infer that 推断出, reasonably infer 合理推断
ieltsWords.example: From the data, we can infer that the economy is recovering. ||| What can you infer from his tone of voice? ||| It is reasonable to infer that the project will be delayed.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 从数据中，我们可以推断经济正在复苏。 ||| 你能从他的语气中推断出什么？ ||| 合理推断该项目将会延迟。

ieltsWords.definition: 影响；势力
ieltsWords.collocations: have influence on 对...有影响, exert influence 施加影响, under the influence of 在...的影响下
ieltsWords.example: Social media has a huge influence on young people's behavior. ||| The government should exert its influence to promote renewable energy. ||| Many decisions are made under the influence of advertising.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 社交媒体对年轻人的行为有巨大影响。 ||| 政府应施加影响以推广可再生能源。 ||| 许多决定是在广告的影响下做出的。

ieltsWords.definition: 通知；告知
ieltsWords.collocations: inform sb of sth 通知某人某事, keep sb informed 让某人随时了解, well-informed 消息灵通的
ieltsWords.example: Please inform us of any changes in your schedule. ||| The report is designed to inform the public about health risks. ||| We will keep you informed of the progress.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请通知我们您日程的任何变化。 ||| 该报告旨在告知公众健康风险。 ||| 我们会随时通知您进展情况。

ieltsWords.definition: 成分；原料；要素
ieltsWords.collocations: key ingredient 关键成分, essential ingredient 基本要素, natural ingredients 天然成分
ieltsWords.example: Fresh ingredients are essential for a healthy diet. ||| Hard work is a key ingredient of success. ||| The product contains only natural ingredients.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新鲜食材对健康饮食至关重要。 ||| 努力工作是成功的关键要素。 ||| 该产品只含有天然成分。

ieltsWords.definition: 居住于；栖息
ieltsWords.collocations: inhabit an area 居住在某区域, inhabited by 由...居住, sparsely inhabited 人烟稀少的
ieltsWords.example: Many species inhabit the Amazon rainforest. ||| The island is inhabited by a small community of fishermen. ||| These birds inhabit coastal regions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多物种栖息在亚马逊雨林中。 ||| 该岛居住着一个小的渔民社区。 ||| 这些鸟类栖息在沿海地区。

ieltsWords.definition: 最初的；开始的
ieltsWords.collocations: initial stage 初始阶段, initial reaction 最初反应, initial investment 初始投资
ieltsWords.example: The initial results of the experiment were promising. ||| She wrote her initials on the document. ||| The initial cost of the project was higher than expected.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 实验的初步结果令人鼓舞。 ||| 她在文件上签了首字母。 ||| 项目的初始成本高于预期。

ieltsWords.definition: 开始；发起
ieltsWords.collocations: initiate a project 启动项目, initiate a discussion 发起讨论, initiate sb into 使某人入门
ieltsWords.example: The government initiated a new policy to reduce pollution. ||| They initiated a conversation about climate change. ||| The program initiates students into the world of science.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府启动了一项减少污染的新政策。 ||| 他们发起了关于气候变化的对话。 ||| 该项目引导学生进入科学世界。

ieltsWords.definition: 创新；革新
ieltsWords.collocations: technological innovation 技术创新, drive innovation 推动创新, product innovation 产品创新
ieltsWords.example: Innovation is crucial for economic growth. ||| The company is known for its continuous innovation. ||| Technological innovation has transformed the way we live.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 创新对经济增长至关重要。 ||| 该公司以持续创新而闻名。 ||| 技术创新改变了我们的生活方式。

ieltsWords.definition: 输入；投入；意见
ieltsWords.collocations: input data 输入数据, valuable input 宝贵的意见, input into 投入...
ieltsWords.example: We need more input from the community. ||| Please input your password to continue. ||| The project requires a significant input of time and money.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要更多来自社区的意见。 ||| 请输入密码以继续。 ||| 该项目需要大量的时间和金钱投入。

ieltsWords.definition: 灵感；鼓舞
ieltsWords.collocations: source of inspiration 灵感来源, draw inspiration from 从...汲取灵感, provide inspiration 提供灵感
ieltsWords.example: Nature is a great source of inspiration for artists. ||| She drew inspiration from her travels. ||| His speech provided inspiration to the whole team.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大自然是艺术家的巨大灵感来源。 ||| 她从旅行中汲取灵感。 ||| 他的演讲鼓舞了整个团队。

ieltsWords.definition: 机构；学院；建立
ieltsWords.collocations: research institute 研究所, institute a policy 制定政策, institute proceedings 提起诉讼
ieltsWords.example: He works at a leading research institute. ||| The government instituted new regulations. ||| The institute offers courses in various fields.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他在一家领先的研究所工作。 ||| 政府制定了新规定。 ||| 该学院提供各个领域的课程。

ieltsWords.definition: 机构；制度；惯例
ieltsWords.collocations: financial institution 金融机构, educational institution 教育机构, social institution 社会制度
ieltsWords.example: Banks are important financial institutions. ||| Marriage is a social institution in many cultures. ||| The university is a prestigious educational institution.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 银行是重要的金融机构。 ||| 婚姻在许多文化中是一种社会制度。 ||| 这所大学是一所著名的教育机构。

ieltsWords.definition: 工具；仪器；乐器
ieltsWords.collocations: musical instrument 乐器, measuring instrument 测量仪器, surgical instrument 手术器械
ieltsWords.example: The guitar is a popular musical instrument. ||| The laboratory is equipped with precise instruments. ||| Language is an instrument of communication.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 吉他是流行的乐器。 ||| 实验室配备了精密仪器。 ||| 语言是交流的工具。

ieltsWords.definition: 整合；融入
ieltsWords.collocations: integrate into 融入, integrate with 与...整合, fully integrated 完全整合的
ieltsWords.example: It is important to integrate theory with practice. ||| The new system integrates seamlessly with existing software. ||| Immigrants often struggle to integrate into a new society.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 将理论与实践结合很重要。 ||| 新系统与现有软件无缝整合。 ||| 移民常常难以融入新社会。

ieltsWords.definition: 智力的；知识分子
ieltsWords.collocations: intellectual property 知识产权, intellectual development 智力发展, intellectual activity 智力活动
ieltsWords.example: Reading is an intellectual activity. ||| The company protects its intellectual property. ||| He is a well-known intellectual in the field of philosophy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 阅读是一种智力活动。 ||| 公司保护其知识产权。 ||| 他是哲学领域著名的知识分子。

ieltsWords.definition: 聪明的；智能的
ieltsWords.collocations: intelligent design 智能设计, intelligent system 智能系统, highly intelligent 非常聪明的
ieltsWords.example: Dolphins are highly intelligent animals. ||| The building uses an intelligent lighting system. ||| She gave an intelligent answer to the question.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 海豚是非常聪明的动物。 ||| 该建筑使用智能照明系统。 ||| 她对问题给出了聪明的回答。

ieltsWords.definition: 强烈的；紧张的
ieltsWords.collocations: intense competition 激烈竞争, intense pressure 巨大压力, intense emotion 强烈情感
ieltsWords.example: There is intense competition for university places. ||| The heat was intense during the summer. ||| She felt intense emotion when she saw her family.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大学入学名额竞争激烈。 ||| 夏天酷热难耐。 ||| 看到家人时，她感到强烈的情感。

ieltsWords.definition: 互动；相互作用
ieltsWords.collocations: interact with 与...互动, interact socially 社交互动, interact effectively 有效互动
ieltsWords.example: Teachers should interact with students in class. ||| These chemicals interact with each other. ||| Children learn to interact socially at school.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师应该在课堂上与学生互动。 ||| 这些化学物质相互作用。 ||| 孩子们在学校学习社交互动。

ieltsWords.definition: 中级的；中间的
ieltsWords.collocations: intermediate level 中级水平, intermediate stage 中间阶段, intermediate product 中间产品
ieltsWords.example: She is taking an intermediate English course. ||| The project is at an intermediate stage. ||| The chemical is an intermediate in the reaction.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她正在上中级英语课程。 ||| 该项目处于中间阶段。 ||| 这种化学物质是反应中的中间体。

ieltsWords.definition: 内部的；国内的
ieltsWords.collocations: internal organs 内脏, internal affairs 内部事务, internal conflict 内部冲突
ieltsWords.example: The company is conducting an internal investigation into the financial irregularities. ||| She suffered from internal injuries after the accident. ||| The country's internal policies have been criticized by international observers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司正在对财务违规行为进行内部调查。 ||| 事故后她受了内伤。 ||| 该国的国内政策受到了国际观察员的批评。

ieltsWords.definition: 解释；口译；理解
ieltsWords.collocations: interpret data 解读数据, interpret a dream 解梦, interpret a text 诠释文本
ieltsWords.example: It is difficult to interpret the results of the experiment without proper context. ||| She works as an interpreter, interpreting for diplomats at international conferences. ||| Different cultures may interpret the same gesture differently.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 没有适当的背景，很难解释实验结果。 ||| 她是一名口译员，在国际会议上为外交官做口译。 ||| 不同文化可能对同一手势有不同的理解。

ieltsWords.definition: 间隔；间歇
ieltsWords.collocations: time interval 时间间隔, at regular intervals 定期地, interval training 间歇训练
ieltsWords.example: The buses run at 15-minute intervals during peak hours. ||| There was a long interval between the two acts of the play. ||| The study measured the interval between stimulus and response.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 高峰时段公交车每15分钟一班。 ||| 这出戏的两幕之间有一段很长的幕间休息。 ||| 这项研究测量了刺激与反应之间的间隔。

ieltsWords.definition: 干预；介入
ieltsWords.collocations: intervene in a dispute 调解争端, intervene militarily 军事干预, intervene to prevent 介入阻止
ieltsWords.example: The United Nations decided to intervene in the conflict to prevent further casualties. ||| The teacher had to intervene when the students started arguing. ||| Several years intervened before they met again.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 联合国决定干预冲突以防止更多伤亡。 ||| 当学生们开始争论时，老师不得不介入。 ||| 他们再次见面之前，中间隔了好几年。

ieltsWords.definition: 固有的；内在的
ieltsWords.collocations: intrinsic value 内在价值, intrinsic motivation 内在动机, intrinsic properties 固有属性
ieltsWords.example: The intrinsic value of education goes beyond just getting a job. ||| She has an intrinsic love for learning that drives her research. ||| The problem lies in the intrinsic flaws of the system.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 教育的内在价值不仅仅是找到一份工作。 ||| 她对学习有一种内在的热爱，驱动着她的研究。 ||| 问题在于系统本身的固有缺陷。

ieltsWords.definition: 调查；研究
ieltsWords.collocations: investigate a crime 调查犯罪, investigate the cause 调查原因, investigate thoroughly 彻底调查
ieltsWords.example: The police are investigating the robbery that occurred last night. ||| Scientists are investigating the effects of climate change on marine life. ||| The committee will investigate the allegations of corruption.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方正在调查昨晚发生的抢劫案。 ||| 科学家正在研究气候变化对海洋生物的影响。 ||| 委员会将调查腐败指控。

ieltsWords.definition: 投资；投入
ieltsWords.collocations: make an investment 进行投资, foreign investment 外国投资, investment strategy 投资策略
ieltsWords.example: Real estate is considered a safe long-term investment. ||| The government is encouraging foreign investment in the technology sector. ||| Education is an investment in the future of our children.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 房地产被认为是一种安全的长期投资。 ||| 政府正在鼓励外国投资于科技领域。 ||| 教育是对我们孩子未来的投资。

ieltsWords.definition: 隔离；孤立
ieltsWords.collocations: isolate a patient 隔离病人, isolate a variable 分离变量, isolate oneself 自我孤立
ieltsWords.example: Patients with the infectious disease were isolated to prevent the spread. ||| In the experiment, it is important to isolate the control group. ||| He tends to isolate himself from others when he is stressed.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 患有传染病的病人被隔离以防止传播。 ||| 在实验中，隔离对照组很重要。 ||| 他压力大时倾向于把自己与他人隔离开来。

ieltsWords.definition: 问题；议题；发行
ieltsWords.collocations: address an issue 解决问题, current issue 当前问题, issue a statement 发表声明
ieltsWords.example: Climate change is one of the most pressing issues of our time. ||| The magazine's latest issue features an interview with the president. ||| The government issued a warning about the approaching storm.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 气候变化是我们这个时代最紧迫的问题之一。 ||| 该杂志的最新一期刊登了对总统的采访。 ||| 政府发布了关于即将到来的风暴的警告。

ieltsWords.definition: 期刊；日记
ieltsWords.collocations: academic journal 学术期刊, keep a journal 写日记, journal article 期刊文章
ieltsWords.example: She publishes her research findings in reputable scientific journals. ||| He keeps a daily journal to record his thoughts and experiences. ||| The journal is indexed in several major databases.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在知名的科学期刊上发表她的研究发现。 ||| 他每天写日记记录自己的想法和经历。 ||| 该期刊被多个主要数据库收录。

ieltsWords.definition: 证明…有理
ieltsWords.collocations: justify an action 证明行为正当, justify the cost 证明成本合理, justify oneself 为自己辩护
ieltsWords.example: How can you justify spending so much money on a luxury item? ||| The end does not always justify the means. ||| He tried to justify his absence by saying he was sick.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你怎么能证明花这么多钱买一件奢侈品是合理的？ ||| 结果并不总是证明手段的正当性。 ||| 他试图以生病为由为自己的缺席辩护。

ieltsWords.definition: 标签；标记
ieltsWords.collocations: price label 价格标签, warning label 警告标签, brand label 品牌标签
ieltsWords.example: Read the label carefully before using any medication. ||| The product label indicates that it is made from organic materials. ||| He was given the label of 'troublemaker' by his teachers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 使用任何药物前仔细阅读标签。 ||| 产品标签显示它是由有机材料制成的。 ||| 他被老师们贴上了“捣蛋鬼”的标签。

ieltsWords.definition: 劳动；工作；劳动力
ieltsWords.collocations: manual labour 体力劳动, labour market 劳动力市场, labour force 劳动力
ieltsWords.example: The construction project requires a large amount of skilled labour. ||| She went into labour at 3 a.m. and was rushed to the hospital. ||| The government is implementing policies to improve labour conditions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个建筑项目需要大量熟练劳动力。 ||| 她在凌晨3点开始分娩，被紧急送往医院。 ||| 政府正在实施改善劳动条件的政策。

ieltsWords.definition: 发射；启动；推出
ieltsWords.collocations: launch a product 推出产品, launch a campaign 发起活动, launch a rocket 发射火箭
ieltsWords.example: The company plans to launch its new smartphone next month. ||| The organization launched a campaign to raise awareness about plastic pollution. ||| The satellite was successfully launched into orbit.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司计划下个月推出其新款智能手机。 ||| 该组织发起了一项提高塑料污染意识的活动。 ||| 卫星被成功发射进入轨道。

ieltsWords.definition: 层；层次
ieltsWords.collocations: ozone layer 臭氧层, multiple layers 多层, layer of paint 一层油漆
ieltsWords.example: The ozone layer protects the Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation. ||| The cake has three layers of chocolate and cream. ||| There are multiple layers of meaning in this poem.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 臭氧层保护地球免受有害紫外线辐射。 ||| 蛋糕有三层巧克力和奶油。 ||| 这首诗有多层含义。

ieltsWords.definition: 讲座；讲课
ieltsWords.collocations: attend a lecture 听讲座, give a lecture 做讲座, lecture hall 演讲厅
ieltsWords.example: Professor Smith gave a fascinating lecture on quantum physics. ||| I have a lecture at 10 a.m. every Monday. ||| My mother gave me a long lecture about being responsible.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 史密斯教授做了一个关于量子物理的精彩讲座。 ||| 我每周一上午10点有一节课。 ||| 我妈妈就负责任的问题给我上了一堂长篇训诫课。

ieltsWords.definition: 法律的；合法的
ieltsWords.collocations: legal system 法律体系, legal advice 法律咨询, legal action 法律行动
ieltsWords.example: It is important to seek legal advice before signing any contract. ||| The company is facing legal action for violating environmental regulations. ||| The legal age for drinking in this country is 21.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在签署任何合同之前寻求法律咨询很重要。 ||| 该公司因违反环境法规而面临法律诉讼。 ||| 这个国家的法定饮酒年龄是21岁。

ieltsWords.definition: 立法；法规
ieltsWords.collocations: pass legislation 通过立法, introduce legislation 提出立法, environmental legislation 环境立法
ieltsWords.example: The government is expected to introduce new legislation on data privacy. ||| The legislation aims to reduce carbon emissions by 50% by 2030. ||| Compliance with health and safety legislation is mandatory for all businesses.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府预计将提出关于数据隐私的新立法。 ||| 该立法旨在到2030年将碳排放减少50%。 ||| 所有企业都必须遵守健康与安全法规。

ieltsWords.definition: 合法的；合理的
ieltsWords.collocations: legitimate concern 合理的担忧, legitimate business 合法生意, legitimate government 合法政府
ieltsWords.example: The protesters have a legitimate grievance against the government's policy. ||| It is a legitimate question that deserves a serious answer. ||| Only legitimate businesses are allowed to operate in this zone.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 抗议者对政府的政策有合理的抱怨。 ||| 这是一个合理的问题，值得认真回答。 ||| 只有合法企业才允许在该区域经营。

ieltsWords.definition: 自由的；开明的
ieltsWords.collocations: liberal arts 文科, liberal democracy 自由民主, liberal views 开明的观点
ieltsWords.example: She holds liberal views on social issues such as marriage equality. ||| The university offers a broad liberal arts education. ||| He made a liberal donation to the charity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在婚姻平等等社会问题上持有开明的观点。 ||| 这所大学提供广泛的文科教育。 ||| 他向慈善机构慷慨捐款。

ieltsWords.definition: 可能性；概率
ieltsWords.collocations: high likelihood 高可能性, low likelihood 低可能性, increase the likelihood 增加可能性
ieltsWords.example: There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow. ||| The likelihood of success depends on your preparation. ||| We must reduce the likelihood of errors in the system.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 明天很有可能下雨。 ||| 成功的可能性取决于你的准备。 ||| 我们必须减少系统中出错的可能性。

ieltsWords.definition: 语言的；语言学的
ieltsWords.collocations: linguistic ability 语言能力, linguistic diversity 语言多样性, linguistic analysis 语言分析
ieltsWords.example: She has excellent linguistic skills in three languages. ||| Linguistic diversity is a valuable cultural asset. ||| The study focuses on linguistic patterns in social media.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她精通三种语言，语言能力出色。 ||| 语言多样性是一种宝贵的文化资产。 ||| 这项研究关注社交媒体中的语言模式。

ieltsWords.definition: 读写能力；文化素养
ieltsWords.collocations: literacy rate 识字率, financial literacy 金融素养, digital literacy 数字素养
ieltsWords.example: The country has achieved a high literacy rate. ||| Financial literacy is essential for managing personal finances. ||| Digital literacy programs help bridge the technology gap.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该国实现了高识字率。 ||| 金融素养对管理个人财务至关重要。 ||| 数字素养项目有助于弥合技术鸿沟。

ieltsWords.definition: 逻辑的；合情合理的
ieltsWords.collocations: logical reasoning 逻辑推理, logical conclusion 逻辑结论, logical explanation 合理解释
ieltsWords.example: It is a logical conclusion based on the evidence. ||| She presented a logical argument for her proposal. ||| Logical thinking is crucial for problem-solving.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这是基于证据得出的逻辑结论。 ||| 她为自己的提议提出了合理的论证。 ||| 逻辑思维对解决问题至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition: 保持；维持；保养
ieltsWords.collocations: maintain order 维持秩序, maintain health 保持健康, maintain a relationship 维持关系
ieltsWords.example: It is important to maintain a balanced diet. ||| The government aims to maintain social stability. ||| Regular exercise helps maintain physical fitness.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 保持均衡饮食很重要。 ||| 政府旨在维持社会稳定。 ||| 定期锻炼有助于保持身体健康。

ieltsWords.definition: 主要的；主修
ieltsWords.collocations: major issue 主要问题, major change 重大变化, major role 重要作用
ieltsWords.example: Pollution is a major concern for urban areas. ||| The company announced a major expansion plan. ||| Education plays a major role in economic development.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 污染是城市地区的主要担忧。 ||| 公司宣布了一项重大扩张计划。 ||| 教育在经济发展中起着重要作用。

ieltsWords.definition: 操控；操纵
ieltsWords.collocations: manipulate data 操纵数据, manipulate public opinion 操纵舆论, manipulate a machine 操作机器
ieltsWords.example: Some politicians manipulate statistics to support their claims. ||| He was accused of manipulating the stock market. ||| The robot can manipulate objects with great precision.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一些政客操纵统计数据来支持他们的主张。 ||| 他被指控操纵股市。 ||| 机器人可以非常精确地操作物体。

ieltsWords.definition: 边缘；余量；利润
ieltsWords.collocations: profit margin 利润率, safety margin 安全边际, by a narrow margin 以微弱优势
ieltsWords.example: The company's profit margin has increased this year. ||| He won the election by a narrow margin. ||| Leave a margin for error in your calculations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司今年的利润率有所提高。 ||| 他以微弱优势赢得了选举。 ||| 在你的计算中留出误差余地。

ieltsWords.definition: 成熟的
ieltsWords.collocations: mature decision 成熟的决定, mature person 成熟的人, mature market 成熟市场
ieltsWords.example: She is very mature for her age. ||| We need a mature approach to solve this problem. ||| The technology has reached a mature stage.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她比同龄人成熟得多。 ||| 我们需要一个成熟的方法来解决这个问题。 ||| 这项技术已经达到成熟阶段。

ieltsWords.definition: 最大的；最大值
ieltsWords.collocations: maximum speed 最高速度, maximum capacity 最大容量, maximum benefit 最大利益
ieltsWords.example: The car can reach a maximum speed of 200 km/h. ||| We should make maximum use of available resources. ||| The maximum capacity of the hall is 500 people.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这辆车最高时速可达200公里。 ||| 我们应该最大限度地利用可用资源。 ||| 大厅的最大容量是500人。

ieltsWords.definition: 机制；机理
ieltsWords.collocations: defense mechanism 防御机制, market mechanism 市场机制, control mechanism 控制机制
ieltsWords.example: The body has a natural defense mechanism against infections. ||| The market mechanism determines prices. ||| The clock's mechanism is very complex.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 身体有天然的防御机制来对抗感染。 ||| 市场机制决定价格。 ||| 钟表的机械装置非常复杂。

ieltsWords.definition: 媒体；媒介
ieltsWords.collocations: social media 社交媒体, mass media 大众媒体, news media 新闻媒体
ieltsWords.example: Social media has changed the way we communicate. ||| The mass media plays a key role in shaping public opinion. ||| The news media reported the event extensively.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 社交媒体改变了我们的交流方式。 ||| 大众媒体在塑造舆论方面起着关键作用。 ||| 新闻媒体广泛报道了这一事件。

ieltsWords.definition: 精神的；心理的
ieltsWords.collocations: mental health 心理健康, mental illness 精神疾病, mental ability 智力
ieltsWords.example: Mental health is as important as physical health. ||| She has excellent mental arithmetic skills. ||| Stress can lead to mental health problems.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 心理健康和身体健康一样重要。 ||| 她有出色的心算能力。 ||| 压力可能导致心理健康问题。

ieltsWords.definition: 方法；办法
ieltsWords.collocations: teaching method 教学方法, research method 研究方法, effective method 有效方法
ieltsWords.example: This teaching method encourages student participation. ||| We need to find a more efficient method. ||| The scientific method involves observation and experimentation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这种教学方法鼓励学生参与。 ||| 我们需要找到更有效的方法。 ||| 科学方法包括观察和实验。

ieltsWords.definition: 迁移；移居；迁徙
ieltsWords.collocations: migrate to another country 移居另一个国家, migrate south 向南迁徙, migrate data 迁移数据
ieltsWords.example: Many birds migrate to warmer regions in winter. ||| People migrate to cities for better job opportunities. ||| The company plans to migrate its data to the cloud.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多鸟类冬天迁徙到更温暖的地区。 ||| 人们为了更好的工作机会迁移到城市。 ||| 公司计划将数据迁移到云端。

ieltsWords.definition: 军事的；军队
ieltsWords.collocations: military service 兵役, military force 军事力量, military training 军事训练
ieltsWords.example: He completed his military service last year. ||| The country has a strong military force. ||| Military training helps develop discipline.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他去年完成了兵役。 ||| 这个国家有强大的军事力量。 ||| 军事训练有助于培养纪律性。

ieltsWords.definition: 最小的；最低限度
ieltsWords.collocations: minimum wage 最低工资, minimum requirement 最低要求, minimum age 最低年龄
ieltsWords.example: The minimum wage has been increased. ||| You need a minimum of five years' experience. ||| The minimum age for driving is 18.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 最低工资已经提高了。 ||| 你至少需要五年经验。 ||| 驾驶的最低年龄是18岁。

ieltsWords.definition: 次要的；较小的
ieltsWords.collocations: minor issue 小问题, minor injury 轻伤, minor role 次要角色
ieltsWords.example: It's just a minor problem; we can fix it easily. ||| He suffered minor injuries in the accident. ||| She played a minor role in the project.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这只是个小问题，我们可以轻松解决。 ||| 他在事故中受了轻伤。 ||| 她在项目中扮演了次要角色。

ieltsWords.definition: 修改；调整
ieltsWords.collocations: modify a plan 修改计划, modify behavior 改变行为, modify a design 修改设计
ieltsWords.example: We need to modify the plan based on new information. ||| The software can be modified to suit your needs. ||| He modified his behavior after the feedback.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要根据新信息修改计划。 ||| 这个软件可以修改以满足你的需求。 ||| 他在反馈后改变了自己的行为。

ieltsWords.definition: 监控；监测
ieltsWords.collocations: monitor progress 监控进展, monitor health 监测健康, monitor activity 监视活动
ieltsWords.example: Doctors monitor patients' vital signs regularly. ||| The system monitors air quality in real time. ||| Teachers monitor students' progress throughout the term.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 医生定期监测患者的生命体征。 ||| 该系统实时监测空气质量。 ||| 教师在整个学期监控学生的进步。

ieltsWords.definition: 道德的；伦理的；寓意
ieltsWords.collocations: moral values 道德价值观, moral dilemma 道德困境, moral support 道义支持
ieltsWords.example: The novel explores the moral dilemma of choosing between loyalty and justice. ||| Parents should teach their children moral values from an early age. ||| She provided moral support to her friend during the difficult time.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这部小说探讨了在忠诚与正义之间选择的道德困境。 ||| 父母应该从小教导孩子道德价值观。 ||| 她在困难时期给朋友提供了道义支持。

ieltsWords.definition: 激励；激发
ieltsWords.collocations: motivate students 激励学生, motivate employees 激励员工, be motivated by 受…驱动
ieltsWords.example: Teachers need to find ways to motivate students to learn actively. ||| The bonus system is designed to motivate employees to work harder. ||| He was motivated by a desire to help others.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 教师需要找到激励学生主动学习的方法。 ||| 奖金制度旨在激励员工更努力工作。 ||| 他受到帮助他人的愿望的驱动。

ieltsWords.definition: 相互的；共同的
ieltsWords.collocations: mutual respect 相互尊重, mutual benefit 互利, mutual understanding 相互理解
ieltsWords.example: A successful relationship is built on mutual respect and trust. ||| The two companies signed a contract for mutual benefit. ||| Cultural exchange programs promote mutual understanding between nations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 成功的关系建立在相互尊重和信任的基础上。 ||| 两家公司签订了互利合同。 ||| 文化交流项目促进国家间的相互理解。

ieltsWords.definition: 消极的；负面的
ieltsWords.collocations: negative impact 负面影响, negative attitude 消极态度, negative feedback 负面反馈
ieltsWords.example: The new policy had a negative impact on small businesses. ||| She tried to avoid negative thoughts and focus on the positive. ||| The teacher gave negative feedback on the student's essay.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新政策对小企业产生了负面影响。 ||| 她试图避免消极想法，专注于积极方面。 ||| 老师对学生的论文给出了负面反馈。

ieltsWords.definition: 谈判；协商
ieltsWords.collocations: negotiate a deal 谈判协议, negotiate a contract 谈判合同, negotiate with 与…谈判
ieltsWords.example: The union is negotiating with management for better working conditions. ||| They managed to negotiate a deal that satisfied both parties. ||| It took months to negotiate the terms of the contract.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 工会正在与管理层谈判以争取更好的工作条件。 ||| 他们成功谈成了一项令双方都满意的协议。 ||| 花了几个月时间谈判合同条款。

ieltsWords.definition: 网络；关系网
ieltsWords.collocations: social network 社交网络, network of contacts 人脉网络, build a network 建立网络
ieltsWords.example: Social networking sites have changed the way people communicate. ||| He has a wide network of contacts in the business world. ||| Attending conferences is a good way to build a professional network.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 社交网站改变了人们的交流方式。 ||| 他在商界有广泛的人脉网络。 ||| 参加会议是建立专业网络的好方法。

ieltsWords.definition: 中立的；中性的
ieltsWords.collocations: neutral position 中立立场, neutral country 中立国, neutral color 中性色
ieltsWords.example: Switzerland remained a neutral country during the war. ||| The mediator must take a neutral position in the dispute. ||| She prefers to wear neutral colors like beige and gray.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 瑞士在战争期间保持中立。 ||| 调解人必须在争议中保持中立立场。 ||| 她更喜欢穿米色和灰色等中性色。

ieltsWords.definition: 然而；尽管如此
ieltsWords.collocations: nevertheless, ... 尽管如此，…, but nevertheless 但尽管如此
ieltsWords.example: The weather was bad; nevertheless, we decided to go hiking. ||| He is very busy; nevertheless, he always finds time to help others. ||| The task was difficult; nevertheless, she completed it on time.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 天气不好，尽管如此，我们还是决定去远足。 ||| 他很忙，不过，他总是抽出时间帮助别人。 ||| 任务很艰巨，尽管如此，她还是按时完成了。

ieltsWords.definition: 概念；看法
ieltsWords.collocations: notion of 关于…的概念, reject the notion 拒绝这一观念, have a notion 有一个想法
ieltsWords.example: The notion of freedom is central to democratic societies. ||| Many people reject the notion that money brings happiness. ||| She had a vague notion that something was wrong.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 自由的概念是民主社会的核心。 ||| 许多人拒绝金钱带来幸福这一观念。 ||| 她隐约觉得有些不对劲。

ieltsWords.definition: 核的；原子能的
ieltsWords.collocations: nuclear energy 核能, nuclear power plant 核电站, nuclear weapon 核武器
ieltsWords.example: Nuclear energy is a controversial source of power. ||| The government plans to build a new nuclear power plant. ||| The treaty aims to reduce the number of nuclear weapons.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 核能是一种有争议的能源。 ||| 政府计划建造一座新的核电站。 ||| 该条约旨在减少核武器数量。

ieltsWords.definition: 目标；客观的
ieltsWords.collocations: achieve an objective 实现目标, main objective 主要目标, set objectives 设定目标
ieltsWords.example: The main objective of the project is to reduce pollution. ||| We need to set clear objectives before starting the work. ||| She worked hard to achieve her career objectives.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该项目的主要目标是减少污染。 ||| 在开始工作之前，我们需要设定明确的目标。 ||| 她努力工作以实现自己的职业目标。

ieltsWords.definition: 获得；得到
ieltsWords.collocations: obtain information 获取信息, obtain a degree 获得学位, obtain permission 获得许可
ieltsWords.example: You can obtain information from the library's website. ||| She obtained a master's degree in economics. ||| We need to obtain permission from the local authorities.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你可以从图书馆的网站上获取信息。 ||| 她获得了经济学硕士学位。 ||| 我们需要获得当地政府的许可。

ieltsWords.definition: 明显的；显然的
ieltsWords.collocations: obvious reason 明显的原因, obvious mistake 明显的错误, it is obvious that 很明显…
ieltsWords.example: It is obvious that he is not telling the truth. ||| There is an obvious mistake in the calculation. ||| The reasons for his resignation were not obvious.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 很明显他没有说实话。 ||| 计算中有一个明显的错误。 ||| 他辞职的原因并不明显。

ieltsWords.definition: 职业；占领
ieltsWords.collocations: occupation group 职业群体, full-time occupation 全职工作, military occupation 军事占领
ieltsWords.example: Please state your name, age, and occupation on the form. ||| Teaching is a rewarding occupation. ||| The country was under foreign occupation for decades.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请在表格上填写姓名、年龄和职业。 ||| 教学是一项有回报的职业。 ||| 该国被外国占领了几十年。

ieltsWords.definition: 发生；出现
ieltsWords.collocations: occur to 想到, occur frequently 频繁发生, occur naturally 自然发生
ieltsWords.example: The accident occurred on a rainy night. ||| It never occurred to me that he might be lying. ||| Earthquakes occur frequently in this region.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 事故发生在雨夜。 ||| 我从未想到他可能在撒谎。 ||| 这个地区地震频繁发生。

ieltsWords.definition: 冒犯；得罪
ieltsWords.collocations: offend someone 冒犯某人, feel offended 感到被冒犯, offend against 违反
ieltsWords.example: I didn't mean to offend you with my comments. ||| She felt offended by his rude behavior. ||| Such actions offend against the rules of the community.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我不是故意用评论冒犯你。 ||| 她被他粗鲁的行为冒犯了。 ||| 这种行为违反了社区规则。

ieltsWords.definition: 操作；运营；动手术
ieltsWords.collocations: operate a machine 操作机器, operate a business 经营企业, operate on 对…动手术
ieltsWords.example: He knows how to operate the new computer system. ||| The company operates three factories in China. ||| The surgeon will operate on the patient tomorrow morning.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他知道如何操作新的计算机系统。 ||| 该公司在中国经营三家工厂。 ||| 外科医生明天早上给病人动手术。

ieltsWords.definition: 意见；看法
ieltsWords.collocations: in my opinion 在我看来, public opinion 公众舆论, express an opinion 表达意见
ieltsWords.example: In my opinion, the government should invest more in education. ||| Public opinion is divided on the issue of climate change. ||| Everyone has the right to express their own opinion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在我看来，政府应该增加教育投资。 ||| 公众舆论在气候变化问题上存在分歧。 ||| 每个人都有权表达自己的意见。

ieltsWords.definition: 对手；反对者
ieltsWords.collocations: political opponent 政治对手, opponent team 对手队, defeat an opponent 击败对手
ieltsWords.example: He defeated his opponent in the election by a large margin. ||| The two opponents shook hands after the match. ||| She is a strong opponent of the new policy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他以很大优势击败了竞选对手。 ||| 比赛结束后，两位对手握手致意。 ||| 她是新政策的强烈反对者。

ieltsWords.definition: 机会；机遇
ieltsWords.collocations: job opportunity 工作机会, golden opportunity 绝佳机会, seize an opportunity 抓住机会
ieltsWords.example: This internship provides a great opportunity to gain experience. ||| Don't miss the golden opportunity to study abroad. ||| She seized the opportunity to start her own business.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这次实习提供了获得经验的绝佳机会。 ||| 不要错过出国留学的绝佳机会。 ||| 她抓住了机会创办了自己的企业。

ieltsWords.definition: 反对；抵制
ieltsWords.collocations: oppose a plan 反对计划, oppose a policy 反对政策, strongly oppose 强烈反对
ieltsWords.example: Many citizens oppose the construction of a new highway through the forest. ||| The committee opposed the proposal due to its high cost. ||| She opposed the decision to cut funding for education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多市民反对修建一条穿越森林的新高速公路。 ||| 委员会因成本过高而反对该提案。 ||| 她反对削减教育经费的决定。

ieltsWords.definition: 乐观的
ieltsWords.collocations: optimistic about 对…乐观, remain optimistic 保持乐观, optimistic view 乐观的看法
ieltsWords.example: Despite the challenges, she remained optimistic about the future. ||| The report takes an optimistic view of economic growth. ||| He is optimistic that the project will be completed on time.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 尽管面临挑战，她仍然对未来保持乐观。 ||| 该报告对经济增长持乐观态度。 ||| 他乐观地认为项目将按时完成。

ieltsWords.definition: 选择；选项
ieltsWords.collocations: have an option 有选择, exercise an option 行使选择权, option to buy 购买选择权
ieltsWords.example: Students have the option to study abroad for a semester. ||| The company decided to exercise its option to purchase the property. ||| We need to consider all available options before making a decision.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生可以选择出国留学一学期。 ||| 公司决定行使购买该房产的选择权。 ||| 在做决定之前，我们需要考虑所有可用的选项。

ieltsWords.definition: 有机的；器官的
ieltsWords.collocations: organic food 有机食品, organic farming 有机农业, organic growth 自然增长
ieltsWords.example: More people are choosing organic food for health reasons. ||| Organic farming avoids the use of synthetic pesticides. ||| The company achieved organic growth through innovation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 越来越多的人出于健康原因选择有机食品。 ||| 有机农业避免使用合成农药。 ||| 该公司通过创新实现了自然增长。

ieltsWords.definition: 方向；定位；入职培训
ieltsWords.collocations: orientation program 迎新活动, sexual orientation 性取向, market orientation 市场导向
ieltsWords.example: The university holds an orientation program for new students. ||| The company has a strong customer orientation. ||| His political orientation is liberal.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大学为新生举办迎新活动。 ||| 该公司具有强烈的客户导向。 ||| 他的政治取向是自由派。

ieltsWords.definition: 起源；渊源
ieltsWords.collocations: origin of life 生命起源, country of origin 原产国, ethnic origin 种族出身
ieltsWords.example: Scientists are still studying the origin of the universe. ||| The product's country of origin is clearly labeled. ||| She is of Chinese origin but grew up in Canada.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 科学家仍在研究宇宙的起源。 ||| 产品的原产国标记得很清楚。 ||| 她是华裔，但在加拿大长大。

ieltsWords.definition: 结果；结局
ieltsWords.collocations: positive outcome 积极结果, outcome of the study 研究结果, expected outcome 预期结果
ieltsWords.example: The outcome of the election was a surprise to many. ||| We are waiting for the outcome of the investigation. ||| The treatment had a positive outcome for the patient.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 选举结果让许多人感到意外。 ||| 我们正在等待调查结果。 ||| 治疗对患者产生了积极的结果。

ieltsWords.definition: 产出；输出；产量
ieltsWords.collocations: industrial output 工业产量, output data 输出数据, increase output 增加产量
ieltsWords.example: The factory has increased its output by 20% this year. ||| The computer's output is displayed on the screen. ||| Agricultural output is affected by weather conditions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 工厂今年产量增加了20%。 ||| 计算机的输出显示在屏幕上。 ||| 农业产量受天气条件影响。

ieltsWords.definition: 总体的；全面地
ieltsWords.collocations: overall performance 整体表现, overall cost 总成本, overall impression 总体印象
ieltsWords.example: The overall cost of the project was higher than expected. ||| Overall, the conference was a success. ||| She received high marks for her overall performance.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 项目的总成本高于预期。 ||| 总体而言，会议是成功的。 ||| 她的整体表现获得了高分。

ieltsWords.definition: 克服；战胜
ieltsWords.collocations: overcome difficulties 克服困难, overcome obstacles 克服障碍, overcome fear 克服恐惧
ieltsWords.example: She managed to overcome her fear of public speaking. ||| The team overcame many obstacles to win the championship. ||| We need to overcome these challenges together.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她设法克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。 ||| 该团队克服了许多障碍赢得了冠军。 ||| 我们需要共同克服这些挑战。

ieltsWords.definition: 重叠；重合
ieltsWords.collocations: overlap with 与…重叠, significant overlap 显著重叠, avoid overlap 避免重叠
ieltsWords.example: The two projects overlap in their objectives. ||| There is a significant overlap between the two fields of study. ||| We need to avoid overlapping responsibilities.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两个项目的目标有重叠。 ||| 这两个研究领域有显著重叠。 ||| 我们需要避免职责重叠。

ieltsWords.definition: 海外的；在海外
ieltsWords.collocations: overseas students 海外学生, overseas market 海外市场, go overseas 去海外
ieltsWords.example: Many overseas students come to study in this country. ||| The company is expanding into overseas markets. ||| She decided to go overseas for further study.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多海外学生来这个国家学习。 ||| 该公司正在向海外市场扩张。 ||| 她决定去海外深造。

ieltsWords.definition: 面板；专家组
ieltsWords.collocations: panel of experts 专家小组, control panel 控制面板, panel discussion 小组讨论
ieltsWords.example: A panel of experts will evaluate the proposals. ||| The control panel is easy to operate. ||| There will be a panel discussion on climate change.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一个专家小组将评估这些提案。 ||| 控制面板易于操作。 ||| 将有一个关于气候变化的小组讨论。

ieltsWords.definition: 范式；典范
ieltsWords.collocations: paradigm shift 范式转变, new paradigm 新范式, research paradigm 研究范式
ieltsWords.example: The discovery led to a paradigm shift in physics. ||| This approach represents a new paradigm in education. ||| The company adopted a different business paradigm.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这一发现导致了物理学范式的转变。 ||| 这种方法代表了教育的新范式。 ||| 该公司采用了不同的商业模式。

ieltsWords.definition: 平行的；类似的
ieltsWords.collocations: parallel lines 平行线, parallel to 与…平行, in parallel 并行地
ieltsWords.example: The two roads run parallel to each other. ||| There are many parallels between the two cases. ||| The tasks can be done in parallel to save time.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两条路相互平行。 ||| 这两个案例有许多相似之处。 ||| 这些任务可以并行进行以节省时间。

ieltsWords.definition: 参与；参加
ieltsWords.collocations: participate in 参与, actively participate 积极参与, participate in a discussion 参与讨论
ieltsWords.example: Students are encouraged to participate in extracurricular activities. ||| She actively participated in the debate. ||| Many countries participated in the international conference.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 鼓励学生参加课外活动。 ||| 她积极参与了辩论。 ||| 许多国家参加了这次国际会议。

ieltsWords.definition: 激情；热情
ieltsWords.collocations: have a passion for 对…有热情, with passion 充满热情, passion for music 对音乐的热爱
ieltsWords.example: She has a passion for teaching. ||| He spoke with passion about environmental issues. ||| His passion for music led him to become a musician.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对教学充满热情。 ||| 他充满激情地谈论环境问题。 ||| 他对音乐的热爱使他成为了一名音乐家。

ieltsWords.definition: 被动的；消极的
ieltsWords.collocations: passive voice 被动语态, passive role 被动角色, passive smoking 被动吸烟
ieltsWords.example: He took a passive role in the discussion. ||| Passive smoking is harmful to health. ||| The sentence is written in the passive voice.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他在讨论中扮演了被动的角色。 ||| 被动吸烟对健康有害。 ||| 这个句子是用被动语态写的。

ieltsWords.definition: 专利；获得专利
ieltsWords.collocations: apply for a patent 申请专利, patent protection 专利保护, patent infringement 专利侵权
ieltsWords.example: The company applied for a patent for its new invention. ||| Patent protection lasts for 20 years. ||| The court ruled that there was no patent infringement.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司为其新发明申请了专利。 ||| 专利保护期限为20年。 ||| 法院裁定没有专利侵权。

ieltsWords.definition: 耐心；忍耐力
ieltsWords.collocations: have patience 有耐心, lose patience 失去耐心, with patience 耐心地
ieltsWords.example: You need to have patience when learning a new language. ||| She lost patience with the slow progress. ||| He waited with patience for the results.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言时需要有耐心。 ||| 她对缓慢的进展失去了耐心。 ||| 他耐心地等待结果。

ieltsWords.definition: 模式；图案
ieltsWords.collocations: behavior pattern 行为模式, pattern of development 发展模式, follow a pattern 遵循模式
ieltsWords.example: The study identified a clear pattern of consumer behavior. ||| The fabric has a beautiful floral pattern. ||| This project can serve as a pattern for future initiatives.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这项研究识别出了消费者行为的清晰模式。 ||| 这种布料有漂亮的 floral 图案。 ||| 这个项目可以作为未来举措的典范。

ieltsWords.definition: 顶峰；最高的
ieltsWords.collocations: peak season 旺季, reach a peak 达到顶峰, peak hours 高峰时段
ieltsWords.example: The mountain peak was covered in snow. ||| Tourism reaches its peak during the summer months. ||| Traffic is heaviest during peak hours.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 山峰被雪覆盖。 ||| 旅游业在夏季达到顶峰。 ||| 高峰时段交通最拥堵。

ieltsWords.definition: 处罚；惩罚
ieltsWords.collocations: penalty for 对…的惩罚, death penalty 死刑, penalty clause 惩罚条款
ieltsWords.example: The penalty for breaking the contract is severe. ||| Some countries have abolished the death penalty. ||| The contract includes a penalty clause for late payment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 违反合同的惩罚很严厉。 ||| 一些国家已经废除了死刑。 ||| 合同包含逾期付款的惩罚条款。

ieltsWords.definition: 察觉；感知；理解
ieltsWords.collocations: perceive as 视为, perceive the difference 察觉差异, perceive a threat 察觉威胁
ieltsWords.example: Many people perceive him as a reliable leader. ||| It is difficult to perceive the difference between the two versions. ||| Animals can perceive threats that humans cannot.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多人认为他是一个可靠的领导者。 ||| 很难察觉两个版本之间的差异。 ||| 动物能察觉到人类无法察觉的威胁。

ieltsWords.definition: 时期；周期
ieltsWords.collocations: period of time 一段时间, transition period 过渡期, trial period 试用期
ieltsWords.example: The project will be completed within a period of six months. ||| The country is going through a transition period. ||| Employees are on a trial period for the first three months.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 项目将在六个月内完成。 ||| 该国正在经历过渡期。 ||| 员工在前三个月处于试用期。

ieltsWords.definition: 永久的；长期的
ieltsWords.collocations: permanent job 固定工作, permanent address 永久地址, permanent damage 永久性损害
ieltsWords.example: She is looking for a permanent job after graduation. ||| Please provide your permanent address. ||| The accident caused permanent damage to his health.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她毕业后在找一份固定工作。 ||| 请提供您的永久地址。 ||| 事故对他的健康造成了永久性损害。

ieltsWords.definition: 允许；许可；许可证
ieltsWords.collocations: permit sb to do 允许某人做, permit doing 允许做, permit of 容许
ieltsWords.example: The school does not permit students to use phones in class. ||| Smoking is not permitted in this area. ||| The situation does not permit of any delay.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学校不允许学生在课堂上使用手机。 ||| 此区域不允许吸烟。 ||| 情况不容许任何延误。

ieltsWords.definition: 坚持；持续
ieltsWords.collocations: persist in 坚持, persist with 继续, persist despite 尽管…仍坚持
ieltsWords.example: He persisted in his research despite many difficulties. ||| If the symptoms persist, consult a doctor. ||| She persisted with her plan even after criticism.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 尽管困难重重，他仍坚持研究。 ||| 如果症状持续，请咨询医生。 ||| 即使受到批评，她仍坚持自己的计划。

ieltsWords.definition: 人员；员工；人事部门
ieltsWords.collocations: personnel department 人事部, qualified personnel 合格人员, military personnel 军事人员
ieltsWords.example: All personnel must attend the safety training. ||| The company is hiring qualified personnel for the new project. ||| Military personnel are stationed at the base.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 所有人员必须参加安全培训。 ||| 公司正在为新项目招聘合格人员。 ||| 军事人员驻扎在基地。

ieltsWords.definition: 视角；观点；透视
ieltsWords.collocations: from a perspective 从…角度, different perspective 不同视角, global perspective 全球视角
ieltsWords.example: From an economic perspective, the policy is beneficial. ||| We should consider the issue from a different perspective. ||| The course offers a global perspective on environmental issues.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 从经济角度来看，这项政策是有益的。 ||| 我们应该从不同视角考虑这个问题。 ||| 这门课程提供了环境问题的全球视角。

ieltsWords.definition: 现象
ieltsWords.collocations: natural phenomenon 自然现象, social phenomenon 社会现象, cultural phenomenon 文化现象
ieltsWords.example: The aurora borealis is a spectacular natural phenomenon. ||| Globalization is a complex social phenomenon. ||| The rise of social media is a cultural phenomenon.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 北极光是一种壮观的自然现象。 ||| 全球化是一种复杂的社会现象。 ||| 社交媒体的兴起是一种文化现象。

ieltsWords.definition: 哲学；人生观
ieltsWords.collocations: philosophy of life 人生哲学, business philosophy 经营理念, political philosophy 政治哲学
ieltsWords.example: He studied philosophy at university. ||| Her philosophy of life is to enjoy every moment. ||| The company's business philosophy emphasizes customer satisfaction.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他在大学学习哲学。 ||| 她的人生哲学是享受每一刻。 ||| 公司的经营理念强调客户满意度。

ieltsWords.definition: 物理的；身体的
ieltsWords.collocations: physical health 身体健康, physical activity 体育活动, physical environment 物理环境
ieltsWords.example: Regular exercise is important for physical health. ||| Children need plenty of physical activity. ||| The physical environment can affect learning.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 定期锻炼对身体健康很重要。 ||| 孩子们需要大量的体育活动。 ||| 物理环境会影响学习。

ieltsWords.definition: 先驱；开拓者
ieltsWords.collocations: pioneer in 在…方面的先驱, pioneer spirit 开拓精神, pioneer work 开创性工作
ieltsWords.example: She was a pioneer in the field of medical research. ||| The settlers had a strong pioneer spirit. ||| His pioneer work laid the foundation for modern genetics.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她是医学研究领域的先驱。 ||| 定居者有着强烈的开拓精神。 ||| 他的开创性工作为现代遗传学奠定了基础。

ieltsWords.definition: 政策；方针
ieltsWords.collocations: government policy 政府政策, economic policy 经济政策, insurance policy 保险单
ieltsWords.example: The government has introduced a new education policy. ||| The company's economic policy focuses on growth. ||| You should read the terms of your insurance policy carefully.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府出台了新的教育政策。 ||| 公司的经济政策侧重于增长。 ||| 你应该仔细阅读保险单的条款。

ieltsWords.definition: 污染
ieltsWords.collocations: air pollution 空气污染, water pollution 水污染, environmental pollution 环境污染
ieltsWords.example: Air pollution is a major problem in many cities. ||| Water pollution affects both humans and wildlife. ||| Environmental pollution has reached alarming levels.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 空气污染是许多城市的主要问题。 ||| 水污染影响人类和野生动物。 ||| 环境污染已达到令人担忧的水平。

ieltsWords.definition: 人口；种群
ieltsWords.collocations: population growth 人口增长, population density 人口密度, aging population 老龄化人口
ieltsWords.example: The population of the city has increased rapidly. ||| Population density is high in urban areas. ||| Many countries face the challenge of an aging population.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个城市的人口增长迅速。 ||| 城市地区人口密度高。 ||| 许多国家面临老龄化人口的挑战。

ieltsWords.definition: 部分；一份
ieltsWords.collocations: portion of 一部分, large portion 大部分, portion size 份量
ieltsWords.example: A large portion of the budget is spent on education. ||| She only ate a small portion of her meal. ||| The restaurant serves generous portion sizes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 预算的很大一部分用于教育。 ||| 她只吃了一小部分饭。 ||| 这家餐厅的份量很足。

ieltsWords.definition: 造成；提出；姿态
ieltsWords.collocations: pose a threat 构成威胁, pose a question 提出问题, pose for 为…摆姿势
ieltsWords.example: The new virus poses a serious threat to public health. ||| The teacher posed a difficult question to the class. ||| The model posed for a photo shoot.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这种新病毒对公共健康构成严重威胁。 ||| 老师向全班提出了一个难题。 ||| 模特为拍照摆姿势。

ieltsWords.definition: 积极的；正面的
ieltsWords.collocations: positive attitude 积极态度, positive effect 积极影响, positive result 积极结果
ieltsWords.example: She has a positive attitude towards life. ||| The new policy had a positive effect on the economy. ||| The experiment yielded positive results.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对生活有积极的态度。 ||| 新政策对经济产生了积极影响。 ||| 实验产生了积极结果。

ieltsWords.definition: 拥有；具有
ieltsWords.collocations: possess knowledge 拥有知识, possess skills 具备技能, possess qualities 具有品质
ieltsWords.example: She possesses a remarkable talent for music. ||| The country possesses vast natural resources. ||| He possesses the ability to solve complex problems.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她拥有非凡的音乐天赋。 ||| 这个国家拥有丰富的自然资源。 ||| 他具备解决复杂问题的能力。

ieltsWords.definition: 潜在的；潜力
ieltsWords.collocations: potential for growth 增长潜力, realize potential 实现潜力, potential risks 潜在风险
ieltsWords.example: The region has great potential for economic development. ||| We need to identify potential problems before they occur. ||| She has the potential to become a world-class athlete.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该地区具有巨大的经济发展潜力。 ||| 我们需要在潜在问题发生之前识别它们。 ||| 她有潜力成为世界级运动员。

ieltsWords.definition: 贫穷；贫困
ieltsWords.collocations: poverty line 贫困线, poverty reduction 减贫, extreme poverty 极端贫困
ieltsWords.example: Many people in rural areas live below the poverty line. ||| Education is key to breaking the cycle of poverty. ||| The government has implemented policies to reduce poverty.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多农村地区的人生活在贫困线以下。 ||| 教育是打破贫困循环的关键。 ||| 政府已实施政策以减少贫困。

ieltsWords.definition: 实际的；实用的
ieltsWords.collocations: practical experience 实践经验, practical skills 实用技能, practical solution 实际解决方案
ieltsWords.example: The course provides practical training in computer programming. ||| We need a practical approach to solve this problem. ||| She has a lot of practical knowledge about gardening.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该课程提供计算机编程的实践培训。 ||| 我们需要一个实际的方法来解决这个问题。 ||| 她有很多关于园艺的实用知识。

ieltsWords.definition: 在…之前
ieltsWords.collocations: precede by 在…之前, precede with 以…为先导, precede the event 在事件之前
ieltsWords.example: The introduction should precede the main discussion. ||| Heavy rain often precedes a storm. ||| The research phase precedes the development phase.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 引言应在主要讨论之前。 ||| 暴雨常常在风暴之前出现。 ||| 研究阶段先于开发阶段。

ieltsWords.definition: 精确的；准确的
ieltsWords.collocations: precise measurement 精确测量, precise definition 精确定义, precise instructions 明确指示
ieltsWords.example: The scientist made precise measurements of the temperature. ||| Can you give a more precise description of the suspect? ||| The instructions must be precise to avoid confusion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 科学家对温度进行了精确测量。 ||| 你能更准确地描述一下嫌疑人吗？ ||| 指示必须明确以避免混淆。

ieltsWords.definition: 预测；预言
ieltsWords.collocations: predict the outcome 预测结果, predict weather 预报天气, predict trends 预测趋势
ieltsWords.example: Economists predict a rise in inflation next year. ||| It is difficult to predict the long-term effects of the policy. ||| The weather forecast predicts rain for tomorrow.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 经济学家预测明年通货膨胀将上升。 ||| 很难预测该政策的长期影响。 ||| 天气预报预测明天有雨。

ieltsWords.definition: 更喜欢；偏爱
ieltsWords.collocations: prefer to do 更喜欢做, prefer A to B 比起B更喜欢A, prefer doing 更喜欢做
ieltsWords.example: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning. ||| Many students prefer to study in the library. ||| She prefers living in the countryside to the city.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 早上我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。 ||| 许多学生更喜欢在图书馆学习。 ||| 她更喜欢住在乡下而不是城市。

ieltsWords.definition: 偏见；歧视
ieltsWords.collocations: racial prejudice 种族偏见, overcome prejudice 克服偏见, prejudice against 对…的偏见
ieltsWords.example: Prejudice against immigrants is still widespread in some societies. ||| Education can help reduce prejudice and promote tolerance. ||| He was a victim of prejudice because of his accent.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在一些社会中，对移民的偏见仍然普遍存在。 ||| 教育有助于减少偏见并促进宽容。 ||| 他因为口音而成为偏见的受害者。

ieltsWords.definition: 初步的；预备的
ieltsWords.collocations: preliminary research 初步研究, preliminary results 初步结果, preliminary stage 初步阶段
ieltsWords.example: The preliminary findings suggest a link between diet and health. ||| We need to conduct a preliminary analysis before the main study. ||| The preliminary round of the competition starts next week.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 初步发现表明饮食与健康之间存在联系。 ||| 我们需要在主要研究之前进行初步分析。 ||| 比赛的预赛下周开始。

ieltsWords.definition: 前提；假定
ieltsWords.collocations: basic premise 基本前提, on the premise that 在…前提下, business premises 商业场所
ieltsWords.example: The argument is based on a false premise. ||| We must accept the premise that all humans are equal. ||| The company has moved to new premises in the city center.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个论点基于一个错误的前提。 ||| 我们必须接受所有人都是平等的这一前提。 ||| 公司已搬到市中心的新办公地点。

ieltsWords.definition: 开药方；规定
ieltsWords.collocations: prescribe medication 开药, prescribe a course of treatment 规定疗程, prescribe rules 制定规则
ieltsWords.example: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for the infection. ||| The law prescribes a maximum penalty for this crime. ||| The therapist prescribed a series of exercises.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 医生为感染开了抗生素。 ||| 法律规定了这种罪行的最高刑罚。 ||| 治疗师规定了一系列锻炼。

ieltsWords.definition: 保存；保护；保鲜
ieltsWords.collocations: preserve the environment 保护环境, preserve cultural heritage 保护文化遗产, preserve food 保存食物
ieltsWords.example: We must preserve natural habitats for future generations. ||| The museum preserves ancient artifacts. ||| It is important to preserve traditional customs.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护自然栖息地。 ||| 博物馆保存着古代文物。 ||| 保护传统习俗很重要。

ieltsWords.definition: 压力；压强
ieltsWords.collocations: under pressure 在压力下, peer pressure 同伴压力, blood pressure 血压
ieltsWords.example: Many students feel pressure to perform well in exams. ||| He works well under pressure. ||| The government is under pressure to reduce taxes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多学生在考试中感到压力，要求表现良好。 ||| 他在压力下工作得很好。 ||| 政府面临减税的压力。

ieltsWords.definition: 盛行；占上风
ieltsWords.collocations: prevail over 战胜, prevail upon 劝说, conditions prevail 情况普遍存在
ieltsWords.example: Justice will prevail in the end. ||| A sense of optimism prevails among the young people. ||| She prevailed upon him to stay for dinner.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 正义最终会获胜。 ||| 年轻人中普遍存在乐观情绪。 ||| 她说服他留下来吃晚饭。

ieltsWords.definition: 以前的；先前的
ieltsWords.collocations: previous experience 以前的经验, previous year 前一年, previous work 先前的工作
ieltsWords.example: She has previous experience in marketing. ||| The previous owner of the house left it in good condition. ||| In the previous chapter, we discussed the causes of the war.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她有市场营销方面的经验。 ||| 房子的前主人把它保养得很好。 ||| 在上一章中，我们讨论了战争的原因。

ieltsWords.definition: 主要的；首要的
ieltsWords.collocations: primary school 小学, primary goal 主要目标, primary source 主要来源
ieltsWords.example: The primary purpose of the study is to find a cure. ||| Primary education is compulsory in most countries. ||| The primary cause of the accident was human error.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这项研究的主要目的是找到治疗方法。 ||| 大多数国家的小学教育是义务的。 ||| 事故的主要原因是人为错误。

ieltsWords.definition: 主要的；校长；本金
ieltsWords.collocations: principal reason 主要原因, school principal 校长, principal amount 本金金额
ieltsWords.example: The principal reason for the delay was bad weather. ||| The principal of the school addressed the students. ||| The loan principal must be repaid within five years.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 延误的主要原因是恶劣天气。 ||| 校长向学生们发表了讲话。 ||| 贷款本金必须在五年内偿还。

ieltsWords.definition: 原则；原理
ieltsWords.collocations: in principle 原则上, basic principle 基本原则, moral principles 道德原则
ieltsWords.example: We agree in principle, but we need to discuss the details. ||| The principle of equality is fundamental to democracy. ||| He always acts according to his principles.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们原则上同意，但需要讨论细节。 ||| 平等原则是民主的基础。 ||| 他总是按照自己的原则行事。

ieltsWords.definition: 优先；重点
ieltsWords.collocations: top priority 首要任务, give priority to 优先考虑, set priorities 设定优先事项
ieltsWords.example: Education should be a top priority for the government. ||| We need to give priority to safety in the workplace. ||| She set her priorities and focused on her studies.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 教育应该是政府的首要任务。 ||| 我们需要优先考虑工作场所的安全。 ||| 她设定了优先事项并专注于学习。

ieltsWords.definition: 程序；步骤
ieltsWords.collocations: standard procedure 标准程序, follow the procedure 遵循程序, legal procedure 法律程序
ieltsWords.example: The company has established a standard procedure for handling complaints. ||| You must follow the correct procedure to apply for a visa. ||| The legal procedure can be time-consuming and expensive.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司已经建立了处理投诉的标准程序。 ||| 你必须按照正确的程序申请签证。 ||| 法律程序可能既耗时又昂贵。

ieltsWords.definition: 过程；流程；处理
ieltsWords.collocations: manufacturing process 制造过程, decision-making process 决策过程, process data 处理数据
ieltsWords.example: The manufacturing process has been improved to reduce waste. ||| It takes time to process the application. ||| The decision-making process involves multiple stakeholders.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 制造过程已经改进以减少浪费。 ||| 处理申请需要时间。 ||| 决策过程涉及多个利益相关者。

ieltsWords.definition: 职业；专业
ieltsWords.collocations: medical profession 医学行业, teaching profession 教学职业, professional development 职业发展
ieltsWords.example: She decided to enter the medical profession after volunteering at a hospital. ||| The teaching profession requires patience and dedication. ||| Continuous professional development is essential for career growth.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在医院做志愿者后决定进入医学行业。 ||| 教学职业需要耐心和奉献精神。 ||| 持续的职业发展对职业成长至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition: 利润；利益
ieltsWords.collocations: net profit 净利润, profit margin 利润率, make a profit 获利
ieltsWords.example: The company reported a net profit of $10 million this quarter. ||| They aim to increase their profit margin by reducing costs. ||| Small businesses often struggle to make a profit in the first year.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司本季度报告净利润1000万美元。 ||| 他们旨在通过降低成本来提高利润率。 ||| 小企业往往在第一年难以获利。

ieltsWords.definition: 深刻的；深远的
ieltsWords.collocations: profound impact 深远影响, profound effect 深刻影响, profound knowledge 渊博知识
ieltsWords.example: The discovery had a profound impact on the field of medicine. ||| Her speech left a profound effect on the audience. ||| He has a profound knowledge of ancient history.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这一发现对医学领域产生了深远影响。 ||| 她的演讲给观众留下了深刻印象。 ||| 他对古代历史有渊博的知识。

ieltsWords.definition: 进步；进展
ieltsWords.collocations: make progress 取得进步, technological progress 技术进步, progress report 进度报告
ieltsWords.example: The student has made significant progress in mathematics this semester. ||| Technological progress has transformed the way we communicate. ||| We need to submit a progress report by Friday.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个学生这学期在数学上取得了显著进步。 ||| 技术进步改变了我们的沟通方式。 ||| 我们需要在周五前提交一份进度报告。

ieltsWords.definition: 禁止；阻止
ieltsWords.collocations: prohibit smoking 禁止吸烟, prohibit entry 禁止进入, strictly prohibited 严格禁止
ieltsWords.example: Smoking is strictly prohibited in public buildings. ||| The new law prohibits the use of plastic bags. ||| The regulations prohibit entry without a valid pass.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公共场所严格禁止吸烟。 ||| 新法律禁止使用塑料袋。 ||| 规定禁止无有效通行证进入。

ieltsWords.definition: 项目；工程；计划；投射
ieltsWords.collocations: research project 研究项目, construction project 建设项目, project management 项目管理
ieltsWords.example: The research project aims to find a cure for the disease. ||| The construction project is expected to be completed next year. ||| Effective project management is crucial for success.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个研究项目旨在找到治疗这种疾病的方法。 ||| 这个建设项目预计明年完工。 ||| 有效的项目管理对成功至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition: 促进；推广；晋升
ieltsWords.collocations: promote health 促进健康, promote products 推广产品, get promoted 获得晋升
ieltsWords.example: Regular exercise promotes good health. ||| The company is using social media to promote its new products. ||| She worked hard and got promoted to manager.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 定期锻炼促进健康。 ||| 公司正在利用社交媒体推广新产品。 ||| 她努力工作，晋升为经理。

ieltsWords.definition: 比例；部分
ieltsWords.collocations: in proportion 成比例, large proportion 很大比例, proportion of population 人口比例
ieltsWords.example: A large proportion of the population lives in urban areas. ||| The ingredients should be mixed in the correct proportion. ||| The size of the font is in proportion to the importance of the text.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 很大一部分人口居住在城市地区。 ||| 配料应按正确比例混合。 ||| 字体大小与文本的重要性成比例。

ieltsWords.definition: 前景；展望
ieltsWords.collocations: job prospects 就业前景, prospect of success 成功可能性, prospect for oil 勘探石油
ieltsWords.example: The job prospects for graduates in this field are excellent. ||| There is little prospect of success without hard work. ||| The company is prospecting for oil in the region.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个领域的毕业生就业前景很好。 ||| 不努力的话成功可能性很小。 ||| 公司正在该地区勘探石油。

ieltsWords.definition: 繁荣；富裕
ieltsWords.collocations: economic prosperity 经济繁荣, shared prosperity 共同繁荣, path to prosperity 繁荣之路
ieltsWords.example: The country enjoyed a period of economic prosperity. ||| The government aims to achieve shared prosperity for all citizens. ||| Education is the key to a path to prosperity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个国家经历了一段经济繁荣时期。 ||| 政府旨在实现所有公民的共同繁荣。 ||| 教育是通往繁荣之路的关键。

ieltsWords.definition: 协议；规程
ieltsWords.collocations: communication protocol 通信协议, safety protocol 安全协议, diplomatic protocol 外交礼仪
ieltsWords.example: The communication protocol ensures data is transmitted securely. ||| All staff must follow the safety protocol in case of fire. ||| Diplomatic protocol requires formal attire at the meeting.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 通信协议确保数据安全传输。 ||| 所有员工在火灾时必须遵守安全协议。 ||| 外交礼仪要求会议着正装。

ieltsWords.definition: 提供；供应
ieltsWords.collocations: provide service 提供服务, provide information 提供信息, provide support 提供支持
ieltsWords.example: The company provides excellent customer service. ||| The website provides detailed information about the product. ||| Parents should provide emotional support to their children.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司提供优质的客户服务。 ||| 网站提供关于产品的详细信息。 ||| 父母应该给孩子提供情感支持。

ieltsWords.definition: 激起；引发
ieltsWords.collocations: provoke debate 引发辩论, provoke anger 激起愤怒, provoke a reaction 引起反应
ieltsWords.example: The controversial statement provoked a heated debate. ||| His rude behavior provoked anger among the crowd. ||| The policy change may provoke a strong reaction from the public.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个有争议的声明引发了激烈的辩论。 ||| 他的粗鲁行为激起了人群的愤怒。 ||| 政策变化可能引起公众的强烈反应。

ieltsWords.definition: 出版；发表
ieltsWords.collocations: publish a book 出版一本书, publish an article 发表文章, publish results 公布结果
ieltsWords.example: She plans to publish her first novel next year. ||| The scientist published an article in a prestigious journal. ||| The company will publish the financial results next week.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她计划明年出版她的第一部小说。 ||| 这位科学家在一家知名期刊上发表了一篇文章。 ||| 公司将于下周公布财务结果。

ieltsWords.definition: 购买；采购
ieltsWords.collocations: purchase goods 购买商品, make a purchase 进行购买, purchase price 购买价格
ieltsWords.example: You can purchase tickets online or at the box office. ||| She made a large purchase of furniture for her new house. ||| The purchase price includes delivery and installation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你可以在网上或售票处购买门票。 ||| 她为新家购买了大量家具。 ||| 购买价格包括送货和安装。

ieltsWords.definition: 追求；追赶；从事
ieltsWords.collocations: pursue a career 追求事业, pursue a goal 追求目标, pursue an interest 追求兴趣
ieltsWords.example: She decided to pursue a career in medicine. ||| He is pursuing his goal of becoming a professional musician. ||| Many people pursue their interests in their free time.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她决定从事医学事业。 ||| 他正在追求成为专业音乐家的目标。 ||| 许多人在空闲时间追求自己的兴趣。

ieltsWords.definition: 使合格；具备资格
ieltsWords.collocations: qualify for 有资格获得, qualify as 有资格成为, qualifying exam 资格考试
ieltsWords.example: You need to pass the exam to qualify for the scholarship. ||| She qualified as a doctor after years of training. ||| The qualifying exam is very challenging.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你需要通过考试才有资格获得奖学金。 ||| 经过多年的培训，她获得了医生资格。 ||| 资格考试非常具有挑战性。

ieltsWords.definition: 数量；大量
ieltsWords.collocations: large quantity 大量, quantity of 一定数量的, in quantity 大量地
ieltsWords.example: A large quantity of food was donated to the shelter. ||| The quantity of water in the reservoir is decreasing. ||| They buy goods in quantity to get a discount.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大量食物被捐赠给了收容所。 ||| 水库中的水量正在减少。 ||| 他们大量购买商品以获得折扣。

ieltsWords.definition: 根本的；激进的
ieltsWords.collocations: radical change 根本变化, radical reform 彻底改革, radical idea 激进想法
ieltsWords.example: The government proposed a radical reform of the tax system. ||| His radical views on education sparked a heated debate. ||| There is a radical difference between the two approaches.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府提出了税制的彻底改革。 ||| 他对教育的激进观点引发了激烈辩论。 ||| 这两种方法之间存在根本差异。

ieltsWords.definition: 范围；幅度；(在一定范围内)变化
ieltsWords.collocations: wide range 广泛范围, price range 价格范围, age range 年龄范围
ieltsWords.example: The store offers a wide range of products. ||| The temperature range in this region is quite narrow. ||| The study covers a range of topics from economics to sociology.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家商店提供种类繁多的产品。 ||| 这个地区的温度范围相当狭窄。 ||| 这项研究涵盖了从经济学到社会学的一系列主题。

ieltsWords.definition: 迅速的；快速的
ieltsWords.collocations: rapid growth 快速增长, rapid change 迅速变化, rapid response 快速反应
ieltsWords.example: The city has experienced rapid economic growth in recent years. ||| Rapid technological change has transformed the workplace. ||| The ambulance made a rapid response to the emergency call.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该市近年来经历了快速的经济增长。 ||| 快速的技术变革改变了工作场所。 ||| 救护车对紧急呼叫做出了快速反应。

ieltsWords.definition: 理性的；合理的
ieltsWords.collocations: rational decision 理性决策, rational explanation 合理解释, rational thinking 理性思考
ieltsWords.example: It is important to make rational decisions based on facts. ||| He gave a rational explanation for his behavior. ||| Rational thinking is essential for solving complex problems.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 基于事实做出理性决策很重要。 ||| 他为自己的行为给出了合理的解释。 ||| 理性思考对于解决复杂问题至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition: 反应；回应
ieltsWords.collocations: react to 对...做出反应, react quickly 迅速反应, react negatively 负面反应
ieltsWords.example: How did the market react to the news? ||| She reacted quickly to avoid the accident. ||| Some people react negatively to stress.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 市场对这一消息有何反应？ ||| 她迅速反应以避免事故。 ||| 有些人对压力有负面反应。

ieltsWords.definition: 现实的；实际的
ieltsWords.collocations: realistic goal 现实目标, realistic expectation 现实期望, realistic approach 现实方法
ieltsWords.example: We need to set realistic goals for the project. ||| It is not realistic to expect immediate results. ||| A realistic approach to budgeting can save money.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要为项目设定现实的目标。 ||| 期望立即得到结果是不现实的。 ||| 现实的预算方法可以省钱。

ieltsWords.definition: 经济衰退
ieltsWords.collocations: economic recession 经济衰退, global recession 全球衰退, severe recession 严重衰退
ieltsWords.example: The country is currently in a deep recession. ||| Many businesses closed during the recession. ||| The government implemented policies to combat the recession.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该国目前处于严重的经济衰退中。 ||| 许多企业在经济衰退期间倒闭了。 ||| 政府实施了应对经济衰退的政策。

ieltsWords.definition: 识别；认可；承认
ieltsWords.collocations: gain recognition 获得认可, facial recognition 面部识别, international recognition 国际认可
ieltsWords.example: She gained recognition for her outstanding work. ||| Facial recognition technology is widely used in security systems. ||| The artist received international recognition for his paintings.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她因出色的工作获得了认可。 ||| 面部识别技术广泛应用于安全系统。 ||| 这位艺术家的画作获得了国际认可。

ieltsWords.definition: 推荐；建议
ieltsWords.collocations: recommend doing 建议做, recommend sb to do 建议某人做, highly recommend 强烈推荐
ieltsWords.example: I recommend reading this book before the exam. ||| The doctor recommended that he take more exercise. ||| This restaurant is highly recommended by locals.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我建议考试前读这本书。 ||| 医生建议他多锻炼。 ||| 这家餐厅受到当地人的强烈推荐。

ieltsWords.definition: 恢复；康复
ieltsWords.collocations: recover from 从...恢复, recover quickly 快速恢复, recover losses 挽回损失
ieltsWords.example: It took her a long time to recover from the illness. ||| The economy is expected to recover next year. ||| The company managed to recover its losses.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她花了很长时间才从疾病中恢复。 ||| 预计经济明年将复苏。 ||| 公司设法挽回了损失。

ieltsWords.definition: 提及；参考
ieltsWords.collocations: refer to 参考；提及, refer to as 被称为, refer sb to 让某人参考
ieltsWords.example: Please refer to the manual for instructions. ||| He referred to the incident in his speech. ||| This term refers to a specific type of behavior.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请参考手册中的说明。 ||| 他在演讲中提到了这一事件。 ||| 这个术语指的是特定类型的行为。

ieltsWords.definition: 反映；反射；思考
ieltsWords.collocations: reflect on 思考, reflect light 反射光, reflect the fact 反映事实
ieltsWords.example: The results reflect the hard work of the team. ||| The mirror reflects light. ||| We need to reflect on our past mistakes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 结果反映了团队的努力工作。 ||| 镜子反射光线。 ||| 我们需要反思过去的错误。

ieltsWords.definition: 改革；革新
ieltsWords.collocations: economic reform 经济改革, political reform 政治改革, education reform 教育改革
ieltsWords.example: The government introduced a series of economic reforms. ||| Political reform is necessary for the country's development. ||| Education reform aims to improve the quality of teaching.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府推出了一系列经济改革。 ||| 政治改革对国家发展是必要的。 ||| 教育改革旨在提高教学质量。

ieltsWords.definition: 不管；无论如何
ieltsWords.collocations: regardless of 不管；不顾, regardless of cost 不惜代价, regardless of age 不论年龄
ieltsWords.example: He continued with his plan regardless of the risks. ||| Everyone is welcome regardless of age or gender. ||| She pursued her dream regardless of the difficulties.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他不顾风险继续执行计划。 ||| 不论年龄或性别，每个人都欢迎。 ||| 她不顾困难追求自己的梦想。

ieltsWords.definition: 地区；区域
ieltsWords.collocations: coastal region 沿海地区, mountainous region 山区, economic region 经济区
ieltsWords.example: This region is known for its beautiful scenery. ||| The coastal region attracts many tourists. ||| The government is developing the economic region.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个地区以其美丽的风景而闻名。 ||| 沿海地区吸引了许多游客。 ||| 政府正在开发这个经济区。

ieltsWords.definition: 登记；注册
ieltsWords.collocations: register for 注册, register a complaint 提出投诉, registered mail 挂号信
ieltsWords.example: You need to register for the course online. ||| She registered a complaint with the manager. ||| I sent the document by registered mail.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你需要在网上注册这门课程。 ||| 她向经理提出了投诉。 ||| 我通过挂号信寄出了文件。

ieltsWords.definition: 调节；管理；控制
ieltsWords.collocations: regulate the market 调节市场, regulate temperature 调节温度, regulate behavior 规范行为
ieltsWords.example: The government regulates the financial market. ||| This device regulates the temperature automatically. ||| Laws are needed to regulate online behavior.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府监管金融市场。 ||| 这个设备自动调节温度。 ||| 需要法律来规范网络行为。

ieltsWords.definition: 加强；强化
ieltsWords.collocations: reinforce the idea 强化观点, reinforce the structure 加固结构, reinforce learning 巩固学习
ieltsWords.example: The evidence reinforces the need for action. ||| The bridge was reinforced with steel beams. ||| Practice reinforces what you have learned.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 证据强化了采取行动的必要性。 ||| 桥梁用钢梁加固了。 ||| 练习巩固了你所学的内容。

ieltsWords.definition: 拒绝；排斥
ieltsWords.collocations: reject an offer 拒绝提议, reject a proposal 驳回提案, reject an idea 拒绝想法
ieltsWords.example: The committee rejected the proposal. ||| She rejected his offer of help. ||| The body may reject a transplanted organ.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 委员会驳回了该提案。 ||| 她拒绝了他的帮助提议。 ||| 身体可能会排斥移植的器官。

ieltsWords.definition: 有关；涉及；产生共鸣
ieltsWords.collocations: relate to 与...相关, relate a story 讲述故事, be related to 与...有关
ieltsWords.example: The findings relate to the previous study. ||| He related the events of the day. ||| Stress is related to many health problems.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这些发现与之前的研究相关。 ||| 他讲述了当天的事件。 ||| 压力与许多健康问题有关。

ieltsWords.definition: 释放；发布；发行
ieltsWords.collocations: release a statement 发布声明, release a product 发布产品, release energy 释放能量
ieltsWords.example: The company will release its new software next month. ||| The prisoner was released after serving five years. ||| He released his grip on the rope.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司将于下个月发布其新软件。 ||| 这名囚犯在服刑五年后被释放。 ||| 他松开了抓住绳子的手。

ieltsWords.definition: 相关的；切题的
ieltsWords.collocations: relevant information 相关信息, relevant experience 相关经验, relevant to the topic 与主题相关
ieltsWords.example: Please provide all relevant documents for the application. ||| His comments were not relevant to the discussion. ||| The course covers topics relevant to modern business.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请提供申请所需的所有相关文件。 ||| 他的评论与讨论无关。 ||| 这门课程涵盖与现代商业相关的主题。

ieltsWords.definition: 不情愿的；勉强的
ieltsWords.collocations: reluctant to accept 不愿接受, reluctant agreement 勉强同意, reluctant participant 不情愿的参与者
ieltsWords.example: She was reluctant to leave her hometown. ||| He gave a reluctant smile. ||| Many students are reluctant to ask questions in class.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她不愿离开家乡。 ||| 他勉强笑了笑。 ||| 许多学生不愿在课堂上提问。

ieltsWords.definition: 依赖；信赖
ieltsWords.collocations: rely on someone 依赖某人, rely on something 依靠某物, rely heavily on 严重依赖
ieltsWords.example: You can rely on her to finish the task on time. ||| Many countries rely on tourism for income. ||| He relies too heavily on his parents for support.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你可以信赖她能按时完成任务。 ||| 许多国家依赖旅游业获取收入。 ||| 他过度依赖父母的支持。

ieltsWords.definition: 保持；留下
ieltsWords.collocations: remain unchanged 保持不变, remain calm 保持冷静, remain in place 留在原地
ieltsWords.example: The weather will remain sunny for the next few days. ||| Please remain seated until the bus stops. ||| Only a few questions remain unanswered.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 未来几天天气将持续晴朗。 ||| 请保持坐姿直到公交车停稳。 ||| 只有几个问题仍未解答。

ieltsWords.definition: 评论；提及
ieltsWords.collocations: make a remark 发表评论, passing remark 随口说的话, critical remark 批评性言论
ieltsWords.example: His remark about the project was very insightful. ||| She made a rude remark that offended everyone. ||| The teacher's remarks helped me improve my essay.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他对这个项目的评论非常有见地。 ||| 她说了句粗鲁的话，冒犯了所有人。 ||| 老师的评语帮助我改进了文章。

ieltsWords.definition: 补救；治疗
ieltsWords.collocations: effective remedy 有效疗法, home remedy 家庭疗法, legal remedy 法律补救措施
ieltsWords.example: Honey is a natural remedy for a sore throat. ||| The government is seeking a remedy for the economic crisis. ||| There is no quick remedy for this problem.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 蜂蜜是治疗喉咙痛的自然疗法。 ||| 政府正在寻求应对经济危机的补救措施。 ||| 这个问题没有快速的解决方法。

ieltsWords.definition: 偏僻的；遥远的；远程的
ieltsWords.collocations: remote area 偏远地区, remote control 遥控器, remote possibility 微小的可能性
ieltsWords.example: They live in a remote village in the mountains. ||| There is a remote chance of rain today. ||| He seemed remote and uninterested in the conversation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们住在山区的一个偏远村庄里。 ||| 今天下雨的可能性很小。 ||| 他显得很疏远，对谈话不感兴趣。

ieltsWords.definition: 移除；去掉
ieltsWords.collocations: remove obstacles 移除障碍, remove stains 去除污渍, remove from office 免职
ieltsWords.example: Please remove your shoes before entering the house. ||| The new policy aims to remove barriers to trade. ||| He was removed from his position due to misconduct.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 进屋前请脱鞋。 ||| 新政策旨在消除贸易壁垒。 ||| 他因行为不当被免职。

ieltsWords.definition: 更新；续约
ieltsWords.collocations: renew a contract 续签合同, renew a license 更新执照, renew energy 恢复精力
ieltsWords.example: I need to renew my passport before the trip. ||| They decided to renew their friendship after years apart. ||| The company renewed its commitment to environmental protection.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 旅行前我需要更新护照。 ||| 他们决定在多年分离后重续友谊。 ||| 公司重申了对环境保护的承诺。

ieltsWords.definition: 替换；代替
ieltsWords.collocations: replace with 用...替换, replace a part 更换零件, replace someone 替代某人
ieltsWords.example: We need to replace the old computer with a new one. ||| She was chosen to replace the retiring manager. ||| Please replace the books on the shelf after reading.
