ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要用新电脑替换旧电脑。 ||| 她被选来接替即将退休的经理。 ||| 阅读后请把书放回书架上。

ieltsWords.definition: 代表；表示
ieltsWords.collocations: represent a company 代表公司, represent an idea 代表一种想法, represent a country 代表国家
ieltsWords.example: The lawyer will represent the client in court. ||| The dove represents peace in many cultures. ||| This graph represents the sales data for the last quarter.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 律师将在法庭上代表客户。 ||| 在许多文化中，鸽子象征和平。 ||| 这张图表示上个季度的销售数据。

ieltsWords.definition: 名誉；声誉
ieltsWords.collocations: good reputation 良好声誉, bad reputation 坏名声, build a reputation 建立声誉
ieltsWords.example: The company has a reputation for high-quality products. ||| His reputation was damaged by the scandal. ||| She earned a reputation as a hardworking employee.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家公司以高质量产品闻名。 ||| 他的声誉因丑闻受损。 ||| 她赢得了勤奋员工的名声。

ieltsWords.definition: 请求；要求
ieltsWords.collocations: make a request 提出请求, request for information 信息请求, formal request 正式请求
ieltsWords.example: She submitted a request for a leave of absence. ||| The customer made a request for a refund. ||| We received many requests for more information.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她提交了请假申请。 ||| 客户要求退款。 ||| 我们收到了许多要求提供更多信息的请求。

ieltsWords.definition: 需要；要求
ieltsWords.collocations: require attention 需要关注, require approval 需要批准, require effort 需要努力
ieltsWords.example: This job requires a lot of patience. ||| All students are required to attend the meeting. ||| The situation requires immediate action.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这份工作需要极大的耐心。 ||| 所有学生都必须参加会议。 ||| 这种情况需要立即采取行动。

ieltsWords.definition: 类似；相像
ieltsWords.collocations: resemble someone 像某人, closely resemble 非常相似, resemble in appearance 在外观上相似
ieltsWords.example: She resembles her mother in many ways. ||| The two buildings closely resemble each other. ||| His painting resembles a photograph in its detail.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在许多方面像她母亲。 ||| 这两栋建筑非常相似。 ||| 他的画在细节上像照片一样。

ieltsWords.definition: 保留；预订
ieltsWords.collocations: reserve a table 预订餐桌, reserve the right 保留权利, reserve funds 储备资金
ieltsWords.example: I'd like to reserve a room for two nights. ||| The company reserves the right to change the terms. ||| We need to reserve some money for emergencies.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我想预订一个房间住两晚。 ||| 公司保留更改条款的权利。 ||| 我们需要留一些钱以备紧急情况。

ieltsWords.definition: 居住；存在
ieltsWords.collocations: reside in 居住在, reside abroad 居住在国外, reside at an address 住在某地址
ieltsWords.example: The family resides in a small town in the countryside. ||| The power to make decisions resides with the board. ||| He has resided in this city for over twenty years.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家人住在乡村的一个小镇上。 ||| 决策权属于董事会。 ||| 他已经在这个城市居住了二十多年。

ieltsWords.definition: 辞职；放弃
ieltsWords.collocations: resign from a job 辞职, resign as manager 辞去经理职务, resign oneself to 顺从于
ieltsWords.example: She decided to resign from her position due to stress. ||| He resigned as chairman of the committee. ||| They resigned themselves to the fact that they had lost.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她因压力决定辞职。 ||| 他辞去了委员会主席的职务。 ||| 他们只好接受失败的事实。

ieltsWords.definition: 抵抗；阻力；免疫力
ieltsWords.collocations: meet resistance 遇到抵抗, resistance to change 对变革的抵制, electrical resistance 电阻
ieltsWords.example: The proposal met with strong resistance from the staff. ||| The army offered little resistance to the enemy. ||| Copper has low electrical resistance.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该提议遭到了员工的强烈抵制。 ||| 军队对敌人几乎没有抵抗。 ||| 铜的电阻很低。

ieltsWords.definition: 决议；决心；分辨率
ieltsWords.collocations: pass a resolution 通过决议, conflict resolution 冲突解决, high resolution 高分辨率, New Year's resolution 新年决心
ieltsWords.example: The committee passed a resolution to increase funding for education. ||| Mediation is often used for conflict resolution in the workplace. ||| The camera's high resolution allows for clear and detailed images.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 委员会通过了一项增加教育经费的决议。 ||| 调解常用于解决工作场所的冲突。 ||| 相机的高分辨率可以拍摄清晰细致的图像。

ieltsWords.definition: 解决；决心
ieltsWords.collocations: resolve a problem 解决问题, resolve to do sth 决心做某事, resolve differences 消除分歧
ieltsWords.example: The government is trying to resolve the housing crisis. ||| She resolved to study harder after failing the exam. ||| The two countries resolved their differences through negotiation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府正试图解决住房危机。 ||| 考试失败后，她决心更加努力学习。 ||| 两国通过谈判消除了分歧。

ieltsWords.definition: 资源
ieltsWords.collocations: natural resources 自然资源, human resources 人力资源, resource management 资源管理, limited resources 有限的资源
ieltsWords.example: The country is rich in natural resources like oil and gas. ||| Effective resource management is crucial for business success. ||| We must use our limited resources wisely.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个国家拥有丰富的石油和天然气等自然资源。 ||| 有效的资源管理对企业成功至关重要。 ||| 我们必须明智地使用有限的资源。

ieltsWords.definition: 回应；反应
ieltsWords.collocations: respond to a question 回答问题, respond quickly 迅速回应, respond to treatment 对治疗有反应
ieltsWords.example: Please respond to the invitation by Friday. ||| The fire department responded quickly to the emergency call. ||| The patient is responding well to the new medication.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请在周五前回复邀请。 ||| 消防部门迅速响应了紧急呼叫。 ||| 患者对新药物反应良好。

ieltsWords.definition: 恢复；修复
ieltsWords.collocations: restore order 恢复秩序, restore confidence 恢复信心, restore a building 修复建筑, restore health 恢复健康
ieltsWords.example: The police worked to restore order after the protest. ||| The government took measures to restore public confidence in the economy. ||| The historic building was carefully restored to its original condition.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方在抗议后努力恢复秩序。 ||| 政府采取措施恢复公众对经济的信心。 ||| 这座历史建筑被精心修复到原状。

ieltsWords.definition: 限制；约束
ieltsWords.collocations: restrict access 限制访问, restrict movement 限制行动, restrict to 限于, be restricted by 受...限制
ieltsWords.example: The new law restricts the use of plastic bags. ||| Access to the building is restricted to employees only. ||| The government restricted movement during the pandemic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新法律限制塑料袋的使用。 ||| 该建筑仅限员工进入。 ||| 政府在疫情期间限制了人员流动。

ieltsWords.definition: 保留；保持
ieltsWords.collocations: retain information 记住信息, retain employees 留住员工, retain control 保持控制, retain water 保持水分
ieltsWords.example: It is important to retain key employees in a competitive market. ||| Students who review regularly retain information better. ||| The company managed to retain control of the project.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在竞争激烈的市场中留住关键员工很重要。 ||| 定期复习的学生能更好地记住信息。 ||| 公司设法保持了对项目的控制。

ieltsWords.definition: 揭示；揭露
ieltsWords.collocations: reveal a secret 揭露秘密, reveal details 透露细节, reveal the truth 揭示真相, reveal itself 显现
ieltsWords.example: The investigation revealed shocking details about the accident. ||| She refused to reveal the source of her information. ||| The test results revealed a serious problem with the system.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 调查揭示了事故的惊人细节。 ||| 她拒绝透露信息来源。 ||| 测试结果揭示了系统的一个严重问题。

ieltsWords.definition: 收入；税收
ieltsWords.collocations: tax revenue 税收, annual revenue 年收入, generate revenue 产生收入, revenue growth 收入增长
ieltsWords.example: The company's annual revenue exceeded $1 billion. ||| The government relies heavily on tax revenue to fund public services. ||| New products are expected to generate significant revenue.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司的年收入超过10亿美元。 ||| 政府严重依赖税收来资助公共服务。 ||| 新产品预计将产生可观的收入。

ieltsWords.definition: 逆转；颠倒
ieltsWords.collocations: reverse a decision 撤销决定, reverse the trend 逆转趋势, in reverse 相反地, reverse gear 倒车档
ieltsWords.example: The court reversed the previous decision. ||| The government took steps to reverse the economic decline. ||| Put the car in reverse and back up slowly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 法院撤销了先前的判决。 ||| 政府采取措施逆转经济衰退。 ||| 挂倒车档，慢慢倒车。

ieltsWords.definition: 修订；修改；复习
ieltsWords.collocations: revise a plan 修改计划, revise an essay 修改文章, revise for an exam 复习备考, revised edition 修订版
ieltsWords.example: The author revised the manuscript before publication. ||| We need to revise our budget to reflect the new costs. ||| She spent the weekend revising for her final exams.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 作者在出版前修订了手稿。 ||| 我们需要修改预算以反映新成本。 ||| 她周末都在复习期末考试。

ieltsWords.definition: 革命；变革
ieltsWords.collocations: industrial revolution 工业革命, technological revolution 技术革命, cultural revolution 文化革命, revolution per minute 每分钟转数
ieltsWords.example: The Industrial Revolution transformed society in the 18th century. ||| The digital revolution has changed the way we communicate. ||| The engine operates at 3000 revolutions per minute.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 工业革命在18世纪改变了社会。 ||| 数字革命改变了我们的交流方式。 ||| 发动机以每分钟3000转的速度运转。

ieltsWords.definition: 风险；危险
ieltsWords.collocations: take a risk 冒险, risk management 风险管理, at risk 处于风险中, health risk 健康风险
ieltsWords.example: Investing in stocks involves a certain amount of risk. ||| He risked his life to save the drowning child. ||| Smoking is a major health risk.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 投资股票涉及一定的风险。 ||| 他冒着生命危险去救溺水的孩子。 ||| 吸烟是一个主要的健康风险。

ieltsWords.definition: 对手；竞争的
ieltsWords.collocations: rival company 竞争对手公司, rival team 对手队伍, without rival 无与伦比, rival in 在...方面相匹敌
ieltsWords.example: The two companies are fierce rivals in the smartphone market. ||| No other city can rival Paris in terms of romance. ||| The rival teams faced off in the final match.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两家公司在智能手机市场是激烈的竞争对手。 ||| 没有其他城市在浪漫方面能与巴黎匹敌。 ||| 两支对手队伍在决赛中交锋。

ieltsWords.definition: 路线；路径
ieltsWords.collocations: bus route 公交线路, trade route 贸易路线, route map 路线图, en route 在途中
ieltsWords.example: The bus route passes through the city center. ||| The Silk Road was an ancient trade route connecting East and West. ||| We are en route to the airport.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这条公交线路经过市中心。 ||| 丝绸之路是连接东西方的古老贸易路线。 ||| 我们正在去机场的路上。

ieltsWords.definition: 满足；使满意
ieltsWords.collocations: satisfy a need 满足需求, satisfy customers 使顾客满意, satisfy requirements 符合要求, satisfy curiosity 满足好奇心
ieltsWords.example: The company aims to satisfy its customers' needs. ||| The meal satisfied my hunger completely. ||| The product does not satisfy safety requirements.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司旨在满足客户的需求。 ||| 这顿饭完全满足了我的饥饿感。 ||| 该产品不符合安全要求。

ieltsWords.definition: 规模；刻度；攀登
ieltsWords.collocations: on a large scale 大规模地, scale up 扩大规模, pay scale 工资等级, scale a mountain 攀登高山
ieltsWords.example: The project was carried out on a large scale. ||| The company plans to scale up production next year. ||| The map has a scale of 1:100,000.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该项目大规模进行。 ||| 公司计划明年扩大生产规模。 ||| 这张地图的比例尺是1:100,000。

ieltsWords.definition: 时间表；日程
ieltsWords.collocations: on schedule 按时, ahead of schedule 提前, behind schedule 落后于计划, flight schedule 航班时刻表
ieltsWords.example: The project is on schedule and will be completed by June. ||| We need to schedule a meeting for next week. ||| The train arrived ahead of schedule.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 项目按计划进行，将在六月前完成。 ||| 我们需要安排下周的会议。 ||| 火车提前到达。

ieltsWords.definition: 方案；计划；体系
ieltsWords.collocations: pension scheme 养老金计划, color scheme 配色方案, scheme to do sth 策划做某事, marketing scheme 营销方案
ieltsWords.example: The government introduced a new pension scheme. ||| The color scheme of the room is blue and white. ||| They schemed to overthrow the government.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府推出了一项新的养老金计划。 ||| 房间的配色方案是蓝白相间。 ||| 他们策划推翻政府。

ieltsWords.definition: 部分；区域；章节
ieltsWords.collocations: cross section 横截面, sports section 体育版, section of society 社会阶层, section off 分隔开
ieltsWords.example: The report is divided into three main sections. ||| The library has a separate section for children's books. ||| The cross section of the pipe shows its internal structure.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 报告分为三个主要部分。 ||| 图书馆有一个单独的儿童图书区。 ||| 管道的横截面显示了其内部结构。

ieltsWords.definition: 部门；领域；行业
ieltsWords.collocations: private sector 私营部门, public sector 公共部门, financial sector 金融领域
ieltsWords.example: The government plans to invest more in the healthcare sector. ||| Employment in the manufacturing sector has declined. ||| The city is divided into several sectors for administrative purposes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府计划在医疗保健领域投入更多资金。 ||| 制造业的就业率下降了。 ||| 该市为行政目的划分为几个区域。

ieltsWords.definition: 安全的；获得；保护
ieltsWords.collocations: secure a job 获得工作, secure data 保护数据, feel secure 感到安全
ieltsWords.example: She managed to secure a scholarship to study abroad. ||| It is important to secure your personal information online. ||| The building is equipped with a secure entry system.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她成功获得了出国留学的奖学金。 ||| 保护在线个人信息很重要。 ||| 该建筑配备了安全的入口系统。

ieltsWords.definition: 寻求；寻找
ieltsWords.collocations: seek advice 寻求建议, seek employment 找工作, seek permission 请求许可
ieltsWords.example: Many graduates seek employment in large corporations. ||| The organization seeks to promote environmental awareness. ||| You should seek professional help if symptoms persist.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多毕业生在大公司寻找就业机会。 ||| 该组织旨在提高环保意识。 ||| 如果症状持续，应寻求专业帮助。

ieltsWords.definition: 部分；片段；分割
ieltsWords.collocations: market segment 细分市场, segment of society 社会阶层, segment the audience 细分受众
ieltsWords.example: The company targets a specific market segment. ||| The documentary covers a segment of history rarely discussed. ||| We need to segment the data for better analysis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司针对特定的细分市场。 ||| 这部纪录片涵盖了很少被讨论的一段历史。 ||| 我们需要对数据进行分割以便更好地分析。

ieltsWords.definition: 选择；挑选
ieltsWords.collocations: select a candidate 选择候选人, select carefully 仔细挑选, select few 少数精选
ieltsWords.example: The committee will select the best proposal. ||| Only a select group of students were invited to the event. ||| You can select from a range of options.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 委员会将选出最佳提案。 ||| 只有少数精选的学生受邀参加活动。 ||| 你可以从一系列选项中进行选择。

ieltsWords.definition: 序列；顺序
ieltsWords.collocations: in sequence 按顺序, sequence of events 事件顺序, DNA sequence DNA序列
ieltsWords.example: The steps must be followed in the correct sequence. ||| The sequence of events led to a major crisis. ||| Scientists sequenced the entire genome.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 必须按照正确的顺序执行步骤。 ||| 事件的顺序导致了一场重大危机。 ||| 科学家们对整个基因组进行了测序。

ieltsWords.definition: 系列；连续
ieltsWords.collocations: a series of 一系列, TV series 电视剧, series of experiments 系列实验
ieltsWords.example: The university offers a series of lectures on climate change. ||| She is watching a popular TV series. ||| A series of accidents prompted a safety review.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该大学提供一系列关于气候变化的讲座。 ||| 她正在看一部热门电视剧。 ||| 一系列事故引发了安全审查。

ieltsWords.definition: 严重的；剧烈的
ieltsWords.collocations: severe weather 恶劣天气, severe pain 剧痛, severe punishment 严厉惩罚
ieltsWords.example: The region experienced severe flooding last year. ||| He received a severe sentence for the crime. ||| The patient is in severe condition after the surgery.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该地区去年遭遇了严重洪灾。 ||| 他因犯罪被判处重刑。 ||| 手术后病人情况严重。

ieltsWords.definition: 转移；转变；轮班
ieltsWords.collocations: shift focus 转移焦点, shift work 轮班工作, paradigm shift 范式转变
ieltsWords.example: The company shifted its focus to online sales. ||| He works the night shift at the factory. ||| There has been a significant shift in public opinion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司将重心转向在线销售。 ||| 他在工厂上夜班。 ||| 公众舆论发生了重大转变。

ieltsWords.definition: 重要的；显著的
ieltsWords.collocations: significant impact 重大影响, significant difference 显著差异, significant progress 重大进展
ieltsWords.example: The new policy had a significant impact on the economy. ||| There is a significant difference between the two groups. ||| She made significant progress in her research.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新政策对经济产生了重大影响。 ||| 两组之间存在显著差异。 ||| 她的研究取得了重大进展。

ieltsWords.definition: 相似的；类似的
ieltsWords.collocations: similar to 与……相似, similar results 类似结果, similar situation 类似情况
ieltsWords.example: The two cultures have similar traditions. ||| The experiment yielded similar results each time. ||| We are facing a similar situation now.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两种文化有相似的传统。 ||| 实验每次都得出了类似的结果。 ||| 我们现在面临着类似的情况。

ieltsWords.definition: 模拟；模仿
ieltsWords.collocations: simulate conditions 模拟条件, simulate a scenario 模拟场景, computer simulation 计算机模拟
ieltsWords.example: The software can simulate real-world driving conditions. ||| The training uses virtual reality to simulate emergencies. ||| They simulated the effects of climate change on crops.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该软件可以模拟真实驾驶条件。 ||| 培训使用虚拟现实模拟紧急情况。 ||| 他们模拟了气候变化对农作物的影响。

ieltsWords.definition: 复杂的；精密的
ieltsWords.collocations: sophisticated technology 精密技术, sophisticated system 复杂系统, sophisticated taste 高雅品味
ieltsWords.example: The device uses sophisticated technology to detect pollutants. ||| She has a sophisticated understanding of the subject. ||| The attack was carried out by a sophisticated network.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该设备使用精密技术检测污染物。 ||| 她对这门学科有深刻的理解。 ||| 这次攻击是由一个复杂的网络实施的。

ieltsWords.definition: 来源；源头
ieltsWords.collocations: source of energy 能源, source of information 信息来源, reliable source 可靠来源
ieltsWords.example: Renewable energy sources are becoming more important. ||| The journalist refused to reveal her source. ||| We need to source materials locally.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 可再生能源变得越来越重要。 ||| 记者拒绝透露她的消息来源。 ||| 我们需要在当地采购材料。

ieltsWords.definition: 具体的；特定的
ieltsWords.collocations: specific purpose 特定目的, specific requirements 具体要求, specific area 特定领域
ieltsWords.example: The instructions are very specific about the procedure. ||| He has a specific interest in ancient history. ||| The grant is for a specific research project.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 说明对程序非常具体。 ||| 他对古代史有特别的兴趣。 ||| 这笔拨款用于一个特定的研究项目。

ieltsWords.definition: 赞助者；赞助
ieltsWords.collocations: corporate sponsor 企业赞助商, sponsor an event 赞助活动, sponsor a visa 担保签证
ieltsWords.example: The event was sponsored by a major corporation. ||| She found a sponsor for her research project. ||| The company sponsors several local sports teams.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该活动由一家大公司赞助。 ||| 她为研究项目找到了赞助者。 ||| 该公司赞助了几个当地运动队。

ieltsWords.definition: 稳定的；马厩
ieltsWords.collocations: stable economy 稳定经济, stable relationship 稳定关系, stable condition 稳定状况
ieltsWords.example: The country has enjoyed a stable political environment. ||| The patient's condition is now stable. ||| They keep their horses in a stable.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该国享有稳定的政治环境。 ||| 病人的情况现在稳定了。 ||| 他们把马养在马厩里。

ieltsWords.definition: 标准；水准
ieltsWords.collocations: standard of living 生活水平, industry standard 行业标准, standard procedure 标准程序
ieltsWords.example: The company maintains high standards of quality. ||| This is the standard method for testing water purity. ||| Living standards have improved significantly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司保持高质量标准。 ||| 这是测试水纯度的标准方法。 ||| 生活水平显著提高。

ieltsWords.definition: 统计；统计数据
ieltsWords.collocations: statistics show 数据显示, official statistics 官方统计, statistics department 统计部门
ieltsWords.example: Statistics show that crime rates have fallen. ||| She is studying statistics at university. ||| The government released new employment statistics.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 统计数据显示犯罪率下降了。 ||| 她在大学学习统计学。 ||| 政府发布了新的就业统计数据。

ieltsWords.definition: 地位；状态；身份
ieltsWords.collocations: social status 社会地位, current status 当前状态, legal status 法律地位
ieltsWords.example: Her status as a expert is widely recognized. ||| What is the current status of the project? ||| The application status can be checked online.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她作为专家的地位得到广泛认可。 ||| 项目目前的状态如何？ ||| 申请状态可以在线查询。

ieltsWords.definition: 战略的；策略性的
ieltsWords.collocations: strategic planning 战略规划, strategic location 战略位置, strategic decision 战略决策
ieltsWords.example: The company made a strategic decision to expand into emerging markets. ||| The bridge is of strategic importance for the region's transportation. ||| Strategic thinking is essential for long-term success in business.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司做出了向新兴市场扩张的战略决策。 ||| 这座桥对该地区的交通具有战略重要性。 ||| 战略思维对商业长期成功至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition: 压力；强调
ieltsWords.collocations: under stress 处于压力下, stress management 压力管理, lay stress on 强调
ieltsWords.example: Many students suffer from stress during exam periods. ||| The teacher stressed the importance of regular practice. ||| In English, the stress often falls on the first syllable.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多学生在考试期间承受压力。 ||| 老师强调了定期练习的重要性。 ||| 英语中，重音通常落在第一个音节上。

ieltsWords.definition: 结构；构造；组织
ieltsWords.collocations: organizational structure 组织结构, sentence structure 句子结构, structure a plan 制定计划
ieltsWords.example: The building's structure was damaged in the earthquake. ||| The essay lacks a clear structure, making it hard to follow. ||| They structured the project to meet tight deadlines.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 建筑物的结构在地震中受损。 ||| 这篇文章缺乏清晰的结构，难以理解。 ||| 他们安排了项目以满足紧迫的截止日期。

ieltsWords.definition: 奋斗；挣扎；斗争
ieltsWords.collocations: struggle with 与...斗争, struggle for 为...奋斗, power struggle 权力斗争
ieltsWords.example: Many immigrants struggle to adapt to a new culture. ||| The team struggled to finish the project on time. ||| The struggle for equality continues in many societies.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多移民努力适应新文化。 ||| 团队努力按时完成项目。 ||| 争取平等的斗争在许多社会持续进行。

ieltsWords.definition: 提交；呈递；服从
ieltsWords.collocations: submit an application 提交申请, submit to authority 服从权威, submit a proposal 提交提案
ieltsWords.example: Applicants must submit their documents before the deadline. ||| He refused to submit to unfair treatment. ||| The lawyer submitted that the evidence was insufficient.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 申请人必须在截止日期前提交文件。 ||| 他拒绝屈服于不公平的待遇。 ||| 律师主张证据不足。

ieltsWords.definition: 随后的
ieltsWords.collocations: subsequent events 随后的事件, subsequent generations 后代, subsequent to 在...之后
ieltsWords.example: The initial findings were confirmed by subsequent research. ||| Subsequent to the meeting, a report was issued. ||| The policy had a significant impact on subsequent economic growth.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 初步发现被随后的研究证实。 ||| 会议之后，发布了一份报告。 ||| 该政策对随后的经济增长产生了重大影响。

ieltsWords.definition: 补贴；津贴
ieltsWords.collocations: government subsidy 政府补贴, agricultural subsidy 农业补贴, housing subsidy 住房补贴
ieltsWords.example: The government provides subsidies to low-income families. ||| Farmers rely on subsidies to maintain their livelihoods. ||| The subsidy for renewable energy has been increased.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府向低收入家庭提供补贴。 ||| 农民依赖补贴维持生计。 ||| 可再生能源的补贴已经增加。

ieltsWords.definition: 物质；实质；内容
ieltsWords.collocations: chemical substance 化学物质, in substance 实质上, substance abuse 药物滥用
ieltsWords.example: The substance of the argument was difficult to grasp. ||| This substance is harmful to the environment. ||| The report lacks substance and fails to provide new insights.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 争论的实质难以把握。 ||| 这种物质对环境有害。 ||| 报告缺乏实质内容，未能提供新见解。

ieltsWords.definition: 大量的；实质的
ieltsWords.collocations: substantial amount 大量, substantial evidence 实质性证据, substantial improvement 显著改善
ieltsWords.example: The company made a substantial profit this year. ||| There is substantial evidence to support the theory. ||| The building requires substantial repairs.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司今年获得了大量利润。 ||| 有实质性证据支持该理论。 ||| 这栋建筑需要大规模修缮。

ieltsWords.definition: 替代品；替代
ieltsWords.collocations: substitute for 替代, substitute teacher 代课老师, a substitute product 替代产品
ieltsWords.example: You can use honey as a substitute for sugar. ||| The coach substituted the injured player in the second half. ||| There is no substitute for hard work.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。 ||| 教练在下半场替换了受伤的球员。 ||| 没有什么可以替代努力工作。

ieltsWords.definition: 成功；继承
ieltsWords.collocations: succeed in doing 成功做某事, succeed to the throne 继承王位, succeed as 作为...成功
ieltsWords.example: She succeeded in passing the exam with high marks. ||| He succeeded his father as CEO of the company. ||| If at first you don't succeed, try again.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她成功以高分通过了考试。 ||| 他接替父亲成为公司首席执行官。 ||| 如果一开始不成功，再试一次。

ieltsWords.definition: 足够的；充分的
ieltsWords.collocations: sufficient evidence 充分证据, sufficient time 足够时间, sufficient condition 充分条件
ieltsWords.example: We have sufficient resources to complete the project. ||| The investigation found sufficient evidence to charge him. ||| Make sure you get sufficient sleep before the exam.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们有足够的资源完成项目。 ||| 调查发现了足够的证据指控他。 ||| 考试前确保有充足的睡眠。

ieltsWords.definition: 总结；概述
ieltsWords.collocations: summarize the main points 总结要点, briefly summarize 简要概括, summarize a report 总结报告
ieltsWords.example: Can you summarize the article in a few sentences? ||| The conclusion summarizes the key findings of the study. ||| To summarize, the project was a success overall.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你能用几句话总结这篇文章吗？ ||| 结论总结了研究的关键发现。 ||| 总的来说，该项目是成功的。

ieltsWords.definition: 优越的；上司
ieltsWords.collocations: superior quality 优质, superior to 优于, immediate superior 直接上级
ieltsWords.example: This product is superior to its competitors in terms of durability. ||| She reported the issue to her superior. ||| The hotel offers superior service to its guests.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该产品在耐用性方面优于竞争对手。 ||| 她向她的上级报告了这个问题。 ||| 这家酒店为客人提供优质服务。

ieltsWords.definition: 补充；增补
ieltsWords.collocations: dietary supplement 膳食补充剂, supplement income 补充收入, supplement a report 补充报告
ieltsWords.example: Many people take vitamin supplements to improve their health. ||| She works part-time to supplement her income. ||| The appendix supplements the main text with additional data.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多人服用维生素补充剂来改善健康。 ||| 她做兼职以补充收入。 ||| 附录用额外数据补充了正文。

ieltsWords.definition: 供应；提供
ieltsWords.collocations: supply and demand 供需, water supply 供水, supply chain 供应链
ieltsWords.example: The city's water supply was contaminated. ||| The company supplies equipment to hospitals. ||| Supply shortages have driven up prices.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 城市的供水被污染了。 ||| 该公司向医院供应设备。 ||| 供应短缺推高了价格。

ieltsWords.definition: 支持；支援
ieltsWords.collocations: support a family 养家, technical support 技术支持, in support of 支持
ieltsWords.example: The bridge is supported by strong pillars. ||| She works hard to support her family. ||| The proposal received widespread support from the community.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座桥由坚固的柱子支撑。 ||| 她努力工作以养家。 ||| 该提案得到了社区的广泛支持。

ieltsWords.definition: 假设；假定
ieltsWords.collocations: be supposed to 应该, suppose that 假设, I suppose 我想
ieltsWords.example: I suppose you are right about the deadline. ||| We are supposed to submit the report by Friday. ||| Suppose it rains, what will we do?
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我想你在截止日期上是对的。 ||| 我们应该在周五前提交报告。 ||| 假设下雨，我们该怎么办？

ieltsWords.definition: 压制；抑制
ieltsWords.collocations: suppress a rebellion 镇压叛乱, suppress emotions 抑制情绪, suppress information 封锁信息
ieltsWords.example: The government tried to suppress the protest. ||| She suppressed a laugh during the serious meeting. ||| The drug can suppress the immune system.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府试图镇压抗议。 ||| 她在严肃的会议中忍住没笑。 ||| 这种药物会抑制免疫系统。

ieltsWords.definition: 表面；水面；浮出水面
ieltsWords.collocations: on the surface 表面上, surface area 表面积, surface water 地表水
ieltsWords.example: The surface of the lake was calm. ||| New evidence has surfaced in the investigation. ||| On the surface, the plan seems feasible.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 湖面平静。 ||| 调查中出现了新证据。 ||| 表面上，这个计划似乎可行。

ieltsWords.definition: 盈余；过剩
ieltsWords.collocations: trade surplus 贸易顺差, budget surplus 预算盈余, surplus value 剩余价值
ieltsWords.example: The country has a large trade surplus with its neighbors. ||| The government plans to use the budget surplus to fund education. ||| Surplus food was distributed to the homeless.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个国家与邻国有着巨大的贸易顺差。 ||| 政府计划利用预算盈余来资助教育。 ||| 剩余的食物被分发给了无家可归者。

ieltsWords.definition: 投降；放弃
ieltsWords.collocations: surrender to 向...投降, surrender control 放弃控制, surrender oneself 自首
ieltsWords.example: The enemy troops were forced to surrender after a long siege. ||| He refused to surrender his principles for personal gain. ||| The suspect surrendered himself to the police.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 敌军在长期围困后被迫投降。 ||| 他拒绝为了个人利益放弃自己的原则。 ||| 嫌疑犯向警方自首了。

ieltsWords.definition: 包围；环绕
ieltsWords.collocations: surround by 被...包围, surround with 用...环绕, surround sound 环绕立体声
ieltsWords.example: The house is surrounded by a beautiful garden. ||| Police surrounded the building to catch the criminals. ||| She likes to surround herself with positive people.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 房子被一个美丽的花园环绕。 ||| 警察包围了大楼以抓捕罪犯。 ||| 她喜欢让自己周围都是积极的人。

ieltsWords.definition: 调查；测量
ieltsWords.collocations: conduct a survey 进行调查, survey results 调查结果, land survey 土地测量
ieltsWords.example: A recent survey shows that most people support the new policy. ||| The survey of the area revealed valuable archaeological findings. ||| We need to survey the damage caused by the storm.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 最近的一项调查显示，大多数人支持新政策。 ||| 对该地区的勘测揭示了宝贵的考古发现。 ||| 我们需要调查风暴造成的损失。

ieltsWords.definition: 幸存；存活
ieltsWords.collocations: survive on 靠...生存, survive the crisis 度过危机, survive the winter 熬过冬天
ieltsWords.example: Only a few passengers survived the plane crash. ||| Many small businesses struggle to survive in a competitive market. ||| She survived her husband by ten years.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 只有少数乘客在飞机失事中幸存。 ||| 许多小企业在竞争激烈的市场中艰难生存。 ||| 她比她的丈夫多活了十年。

ieltsWords.definition: 怀疑；嫌疑人；可疑的
ieltsWords.collocations: suspect of 怀疑...有罪, suspect that 怀疑..., prime suspect 主要嫌疑人
ieltsWords.example: The police suspect him of stealing the money. ||| I suspect that he is not telling the truth. ||| He is the prime suspect in the murder case.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警察怀疑他偷了钱。 ||| 我怀疑他没有说实话。 ||| 他是这起谋杀案的主要嫌疑人。

ieltsWords.definition: 暂停；悬挂
ieltsWords.collocations: suspend from 从...悬挂, suspend operations 暂停运营, suspend judgment 暂缓判断
ieltsWords.example: The company had to suspend production due to a lack of materials. ||| A lamp was suspended from the ceiling. ||| The judge decided to suspend the sentence.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于材料短缺，公司不得不暂停生产。 ||| 一盏灯从天花板上悬挂下来。 ||| 法官决定暂缓执行判决。

ieltsWords.definition: 维持；支撑
ieltsWords.collocations: sustain life 维持生命, sustain growth 维持增长, sustain damage 遭受损害
ieltsWords.example: The soil is too poor to sustain plant growth. ||| The economy needs new industries to sustain growth. ||| The building sustained severe damage in the earthquake.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 土壤太贫瘠，无法维持植物生长。 ||| 经济需要新产业来维持增长。 ||| 这座建筑在地震中遭受了严重破坏。

ieltsWords.definition: 符号；象征
ieltsWords.collocations: symbol of  ...的象征, status symbol 身份象征, chemical symbol 化学符号
ieltsWords.example: The dove is a symbol of peace. ||| Owning a luxury car is often seen as a status symbol. ||| The chemical symbol for water is H2O.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 鸽子是和平的象征。 ||| 拥有豪车常被视为身份象征。 ||| 水的化学符号是H2O。

ieltsWords.definition: 同情；同情心
ieltsWords.collocations: express sympathy 表示同情, sympathy for 对...的同情, in sympathy with 赞同
ieltsWords.example: I have great sympathy for the victims of the disaster. ||| The workers went on strike in sympathy with their colleagues. ||| He sent a letter of sympathy to the bereaved family.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我对灾难的受害者深表同情。 ||| 工人们罢工以声援他们的同事。 ||| 他给失去亲人的家庭寄去了一封慰问信。

ieltsWords.definition: 处理；应对；用具
ieltsWords.collocations: tackle a problem 解决问题, tackle a task 处理任务, tackle an opponent 擒抱对手
ieltsWords.example: The government must tackle the issue of unemployment. ||| He tackled the difficult task with determination. ||| The footballer tackled the striker to prevent a goal.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府必须解决失业问题。 ||| 他决心处理这项艰巨的任务。 ||| 足球运动员擒抱了前锋以阻止进球。

ieltsWords.definition: 目标；对象
ieltsWords.collocations: target audience 目标受众, target market 目标市场, on target 达到目标
ieltsWords.example: Our target is to increase sales by 20% this year. ||| The advertisement is aimed at a young target audience. ||| The archer hit the target with his first arrow.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们的目标是今年销售额增长20%。 ||| 这则广告针对的是年轻的目标受众。 ||| 弓箭手第一箭就击中了靶子。

ieltsWords.definition: 技术；技巧
ieltsWords.collocations: advanced technique 先进技术, learning technique 学习技巧, surgical technique 手术技术
ieltsWords.example: The artist uses a unique technique to create her paintings. ||| Mastering a new technique requires practice. ||| The surgeon performed the operation using a minimally invasive technique.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位艺术家使用独特的手法创作她的画作。 ||| 掌握一项新技术需要练习。 ||| 外科医生使用微创技术进行了手术。

ieltsWords.definition: 技术；科技
ieltsWords.collocations: information technology 信息技术, technology development 技术开发, cutting-edge technology 尖端技术
ieltsWords.example: Technology has transformed the way we communicate. ||| The company invests heavily in research and technology. ||| Advances in medical technology have saved many lives.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 科技改变了我们的交流方式。 ||| 该公司在研发和技术上投入巨资。 ||| 医疗技术的进步挽救了许多生命。

ieltsWords.definition: 临时的；暂时的
ieltsWords.collocations: temporary job 临时工作, temporary solution 临时解决方案, temporary accommodation 临时住所
ieltsWords.example: She found a temporary job while looking for a permanent one. ||| The bridge is a temporary solution until the new one is built. ||| The refugees were provided with temporary accommodation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在寻找永久工作的同时找到了一份临时工作。 ||| 这座桥是临时解决方案，直到新桥建成。 ||| 难民们得到了临时住所。

ieltsWords.definition: 趋势；倾向
ieltsWords.collocations: tendency to  ...的倾向, upward tendency 上升趋势, natural tendency 自然倾向
ieltsWords.example: There is a growing tendency for people to work from home. ||| He has a tendency to exaggerate his achievements. ||| The stock market shows an upward tendency this quarter.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 人们在家工作的趋势日益增长。 ||| 他有夸大自己成就的倾向。 ||| 本季度股市呈现上升趋势。

ieltsWords.definition: 领土；领域；地盘
ieltsWords.collocations: territory dispute 领土争端, sales territory 销售区域, uncharted territory 未知领域
ieltsWords.example: The two countries are in a dispute over the border territory. ||| Each salesperson is assigned a specific territory. ||| The discovery opened up new territory for scientific research.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 两国在边境领土上存在争端。 ||| 每个销售人员都被分配了一个特定的销售区域。 ||| 这一发现为科学研究开辟了新的领域。

ieltsWords.definition: 理论；学说
ieltsWords.collocations: theory of relativity 相对论, in theory 理论上, economic theory 经济理论
ieltsWords.example: Einstein's theory of relativity revolutionized physics. ||| In theory, the plan should work, but in practice it may fail. ||| The professor is an expert in economic theory.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 爱因斯坦的相对论彻底改变了物理学。 ||| 理论上，这个计划应该可行，但实际上可能会失败。 ||| 这位教授是经济理论方面的专家。

ieltsWords.definition: 治疗；疗法
ieltsWords.collocations: physical therapy 物理治疗, therapy session 治疗疗程, undergo therapy 接受治疗
ieltsWords.example: She is undergoing therapy for her knee injury. ||| Cognitive behavioral therapy is effective for anxiety. ||| The patient attends therapy sessions twice a week.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她正在接受膝盖损伤的治疗。 ||| 认知行为疗法对焦虑症有效。 ||| 病人每周参加两次治疗疗程。

ieltsWords.definition: 彻底的；全面的
ieltsWords.collocations: thorough investigation 彻底调查, thorough understanding 透彻理解, thorough cleaning 彻底清洁
ieltsWords.example: The police conducted a thorough investigation of the crime scene. ||| She has a thorough understanding of the subject. ||| We need to give the house a thorough cleaning before the guests arrive.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方对犯罪现场进行了彻底调查。 ||| 她对这门学科有透彻的理解。 ||| 在客人到来之前，我们需要彻底打扫房子。

ieltsWords.definition: 威胁；恐吓
ieltsWords.collocations: pose a threat 构成威胁, security threat 安全威胁, threat to health 健康威胁
ieltsWords.example: Climate change poses a serious threat to global ecosystems. ||| The government is taking measures to counter the threat of cyber attacks. ||| He received a death threat for his political activism.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 气候变化对全球生态系统构成严重威胁。 ||| 政府正在采取措施应对网络攻击的威胁。 ||| 他因政治活动收到了死亡威胁。

ieltsWords.definition: 容忍；忍受
ieltsWords.collocations: tolerate noise 忍受噪音, tolerate dissent 容忍异议, cannot tolerate 无法容忍
ieltsWords.example: The school does not tolerate bullying in any form. ||| Some plants can tolerate extreme drought conditions. ||| She finds it hard to tolerate her colleague's constant complaining.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学校不容忍任何形式的欺凌。 ||| 有些植物能忍受极端干旱条件。 ||| 她很难忍受同事不断的抱怨。

ieltsWords.definition: 追踪；追溯；痕迹
ieltsWords.collocations: trace back to 追溯到, trace the source 追踪来源, without a trace 无影无踪
ieltsWords.example: The police managed to trace the stolen car to a nearby garage. ||| The tradition can be traced back to the 16th century. ||| There was no trace of the missing hiker in the forest.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方成功将被盗汽车追踪到附近的一个车库。 ||| 这一传统可以追溯到16世纪。 ||| 森林里没有失踪徒步者的任何痕迹。

ieltsWords.definition: 传统；惯例
ieltsWords.collocations: cultural tradition 文化传统, family tradition 家族传统, break with tradition 打破传统
ieltsWords.example: It is a tradition in many countries to exchange gifts during festivals. ||| The university has a long tradition of academic excellence. ||| They decided to break with tradition and hold the wedding outdoors.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多国家有在节日期间交换礼物的传统。 ||| 这所大学有着学术卓越的悠久传统。 ||| 他们决定打破传统，在户外举行婚礼。

ieltsWords.definition: 转移；调动；转乘
ieltsWords.collocations: transfer to 转移到, bank transfer 银行转账, transfer of technology 技术转让
ieltsWords.example: She transferred from the New York office to the London branch. ||| You can transfer money to your account using online banking. ||| The patient was transferred to a specialist hospital for further treatment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她从纽约办事处调到了伦敦分公司。 ||| 你可以通过网上银行将钱转到你的账户。 ||| 病人被转送到专科医院接受进一步治疗。

ieltsWords.definition: 改变；转变；改造
ieltsWords.collocations: transform into 转变为, transform the economy 转变经济, transform one's life 改变生活
ieltsWords.example: The new technology has transformed the way we communicate. ||| The abandoned warehouse was transformed into a modern art gallery. ||| Education can transform a person's life and open up new opportunities.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新技术改变了我们的沟通方式。 ||| 废弃的仓库被改造成了一个现代艺术画廊。 ||| 教育可以改变一个人的生活并开辟新的机会。

ieltsWords.definition: 过渡；转变
ieltsWords.collocations: transition period 过渡期, transition to 向…过渡, in transition 在过渡中
ieltsWords.example: The country is undergoing a transition from a planned economy to a market economy. ||| The transition from school to work can be challenging for young people. ||| The company is in transition as it adapts to new market conditions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该国正经历从计划经济向市场经济的过渡。 ||| 从学校到工作的过渡对年轻人来说可能具有挑战性。 ||| 公司在适应新市场条件的过程中处于过渡期。

ieltsWords.definition: 传输；传播；传染
ieltsWords.collocations: transmit data 传输数据, transmit disease 传播疾病, transmit signals 传送信号
ieltsWords.example: The radio station transmits signals over a wide area. ||| Mosquitoes can transmit diseases such as malaria and dengue fever. ||| The fiber optic cable transmits data at high speeds.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 广播电台向广阔区域传送信号。 ||| 蚊子可以传播疟疾和登革热等疾病。 ||| 光纤电缆以高速传输数据。

ieltsWords.definition: 透明的；坦率的
ieltsWords.collocations: transparent process 透明流程, transparent decision 透明决策, become transparent 变得透明
ieltsWords.example: The company promised to make its financial reporting more transparent. ||| The glass is completely transparent, allowing you to see through it clearly. ||| The government's lack of transparency has led to public distrust.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司承诺使其财务报告更加透明。 ||| 玻璃是完全透明的，可以清晰地看穿。 ||| 政府缺乏透明度导致了公众的不信任。

ieltsWords.definition: 运输；交通
ieltsWords.collocations: public transport 公共交通, transport system 运输系统, transport goods 运输货物
ieltsWords.example: The city has an efficient public transport system including buses and trains. ||| The goods were transported by truck to the distribution center. ||| Air transport is the fastest way to deliver urgent items.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该市拥有包括公共汽车和火车在内的高效公共交通系统。 ||| 货物由卡车运送到配送中心。 ||| 空运是运送紧急物品最快的方式。

ieltsWords.definition: 趋势；潮流
ieltsWords.collocations: current trend 当前趋势, follow a trend 跟随潮流, upward trend 上升趋势
ieltsWords.example: There is a growing trend towards remote work in many industries. ||| The latest fashion trends are often influenced by social media. ||| The data shows a clear upward trend in global temperatures.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多行业出现了远程工作的增长趋势。 ||| 最新的时尚潮流往往受社交媒体影响。 ||| 数据显示全球气温明显呈上升趋势。

ieltsWords.definition: 触发；引发；扳机
ieltsWords.collocations: trigger a reaction 引发反应, trigger an alarm 触发警报, trigger point 触发点
ieltsWords.example: The announcement triggered a wave of protests across the country. ||| Certain foods can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals. ||| The economic crisis was triggered by a collapse in the housing market.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公告在全国范围内引发了一波抗议。 ||| 某些食物可能引发敏感人群的过敏反应。 ||| 经济危机是由房地产市场崩溃引发的。

ieltsWords.definition: 典型的
ieltsWords.collocations: typical example 典型例子, typical behavior 典型行为, typical of 是…的特点
ieltsWords.example: This is a typical example of how the system works. ||| It is typical for students to feel nervous before an exam. ||| The weather here is typical of a Mediterranean climate.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这是系统如何运作的一个典型例子。 ||| 学生在考试前感到紧张是很典型的。 ||| 这里的天气是典型的地中海气候。

ieltsWords.definition: 最终的；极端的
ieltsWords.collocations: ultimate goal 最终目标, ultimate responsibility 最终责任, ultimate decision 最终决定
ieltsWords.example: The ultimate goal of the project is to reduce carbon emissions by 50%. ||| The ultimate responsibility for the safety of the passengers lies with the captain. ||| Winning the championship was the ultimate achievement of his career.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该项目的最终目标是将碳排放减少50%。 ||| 乘客安全的最终责任在于机长。 ||| 赢得冠军是他职业生涯的最终成就。

ieltsWords.definition: 经历；经受
ieltsWords.collocations: undergo surgery 接受手术, undergo changes 经历变化, undergo training 接受培训
ieltsWords.example: The patient will undergo a series of tests to determine the cause of the illness. ||| The city has undergone significant transformation in the past decade. ||| All new employees must undergo a training program before starting work.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 病人将接受一系列检查以确定病因。 ||| 这座城市在过去十年经历了重大转变。 ||| 所有新员工在开始工作前必须接受培训。

ieltsWords.definition: 削弱；破坏
ieltsWords.collocations: undermine confidence 削弱信心, undermine authority 破坏权威, undermine efforts 破坏努力
ieltsWords.example: The constant criticism undermined her self-confidence. ||| The scandal could undermine public trust in the government. ||| The lack of funding undermined the effectiveness of the project.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 不断的批评削弱了她的自信心。 ||| 丑闻可能破坏公众对政府的信任。 ||| 资金不足削弱了项目的有效性。

ieltsWords.definition: 承担；从事
ieltsWords.collocations: undertake a project 承担项目, undertake research 从事研究, undertake responsibility 承担责任
ieltsWords.example: The company will undertake a major renovation of the building. ||| She undertook the task of organizing the conference. ||| The government has undertaken to reduce poverty by 2025.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司将对该建筑进行重大翻新。 ||| 她承担了组织会议的任务。 ||| 政府已承诺到2025年减少贫困。

ieltsWords.definition: 失业
ieltsWords.collocations: unemployment rate 失业率, high unemployment 高失业率, unemployment benefit 失业救济金
ieltsWords.example: The unemployment rate has dropped to its lowest level in five years. ||| Long-term unemployment can have serious effects on mental health. ||| The government introduced new measures to tackle youth unemployment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 失业率已降至五年来的最低水平。 ||| 长期失业可能对心理健康产生严重影响。 ||| 政府推出了解决青年失业问题的新措施。

ieltsWords.definition: 独特的；唯一的
ieltsWords.collocations: unique feature 独特特征, unique opportunity 独特机会, unique to 为…所独有
ieltsWords.example: Each person has a unique set of fingerprints. ||| The island has a unique ecosystem found nowhere else on Earth. ||| This is a unique opportunity to study the effects of climate change.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 每个人都有独特的指纹。 ||| 该岛拥有地球上其他地方找不到的独特生态系统。 ||| 这是研究气候变化影响的独特机会。

ieltsWords.definition: 普遍的；全世界的
ieltsWords.collocations: universal value 普世价值, universal access 普遍接入, universal language 通用语言
ieltsWords.example: The right to education is a universal human right. ||| Music is often considered a universal language that transcends cultural barriers. ||| The company aims to provide universal access to clean water in developing countries.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 受教育权是一项普遍的人权。 ||| 音乐常被视为超越文化障碍的通用语言。 ||| 该公司旨在为发展中国家提供普遍获得清洁用水的机会。

ieltsWords.definition: 更新；升级
ieltsWords.collocations: update information 更新信息, update software 更新软件, keep someone updated 让某人了解最新情况
ieltsWords.example: The software requires an update to fix security issues. ||| Please update me on the project's progress. ||| We need to update our database with the new records.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该软件需要更新以修复安全问题。 ||| 请向我通报项目的最新进展。 ||| 我们需要用新记录更新数据库。

ieltsWords.definition: 升级；提升
ieltsWords.collocations: upgrade equipment 升级设备, upgrade skills 提升技能, upgrade to a better version 升级到更好的版本
ieltsWords.example: The company decided to upgrade its computer systems. ||| She upgraded her ticket to first class. ||| We need to upgrade our infrastructure to meet demand.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司决定升级其计算机系统。 ||| 她把票升级到头等舱。 ||| 我们需要升级基础设施以满足需求。

ieltsWords.definition: 城市的；都市的
ieltsWords.collocations: urban area 市区, urban development 城市发展, urban population 城市人口
ieltsWords.example: Urban areas are often more crowded than rural areas. ||| The government is focusing on urban renewal projects. ||| Urban planning is essential for sustainable growth.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 城市地区通常比农村地区更拥挤。 ||| 政府正专注于城市更新项目。 ||| 城市规划对可持续发展至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition: 利用；使用
ieltsWords.collocations: utilize resources 利用资源, utilize technology 利用技术, fully utilize 充分利用
ieltsWords.example: We must utilize renewable energy sources to reduce pollution. ||| The company utilizes advanced algorithms for data analysis. ||| It is important to utilize time efficiently.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们必须利用可再生能源来减少污染。 ||| 该公司利用先进算法进行数据分析。 ||| 有效利用时间很重要。

ieltsWords.definition: 有效的；合理的
ieltsWords.collocations: valid reason 正当理由, valid passport 有效护照, valid argument 合理的论点
ieltsWords.example: Your ticket is valid for three months. ||| She provided a valid explanation for her absence. ||| The experiment produced valid results.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你的票有效期为三个月。 ||| 她为自己的缺席提供了合理的解释。 ||| 实验产生了有效的结果。

ieltsWords.definition: 价值；珍视
ieltsWords.collocations: market value 市场价值, cultural value 文化价值, value system 价值体系
ieltsWords.example: The value of the house has increased significantly. ||| Education is of great value to society. ||| They share similar values and beliefs.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这所房子的价值大幅上涨。 ||| 教育对社会具有重要价值。 ||| 他们有相似的价值观和信仰。

ieltsWords.definition: 变化；变异
ieltsWords.collocations: genetic variation 遗传变异, variation in temperature 温度变化, slight variation 细微变化
ieltsWords.example: There is a wide variation in prices across different stores. ||| Genetic variation is essential for evolution. ||| The music piece has several variations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 不同商店的价格差异很大。 ||| 遗传变异对进化至关重要。 ||| 这首乐曲有几个变奏。

ieltsWords.definition: 多样性；种类
ieltsWords.collocations: a variety of 各种各样的, variety show 综艺节目, wide variety 种类繁多
ieltsWords.example: The store offers a variety of products. ||| Variety is the spice of life. ||| We need more variety in our diet.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家商店提供各种各样的产品。 ||| 变化是生活的调味品。 ||| 我们的饮食需要更多种类。

ieltsWords.definition: 企业；风险项目；冒险
ieltsWords.collocations: business venture 商业冒险, joint venture 合资企业, venture capital 风险资本
ieltsWords.example: They started a new business venture together. ||| The joint venture was successful in expanding the market. ||| Venture capital is often used to fund startups.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们一起创办了一个新的商业项目。 ||| 合资企业成功扩大了市场。 ||| 风险资本常用于资助初创企业。

ieltsWords.definition: 验证；核实
ieltsWords.collocations: verify identity 核实身份, verify information 核实信息, verify accuracy 验证准确性
ieltsWords.example: Please verify your email address to complete registration. ||| The police verified the witness's statement. ||| We need to verify the data before publishing.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请验证您的电子邮件地址以完成注册。 ||| 警方核实了证人的陈述。 ||| 我们需要在发布前验证数据。

ieltsWords.definition: 版本；说法
ieltsWords.collocations: latest version 最新版本, original version 原始版本, version of events 事件的说法
ieltsWords.example: The latest version of the software includes new features. ||| His version of the story differs from hers. ||| This is the English version of the book.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 最新版本的软件包含新功能。 ||| 他对故事的说法与她的不同。 ||| 这是这本书的英文版本。

ieltsWords.definition: 通过；经由
ieltsWords.collocations: via email 通过电子邮件, via the internet 通过互联网, travel via 经由…旅行
ieltsWords.example: You can contact us via phone or email. ||| We traveled to Paris via London. ||| The data was transmitted via satellite.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 您可以通过电话或电子邮件联系我们。 ||| 我们经由伦敦前往巴黎。 ||| 数据通过卫星传输。

ieltsWords.definition: 受害者；牺牲品
ieltsWords.collocations: crime victim 犯罪受害者, fall victim to 成为…的受害者, victim of circumstance 环境的牺牲品
ieltsWords.example: The victim of the accident was taken to hospital. ||| Many people fall victim to online scams. ||| She was a victim of bullying at school.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 事故受害者被送往医院。 ||| 许多人成为网络诈骗的受害者。 ||| 她是学校欺凌的受害者。

ieltsWords.definition: 违反；侵犯
ieltsWords.collocations: violate the law 违反法律, violate rights 侵犯权利, violate rules 违反规则
ieltsWords.example: The company violated environmental regulations. ||| He was accused of violating the terms of the contract. ||| The protestors claimed the policy violated their rights.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司违反了环境法规。 ||| 他被指控违反合同条款。 ||| 抗议者声称该政策侵犯了他们的权利。

ieltsWords.definition: 虚拟的；实质上的
ieltsWords.collocations: virtual reality 虚拟现实, virtual meeting 虚拟会议, virtual assistant 虚拟助手
ieltsWords.example: Virtual reality technology is advancing rapidly. ||| We held a virtual meeting due to the pandemic. ||| She works as a virtual assistant for several clients.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 虚拟现实技术正在迅速发展。 ||| 由于疫情，我们举行了虚拟会议。 ||| 她为几个客户担任虚拟助手。

ieltsWords.definition: 可见的；明显的
ieltsWords.collocations: visible light 可见光, visible signs 明显的迹象, clearly visible 清晰可见
ieltsWords.example: The stars are visible on a clear night. ||| There were visible signs of damage to the building. ||| The results of the policy are now visible.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在晴朗的夜晚可以看到星星。 ||| 建筑物上有明显的损坏迹象。 ||| 该政策的结果现在显而易见。

ieltsWords.definition: 愿景；视力；远见
ieltsWords.collocations: night vision 夜视, have a vision 有愿景, clear vision 清晰的视野
ieltsWords.example: He has poor vision and needs glasses. ||| The leader outlined his vision for the future. ||| A good manager needs to have vision.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他视力不好，需要戴眼镜。 ||| 领导人概述了他对未来的愿景。 ||| 一个好的管理者需要有远见。

ieltsWords.definition: 视觉的；直观的
ieltsWords.collocations: visual aid 视觉辅助, visual effect 视觉效果, visual art 视觉艺术
ieltsWords.example: The presentation included many visual aids. ||| The movie's visual effects were stunning. ||| She is studying visual arts at university.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 演示中包含了许多视觉辅助工具。 ||| 这部电影的视觉效果令人惊叹。 ||| 她在大学学习视觉艺术。

ieltsWords.definition: 至关重要的
ieltsWords.collocations: vital role 关键作用, vital signs 生命体征, vital importance 至关重要
ieltsWords.example: Exercise is vital for good health. ||| The doctor checked the patient's vital signs. ||| Education plays a vital role in society.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 锻炼对健康至关重要。 ||| 医生检查了病人的生命体征。 ||| 教育在社会中起着至关重要的作用。

ieltsWords.definition: 量；体积；音量
ieltsWords.collocations: volume of water 水量, turn up the volume 调高音量, sales volume 销售量
ieltsWords.example: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters. ||| Please turn down the volume of the TV. ||| The company's sales volume increased this quarter.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。 ||| 请把电视音量调低。 ||| 该公司的销售量本季度有所增长。

ieltsWords.definition: 自愿的；志愿的
ieltsWords.collocations: voluntary work 志愿工作, voluntary contribution 自愿捐款, voluntary participation 自愿参与
ieltsWords.example: Many students engage in voluntary work during their summer break. ||| The company made a voluntary contribution to the local charity. ||| Participation in the program is entirely voluntary.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多学生在暑假期间参加志愿工作。 ||| 该公司向当地慈善机构进行了自愿捐款。 ||| 参与该项目完全是自愿的。

ieltsWords.definition: 脆弱的；易受伤害的
ieltsWords.collocations: vulnerable groups 弱势群体, vulnerable to attack 易受攻击, vulnerable position 脆弱地位
ieltsWords.example: Elderly people are particularly vulnerable during the cold winter months. ||| The system is vulnerable to cyber attacks if not properly secured. ||| Children from low-income families are more vulnerable to health problems.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老年人在寒冷的冬季尤其脆弱。 ||| 如果未妥善保护，该系统易受网络攻击。 ||| 来自低收入家庭的孩子更容易出现健康问题。

ieltsWords.definition: 福利；幸福
ieltsWords.collocations: social welfare 社会福利, welfare system 福利制度, child welfare 儿童福利
ieltsWords.example: The government is responsible for the welfare of its citizens. ||| Many countries have reformed their welfare systems to encourage employment. ||| Animal welfare organizations work to protect animals from cruelty.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府负责公民的福利。 ||| 许多国家改革了福利制度以鼓励就业。 ||| 动物福利组织致力于保护动物免受虐待。

ieltsWords.definition: 广泛的；普遍的
ieltsWords.collocations: widespread use 广泛使用, widespread concern 普遍关注, widespread damage 大面积破坏
ieltsWords.example: The use of smartphones has become widespread in recent years. ||| There is widespread concern about the effects of climate change. ||| The earthquake caused widespread damage to buildings and infrastructure.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 近年来智能手机的使用已变得广泛。 ||| 人们对气候变化的影响普遍关注。 ||| 地震对建筑物和基础设施造成了广泛破坏。

ieltsWords.definition: 愿意的；乐意的
ieltsWords.collocations: willing to help 乐于助人, willing participant 自愿参与者, willing to learn 愿意学习
ieltsWords.example: She is always willing to help her colleagues with their work. ||| He was a willing participant in the research study. ||| Students who are willing to learn often achieve better results.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她总是乐于帮助同事完成工作。 ||| 他是该研究项目的自愿参与者。 ||| 愿意学习的学生通常能取得更好的成绩。

ieltsWords.definition: 撤回；退出；提取
ieltsWords.collocations: withdraw from 退出, withdraw money 取钱, withdraw support 撤回支持
ieltsWords.example: He decided to withdraw from the competition due to injury. ||| You can withdraw money from an ATM at any time. ||| The company withdrew its support for the project.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他因伤决定退出比赛。 ||| 你可以随时从自动取款机取钱。 ||| 该公司撤回了对该项目的支持。

ieltsWords.definition: 目击者；证人；见证
ieltsWords.collocations: witness statement 证人陈述, witness to 目击, bear witness 作证
ieltsWords.example: The witness provided a detailed account of the accident. ||| We witnessed a dramatic change in the weather. ||| Several people witnessed the robbery and called the police.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 目击者提供了事故的详细描述。 ||| 我们目睹了天气的剧烈变化。 ||| 几个人目击了抢劫并报了警。

ieltsWords.definition: 劳动力
ieltsWords.collocations: skilled workforce 熟练劳动力, workforce diversity 劳动力多样性, workforce planning 劳动力规划
ieltsWords.example: A skilled workforce is essential for economic growth. ||| The company is committed to increasing workforce diversity. ||| Effective workforce planning helps organizations meet future demands.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 熟练劳动力对经济增长至关重要。 ||| 该公司致力于增加劳动力多样性。 ||| 有效的劳动力规划有助于组织满足未来需求。

ieltsWords.definition: 产出；屈服；收益
ieltsWords.collocations: yield results 产生结果, yield to 屈服于, crop yield 作物产量
ieltsWords.example: The experiment yielded promising results. ||| Farmers are concerned about this year's crop yield due to drought. ||| He refused to yield to pressure from his peers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 实验产生了有希望的结果。 ||| 由于干旱，农民们担心今年的作物产量。 ||| 他拒绝屈服于同伴的压力。

ieltsWords.definition: 区域；地带；分区
ieltsWords.collocations: time zone 时区, industrial zone 工业区, residential zone 住宅区
ieltsWords.example: The city has designated a new industrial zone for manufacturing. ||| Traveling across time zones can cause jet lag. ||| This area is a pedestrian-only zone on weekends.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该市划定了新的工业区用于制造业。 ||| 穿越时区旅行会导致时差反应。 ||| 这个区域在周末是步行区。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 反常的, 不规则的, 变态的, 畸形的
n. 畸形的人
ieltsWords.collocations: abnormal behavior 异常行为, abnormal results 异常结果, abnormal weather 反常天气
ieltsWords.example: The patient showed abnormal behavior after the accident. ||| Abnormal weather patterns have been observed in recent years. ||| The test results were abnormal, requiring further investigation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 事故后患者表现出异常行为。 ||| 近年来观察到反常的天气模式。 ||| 测试结果异常，需要进一步调查。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 流产, 堕胎, 失败, 夭折, 中止
[医] 流产, 小产; 顿挫
ieltsWords.collocations: abortion law 堕胎法, abortion debate 堕胎辩论, illegal abortion 非法堕胎
ieltsWords.example: The abortion law has been a subject of heated debate. ||| She decided to have an abortion due to health reasons. ||| The project was an abortion due to lack of funding.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 堕胎法一直是激烈辩论的话题。 ||| 她因健康原因决定堕胎。 ||| 该项目因缺乏资金而夭折。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 荒谬的, 不合理的, 可笑的
n. 荒诞
ieltsWords.collocations: absurd idea 荒谬的想法, absurd situation 荒谬的情况, absurdly low 低得荒谬
ieltsWords.example: It is absurd to think that money can buy happiness. ||| The prices in that store are absurdly high. ||| He found himself in an absurd situation where no one believed him.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 认为金钱能买到幸福是荒谬的。 ||| 那家商店的价格高得荒谬。 ||| 他发现自己处于一个荒谬的境地，没有人相信他。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 丰富, 充足, 大量
[经] 丰富, 充裕
ieltsWords.collocations: abundance of 大量的, in abundance 丰富地, natural abundance 自然丰度
ieltsWords.example: The region has an abundance of natural resources. ||| Food was in abundance at the festival. ||| An abundance of evidence supports the theory.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该地区拥有丰富的自然资源。 ||| 节日期间食物充足。 ||| 大量证据支持这一理论。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 易接近的, 可进入的, 可使用的, 易受影响的, 可理解的
ieltsWords.collocations: accessible to 对...可及, easily accessible 易于接近, wheelchair accessible 轮椅可通行
ieltsWords.example: The building is accessible to people with disabilities. ||| The information should be made accessible to the public. ||| The park is easily accessible by public transport.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该建筑对残疾人无障碍。 ||| 这些信息应向公众公开。 ||| 公园乘坐公共交通很容易到达。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 膳宿, 预订铺位, 适应性调节, 调和, 贷款
[医] 调节(眼); 适应
ieltsWords.collocations: provide accommodation 提供住宿, accommodation costs 住宿费用, reach an accommodation 达成和解
ieltsWords.example: The university provides accommodation for international students. ||| Accommodation costs in the city center are very high. ||| The two sides finally reached an accommodation after long negotiations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大学为国际学生提供住宿。 ||| 市中心的住宿费用非常高。 ||| 经过长时间谈判，双方最终达成了和解。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 报告, 解释, 估价, 理由, 利润, 算账, 帐目
vi. 报帐, 解释, 导致, 报偿, 占, 杀死
vt. 认为
[计] 帐户, 帐号
ieltsWords.collocations: bank account 银行账户, account for 解释，占, take into account 考虑到
ieltsWords.example: I need to open a bank account for my salary. ||| How do you account for the sudden increase in sales? ||| We must take into account all possible factors.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我需要开一个银行账户来存工资。 ||| 你如何解释销售额的突然增长？ ||| 我们必须考虑到所有可能的因素。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 会计人员, 会计师
[经] 会计师, 会计人员
ieltsWords.collocations: chartered accountant 特许会计师, certified public accountant 注册会计师, accountant firm 会计师事务所
ieltsWords.example: She works as a chartered accountant for a large firm. ||| The accountant prepared the financial statements for the year. ||| A good accountant can help you save money on taxes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在一家大公司担任特许会计师。 ||| 会计师编制了年度财务报表。 ||| 一个好的会计师可以帮助你节省税款。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 精确, 正确
[计] 准确度
ieltsWords.collocations: high accuracy 高精度, accuracy rate 准确率, with accuracy 准确地
ieltsWords.example: The accuracy of the data is crucial for the research. ||| The machine can measure with great accuracy. ||| The accuracy rate of the test is over 99%.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 数据的准确性对研究至关重要。 ||| 这台机器可以非常精确地测量。 ||| 测试的准确率超过99%。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 指责, 控告, 归咎于
vi. 指责, 控告
ieltsWords.collocations: accuse of 指控, falsely accuse 诬告, accuse sb of doing sth 指控某人做某事
ieltsWords.example: He was accused of stealing the money. ||| She accused her colleague of lying. ||| The politician was falsely accused of corruption.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他被指控偷了钱。 ||| 她指责同事说谎。 ||| 这位政治家被诬告贪污。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 完成, 成就, 功业
ieltsWords.collocations: great achievement 巨大成就, academic achievement 学业成就, sense of achievement 成就感
ieltsWords.example: Winning the scholarship was a remarkable achievement for her. ||| The project was a major achievement in the field of renewable energy. ||| He felt a great sense of achievement after completing the marathon.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 获得奖学金对她来说是一项了不起的成就。 ||| 该项目是可再生能源领域的一项重大成就。 ||| 完成马拉松后，他感到强烈的成就感。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 获得, 获得物
[经] 收购, 招揽, 取得
ieltsWords.collocations: language acquisition 语言习得, acquisition of knowledge 知识获取, merger and acquisition 并购
ieltsWords.example: The company's acquisition of the startup expanded its market share. ||| Language acquisition in children is a fascinating process. ||| The museum's latest acquisition is a rare painting from the 18th century.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司对初创公司的收购扩大了其市场份额。 ||| 儿童的语言习得是一个迷人的过程。 ||| 博物馆最新获得的一件藏品是一幅18世纪的稀有画作。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使活动, 使激活, 正式建成
vi. 有活力
ieltsWords.collocations: activate a device 激活设备, activate a plan 启动计划, activate an account 激活账户
ieltsWords.example: You need to activate your new credit card before using it. ||| The alarm system is activated by motion sensors. ||| The government activated emergency protocols during the crisis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你需要先激活新信用卡才能使用。 ||| 报警系统由运动传感器激活。 ||| 政府在危机期间启动了紧急预案。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 尖锐的, 敏锐的, 激烈的, 严重的, 急性的
[医] 急性的; 尖锐的
ieltsWords.collocations: acute pain 剧痛, acute problem 严重问题, acute angle 锐角
ieltsWords.example: The patient was admitted with acute abdominal pain. ||| Dogs have an acute sense of smell. ||| The city faces an acute shortage of affordable housing.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 患者因急性腹痛入院。 ||| 狗有敏锐的嗅觉。 ||| 该市面临经济适用房的严重短缺。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使沉溺, 使上瘾
n. 入迷的人, 上瘾者
ieltsWords.collocations: drug addict 吸毒成瘾者, gambling addict 赌博成瘾者, internet addict 网瘾者
ieltsWords.example: He became a drug addict after years of substance abuse. ||| Support groups help gambling addicts recover. ||| She is a self-confessed coffee addict.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 经过多年的药物滥用，他成了吸毒成瘾者。 ||| 支持小组帮助赌博成瘾者康复。 ||| 她自称是个咖啡上瘾者。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 加法, 增加的人(或物)
[计] 加法
ieltsWords.collocations: in addition 此外, addition to the family 家庭新成员, addition of sugar 加糖
ieltsWords.example: In addition to his job, he volunteers at a local charity. ||| The new wing is a welcome addition to the hospital. ||| Children learn addition and subtraction in elementary school.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 除了工作，他还在当地一家慈善机构做志愿者。 ||| 新侧楼是医院受欢迎的扩建部分。 ||| 孩子们在小学学习加法和减法。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 附加的, 另外的, 额外的
[机] 加添的, 附加的
ieltsWords.collocations: additional cost 额外费用, additional information 附加信息, additional support 额外支持
ieltsWords.example: There will be an additional charge for late registration. ||| We need additional time to complete the project. ||| The teacher provided additional resources for struggling students.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 逾期注册将收取额外费用。 ||| 我们需要额外时间来完成项目。 ||| 老师为学习困难的学生提供了额外资源。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 住址, 演说, 举止, 灵巧, 求爱
vt. 发表(演说或讲话), 对付, 写地址
[计] 地址, 寻址
ieltsWords.collocations: address a problem 解决问题, address an audience 向听众讲话, address a letter 在信上写地址
ieltsWords.example: The government must address the issue of climate change urgently. ||| The president addressed the nation on television. ||| Please address the package to my office.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府必须紧急处理气候变化问题。 ||| 总统在电视上向全国发表讲话。 ||| 请把包裹寄到我的办公室。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 毗连的, 邻近的, 连接的
[机] 相邻的, 邻位的, 交界的
ieltsWords.collocations: adjacent to 邻近, adjacent rooms 相邻房间, adjacent buildings 相邻建筑
ieltsWords.example: The hotel is adjacent to the train station. ||| We booked two adjacent seats on the flight. ||| The garden is adjacent to the main house.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家酒店毗邻火车站。 ||| 我们预订了航班上相邻的两个座位。 ||| 花园紧邻主屋。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 行政, 管理, 政府机关
[化] 给药
ieltsWords.collocations: business administration 工商管理, public administration 公共管理, under the administration of 在…的管理下
ieltsWords.example: She studied business administration at university. ||| The Obama administration implemented healthcare reforms. ||| The administration of the exam was smooth.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在大学学习工商管理。 ||| 奥巴马政府实施了医疗改革。 ||| 考试的执行很顺利。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 管理人, 行政官
[经] 遗产管理人员
ieltsWords.collocations: system administrator 系统管理员, school administrator 学校行政人员, network administrator 网络管理员
ieltsWords.example: The system administrator fixed the server issue. ||| School administrators are responsible for policy implementation. ||| He works as a database administrator for a large company.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 系统管理员修复了服务器问题。 ||| 学校行政人员负责政策实施。 ||| 他在一家大公司担任数据库管理员。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 准许进入, 入场费, 录用, 承认
[经] 加入, 入股
ieltsWords.collocations: admission fee 入场费, admission to university 大学录取, by his own admission 据他自己承认
ieltsWords.example: Admission to the museum is free on Sundays. ||| She gained admission to a top university. ||| By his own admission, he made a mistake.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 周日博物馆免费入场。 ||| 她被一所顶尖大学录取。 ||| 据他自己承认，他犯了一个错误。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 在前的, 高级的, 先进的, 年老的
[法] 预付的, 预支的, 垫付的
ieltsWords.collocations: advanced technology 先进技术, advanced course 高级课程, advanced stage 晚期阶段
ieltsWords.example: The country has advanced technology in renewable energy. ||| She is taking an advanced English course. ||| The disease was diagnosed at an advanced stage.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该国在可再生能源方面拥有先进技术。 ||| 她正在上高级英语课程。 ||| 该疾病在晚期才被诊断出来。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 来到, 来临
ieltsWords.collocations: the advent of 的出现, with the advent of 随着的到来
ieltsWords.example: The advent of the internet revolutionized communication. ||| With the advent of spring, the flowers began to bloom. ||| The advent of artificial intelligence has raised ethical concerns.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 互联网的出现彻底改变了通信方式。 ||| 随着春天的到来，花儿开始绽放。 ||| 人工智能的出现引发了伦理担忧。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 做广告, 通知, 公布
vi. 做广告
ieltsWords.collocations: advertise a product 为产品做广告, advertise online 在线广告, advertise for staff 招聘广告
ieltsWords.example: Companies advertise their products on social media. ||| They advertised for a new manager in the newspaper. ||| The event was widely advertised across the city.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司在社交媒体上为产品做广告。 ||| 他们在报纸上刊登广告招聘新经理。 ||| 该活动在全市广泛宣传。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 广告, 启事, 广告宣传
[法] 广告, 公告, 告示
ieltsWords.collocations: television advertisement 电视广告, job advertisement 招聘广告, place an advertisement 刊登广告
ieltsWords.example: The television advertisement was very creative. ||| She saw a job advertisement in the local paper. ||| The company placed an advertisement in a national magazine.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这则电视广告非常有创意。 ||| 她在当地报纸上看到一则招聘广告。 ||| 该公司在一家全国性杂志上刊登了广告。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 广告业, 广告
a. 广告的
[计] 发广告
ieltsWords.collocations: advertising campaign 广告活动, advertising agency 广告公司, online advertising 在线广告
ieltsWords.example: The company launched a new advertising campaign. ||| She works for a leading advertising agency. ||| Online advertising has become increasingly targeted.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司发起了一项新的广告活动。 ||| 她在一家领先的广告公司工作。 ||| 在线广告变得越来越有针对性。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 美学的, 审美的, 有美感的
ieltsWords.collocations: aesthetic value 美学价值, aesthetic appeal 审美吸引力, aesthetic sense 审美感
ieltsWords.example: The building's design has great aesthetic appeal. ||| She has a strong aesthetic sense and loves modern art. ||| The aesthetic value of the painting is undeniable.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座建筑的设计具有很大的审美吸引力。 ||| 她有很强的审美感，热爱现代艺术。 ||| 这幅画的美学价值不可否认。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使紧密联系, 使附属, 接纳, 收养
vi. 发生联系, 参加
ieltsWords.collocations: affiliate with 与…联合, affiliate member 附属会员, affiliate program 联盟计划
ieltsWords.example: The local club is affiliated with the national organization. ||| She decided to affiliate with the political party. ||| The university has several affiliated research institutes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 当地俱乐部隶属于全国性组织。 ||| 她决定加入该政党。 ||| 该大学有几个附属研究机构。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 断言, 确认
ieltsWords.collocations: affirm a decision 肯定决定, affirm one's belief 肯定信念, affirm the truth 确认真相
ieltsWords.example: The court affirmed the lower court's decision. ||| He affirmed his commitment to the project. ||| The witness affirmed that she saw the accident.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 法院维持了下级法院的判决。 ||| 他肯定了自己对项目的承诺。 ||| 证人证实她看到了事故。

ieltsWords.definition:
pl. 议程, 日常工作事项
[计] 待议事件
ieltsWords.collocations: set the agenda 制定议程, political agenda 政治议程, hidden agenda 隐藏的意图
ieltsWords.example: The first item on the agenda is the budget proposal. ||| She has a hidden agenda for joining the committee. ||| The government set a new agenda for environmental reform.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 议程上的第一项是预算提案。 ||| 她加入委员会有隐藏的意图。 ||| 政府为环境改革制定了新议程。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 使恶化, 使更严重, 加重
ieltsWords.collocations: aggravate the situation 使情况恶化, aggravate symptoms 加重症状, aggravate someone 激怒某人
ieltsWords.example: Smoking can aggravate respiratory problems. ||| His constant complaining aggravated his colleagues. ||| The delay only aggravated the already tense situation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 吸烟会加重呼吸问题。 ||| 他不断的抱怨激怒了同事。 ||| 延误只会使已经紧张的局面恶化。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 合计, 总计, 聚集体
a. 合计的, 聚集的
v. 聚集, 集合, 合计达
[计] 聚合体; 聚集
ieltsWords.collocations: in aggregate 总计, aggregate demand 总需求, aggregate data 汇总数据
ieltsWords.example: The aggregate of all donations reached $10,000. ||| We need to aggregate the results from different surveys. ||| The aggregate score was higher than expected.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 所有捐款总计达到一万美元。 ||| 我们需要汇总不同调查的结果。 ||| 总分高于预期。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 极大的痛苦, 挣扎
[医] 濒死苦闷; 剧痛
ieltsWords.collocations: in agony 痛苦地, agony of defeat 失败的痛苦, prolong the agony 延长痛苦
ieltsWords.example: He screamed in agony after breaking his leg. ||| The team suffered the agony of losing the final match. ||| Waiting for the test results was pure agony.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他摔断腿后痛苦地尖叫。 ||| 球队承受了输掉决赛的痛苦。 ||| 等待测试结果简直是折磨。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 农业
[机] 农业, 农学
ieltsWords.collocations: sustainable agriculture 可持续农业, agriculture sector 农业部门, agriculture technology 农业技术
ieltsWords.example: Agriculture is the backbone of the country's economy. ||| Modern agriculture relies heavily on technology. ||| The government provides subsidies to support agriculture.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 农业是这个国家经济的支柱。 ||| 现代农业严重依赖技术。 ||| 政府提供补贴以支持农业。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 外国人, 外侨
a. 外国的, 相异的
ieltsWords.collocations: alien culture 异国文化, alien concept 陌生的概念, illegal alien 非法移民
ieltsWords.example: The customs of this tribe are alien to me. ||| Many science fiction movies feature aliens from other planets. ||| He felt like an alien in the new city.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个部落的习俗对我来说很陌生。 ||| 许多科幻电影都有来自其他星球的外星人。 ||| 他在新城市里感觉像个外国人。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使疏远, 离间, 转让
[法] 转让, 让与, 疏远
ieltsWords.collocations: alienate friends 疏远朋友, alienate voters 失去选民支持, feel alienated 感到被疏远
ieltsWords.example: His rude behavior alienated many of his colleagues. ||| The policy may alienate some minority groups. ||| She felt alienated from her family after moving abroad.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的行为疏远了许多同事。 ||| 这项政策可能会疏远一些少数群体。 ||| 移居国外后，她感到与家人疏远了。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 宣称, 主张, 提出, 断言
[法] 断言, 指称, 指证
ieltsWords.collocations: allege that 声称, allegedly 据称, allege wrongdoing 指控不当行为
ieltsWords.example: The victim alleged that the man had stolen her purse. ||| It is alleged that the company violated safety regulations. ||| The newspaper alleged corruption in the government.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 受害者声称那个男人偷了她的钱包。 ||| 据称该公司违反了安全规定。 ||| 报纸指控政府腐败。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 对...过敏的, 极反感的
[医] 变应性的
ieltsWords.collocations: allergic reaction 过敏反应, allergic to 对…过敏, allergic rhinitis 过敏性鼻炎
ieltsWords.example: She is allergic to peanuts and must avoid them. ||| Some people have allergic reactions to certain medications. ||| He is allergic to hard work, always looking for shortcuts.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对花生过敏，必须避免食用。 ||| 有些人对某些药物有过敏反应。 ||| 他对努力工作很反感，总是找捷径。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 变应性, 反感, 厌恶
[化] 变态反应; 变应性
ieltsWords.collocations: food allergy 食物过敏, allergy test 过敏测试, suffer from allergies 患有过敏症
ieltsWords.example: Her allergy to pollen causes sneezing in spring. ||| The doctor recommended an allergy test to identify triggers. ||| Many children outgrow their allergies as they get older.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对花粉过敏导致春天打喷嚏。 ||| 医生建议做过敏测试以找出诱因。 ||| 许多孩子长大后过敏症会消失。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 联盟, 联合
[法] 同盟, 联盟, 联姻
ieltsWords.collocations: form an alliance 结成联盟, strategic alliance 战略联盟, military alliance 军事同盟
ieltsWords.example: The two countries formed a military alliance for mutual defense. ||| The company entered into a strategic alliance with a tech firm. ||| The alliance between the parties helped them win the election.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 两国结成军事同盟以共同防御。 ||| 该公司与一家科技公司建立了战略联盟。 ||| 政党之间的联盟帮助他们赢得了选举。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 津贴, 零用钱, 限额, 折扣, 允许
vt. 定量供应
ieltsWords.collocations: make allowance for 考虑到, travel allowance 差旅津贴, weekly allowance 每周零花钱
ieltsWords.example: My parents give me a weekly allowance of $20. ||| The company provides a travel allowance for business trips. ||| We must make allowance for delays due to bad weather.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我父母每周给我20美元零花钱。 ||| 公司为出差提供差旅津贴。 ||| 我们必须考虑到恶劣天气造成的延误。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 合金
vt. 将...铸成合金, 减低成色
vi. 合铸
ieltsWords.collocations: aluminum alloy 铝合金, alloy steel 合金钢, alloy with 与…熔合
ieltsWords.example: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc. ||| The new alloy is stronger and lighter than pure metals. ||| The joy of success was alloyed with the sadness of leaving.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 黄铜是铜和锌的合金。 ||| 这种新合金比纯金属更坚固更轻。 ||| 成功的喜悦因离别的悲伤而打了折扣。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 同盟者, 同盟国, 助手
vt. 使联盟, 使联合, 使有关系
vi. 结盟
ieltsWords.collocations: close ally 亲密盟友, ally with 与…结盟, political ally 政治盟友
ieltsWords.example: The UK is a close ally of the United States. ||| They decided to ally with the neighboring country for trade. ||| She found an ally in her fight for equal rights.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 英国是美国的亲密盟友。 ||| 他们决定与邻国结盟以促进贸易。 ||| 她在争取平等权利的过程中找到了支持者。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 改变
ieltsWords.collocations: alter the plan 改变计划, alter one's mind 改变主意, alter the course 改变方向
ieltsWords.example: We had to alter our plans due to the weather. ||| The tailor altered the dress to fit perfectly. ||| The new evidence altered the outcome of the trial.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于天气原因，我们不得不改变计划。 ||| 裁缝修改了裙子使其完美合身。 ||| 新证据改变了审判结果。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 交替的, 轮流的, 间隔的
v. 轮流, (使)交替
ieltsWords.collocations: alternate route 替代路线, alternate between 在…之间交替, alternate with 与…交替
ieltsWords.example: We take an alternate route to avoid traffic. ||| The weather alternated between rain and sunshine. ||| She served as an alternate for the team captain.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们走另一条路线以避开交通拥堵。 ||| 天气时雨时晴。 ||| 她担任队长的替补。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 高度, 海拔, 高处
[电] 高度
ieltsWords.collocations: high altitude 高海拔, altitude sickness 高原反应, at an altitude of 在…海拔高度
ieltsWords.example: The plane is flying at an altitude of 10,000 meters. ||| Climbers may suffer from altitude sickness above 3,000 meters. ||| The city is located at a high altitude, so the air is thin.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 飞机在一万米的高度飞行。 ||| 登山者在海拔3000米以上可能会患高原反应。 ||| 这座城市位于高海拔地区，空气稀薄。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 业余爱好者, 外行, 爱好者
[电] 业余家
ieltsWords.collocations: amateur photographer 业余摄影师, amateur sports 业余体育, amateur status 业余身份
ieltsWords.example: He is an amateur musician who plays in his free time. ||| The competition is open to both amateurs and professionals. ||| Her amateur painting was surprisingly good.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他是一名业余音乐家，空闲时演奏。 ||| 比赛对业余爱好者和专业人士都开放。 ||| 她的业余画作出奇地好。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 使吃惊
ieltsWords.collocations: amaze someone 使某人惊奇, be amazed at 对…感到惊奇, never cease to amaze 总是令人惊奇
ieltsWords.example: The magician's tricks amazed the audience. ||| I am amazed at how quickly she learned Chinese. ||| The beauty of the sunset never ceases to amaze me.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 魔术师的把戏令观众惊奇。 ||| 我对她学中文的速度感到惊讶。 ||| 日落的美景总是让我惊叹不已。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 令人惊异的
ieltsWords.collocations: amazing experience 惊人的经历, amazing results 惊人的结果, absolutely amazing 绝对惊人
ieltsWords.example: The view from the top of the mountain was amazing. ||| She gave an amazing performance in the concert. ||| It's amazing how much progress he has made.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 山顶的景色令人惊叹。 ||| 她在音乐会上表演得非常精彩。 ||| 他取得的进步真是惊人。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 大使
[法] 大使, 使节, 代理
ieltsWords.collocations: ambassador to 驻...大使, former ambassador 前大使, cultural ambassador 文化大使
ieltsWords.example: The ambassador was invited to attend the international summit. ||| She served as a goodwill ambassador for the United Nations. ||| The new ambassador presented his credentials to the president.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大使受邀参加国际峰会。 ||| 她担任联合国亲善大使。 ||| 新任大使向总统递交了国书。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 不明确的, 模棱两可的
[法] 意思含糊的, 模棱两可的, 暧昧的
ieltsWords.collocations: ambiguous statement 模棱两可的陈述, ambiguous meaning 歧义, deliberately ambiguous 故意含糊的
ieltsWords.example: His ambiguous response left everyone confused. ||| The contract contains an ambiguous clause that needs clarification. ||| The results of the experiment were ambiguous and required further testing.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他模棱两可的回答让所有人都困惑。 ||| 合同中有个含糊的条款需要澄清。 ||| 实验结果不明确，需要进一步测试。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 野心, 志向
ieltsWords.collocations: political ambition 政治野心, career ambition 事业抱负, achieve one's ambition 实现抱负
ieltsWords.example: Her ambition is to become a successful entrepreneur. ||| He lacked the ambition to pursue higher education. ||| The young artist's ambition drove her to work tirelessly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她的雄心是成为一名成功的企业家。 ||| 他缺乏追求高等教育的抱负。 ||| 这位年轻艺术家的雄心驱使她不知疲倦地工作。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 救护车
[医] 救护车
ieltsWords.collocations: call an ambulance 叫救护车, ambulance service 救护服务, ambulance crew 救护人员
ieltsWords.example: The injured pedestrian was rushed to the hospital by ambulance. ||| An ambulance arrived at the scene within minutes. ||| The ambulance driver navigated through heavy traffic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 受伤的行人被救护车紧急送往医院。 ||| 几分钟内救护车就赶到了现场。 ||| 救护车司机在拥堵的交通中穿行。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 修改, 改善, 改良
vi. 改过自新
ieltsWords.collocations: amend the constitution 修改宪法, amend a contract 修改合同, amend one's behavior 改正行为
ieltsWords.example: The government decided to amend the education policy. ||| He promised to amend his ways after the incident. ||| The committee voted to amend the proposal.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府决定修订教育政策。 ||| 他承诺在事件后改正自己的行为。 ||| 委员会投票决定修改提案。

ieltsWords.definition:
prep. 在其间, 在其中
[经] 在...中
ieltsWords.collocations: amid the chaos 在混乱中, amid growing concerns 在日益担忧中, amid rumors 在谣言中
ieltsWords.example: The company remained profitable amid the economic downturn. ||| Amid the crowd, she spotted her long-lost friend. ||| The negotiations continued amid rising tensions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司在经济低迷期间仍保持盈利。 ||| 在人群中，她看到了失散多年的朋友。 ||| 谈判在日益紧张的局势中继续进行。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 总数, 总额
vi. 总计, 等同
ieltsWords.collocations: large amount of 大量的, amount to 总计达, total amount 总额
ieltsWords.example: A significant amount of money was donated to the charity. ||| The amount of homework assigned was overwhelming. ||| The bill amounted to $200.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大量资金被捐赠给了慈善机构。 ||| 布置的作业量令人不堪重负。 ||| 账单总计200美元。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 大量的, 充足的, 丰富的
ieltsWords.collocations: ample time 充足的时间, ample evidence 充分证据, ample space 宽敞的空间
ieltsWords.example: There is ample parking space available at the mall. ||| She had ample opportunity to express her views. ||| The garden provides ample room for children to play.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 商场有充足的停车位。 ||| 她有充分的机会表达自己的观点。 ||| 花园提供了充足的空间供孩子们玩耍。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 增强, 放大, 扩大, 详述
vi. 引伸
ieltsWords.collocations: amplify sound 放大声音, amplify the message 扩大信息, amplify the effect 增强效果
ieltsWords.example: The microphone amplifies the speaker's voice. ||| The media amplified the impact of the scandal. ||| He amplified his argument with detailed examples.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 麦克风放大了演讲者的声音。 ||| 媒体放大了丑闻的影响。 ||| 他用详细的例子详述了自己的论点。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 消遣, 娱乐, 使发笑
ieltsWords.collocations: amuse oneself 自娱自乐, amuse the audience 娱乐观众, be amused at 被...逗乐
ieltsWords.example: The clown's antics amused the children. ||| She amused herself by reading a novel. ||| We were amused by his witty remarks.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 小丑的滑稽动作逗乐了孩子们。 ||| 她读小说自娱自乐。 ||| 我们被他机智的言论逗乐了。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 相似, 类似
[计] 模拟
ieltsWords.collocations: draw an analogy 作类比, by analogy 通过类比, analogy between ...之间的类比
ieltsWords.example: The teacher drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump. ||| By analogy, we can understand the concept better. ||| There is an analogy between the two situations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师将人的心脏比作水泵。 ||| 通过类比，我们可以更好地理解这个概念。 ||| 这两种情况有相似之处。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 分析
[计] 分析机; 分析员; 分析; 分析程序
ieltsWords.collocations: data analysis 数据分析, in-depth analysis 深入分析, analysis of variance 方差分析
ieltsWords.example: The analysis of the data revealed interesting trends. ||| He provided a detailed analysis of the poem. ||| The report includes a thorough analysis of the market.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 数据分析揭示了有趣的趋势。 ||| 他对这首诗进行了详细的分析。 ||| 报告包括对市场的全面分析。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 祖先, 祖宗
ieltsWords.collocations: common ancestor 共同祖先, direct ancestor 直系祖先, ancestor worship 祖先崇拜
ieltsWords.example: Our ancestors lived in caves thousands of years ago. ||| The modern computer's ancestor was the abacus. ||| She traced her ancestors back to the 18th century.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们的祖先几千年前住在洞穴里。 ||| 现代计算机的前身是算盘。 ||| 她将自己的祖先追溯到18世纪。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 锚
vt. 抛锚停泊, 使固定
[计] 锚
ieltsWords.collocations: anchor the ship 抛锚停船, news anchor 新闻主播, anchor the program 主持节目
ieltsWords.example: The ship dropped anchor in the harbor. ||| She works as a news anchor for a local TV station. ||| The tent was anchored firmly to the ground.
