ieltsWords.exampleZh: 船在港口抛锚停泊。 ||| 她在当地电视台担任新闻主播。 ||| 帐篷被牢牢固定在地上。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 轶事, 奇闻
ieltsWords.collocations: personal anecdote 个人轶事, humorous anecdote 幽默轶事, share an anecdote 分享趣闻
ieltsWords.example: He entertained the guests with amusing anecdotes. ||| The book is full of historical anecdotes. ||| She told an anecdote about her childhood.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他用有趣的轶事逗乐了客人。 ||| 这本书充满了历史轶事。 ||| 她讲了一个关于她童年的趣事。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 忿怒
vt. 激怒, 使发怒
vi. 发怒
ieltsWords.collocations: anger management 愤怒管理, express anger 表达愤怒, suppress anger 压抑愤怒
ieltsWords.example: He struggled to control his anger. ||| The unfair decision angered the employees. ||| She felt a surge of anger at the insult.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他努力控制自己的愤怒。 ||| 不公平的决定激怒了员工。 ||| 她对侮辱感到一阵愤怒。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 生气的, 愤怒的
ieltsWords.collocations: angry at/about 对...生气, angry with 生某人的气, angry voice 愤怒的声音
ieltsWords.example: She was angry about the delay. ||| The angry crowd demanded justice. ||| He gave her an angry look.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对延误感到生气。 ||| 愤怒的人群要求公正。 ||| 他愤怒地看了她一眼。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 踝
[医] 踝, 踝关节
ieltsWords.collocations: sprain one's ankle 扭伤脚踝, ankle injury 脚踝受伤, ankle bracelet 脚链
ieltsWords.example: He twisted his ankle while playing basketball. ||| The doctor examined her swollen ankle. ||| She wore a silver ankle bracelet.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他打篮球时扭伤了脚踝。 ||| 医生检查了她肿胀的脚踝。 ||| 她戴着一条银脚链。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 周年纪念
ieltsWords.collocations: wedding anniversary 结婚纪念日, anniversary celebration 周年庆典, anniversary of  ...周年纪念
ieltsWords.example: They celebrated their 25th wedding anniversary. ||| The company marked its 50th anniversary with a gala. ||| The anniversary of the event was commemorated with a ceremony.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们庆祝了结婚25周年。 ||| 公司举办庆典庆祝成立50周年。 ||| 该事件的周年纪念日举行了仪式。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 公告, 发表, 告知
[经] 通告, 布告, 公告
ieltsWords.collocations: make an announcement 发布公告, official announcement 官方公告, public announcement 公开声明
ieltsWords.example: The company made an announcement about the merger. ||| The announcement of the winner was met with applause. ||| We are waiting for an official announcement from the government.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司发布了关于合并的公告。 ||| 获胜者的宣布赢得了掌声。 ||| 我们在等待政府的官方公告。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 使恼怒, 骚扰
ieltsWords.collocations: annoy sb. 惹恼某人, be annoyed at/about sth. 对某事感到恼怒, annoy with 因...而烦恼
ieltsWords.example: The constant noise from the construction site annoyed the residents. ||| She was annoyed at herself for making such a silly mistake. ||| It annoys me when people don't reply to my messages.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 建筑工地持续的噪音惹恼了居民。 ||| 她因为犯了这么愚蠢的错误而对自己感到恼怒。 ||| 当人们不回我消息时，我会感到烦恼。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 姓氏不详的, 无名的, 无特色的
[计] 无记录
ieltsWords.collocations: anonymous letter 匿名信, anonymous donor 匿名捐赠者, remain anonymous 保持匿名
ieltsWords.example: The whistleblower chose to remain anonymous for fear of retaliation. ||| An anonymous donor contributed a large sum to the charity. ||| The author of the article wished to stay anonymous.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 举报人因害怕报复而选择保持匿名。 ||| 一位匿名捐赠者向慈善机构捐赠了一大笔钱。 ||| 这篇文章的作者希望保持匿名。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 南极的, 南极地带的
n. 南极地区
ieltsWords.collocations: Antarctic Circle 南极圈, Antarctic region 南极地区, Antarctic ice sheet 南极冰盖
ieltsWords.example: Scientists study the Antarctic ice sheet to understand climate change. ||| The Antarctic Circle is one of the five major circles of latitude. ||| Many expeditions have been launched to explore the Antarctic region.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 科学家研究南极冰盖以了解气候变化。 ||| 南极圈是五个主要纬度圈之一。 ||| 许多探险队已被派往探索南极地区。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 人类学
[医] 人类学
ieltsWords.collocations: cultural anthropology 文化人类学, physical anthropology 体质人类学, social anthropology 社会人类学
ieltsWords.example: She decided to major in anthropology at university. ||| Cultural anthropology examines the customs and beliefs of different societies. ||| Anthropology provides insights into human evolution and diversity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她决定在大学主修人类学。 ||| 文化人类学研究不同社会的习俗和信仰。 ||| 人类学提供了对人类进化和多样性的见解。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 抗生素
a. 抗生的
ieltsWords.collocations: take antibiotics 服用抗生素, broad-spectrum antibiotic 广谱抗生素, antibiotic resistance 抗生素耐药性
ieltsWords.example: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to treat the bacterial infection. ||| Overuse of antibiotics can lead to antibiotic resistance. ||| It is important to complete the full course of antibiotics.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 医生开了抗生素来治疗细菌感染。 ||| 过度使用抗生素会导致抗生素耐药性。 ||| 完成整个抗生素疗程很重要。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 预期, 预料
[医] 提前出现(如遗传病)
ieltsWords.collocations: in anticipation of 期待..., with anticipation 满怀期待地, eager anticipation 热切期待
ieltsWords.example: The children were filled with anticipation on Christmas morning. ||| In anticipation of the storm, residents stocked up on supplies. ||| The team worked hard in anticipation of a promotion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 孩子们在圣诞节早晨满怀期待。 ||| 预计会有暴风雨，居民们储备了物资。 ||| 团队努力工作，期待升职。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 焦虑, 忧虑, 令人焦虑的事
[医] 焦虑
ieltsWords.collocations: anxiety disorder 焦虑症, cause anxiety 引起焦虑, with anxiety 焦虑地
ieltsWords.example: She felt a great deal of anxiety before her job interview. ||| Chronic anxiety can affect one's physical health. ||| The uncertainty of the future caused him anxiety.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在工作面试前感到非常焦虑。 ||| 慢性焦虑会影响身体健康。 ||| 未来的不确定性使他焦虑。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 房间, 公寓
ieltsWords.collocations: apartment building 公寓楼, rent an apartment 租公寓, apartment complex 公寓小区
ieltsWords.example: They live in a small apartment in the city center. ||| The apartment building has a gym and a swimming pool. ||| She is looking for an apartment to rent near the university.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们住在市中心的一个小公寓里。 ||| 这栋公寓楼有健身房和游泳池。 ||| 她正在找大学附近要租的公寓。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 无尾猿
[计] 应用程序评价
ieltsWords.collocations: great ape 大型猿类, ape species 猿类物种, ape-like 像猿的
ieltsWords.example: Gorillas are one of the largest ape species. ||| The study of apes helps us understand human evolution. ||| The ape swung from branch to branch in the jungle.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大猩猩是最大的猿类物种之一。 ||| 对猿类的研究有助于我们理解人类进化。 ||| 那只猿在丛林中从一根树枝荡到另一根。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 装置, 器具, 器官
[化] 仪器; 器械
ieltsWords.collocations: laboratory apparatus 实验室设备, breathing apparatus 呼吸器, apparatus for 用于...的装置
ieltsWords.example: The laboratory is equipped with modern apparatus. ||| Firefighters use breathing apparatus in smoke-filled buildings. ||| The apparatus for measuring temperature is very accurate.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 实验室配备了现代设备。 ||| 消防员在充满烟雾的建筑物中使用呼吸器。 ||| 测量温度的仪器非常精确。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 出现, 露面, 外观, 外表, 出版
[计] 外观, 版面
ieltsWords.collocations: physical appearance 外貌, make an appearance 露面, first appearance 首次出现
ieltsWords.example: Her appearance at the party surprised everyone. ||| Physical appearance should not be the basis for judgment. ||| The actor made a brief appearance in the film.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在派对上的出现让所有人惊讶。 ||| 外貌不应成为判断的依据。 ||| 那位演员在电影中短暂露面。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 附录, 附加物, 阑尾
[化] 增补
ieltsWords.collocations: appendix to 附录于..., in the appendix 在附录中, appendix removal 阑尾切除
ieltsWords.example: The details are provided in the appendix of the report. ||| He had to have his appendix removed due to appendicitis. ||| The appendix contains additional data and references.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 细节在报告的附录中提供。 ||| 他因阑尾炎不得不切除阑尾。 ||| 附录包含额外的数据和参考文献。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 食欲, 欲望, 爱好
[医] 食欲
ieltsWords.collocations: appetite for 对...的胃口, loss of appetite 食欲不振, healthy appetite 好胃口
ieltsWords.example: The spicy food stimulated her appetite. ||| He has a huge appetite for knowledge. ||| Stress can lead to a loss of appetite.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 辛辣的食物刺激了她的食欲。 ||| 他对知识有巨大的渴望。 ||| 压力会导致食欲不振。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 拍手喝彩, 称赞, 赞同
ieltsWords.collocations: applaud sb. 为某人鼓掌, applaud the decision 赞同决定, applaud loudly 大声鼓掌
ieltsWords.example: The audience applauded the performers at the end of the show. ||| We applaud the government's efforts to reduce pollution. ||| The crowd applauded loudly when the winner was announced.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 观众在演出结束时向表演者鼓掌。 ||| 我们称赞政府减少污染的努力。 ||| 当获胜者宣布时，人群大声鼓掌。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 器械, 用具, 应用
[医] 矫正器; 器
ieltsWords.collocations: household appliance 家用电器, kitchen appliance 厨房电器, electrical appliance 电器
ieltsWords.example: Modern kitchen appliances make cooking much easier. ||| The store sells a wide range of household appliances. ||| It is important to unplug appliances when not in use.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 现代厨房电器使烹饪变得容易得多。 ||| 这家商店出售各种家用电器。 ||| 不使用时拔掉电器插头很重要。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 申请者
[经] 申请人, 请求人, 谋事人
ieltsWords.collocations: job applicant 求职者, successful applicant 成功的申请人, applicant for 申请...的人
ieltsWords.example: There were over a hundred applicants for the position. ||| The applicant must have a degree in engineering. ||| Shortlisted applicants will be invited for an interview.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个职位有超过一百名申请人。 ||| 申请人必须拥有工程学学位。 ||| 入围的申请人将被邀请参加面试。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 应用的
[机] 应用的; 应用, 申请
ieltsWords.collocations: applied science 应用科学, applied mathematics 应用数学, applied research 应用研究
ieltsWords.example: He is studying applied mathematics at university. ||| Applied research focuses on solving practical problems. ||| The course covers both theoretical and applied aspects.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他在大学学习应用数学。 ||| 应用研究侧重于解决实际问题。 ||| 这门课程涵盖理论和应用两个方面。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 约会, 委任的职位, 委派
[经] 任命, 派, 指定
ieltsWords.collocations: make an appointment 预约, appointment with 与...的约会, by appointment 预约的
ieltsWords.example: I have a dentist appointment at 3 pm. ||| Her appointment as CEO was announced yesterday. ||| You can see the doctor by appointment only.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我下午三点有个牙医预约。 ||| 她被任命为首席执行官的消息昨天宣布了。 ||| 你只能通过预约看医生。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 评价, 估价
[经] 评价, 评估
ieltsWords.collocations: performance appraisal 绩效评估, appraisal of 对...的评价, property appraisal 房产评估
ieltsWords.example: The annual performance appraisal helps employees improve. ||| The expert gave an appraisal of the antique vase. ||| A property appraisal is required before selling the house.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 年度绩效评估有助于员工改进。 ||| 专家对古董花瓶进行了鉴定。 ||| 卖房前需要进行房产评估。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 学徒, 生手
vt. 使做学徒
ieltsWords.collocations: apprentice to 给...当学徒, apprentice program 学徒计划, apprentice electrician 电工学徒
ieltsWords.example: He started as an apprentice in a carpentry workshop. ||| The company offers an apprenticeship program for young people. ||| She worked as an apprentice chef in a famous restaurant.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他最初在一家木工车间当学徒。 ||| 该公司为年轻人提供学徒计划。 ||| 她在一家著名餐厅当厨师学徒。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 赞成, 批准
[化] 核准
ieltsWords.collocations: seek approval 寻求批准, give approval 给予批准, win approval 赢得认可
ieltsWords.example: The project received official approval from the government. ||| She nodded her head in approval. ||| The new policy is subject to board approval.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该项目获得了政府的正式批准。 ||| 她点头表示赞成。 ||| 新政策需经董事会批准。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 大约的, 接近的, 近似的
vt. 接近, 使接近, 粗略估计
vi. 接近于
ieltsWords.collocations: approximate value 近似值, approximate cost 大约成本, approximate number 近似数量
ieltsWords.example: The approximate cost of the renovation is $10,000. ||| Can you give me an approximate time of arrival? ||| The approximate number of participants was 200.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 翻新的大约成本是1万美元。 ||| 你能给我一个大约的到达时间吗？ ||| 参与者的近似数量是200人。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 水族馆, 养鱼池, 水草缸
[医] 培养缸
ieltsWords.collocations: visit an aquarium 参观水族馆, public aquarium 公共水族馆, tropical aquarium 热带鱼缸
ieltsWords.example: The children were fascinated by the sharks in the aquarium. ||| He keeps a small aquarium in his living room. ||| The aquarium has a special exhibit on coral reefs.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 孩子们对水族馆里的鲨鱼着迷。 ||| 他在客厅里养了一个小鱼缸。 ||| 水族馆有一个关于珊瑚礁的特别展览。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 水生动物, 水生植物
a. 水生的, 水中的, 水上的
ieltsWords.collocations: aquatic plants 水生植物, aquatic animals 水生动物, aquatic sports 水上运动
ieltsWords.example: Lotus is a common aquatic plant. ||| The lake supports a rich variety of aquatic life. ||| Swimming and diving are popular aquatic sports.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 莲花是一种常见的水生植物。 ||| 这个湖泊支持着丰富多样的水生生物。 ||| 游泳和跳水是受欢迎的水上运动。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 任意的, 武断的, 专治的, 霸道的
ieltsWords.collocations: arbitrary decision 武断的决定, arbitrary rule 专制统治, arbitrary choice 任意选择
ieltsWords.example: The judge criticized the arbitrary nature of the decision. ||| The selection process seemed completely arbitrary. ||| Citizens protested against the arbitrary actions of the government.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 法官批评了这个决定的武断性。 ||| 选拔过程似乎完全是任意的。 ||| 公民抗议政府的专制行为。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 北极的, 极寒的
n. 北极圈, 北极
ieltsWords.collocations: Arctic Circle 北极圈, Arctic region 北极地区, arctic weather 极寒天气
ieltsWords.example: Polar bears are native to the Arctic region. ||| The arctic winds made the temperature drop dramatically. ||| Scientists are studying the effects of climate change on the Arctic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 北极熊原产于北极地区。 ||| 极寒的风使温度急剧下降。 ||| 科学家正在研究气候变化对北极的影响。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 角斗场, 舞台, 场地
[医] 尿沉渣, 尿沙; 脑沙
ieltsWords.collocations: sports arena 体育竞技场, political arena 政治舞台, arena of debate 辩论领域
ieltsWords.example: The concert was held in a large indoor arena. ||| She is a prominent figure in the political arena. ||| The company entered the global market arena.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 音乐会在一个大型室内竞技场举行。 ||| 她在政治舞台上是一位杰出人物。 ||| 该公司进入了全球市场领域。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 提出理由, 争论, 辩论
vt. 主张, 辩论, 证明, 说服
ieltsWords.collocations: argue about 争论关于, argue with 与…争论, argue for 主张
ieltsWords.example: They argued about the best way to solve the problem. ||| I don't want to argue with you over such a trivial matter. ||| Many experts argue for stricter environmental regulations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们就解决问题的最佳方式争论不休。 ||| 我不想为这样的小事和你争论。 ||| 许多专家主张更严格的环境法规。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 争论, 论证, 论据, 自变量
[计] 参数
ieltsWords.collocations: have an argument 发生争论, strong argument 有力的论点, support an argument 支持论点
ieltsWords.example: They had a heated argument about politics. ||| Her argument was based on solid evidence. ||| The lawyer presented a compelling argument in court.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们就政治问题进行了激烈的争论。 ||| 她的论点基于确凿的证据。 ||| 律师在法庭上提出了令人信服的论据。

ieltsWords.definition: vi. 站立, 出现, 起来
ieltsWords.collocations: arise from 由…引起, arise out of 产生于, problems arise 问题出现
ieltsWords.example: New challenges arise as the company expands. ||| The accident arose from a simple mistake. ||| He arose from his seat to greet the guests.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 随着公司扩张，新的挑战出现了。 ||| 事故是由一个简单的错误引起的。 ||| 他从座位上起身迎接客人。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 军队, 陆军
ieltsWords.collocations: join the army 参军, army officer 军官, army of volunteers 大批志愿者
ieltsWords.example: He decided to join the army after graduation. ||| The army was deployed to maintain order. ||| An army of volunteers helped clean up the park.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他决定毕业后参军。 ||| 军队被部署以维持秩序。 ||| 大批志愿者帮助清理了公园。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 唤醒, 鼓励, 引起
vi. 醒来
ieltsWords.collocations: arouse interest 引起兴趣, arouse suspicion 引起怀疑, arouse emotions 激起情感
ieltsWords.example: The speech aroused great enthusiasm among the audience. ||| His strange behavior aroused the police's suspicion. ||| The documentary aims to arouse public awareness of the issue.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 演讲在观众中引起了极大的热情。 ||| 他的奇怪行为引起了警方的怀疑。 ||| 这部纪录片旨在唤起公众对这个问题的意识。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 排列, 衣服, 大批, 军队
vt. 布署, 打扮, 排列
[计] 数组; 阵列
ieltsWords.collocations: an array of 一系列, wide array 广泛的排列, array of options 一系列选项
ieltsWords.example: The store offers a wide array of products. ||| The data is stored in an array for easy access. ||| There is an impressive array of talent in the team.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家商店提供各种各样的产品。 ||| 数据存储在一个数组中以便访问。 ||| 团队中有一系列令人印象深刻的人才。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 到达, 抵达, 到达者
[经] 到达, 到达物
ieltsWords.collocations: arrival time 到达时间, arrival gate 到达口, new arrival 新来者
ieltsWords.example: We are expecting the arrival of the guests at 6 p.m. ||| The arrival of spring brings warmer weather. ||| Please check the arrival board for flight information.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们预计客人将在下午6点到达。 ||| 春天的到来带来了更温暖的天气。 ||| 请查看到达信息板了解航班信息。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 自大的, 傲慢的
ieltsWords.collocations: arrogant attitude 傲慢的态度, arrogant behavior 自大的行为, arrogant person 傲慢的人
ieltsWords.example: His arrogant attitude made him unpopular among colleagues. ||| She was too arrogant to admit her mistakes. ||| The arrogant manager refused to listen to suggestions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他傲慢的态度使他在同事中不受欢迎。 ||| 她太自大，不愿承认自己的错误。 ||| 傲慢的经理拒绝听取建议。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 发音清晰的, 口才好的
vt. 明白地说, 以关节连接, 使成为系统的整体
ieltsWords.collocations: articulate speaker 善于表达的演讲者, articulate expression 清晰的表达, articulate argument 清晰的论点
ieltsWords.example: She is an articulate and persuasive speaker. ||| The child was surprisingly articulate for his age. ||| He presented an articulate argument in the debate.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她是一位善于表达且有说服力的演讲者。 ||| 这个孩子就他的年龄而言出奇地口齿清晰。 ||| 他在辩论中提出了清晰的论点。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 火炮, 炮兵, 炮术
[机] 火炮, 炮兵
ieltsWords.collocations: heavy artillery 重型火炮, artillery fire 炮火, artillery unit 炮兵部队
ieltsWords.example: The army used heavy artillery to bombard the enemy positions. ||| Artillery played a crucial role in the battle. ||| The sound of artillery could be heard from miles away.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 军队使用重型火炮轰炸敌军阵地。 ||| 炮兵在战斗中发挥了关键作用。 ||| 几英里外都能听到炮声。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 上升, 追溯, 登高
vt. 攀登
ieltsWords.collocations: ascend to 上升到, ascend the throne 登基, ascend a mountain 登山
ieltsWords.example: The hot air balloon began to ascend slowly. ||| He ascended the corporate ladder quickly. ||| The climbers ascended the mountain with great difficulty.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 热气球开始缓慢上升。 ||| 他迅速晋升到公司高层。 ||| 登山者艰难地攀登了这座山。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 确定, 查明
[法] 查明, 弄清, 确定
ieltsWords.collocations: ascertain the truth 查明真相, ascertain the facts 确定事实, ascertain whether 查明是否
ieltsWords.example: The police are trying to ascertain the cause of the accident. ||| We need to ascertain the exact number of participants. ||| It is difficult to ascertain whether the information is accurate.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方正试图查明事故原因。 ||| 我们需要确定参与者的确切人数。 ||| 很难确定信息是否准确。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 归因于, 归咎于
[法] 归咎于
ieltsWords.collocations: ascribe to 归因于, ascribe meaning 赋予意义, ascribe importance 认为重要
ieltsWords.example: The success of the project can be ascribed to teamwork. ||| Many people ascribe their health problems to stress. ||| The painting is ascribed to a famous artist.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 项目的成功可归因于团队合作。 ||| 许多人将健康问题归咎于压力。 ||| 这幅画被认为是一位著名艺术家的作品。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 惭愧的, 羞耻的
ieltsWords.collocations: feel ashamed 感到羞愧, be ashamed of 为…感到羞耻, ashamed to do 羞于做
ieltsWords.example: He felt ashamed of his rude behavior at the dinner party. ||| She was too ashamed to admit that she had lied. ||| The government should be ashamed of its failure to address poverty.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他为自己在晚宴上的粗鲁行为感到羞愧。 ||| 她羞于承认自己说了谎。 ||| 政府应为未能解决贫困问题感到羞愧。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 热望, 志向, 渴望
[医] 吸入; 吸[引], 吸引术
ieltsWords.collocations: career aspiration 职业抱负, personal aspiration 个人志向, have an aspiration 有抱负
ieltsWords.example: Her aspiration is to become a leading scientist in renewable energy. ||| Many young people have high aspirations but lack the resources to achieve them. ||| The organization supports the educational aspirations of underprivileged children.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她的志向是成为可再生能源领域的顶尖科学家。 ||| 许多年轻人有很高的抱负，但缺乏实现它们的资源。 ||| 该组织支持贫困儿童的教育愿望。

ieltsWords.definition: vi. 渴望, 立志于
ieltsWords.collocations: aspire to 渴望成为, aspire to do 渴望做, aspire after 追求
ieltsWords.example: She aspires to become a successful entrepreneur. ||| Many athletes aspire to compete in the Olympic Games. ||| He aspired to a career in diplomacy from a young age.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她渴望成为一名成功的企业家。 ||| 许多运动员渴望参加奥运会。 ||| 他从小就有志于外交事业。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 暗杀
[法] 暗杀, 行刺
ieltsWords.collocations: political assassination 政治暗杀, assassination attempt 暗杀企图, target assassination 定点清除
ieltsWords.example: The assassination of the political leader shocked the entire nation. ||| The government foiled an assassination plot against the president. ||| Historical accounts often debate the motives behind famous assassinations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位政治领袖被暗杀震惊了整个国家。 ||| 政府挫败了一起针对总统的暗杀阴谋。 ||| 历史记载常常争论著名暗杀背后的动机。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 攻击, 袭击
vt. 袭击, 攻击
vi. 发动攻击
ieltsWords.collocations: sexual assault 性侵犯, assault charge 袭击指控, assault on 对…的攻击
ieltsWords.example: He was arrested for assault after the street fight. ||| The army launched an assault on the enemy stronghold. ||| The victim reported the assault to the police immediately.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他在街头斗殴后因袭击罪被捕。 ||| 军队对敌人据点发动了攻击。 ||| 受害者立即向警方报告了袭击事件。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 集合, 收集, 装配
vi. 集合
[计] 汇编
ieltsWords.collocations: assemble a team 组建团队, assemble evidence 收集证据, assemble furniture 组装家具
ieltsWords.example: The students assembled in the auditorium for the lecture. ||| It took us two hours to assemble the bookshelf. ||| The committee assembled a report based on the survey data.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生们在礼堂集合听讲座。 ||| 我们花了两个小时组装书架。 ||| 委员会根据调查数据汇编了一份报告。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 主张, 坚称, 断言
[法] 宣称, 断言, 维护
ieltsWords.collocations: assert oneself 坚持己见, assert authority 维护权威, assert that 声称…
ieltsWords.example: He asserted his innocence despite the strong evidence against him. ||| The manager asserted her authority by implementing new rules. ||| Scientists assert that climate change is caused by human activities.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 尽管有对他不利的有力证据，他仍坚称自己无罪。 ||| 经理通过实施新规定来维护她的权威。 ||| 科学家断言气候变化是由人类活动引起的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 评估, 估定, 评定的款额
[化] 评估
ieltsWords.collocations: risk assessment 风险评估, performance assessment 绩效评估, assessment criteria 评估标准
ieltsWords.example: The teacher gave a detailed assessment of each student's project. ||| A thorough risk assessment is required before starting the construction. ||| The company conducts annual performance assessments for all employees.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师对每个学生的项目进行了详细评估。 ||| 在开始施工前需要进行彻底的风险评估。 ||| 公司对所有员工进行年度绩效评估。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 资产, 有益的东西
ieltsWords.collocations: financial asset 金融资产, asset management 资产管理, valuable asset 宝贵资产
ieltsWords.example: Real estate is considered a long-term asset. ||| Her fluency in multiple languages is a great asset in her career. ||| The company's assets include cash, equipment, and intellectual property.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 房地产被视为一种长期资产。 ||| 她流利的多语言能力是她职业生涯中的一大优势。 ||| 公司的资产包括现金、设备和知识产权。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 分配, 功课, 任务, 转让, 归因, 陈述
[计] 赋值
ieltsWords.collocations: homework assignment 家庭作业, writing assignment 写作任务, assignment of duties 职责分配
ieltsWords.example: The teacher gave us a challenging math assignment. ||| He completed his assignment ahead of schedule. ||| The assignment of roles in the project was based on each member's skills.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师给我们布置了一项有挑战性的数学作业。 ||| 他提前完成了任务。 ||| 项目中的角色分配基于每个成员的技能。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 协助, 援助
[经] 援助, 帮助
ieltsWords.collocations: financial assistance 财政援助, technical assistance 技术援助, offer assistance 提供帮助
ieltsWords.example: The charity provides financial assistance to low-income families. ||| She offered her assistance to the elderly man carrying heavy bags. ||| International assistance is crucial for disaster relief efforts.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该慈善机构为低收入家庭提供经济援助。 ||| 她主动帮助那位提着沉重袋子的老人。 ||| 国际援助对救灾工作至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 助手, 助理, 助教
a. 有帮助的, 辅助的, 助理的
ieltsWords.collocations: personal assistant 私人助理, assistant manager 副经理, research assistant 研究助理
ieltsWords.example: She works as a personal assistant to the CEO. ||| The assistant professor taught the introductory course. ||| He hired an assistant to help with administrative tasks.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她是首席执行官的个人助理。 ||| 助理教授教授入门课程。 ||| 他雇了一名助手来处理行政事务。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 协会
[计] 关联
ieltsWords.collocations: professional association 专业协会, in association with 与…联合, association of ideas 联想
ieltsWords.example: She is a member of the local historical association. ||| The study found a strong association between smoking and lung cancer. ||| The event was organized in association with the university.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她是当地历史协会的成员。 ||| 研究发现吸烟与肺癌有很强的关联。 ||| 该活动是与大学联合组织的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 假定, 自负, 担任, 假装
[经] 假定, 承担
ieltsWords.collocations: make an assumption 做出假设, underlying assumption 基本假设, assumption of responsibility 承担责任
ieltsWords.example: We made the assumption that the data was accurate. ||| His assumption of the leadership role was widely welcomed. ||| The theory is based on several key assumptions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们假设数据是准确的。 ||| 他承担领导角色受到广泛欢迎。 ||| 该理论基于几个关键假设。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 保证, 把握, 信心, 保险
[经] 保证, 担保, 保险
ieltsWords.collocations: quality assurance 质量保证, give assurance 给予保证, self-assurance 自信
ieltsWords.example: The company gave us assurance that the product would be delivered on time. ||| She spoke with great assurance during the presentation. ||| Quality assurance is an essential part of the manufacturing process.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司向我们保证产品会按时交付。 ||| 她在演讲中表现得非常自信。 ||| 质量保证是制造过程中必不可少的一部分。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 保证, 使确信, 弄清楚, 担保
[法] 确信, 保证, 保障
ieltsWords.collocations: assure someone that 向某人保证, assure safety 确保安全, rest assured 放心
ieltsWords.example: I assure you that the project will be completed on time. ||| The pilot assured the passengers that the flight was safe. ||| You can rest assured that we will do our best.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我向你保证项目会按时完成。 ||| 飞行员向乘客保证飞行是安全的。 ||| 你放心，我们会尽最大努力。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 天文学
ieltsWords.collocations: astronomy department 天文学系, astronomy enthusiast 天文爱好者, modern astronomy 现代天文学
ieltsWords.example: He decided to major in astronomy after visiting the observatory. ||| Advances in astronomy have deepened our understanding of the universe. ||| She is an astronomy enthusiast who owns a telescope.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在参观天文台后，他决定主修天文学。 ||| 天文学的进步加深了我们对宇宙的理解。 ||| 她是一位拥有望远镜的天文爱好者。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 庇护, 收容所
[医] 养育院
ieltsWords.collocations: seek asylum 寻求庇护, political asylum 政治庇护, grant asylum 给予庇护
ieltsWords.example: The refugee sought asylum in a neighboring country. ||| The government granted political asylum to the dissident. ||| The old building was once a mental asylum.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 难民在邻国寻求庇护。 ||| 政府给予持不同政见者政治庇护。 ||| 这座老建筑曾经是一家精神病院。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 运动员, 运动选手
[医] 运动员
ieltsWords.collocations: professional athlete 职业运动员, Olympic athlete 奥运选手, athlete's foot 脚癣
ieltsWords.example: The athlete trained rigorously for the upcoming marathon. ||| Many young athletes dream of representing their country in the Olympics. ||| She is a versatile athlete who excels in both swimming and running.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位运动员为即将到来的马拉松进行了严格的训练。 ||| 许多年轻运动员梦想代表国家参加奥运会。 ||| 她是一位多才多艺的运动员，在游泳和跑步方面都很出色。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 地图集, 图表集
[计] 自动测试和负载分析系统
ieltsWords.collocations: world atlas 世界地图集, road atlas 道路地图册, historical atlas 历史地图集

ieltsWords.example: Protesters carried banners demanding justice. ||| The website displays a banner ad at the top of the page. ||| The team won the championship under the banner of their coach.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 抗议者举着要求正义的横幅。 ||| 该网站在页面顶部显示横幅广告。 ||| 该队在教练的旗帜下赢得了冠军。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 桶
vt. 装入桶内
ieltsWords.collocations: barrel of oil 一桶石油, gun barrel 枪管, barrel organ 手摇风琴
ieltsWords.example: The price of oil has risen to $80 per barrel. ||| The wine was aged in oak barrels for two years. ||| He cleaned the gun barrel carefully.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 石油价格已升至每桶80美元。 ||| 葡萄酒在橡木桶中陈酿了两年。 ||| 他仔细地清洁了枪管。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 不育的, 贫瘠的
n. 荒地
ieltsWords.collocations: barren land 贫瘠的土地, barren landscape 荒凉的景观, barren woman 不孕妇女
ieltsWords.example: The barren soil could not support any crops. ||| After the fire, the forest became a barren wasteland. ||| His efforts to negotiate a peace deal proved barren.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 贫瘠的土壤无法种植任何作物。 ||| 火灾后，森林变成了一片荒芜的荒地。 ||| 他谈判和平协议的努力毫无结果。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 地下室, 墙脚
[化] 地下室
ieltsWords.collocations: basement apartment 地下室公寓, basement floor 地下室楼层, storage basement 地下储藏室
ieltsWords.example: They stored old furniture in the basement. ||| The basement flooded after the heavy rain. ||| She rented a small basement room near the university.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们把旧家具存放在地下室里。 ||| 大雨过后地下室被淹了。 ||| 她在大学附近租了一间小地下室房间。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 基础, 主要成分
[化] 基底
ieltsWords.collocations: on a regular basis 定期地, on the basis of 基于, legal basis 法律依据
ieltsWords.example: We meet on a weekly basis to discuss progress. ||| The decision was made on the basis of the evidence. ||| This theory forms the basis of modern physics.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们每周会面讨论进展。 ||| 这个决定是基于证据做出的。 ||| 这个理论构成了现代物理学的基础。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 一次所烘的面包, 一次所制之量, 一组, 批, 成批, 分批
v. 成批, 分批处理
[计] 一批
ieltsWords.collocations: a batch of cookies 一批饼干, batch production 批量生产, in batches 分批地
ieltsWords.example: The bakery produces a fresh batch of bread every morning. ||| We processed the applications in batches. ||| The first batch of students graduated last year.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 面包店每天早上生产一批新鲜面包。 ||| 我们分批处理了申请。 ||| 第一批学生去年毕业了。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 电池, 殴打
[化] 蓄电池
ieltsWords.collocations: rechargeable battery 充电电池, battery life 电池寿命, battery charger 充电器
ieltsWords.example: My phone battery died during the meeting. ||| The car battery needs to be replaced. ||| He was charged with assault and battery.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我的手机电池在会议期间没电了。 ||| 汽车电池需要更换。 ||| 他被控人身攻击和殴打。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 海湾, 狗吠声, 月桂
vt. 吠, 使走投无路
vi. 吠
ieltsWords.collocations: bay window 凸窗, parking bay 停车位, bay area 湾区
ieltsWords.example: The ship anchored in the bay. ||| We have a loading bay at the back of the store. ||| The view from the bay window was stunning.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 船停泊在海湾里。 ||| 我们商店后面有一个装卸区。 ||| 从凸窗看出去的景色美极了。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 横梁, 杆, 光线, 容光焕发
vi. 用梁支承, 微笑, 射出光线
vt. 照耀, 感到欣喜
[计] 束
ieltsWords.collocations: laser beam 激光束, balance beam 平衡木, beam of light 光线
ieltsWords.example: The wooden beam supports the roof. ||| A beam of sunlight streamed through the window. ||| She beamed with pride when she received the award.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 木梁支撑着屋顶。 ||| 一束阳光从窗户射进来。 ||| 她领奖时自豪地微笑着。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 熊
vt. 忍受, 支承, 产生, 怀有, 通过卖空使跌价
vi. 忍受, 结果实, 压挤, 行进, 转向
ieltsWords.collocations: bear responsibility 承担责任, bear in mind 记住, bear market 熊市
ieltsWords.example: I cannot bear the pain any longer. ||| She bore three children in five years. ||| Investors are worried about the bear market.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我再也无法忍受这种疼痛了。 ||| 她五年内生了三个孩子。 ||| 投资者对熊市感到担忧。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 利益, 方面
ieltsWords.collocations: on behalf of 代表, in behalf of 为了…的利益
ieltsWords.example: I am writing on behalf of my mother. ||| He accepted the award on behalf of the team. ||| The lawyer acted on behalf of the client.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我代表我母亲写信。 ||| 他代表团队接受了奖项。 ||| 律师代表客户行事。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 举止端正, 行为规矩
vt. 检点(自己的)行为, 使表现好
ieltsWords.collocations: behave well 表现好, behave badly 表现差, behave oneself 守规矩
ieltsWords.example: The children behaved well during the trip. ||| He doesn't know how to behave in public. ||| She behaved as if nothing had happened.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 孩子们在旅途中表现很好。 ||| 他不知道如何在公共场合举止得体。 ||| 她表现得好像什么都没发生过。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 行为, 举止
[医] 行为
ieltsWords.collocations: human behavior 人类行为, social behavior 社会行为, behavior pattern 行为模式
ieltsWords.example: His behavior at the party was unacceptable. ||| Scientists study animal behavior in the wild. ||| Good behavior is rewarded in this school.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他在派对上的行为不可接受。 ||| 科学家研究野生动物的行为。 ||| 这所学校奖励良好行为。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 有益的, 受益的
[经] 有使用权的, 可享利益的
ieltsWords.collocations: beneficial effect 有益效果, beneficial to health 有益健康, mutually beneficial 互利的
ieltsWords.example: Regular exercise is beneficial to your health. ||| The new policy has a beneficial impact on the economy. ||| This agreement is mutually beneficial for both companies.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 定期锻炼有益健康。 ||| 新政策对经济有有利影响。 ||| 这项协议对两家公司互惠互利。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 出卖, 背叛, 辜负, 暴露
[法] 出卖, 背叛, 泄漏
ieltsWords.collocations: betray one's trust 辜负信任, betray a secret 泄露秘密, feel betrayed 感到被背叛
ieltsWords.example: He betrayed his friend by revealing his secret. ||| She felt betrayed when she learned the truth. ||| His expression betrayed his nervousness.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他泄露了朋友的秘密，背叛了他。 ||| 当她得知真相时，感到被背叛了。 ||| 他的表情暴露了他的紧张。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 饮料
[化] 饮料(如牛奶、茶、咖啡、啤酒等)
ieltsWords.collocations: alcoholic beverage 酒精饮料, hot beverage 热饮, beverage industry 饮料行业
ieltsWords.example: We offer a wide range of beverages, including coffee and tea. ||| Alcoholic beverages are not allowed in the park. ||| The beverage industry is highly competitive.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们提供各种饮料，包括咖啡和茶。 ||| 公园内禁止饮用酒精饮料。 ||| 饮料行业竞争激烈。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 使迷惑, 使不知所措
ieltsWords.collocations: bewilder someone 使某人困惑, completely bewildered 完全困惑的, bewildering variety 令人困惑的多样性
ieltsWords.example: The complex instructions bewildered the students. ||| She was bewildered by the sudden change of plans. ||| The bewildering array of choices made it hard to decide.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 复杂的说明让学生们感到困惑。 ||| 她对计划的突然改变感到不知所措。 ||| 令人眼花缭乱的选择让人难以决定。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 偏见, 斜纹
a. 偏斜的
adv. 偏斜
vt. 使有偏见
[计] 偏流; 偏压; 偏磁; 偏离
ieltsWords.collocations: gender bias 性别偏见, racial bias 种族偏见, bias against 对…有偏见
ieltsWords.example: The article showed a clear bias against immigrants. ||| We must avoid bias in the selection process. ||| His background biased him towards traditional values.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这篇文章明显对移民有偏见。 ||| 我们必须在选拔过程中避免偏见。 ||| 他的背景使他偏向传统价值观。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 圣经
ieltsWords.collocations: Holy Bible 圣经, read the Bible 读圣经, bible study 圣经学习
ieltsWords.example: She reads the Bible every morning. ||| This book is considered the bible of computer programming. ||| The Bible is one of the most widely printed books in history.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她每天早上读圣经。 ||| 这本书被认为是计算机编程的圣经。 ||| 圣经是历史上印刷最广泛的书籍之一。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 自行车
ieltsWords.collocations: ride a bicycle 骑自行车, bicycle lane 自行车道, bicycle helmet 自行车头盔
ieltsWords.example: He goes to work by bicycle every day. ||| The city has built new bicycle lanes to encourage cycling. ||| Always wear a bicycle helmet for safety.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他每天骑自行车上班。 ||| 城市修建了新的自行车道以鼓励骑行。 ||| 为了安全，始终要戴自行车头盔。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 出价
v. 命令, 吩咐, 请求, 表示, 宣布, 投标
ieltsWords.collocations: bid for 投标争取, make a bid 出价, bid farewell 告别
ieltsWords.example: The company bid $1 million for the contract. ||| She made a bid for the antique vase at the auction. ||| He bid farewell to his colleagues before leaving.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司为合同投标100万美元。 ||| 她在拍卖会上出价竞拍古董花瓶。 ||| 他离开前向同事们告别。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 有两边的, 双边的, 双方的
[医] 两侧的
ieltsWords.collocations: bilateral agreement 双边协议, bilateral relations 双边关系, bilateral trade 双边贸易
ieltsWords.example: The two countries signed a bilateral trade agreement. ||| Bilateral relations have improved significantly. ||| The talks focused on bilateral cooperation in education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项双边贸易协定。 ||| 双边关系显著改善。 ||| 会谈聚焦于教育领域的双边合作。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 双语的
ieltsWords.collocations: bilingual education 双语教育, bilingual speaker 双语使用者, bilingual dictionary 双语词典
ieltsWords.example: She is bilingual in English and French. ||| The school offers a bilingual program for immigrant children. ||| Bilingualism can enhance cognitive abilities.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她能说英语和法语两种语言。 ||| 这所学校为移民儿童提供双语课程。 ||| 双语能力可以增强认知能力。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 帐单, 清单, 钞票, 鸟嘴, 广告, 法案, 票据
vt. 开帐单, (用招贴)宣布
ieltsWords.collocations: pay the bill 付账, pass a bill 通过法案, dollar bill 美元钞票
ieltsWords.example: The waiter brought the bill after dinner. ||| The new bill was passed by parliament. ||| He handed me a ten-dollar bill.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 晚餐后服务员拿来了账单。 ||| 新法案在议会通过了。 ||| 他递给我一张十美元的钞票。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 绑, 约束, 装订, 包扎, 使结合
vi. 凝固, 有约束力
[计] 赋值, 绑定
ieltsWords.collocations: bind together 绑在一起, bind by contract 受合同约束, bind up 包扎
ieltsWords.example: They used rope to bind the boxes together. ||| The agreement binds both parties to the terms. ||| She bound the wound with a clean cloth.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们用绳子把箱子捆在一起。 ||| 协议约束双方遵守条款。 ||| 她用干净的布包扎了伤口。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 传记
ieltsWords.collocations: write a biography 写传记, authorized biography 授权传记, biography of a famous person 名人传记
ieltsWords.example: He is reading a biography of Einstein. ||| The biography reveals many unknown facts about the artist. ||| She decided to write her own biography.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他正在读爱因斯坦的传记。 ||| 这本传记揭示了关于这位艺术家的许多未知事实。 ||| 她决定写自己的传记。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 生物学的
[医] 生物学的
ieltsWords.collocations: biological diversity 生物多样性, biological process 生物过程, biological parent 亲生父母
ieltsWords.example: The park is known for its biological diversity. ||| Biological processes are essential for life. ||| She was adopted and never met her biological parents.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个公园以其生物多样性而闻名。 ||| 生物过程对生命至关重要。 ||| 她被收养，从未见过亲生父母。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 生物学
[化] 生物; 生物学
ieltsWords.collocations: study biology 学习生物学, molecular biology 分子生物学, biology class 生物课
ieltsWords.example: She is majoring in biology at university. ||| Molecular biology has advanced rapidly in recent years. ||| The biology class went on a field trip to the forest.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在大学主修生物学。 ||| 分子生物学近年来发展迅速。 ||| 生物课去森林实地考察了。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 奇异的
ieltsWords.collocations: bizarre behavior 怪异行为, bizarre idea 古怪想法, bizarre appearance 奇异外观
ieltsWords.example: He had a bizarre sense of humor. ||| The painting depicted a bizarre scene. ||| Her bizarre outfit attracted everyone's attention.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他有一种怪异的幽默感。 ||| 这幅画描绘了一个怪诞的场景。 ||| 她奇异的服装吸引了所有人的注意。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 过失, 责备
vt. 责备, 归咎于
ieltsWords.collocations: blame someone for 因...责备某人, take the blame 承担责任, put the blame on 把责任推给
ieltsWords.example: Don't blame me for the mistake. ||| He took the blame for the team's failure. ||| She put the blame on her colleague.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 别因为那个错误责备我。 ||| 他承担了团队失败的责任。 ||| 她把责任推给了同事。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 空格, 空白
a. 空白的, 空虚的, 完全的, 无色的
vi. 消失, 成为空白
vt. 使无效, 取消, 封锁
[计] 空白
ieltsWords.collocations: blank page 空白页, blank expression 茫然的表情, fill in the blank 填空
ieltsWords.example: Please write your name on the blank line. ||| He stared at me with a blank expression. ||| The test requires you to fill in the blanks.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请在空白行写上你的名字。 ||| 他茫然地看着我。 ||| 考试要求你填空。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 一阵风, 爆炸, 枯萎病
vt. 炸, 使枯萎
vi. 炸, 猛攻, 猛烈抨击, 枯萎
ieltsWords.collocations: bomb blast 炸弹爆炸, blast of wind 一阵风, blast off 发射升空
ieltsWords.example: The blast destroyed the building. ||| A blast of cold air hit us as we opened the door. ||| The rocket blasted off at dawn.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 爆炸摧毁了那栋建筑。 ||| 我们开门时一阵冷风袭来。 ||| 火箭在黎明时发射升空。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 火焰, 烈火, 光辉
vi. 燃烧, 发光
vt. 使燃烧, 宣布, 在树皮上刻痕
ieltsWords.collocations: blaze of fire 火焰, blaze a trail 开辟道路, blaze through 快速通过
ieltsWords.example: The firemen quickly put out the blaze. ||| The sun blazed down on the desert. ||| She blazed through the exam in an hour.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 消防员迅速扑灭了大火。 ||| 太阳炙烤着沙漠。 ||| 她一小时内快速完成了考试。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 流血, 悲痛, 渗出
vt. 使出血, 榨取
ieltsWords.collocations: bleed heavily 大量出血, bleed to death 流血致死, bleed the system 放气
ieltsWords.example: He cut his finger and it started to bleed. ||| The patient was bleeding heavily from the wound. ||| The company is bleeding money due to poor management.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他割伤了手指，开始流血。 ||| 病人伤口大量出血。 ||| 由于管理不善，公司正在亏损。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 混合
n. 混合
ieltsWords.collocations: blend in 融入, blend together 混合在一起, perfect blend 完美融合
ieltsWords.example: Blend the ingredients until smooth. ||| The new building blends in with the old architecture. ||| This coffee is a blend of beans from different regions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 将配料搅拌至顺滑。 ||| 新建筑与旧建筑融为一体。 ||| 这种咖啡是来自不同地区的豆子的混合。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 祝福, 祈佑, 使神圣化
ieltsWords.collocations: bless you 祝福你, be blessed with 有幸拥有, bless the food 为食物祈祷
ieltsWords.example: The priest blessed the congregation. ||| She is blessed with a beautiful voice. ||| They blessed the food before eating.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 牧师祝福了会众。 ||| 她有幸拥有一副美丽的嗓音。 ||| 他们在吃饭前为食物祈祷。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 蒙蔽物, 窗帘
a. 盲目的, 瞎的, 不加思考的
vt. 使失明, 蒙蔽, 遮暗
adv. 盲目地
ieltsWords.collocations: blind person 盲人, blind spot 盲点, blind faith 盲目信仰
ieltsWords.example: He is blind in one eye. ||| The bright light blinded me for a moment. ||| She pulled down the blinds to block the sun.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他一只眼睛失明。 ||| 强光使我暂时失明。 ||| 她拉下百叶窗遮挡阳光。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 街区, 木块, 石块, 块
vt. 阻塞, 封锁, 使成块状
[计] 块, 数据块
ieltsWords.collocations: block of flats 公寓楼, road block 路障, block the way 挡住路
ieltsWords.example: She lives three blocks away. ||| A fallen tree blocked the road. ||| He bought a block of cheese from the store.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她住在三个街区外。 ||| 一棵倒下的树阻塞了道路。 ||| 他从商店买了一块奶酪。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 花, 开花, 青春, 钢块
vi. 开花, 焕发青春, 茂盛
vt. 使茂盛, 把...轧成钢坯
ieltsWords.collocations: in full bloom 盛开, bloom of youth 青春年华, bloom into 发展成
ieltsWords.example: The roses are in full bloom. ||| Her talent began to bloom at an early age. ||| The cherry trees bloom in spring.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 玫瑰盛开了。 ||| 她的才华在很小的时候就开始绽放。 ||| 樱桃树在春天开花。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 花, 花开的状态, 兴旺期
vi. 开花, 兴旺, 发展
ieltsWords.collocations: cherry blossom 樱花, blossom into 发展成为, in blossom 开花
ieltsWords.example: The cherry blossoms are beautiful this year. ||| Their friendship blossomed into love. ||| The apple trees are in blossom.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 今年的樱花很美。 ||| 他们的友谊发展成了爱情。 ||| 苹果树正在开花。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 大错, 大失策
vi. 失策, 跌跌撞撞地走, 犯错
vt. 做错
ieltsWords.collocations: make a blunder 犯大错, blunder into 误入, costly blunder 代价高昂的错误
ieltsWords.example: He made a serious blunder in the report. ||| She blundered into the wrong room. ||| The decision turned out to be a costly blunder.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他在报告中犯了一个严重的错误。 ||| 她误入了错误的房间。 ||| 这个决定最终代价高昂。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使模糊, 弄脏
vi. 弄脏, 模糊
ieltsWords.collocations: blur the line 模糊界限, become a blur 变得模糊, motion blur 运动模糊
ieltsWords.example: The tears blurred her vision. ||| The distinction between work and leisure has blurred. ||| The photo is a blur because the camera moved.

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 推进, 吹捧
vt. 推进, 提高, 宣扬, 促进

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 边缘, 边境, 边界, 花坛
vt. 在...上镶边, 接近
vi. 接界, 近似
[计] 边框
ieltsWords.collocations: border control 边境管制, border dispute 边界争端, cross the border 过境, border line 边界线

ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们越过边境进入加拿大。 ||| 两国之间存在长期的边界争端。 ||| 花园以树篱为边界。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 烦扰, 迷惑
vi. 烦恼, 操心

ieltsWords.collocations: bother about 为……烦恼, bother to do 费心去做, don't bother 不必麻烦, bother someone 打扰某人

ieltsWords.exampleZh: 抱歉打扰你，你能帮我吗？ ||| 别为细节烦恼，只关注主要观点。 ||| 他甚至懒得回复我的邮件。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 跳, 跳跃, 弹力, 撞击
vi. 反跳, 弹跳
vt. 使跳回, 撞击
[计] 打回
ieltsWords.collocations: bounce back 反弹/恢复, bounce a ball 拍球, bounce off 弹开, bounce check 空头支票

ieltsWords.exampleZh: 球从墙上弹了回来。 ||| 预计明年经济将反弹。 ||| 她在膝盖上颠着婴儿。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 跃, 回跳, 范围, 边界
a. 受约束的, 装有封面的, 有义务的, 关联的, 被束缚的, 准备去...的, 便秘的

vt. 使跳, 限制, 形成...的疆界

ieltsWords.collocations: bound to happen 必然发生, bound by law 受法律约束, bound for 前往, be bound up with 与……密切相关

ieltsWords.exampleZh: 很快就要下雨了。 ||| 这艘船驶往纽约。 ||| 他感到受自己诺言的约束。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 边界, 分界线
[计] 边界

ieltsWords.example: The river forms the boundary between the two countries. ||| It is important to set clear boundaries in a relationship. ||| The fence marks the boundary of the property.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这条河构成了两国之间的边界。 ||| 在关系中设定明确的界限很重要。 ||| 篱笆标出了地产的边界。

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.exampleZh: 悬赏捉拿该罪犯。 ||| 菜园出产了大量的蔬菜。 ||| 公司有报告漏洞的奖励计划。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 联合抵制

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 目录, 大学概况手册
vt. 编目录
[计] 目录; 编目
ieltsWords.collocations: product catalog 产品目录, library catalog 图书馆目录, catalog sales 目录销售

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 目录, 大学情况一览
vt. 编入目录
ieltsWords.collocations: product catalogue 产品目录, library catalogue 图书馆目录, catalogue of disasters 一连串灾难
ieltsWords.example: The library has an online catalogue for students to search for books. ||| The company released its new product catalogue at the trade fair. ||| The earthquake was followed by a catalogue of aftershocks.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 图书馆有在线目录供学生查找书籍。 ||| 公司在贸易展上发布了新产品目录。 ||| 地震之后发生了一连串余震。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 大灾难, 大祸
[化] 突变
ieltsWords.collocations: natural catastrophe 自然灾害, environmental catastrophe 环境灾难, avert a catastrophe 避免灾难
ieltsWords.example: The flood was a major catastrophe that displaced thousands of people. ||| Without proper planning, the project could end in catastrophe. ||| Climate change is often described as a global catastrophe in the making.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 洪水是一场重大灾难，导致数千人流离失所。 ||| 没有适当的规划，这个项目可能会以灾难告终。 ||| 气候变化常被描述为一场正在形成的全球灾难。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 捕捉, 陷阱, 捕捉之物, 抓, 拉手
vt. 捕捉, 赶上, 感染, 听清楚
vi. 抓住, 燃着
ieltsWords.collocations: catch a train 赶火车, catch a cold 感冒, catch someone's attention 引起某人注意
ieltsWords.example: I need to catch the early flight to London tomorrow. ||| She caught a cold after walking in the rain. ||| The bright colors of the advertisement caught my attention immediately.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我明天需要赶早班飞机去伦敦。 ||| 她在雨中行走后感冒了。 ||| 广告的鲜艳色彩立刻引起了我的注意。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 提供饮食及服务, 投合, 迎合
ieltsWords.collocations: cater for 为…提供饮食, cater to 迎合, cater for all tastes 满足各种口味
ieltsWords.example: The restaurant can cater for up to 200 guests at a time. ||| The new policy aims to cater to the needs of small businesses. ||| The hotel offers a wide range of services to cater for international tourists.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家餐厅一次最多可接待200位客人。 ||| 新政策旨在满足小企业的需求。 ||| 酒店提供广泛的服务以满足国际游客的需求。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 给养；承办酒席；[医]提供饮食及服务
ieltsWords.collocations: catering industry 餐饮业, catering service 餐饮服务, catering company 餐饮公司
ieltsWords.example: The wedding reception was handled by a professional catering company. ||| The catering industry has been severely affected by the pandemic. ||| They offer a catering service for corporate events and private parties.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 婚宴由一家专业的餐饮公司承办。 ||| 餐饮业受到了疫情的严重影响。 ||| 他们为企业活动和私人聚会提供餐饮服务。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 天主教徒
a. 天主教的, 普遍的, 广泛的, 宽宏大量的
ieltsWords.collocations: Catholic Church 天主教会, Catholic school 天主教学校, catholic taste 广泛的兴趣
ieltsWords.example: He was educated at a Catholic school in Dublin. ||| She has a catholic taste in music, from classical to rock. ||| The museum's collection reflects a catholic range of artistic styles.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他在都柏林的一所天主教学校接受教育。 ||| 她对音乐有广泛的兴趣，从古典到摇滚都喜欢。 ||| 博物馆的收藏反映了广泛的艺术风格。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 牛, 家畜
[法] 家畜
ieltsWords.collocations: cattle farm 养牛场, cattle breeding 养牛业, herd of cattle 牛群
ieltsWords.example: The farmer raises cattle for both milk and meat production. ||| A large herd of cattle was grazing in the meadow. ||| Cattle farming is a major industry in many rural areas.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位农民养牛既为了产奶也为了产肉。 ||| 一大群牛在草地上吃草。 ||| 养牛业是许多农村地区的主要产业。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 小心, 慎重, 警示
vt. 警告
[计] 警告
ieltsWords.collocations: with caution 谨慎地, exercise caution 保持谨慎, caution against 警告不要
ieltsWords.example: You should proceed with caution when investing in risky assets. ||| The sign on the door said 'Caution: Wet Floor'. ||| The doctor advised caution against overexertion after surgery.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 投资风险资产时应谨慎行事。 ||| 门上的牌子写着‘小心地滑’。 ||| 医生建议手术后要小心避免过度劳累。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 谨慎的, 小心的
ieltsWords.collocations: cautious approach 谨慎的方法, cautious optimism 谨慎乐观, be cautious about 对…谨慎
ieltsWords.example: The government took a cautious approach to economic reform. ||| Investors are cautiously optimistic about the market recovery. ||| She is always cautious about sharing personal information online.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府对经济改革采取了谨慎的态度。 ||| 投资者对市场复苏持谨慎乐观态度。 ||| 她总是谨慎地在网上分享个人信息。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 洞, 穴
vi. 凹陷, 塌落
vt. 挖洞, 使凹陷, 损坏...的基础
ieltsWords.collocations: cave exploration 洞穴探险, cave painting 洞穴壁画, cave in 塌陷；屈服

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 停止
v. 停止, 终了
ieltsWords.collocations: cease fire 停火, cease to exist 不复存在, cease operations 停止运营
ieltsWords.example: The two sides agreed to a ceasefire after months of conflict. ||| The company will cease operations at the end of the year. ||| The old traditions have ceased to exist in modern society.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 双方在数月的冲突后同意停火。 ||| 该公司将在年底停止运营。 ||| 这些古老的传统在现代社会中已不复存在。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 地窖, 地下室, 藏酒
ieltsWords.collocations: wine cellar 酒窖, cellar door 地窖门, storage cellar 储藏地窖

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.definition:

ieltsWords.definition:
