ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们相遇纯属巧合。 ||| 碰巧，他们穿了同样的裙子。 ||| 真巧！我正想着你呢。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 合作, 勾结
[法] 通敌卖国者, 奸细
ieltsWords.collocations: close collaboration 紧密合作, collaboration with 与...合作, collaborative project 合作项目
ieltsWords.example: The project was a collaboration between two universities. ||| Close collaboration with industry is essential. ||| They were accused of collaboration with the enemy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该项目是两所大学的合作。 ||| 与行业的紧密合作至关重要。 ||| 他们被指控与敌人勾结。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 收集, 采集, (一批)收藏品, 募捐
[医] 收集; 收集品, 标本
ieltsWords.collocations: art collection 艺术收藏, collection of data 数据收集, tax collection 税收
ieltsWords.example: He has an impressive stamp collection. ||| The museum's collection includes ancient artifacts. ||| Data collection is the first step in research.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他有一个令人印象深刻的邮票收藏。 ||| 博物馆的收藏包括古代文物。 ||| 数据收集是研究的第一步。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 学院, 大学, 学会
ieltsWords.collocations: community college 社区学院, college student 大学生, college degree 大学学位
ieltsWords.example: She is attending college to study engineering. ||| Many students choose a community college for its affordability. ||| He earned his college degree in economics.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她正在上大学学习工程学。 ||| 许多学生选择社区学院因其费用低廉。 ||| 他获得了经济学大学学位。

ieltsWords.definition: vi. 碰撞, 互撞, 抵触
ieltsWords.collocations: collide with 与…碰撞, collide head-on 正面相撞, interests collide 利益冲突
ieltsWords.example: The two cars collided at the intersection. ||| Their views on education often collide. ||| The particles collide at high speed in the accelerator.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 两辆车在十字路口相撞。 ||| 他们在教育观点上经常冲突。 ||| 粒子在加速器中高速碰撞。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 碰撞, 冲突, 抵触
[计] 冲突
ieltsWords.collocations: head-on collision 正面碰撞, collision course 冲突路线, avoid a collision 避免碰撞
ieltsWords.example: The collision caused a major traffic jam. ||| The two countries are on a collision course over trade. ||| The collision of cultures can lead to misunderstandings.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 碰撞导致了严重的交通堵塞。 ||| 两国在贸易问题上正走向冲突。 ||| 文化冲突可能导致误解。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 殖民的, 殖民地的
[法] 殖民地居民
ieltsWords.collocations: colonial period 殖民时期, colonial power 殖民强国, colonial architecture 殖民风格建筑
ieltsWords.example: The country gained independence after a long colonial period. ||| Colonial powers exploited the resources of their colonies. ||| The city still has many colonial buildings.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该国在漫长的殖民时期后获得了独立。 ||| 殖民强国剥削其殖民地的资源。 ||| 这座城市仍有许多殖民时期的建筑。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 殖民地, 移民队
[医] 菌(集)落, 菌丛; 移民区
ieltsWords.collocations: former colony 前殖民地, crown colony 直辖殖民地, ant colony 蚁群
ieltsWords.example: The colony declared independence from the mother country. ||| There is a large Chinese colony in this city. ||| The ant colony works together to gather food.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该殖民地宣布脱离母国独立。 ||| 这个城市有一个很大的华人聚居区。 ||| 蚁群合作采集食物。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 专栏, 圆柱, 纵队, 列, 柱形物
[计] 列, 柱形图
ieltsWords.collocations: newspaper column 报纸专栏, spinal column 脊柱, column of smoke 烟柱
ieltsWords.example: She writes a weekly column for the local newspaper. ||| The temple is supported by marble columns. ||| A column of soldiers marched down the street.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她为当地报纸撰写每周专栏。 ||| 这座寺庙由大理石柱支撑。 ||| 一列士兵沿街行进。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 争斗, 战斗
vi. 战斗, 争斗
vt. 与...战斗, 与...斗争
ieltsWords.collocations: combat zone 战斗区域, hand-to-hand combat 肉搏战, combat crime 打击犯罪
ieltsWords.example: The soldiers were trained for combat. ||| The government is taking measures to combat inflation. ||| He was awarded a medal for bravery in combat.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 士兵们接受了战斗训练。 ||| 政府正在采取措施应对通货膨胀。 ||| 他因在战斗中的英勇表现被授予勋章。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 喜剧, 有趣的事情
ieltsWords.collocations: comedy film 喜剧电影, stand-up comedy 单口喜剧, comedy of manners 风尚喜剧
ieltsWords.example: The comedy had the audience laughing throughout. ||| He is known for his stand-up comedy routines. ||| The play is a comedy about family relationships.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这部喜剧让观众从头笑到尾。 ||| 他以单口喜剧表演闻名。 ||| 这部戏是一部关于家庭关系的喜剧。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 彗星
ieltsWords.collocations: Halley's Comet 哈雷彗星, comet tail 彗尾, observe a comet 观测彗星
ieltsWords.example: The comet appears once every 76 years. ||| Astronomers are tracking the comet's path. ||| The comet's tail is made of gas and dust.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这颗彗星每76年出现一次。 ||| 天文学家正在追踪彗星的路径。 ||| 彗尾由气体和尘埃组成。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 舒服的, 轻松的
n. 盖被
ieltsWords.collocations: comfortable chair 舒适的椅子, comfortable lifestyle 舒适的生活方式, feel comfortable 感到自在
ieltsWords.example: This sofa is very comfortable to sit on. ||| She has a comfortable income and can afford to travel. ||| I don't feel comfortable discussing this topic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这张沙发坐起来非常舒适。 ||| 她收入可观，能够负担旅行费用。 ||| 讨论这个话题让我感到不自在。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 连环漫画, 喜剧演员, 滑稽的人
a. 滑稽的, 有趣的, 喜剧的
ieltsWords.collocations: comic book 漫画书, comic strip 连环漫画, comic actor 喜剧演员
ieltsWords.example: He is a famous comic actor known for his slapstick humor. ||| The comic strip appears in the Sunday newspaper. ||| The situation was so absurd it was almost comic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他是一位以滑稽幽默闻名的喜剧演员。 ||| 连环漫画刊登在周日报纸上。 ||| 情况如此荒谬，几乎令人发笑。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 纪念
ieltsWords.collocations: commemorate an event 纪念事件, commemorate the anniversary 纪念周年, commemorative stamp 纪念邮票
ieltsWords.example: A statue was built to commemorate the war heroes. ||| The festival commemorates the founding of the city. ||| They issued a commemorative coin for the occasion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 建造了一座雕像以纪念战争英雄。 ||| 这个节日庆祝城市的建立。 ||| 他们为此发行了一枚纪念币。

ieltsWords.definition: v. (使)开始, 得学位
ieltsWords.collocations: commence operations 开始运营, commence proceedings 开始诉讼, commence with 以…开始
ieltsWords.example: The meeting will commence at 9 a.m. sharp. ||| Construction of the new bridge is scheduled to commence next month. ||| The ceremony commenced with a speech by the president.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 会议将在上午9点准时开始。 ||| 新桥的建设计划下个月开始。 ||| 仪式以总统的演讲开始。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 嘉奖, 委托给, 推荐
ieltsWords.collocations: commend someone for 因…表扬某人, highly commended 高度赞扬, commend itself to 受…欢迎
ieltsWords.example: The teacher commended the student for his hard work. ||| I commend this book to all who are interested in history. ||| The proposal commends itself to the committee.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师表扬了学生的勤奋。 ||| 我向所有对历史感兴趣的人推荐这本书。 ||| 该提案受到委员会的欢迎。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 注解, 批评, 评论, 备注
vi. 评论, 注解
[计] 备注
ieltsWords.collocations: make a comment 发表评论, no comment 无可奉告, comment on 对…评论
ieltsWords.example: He refused to comment on the allegations. ||| The article attracted a lot of comments online. ||| She made a brief comment about the weather.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他拒绝对这些指控发表评论。 ||| 这篇文章在网上吸引了很多评论。 ||| 她对天气做了简短评论。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 注释, 评论, 说明
[法] 注释, 评注, 评论
ieltsWords.collocations: live commentary 现场解说, political commentary 政治评论, commentary on 关于…的评论
ieltsWords.example: The sports commentator provided live commentary during the match. ||| His blog offers insightful commentary on current events. ||| The book includes a commentary on the text.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 体育解说员在比赛期间进行了现场解说。 ||| 他的博客对时事提供了深刻的评论。 ||| 这本书包含对文本的注释。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 商业的, 商用的, 商品化的
n. 商业广告节目
ieltsWords.collocations: commercial bank 商业银行, commercial success 商业成功, television commercial 电视广告
ieltsWords.example: The company focuses on commercial applications of the technology. ||| The film was a huge commercial success. ||| They aired a commercial during the Super Bowl.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司专注于该技术的商业应用。 ||| 这部电影取得了巨大的商业成功。 ||| 他们在超级碗期间播放了一则广告。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 委任状, 任官令, 所委职责, 佣金, 犯, 委托, 所托之事
vt. 委任, 委托制作, 使服役
ieltsWords.collocations: European Commission 欧盟委员会, commission a study 委托研究, sales commission 销售佣金
ieltsWords.example: The commission is responsible for investigating the accident. ||| She earns a 10% commission on each sale. ||| The artist was commissioned to paint a portrait.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该委员会负责调查事故。 ||| 她每笔销售赚取10%的佣金。 ||| 这位艺术家受委托画一幅肖像。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 委托(托付), 犯罪, 指派...作战, 使承担义务
[法] 犯, 做, 把...交托给
ieltsWords.collocations: commit a crime 犯罪, commit suicide 自杀, commit to 承诺；致力于
ieltsWords.example: He was found guilty of committing fraud. ||| The government has committed to reducing carbon emissions. ||| She committed herself to helping the poor.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他被判犯有欺诈罪。 ||| 政府已承诺减少碳排放。 ||| 她致力于帮助穷人。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 委托, 交押, 承担义务, 赞助
[医] 院禁
ieltsWords.collocations: make a commitment 做出承诺, strong commitment 坚定的承诺, commitment to 对…的承诺
ieltsWords.example: He made a commitment to finish the project on time. ||| The company shows a strong commitment to quality. ||| Balancing work and family commitments can be challenging.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他承诺按时完成项目。 ||| 该公司表现出对质量的坚定承诺。 ||| 平衡工作和家庭责任可能具有挑战性。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 委员会
[经] 委员会
ieltsWords.collocations: committee meeting 委员会会议, standing committee 常务委员会, committee member 委员会成员
ieltsWords.example: The committee will meet next week to discuss the proposal. ||| She was elected to the finance committee. ||| The committee consists of ten members.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 委员会将于下周开会讨论该提案。 ||| 她被选入财务委员会。 ||| 委员会由十名成员组成。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 农产品, 商品, 有用的物品
[经] 商品, 货物, 日用品
ieltsWords.collocations: commodity market 商品市场, commodity price 商品价格, agricultural commodity 农产品
ieltsWords.example: Oil is a vital commodity in the global economy. ||| The price of this commodity has fluctuated significantly this year. ||| Water is becoming a scarce commodity in many regions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 石油是全球经济中一种至关重要的商品。 ||| 这种商品的价格今年波动很大。 ||| 水在许多地区正成为一种稀缺商品。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 寻常事, 老生常谈, 普通的东西
a. 平凡的, 普通的
ieltsWords.collocations: commonplace occurrence 常见现象, commonplace book 摘录簿, become commonplace 变得普遍
ieltsWords.example: Smartphones have become commonplace in modern society. ||| It is now commonplace for people to work from home. ||| The idea was once revolutionary but is now commonplace.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 智能手机在现代社会已变得很普遍。 ||| 人们在家办公现在已很常见。 ||| 这个想法曾经是革命性的，但现在已很普通。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 交流, 交通, 通讯
[计] 通信
ieltsWords.collocations: communication skills 沟通技巧, means of communication 通信方式, effective communication 有效沟通
ieltsWords.example: Effective communication is essential in the workplace. ||| The internet has revolutionized global communication. ||| There was a breakdown in communication between the two departments.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 有效沟通在工作场所至关重要。 ||| 互联网彻底改变了全球通信。 ||| 两个部门之间的沟通出现了问题。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 交换, 折偿, 减轻
vi. 代偿, 经常乘车来往
ieltsWords.collocations: commute to work 通勤上班, commute between 在...之间通勤, commute a sentence 减刑
ieltsWords.example: She commutes to the city by train every day. ||| The long commute drains his energy. ||| The governor commuted the prisoner's sentence to life imprisonment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她每天乘火车通勤到城里。 ||| 长时间的通勤耗尽了他的精力。 ||| 州长将囚犯的减刑为终身监禁。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 乘公共车辆上下班者, 月季票乘客
[经] 非(当地)居民
ieltsWords.collocations: commuter train 通勤列车, commuter belt 通勤带, daily commuter 每日通勤者
ieltsWords.example: The commuter train was packed this morning. ||| Many commuters prefer cycling to work to avoid traffic jams. ||| The new express service benefits long-distance commuters.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 今早通勤列车非常拥挤。 ||| 许多通勤者更喜欢骑自行车上班以避开交通堵塞。 ||| 新的快车服务使长途通勤者受益。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 紧凑的, 紧密的, 简洁的
vt. 使紧密结合, 压缩
vi. 变坚实
ieltsWords.collocations: compact car 小型汽车, compact disc 光盘, compact design 紧凑设计
ieltsWords.example: The apartment has a compact but functional layout. ||| This camera is compact enough to fit in your pocket. ||| The soil was compact and difficult to dig.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这套公寓布局紧凑但功能齐全。 ||| 这款相机小巧到可以放进口袋。 ||| 土壤很紧密，难以挖掘。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 朋友, 陪伴, 指南, 升降口围罩
vt. 陪伴
ieltsWords.collocations: travel companion 旅伴, faithful companion 忠实伙伴, companion animal 伴侣动物
ieltsWords.example: My dog has been a loyal companion for years. ||| She was my constant companion during the trip. ||| A good book can be a wonderful companion on a rainy day.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我的狗多年来一直是我忠实的伙伴。 ||| 她是我旅途中的常伴。 ||| 一本好书在雨天可以成为很好的伴侣。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 公司, 友伴, 交往, 连队, 朋友, 一群
vt. 陪伴
vi. 交往
ieltsWords.collocations: company policy 公司政策, keep company 陪伴, in company with 与...一起
ieltsWords.example: She works for a multinational company. ||| I enjoy the company of my friends. ||| The company is expanding its operations overseas.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在一家跨国公司工作。 ||| 我喜欢和朋友在一起。 ||| 该公司正在扩大海外业务。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 可比较的, 比得上的
ieltsWords.collocations: comparable to 与...可比, comparable with 与...相当, comparable data 可比数据
ieltsWords.example: The two products are comparable in quality. ||| His salary is comparable to that of a manager. ||| We need comparable data from previous years.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两种产品质量相当。 ||| 他的薪水与经理的相当。 ||| 我们需要前几年的可比数据。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 分隔间, 卧车包房, 防水舱隔
[医] 隔室, 隔间
ieltsWords.collocations: luggage compartment 行李舱, glove compartment 手套箱, compartment of a train 火车车厢
ieltsWords.example: Please put your luggage in the overhead compartment. ||| The train compartment was empty. ||| The bag has several compartments for organization.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请将行李放在头顶行李舱内。 ||| 火车车厢是空的。 ||| 这个包有几个隔层便于整理。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 指南针, 范围, 音域
vt. 包围, 达到, 图谋, 理解
ieltsWords.collocations: compass needle 罗盘指针, moral compass 道德指南, within the compass of 在...范围内
ieltsWords.example: A compass is essential for hiking in the wilderness. ||| He lost his moral compass and made bad decisions. ||| The discussion stayed within the compass of the topic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在荒野徒步时指南针是必不可少的。 ||| 他失去了道德指南，做出了错误的决定。 ||| 讨论保持在话题范围内。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 能共处的, 可并立的, 适合的
[计] 相容的; 兼容的
ieltsWords.collocations: compatible with 与...兼容, compatible software 兼容软件, compatible relationship 和谐关系
ieltsWords.example: This software is compatible with all operating systems. ||| They are a compatible couple with similar interests. ||| The new device is not compatible with older models.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个软件与所有操作系统兼容。 ||| 他们是兴趣相投的和谐夫妻。 ||| 新设备与旧型号不兼容。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 强迫, 迫使
ieltsWords.collocations: compel someone to do 强迫某人做, be compelled to 被迫, compel attention 引起注意
ieltsWords.example: The law compels drivers to wear seat belts. ||| He felt compelled to tell the truth. ||| Her performance compelled the audience's attention.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 法律强制驾驶员系安全带。 ||| 他感到被迫说出真相。 ||| 她的表演引起了观众的注意。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 补偿, 赔偿金, 工资
[医] 代偿(机能), 补偿
ieltsWords.collocations: compensation package 薪酬包, compensation for 对...的补偿, claim compensation 索赔
ieltsWords.example: The company offered compensation for the damaged goods. ||| He received a generous compensation package when he retired. ||| Victims are seeking compensation for their losses.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司对损坏的货物提供了赔偿。 ||| 他退休时获得了丰厚的薪酬包。 ||| 受害者正在寻求损失赔偿。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 胜任, 职称, 能力
[医] 能力, 活性
ieltsWords.collocations: professional competence 专业能力, core competence 核心竞争力, demonstrate competence 展示能力
ieltsWords.example: The job requires a high level of technical competence. ||| She demonstrated her competence in handling the crisis. ||| The team's competence is beyond doubt.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这份工作需要高水平的技术能力。 ||| 她展示了处理危机的能力。 ||| 团队的能力毋庸置疑。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 竞争, 竞赛
[经] 竞争, 竞销, 比赛
ieltsWords.collocations: fierce competition 激烈竞争, competition for 对...的竞争, face competition 面临竞争
ieltsWords.example: There is intense competition for the scholarship. ||| The company faces stiff competition from overseas rivals. ||| She won first place in the piano competition.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 奖学金的竞争非常激烈。 ||| 公司面临来自海外对手的激烈竞争。 ||| 她在钢琴比赛中获得了第一名。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 竞争的
[经] 竞争的
ieltsWords.collocations: competitive advantage 竞争优势, competitive price 有竞争力的价格, competitive market 竞争市场
ieltsWords.example: The company needs to stay competitive in the global market. ||| He has a very competitive nature. ||| They offer competitive prices and high quality.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司需要保持在全球市场的竞争力。 ||| 他非常好胜。 ||| 他们提供有竞争力的价格和高质量。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 编译, 编辑, 编纂, 收集
[计] 编译
ieltsWords.collocations: compile data 汇编数据, compile a list 编制清单, compile information 收集信息
ieltsWords.example: The researcher compiled data from various sources. ||| We need to compile a report by the end of the week. ||| The dictionary was compiled over many years.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 研究人员从各种来源汇编了数据。 ||| 我们需要在周末前编制一份报告。 ||| 这本词典是经过多年编纂而成的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 诉苦, 抱怨, 控诉
[医] 陈诉; 病
ieltsWords.collocations: make a complaint 投诉, complaint about 关于...的投诉, lodge a complaint 提出投诉
ieltsWords.example: She filed a complaint about the poor service. ||| The customer's complaint was handled promptly. ||| He has no complaints about his job.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她就服务差提出了投诉。 ||| 顾客的投诉得到了及时处理。 ||| 他对自己的工作没有怨言。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 补足物, 补语, 补数
vt. 补充, 补足
[计] 补码; 反相器; 补数
ieltsWords.collocations: complement each other 相互补充, complement one's skills 补充技能, complement the team 补充团队
ieltsWords.example: The wine complements the cheese perfectly. ||| Her skills complement those of her colleague. ||| The new building complements the existing architecture.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这种酒与奶酪完美搭配。 ||| 她的技能与同事的技能互补。 ||| 新建筑与现有建筑相得益彰。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 肤色, 情况, 局面
[医] 体质; 面色, 面容
ieltsWords.collocations: fair complexion 白皙肤色, dark complexion 深色肤色, healthy complexion 健康面色
ieltsWords.example: She has a fair complexion that burns easily in the sun. ||| The political complexion of the region has changed dramatically. ||| Regular exercise can improve your complexion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她肤色白皙，在阳光下容易晒伤。 ||| 该地区的政治局面发生了巨大变化。 ||| 定期锻炼可以改善你的肤色。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 遵从, 顺从, 屈从
[化] 柔顺; 顺应
ieltsWords.collocations: in compliance with 遵守, regulatory compliance 监管合规, compliance department 合规部门
ieltsWords.example: All employees must act in compliance with company policies. ||| The factory was fined for non-compliance with safety regulations. ||| Her compliance with the doctor's advice led to a quick recovery.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 所有员工必须遵守公司政策。 ||| 该工厂因违反安全规定被罚款。 ||| 她遵从医生的建议，很快康复了。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 复杂的
[医] 并发的
ieltsWords.collocations: complicated process 复杂过程, complicated relationship 复杂关系, complicated instructions 复杂说明
ieltsWords.example: The instructions were so complicated that I gave up reading them. ||| Their relationship is complicated and hard to explain. ||| Solving this complicated equation requires advanced math skills.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 说明太复杂了，我放弃了阅读。 ||| 他们的关系很复杂，难以解释。 ||| 解这个复杂方程需要高级数学技能。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 复杂化, 复杂情况
[医] 并发症, 并发病
ieltsWords.collocations: medical complication 医疗并发症, unexpected complication 意外并发症, avoid complication 避免复杂化
ieltsWords.example: The patient developed a complication after the surgery. ||| The project faced unexpected complications due to bad weather. ||| Adding more rules will only create unnecessary complications.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 病人手术后出现了并发症。 ||| 由于恶劣天气，项目遇到了意外困难。 ||| 增加更多规则只会造成不必要的复杂化。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 称赞, 恭维, 敬意
vt. 称赞, 褒扬, 恭维
ieltsWords.collocations: pay a compliment 给予赞美, receive a compliment 接受赞美, return the compliment 回敬赞美
ieltsWords.example: She paid him a compliment on his excellent presentation. ||| I take that as a compliment, thank you. ||| He complimented her on her new hairstyle.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她称赞他出色的演讲。 ||| 我视之为赞美，谢谢。 ||| 他称赞她的新发型。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 顺从, 依从
[法] 遵守, 承诺, 照做
ieltsWords.collocations: comply with regulations 遵守规定, comply with requests 服从要求, comply with standards 符合标准
ieltsWords.example: All citizens must comply with the law. ||| The company failed to comply with safety standards. ||| He reluctantly complied with the doctor's orders.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 所有公民必须遵守法律。 ||| 该公司未能遵守安全标准。 ||| 他不情愿地遵从了医生的嘱咐。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 组成, 写作, 作曲, 使平静
vi. 创作, 排字
[计] 编写
ieltsWords.collocations: compose a song 创作歌曲, compose a letter 写信, be composed of 由……组成
ieltsWords.example: Mozart composed his first symphony at the age of eight. ||| Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen. ||| She took a deep breath to compose herself before the interview.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 莫扎特八岁时创作了他的第一部交响曲。 ||| 水由氢和氧组成。 ||| 她深吸一口气，在面试前使自己镇定下来。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 合成的, 混合成的, 菊科的
n. 合成物, 复合材料, 菊科
ieltsWords.collocations: composite material 复合材料, composite index 综合指数, composite image 合成图像
ieltsWords.example: The aircraft uses advanced composite materials to reduce weight. ||| The composite index rose by 2% this quarter. ||| The photo is a composite of several images.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 飞机使用先进的复合材料来减轻重量。 ||| 综合指数本季度上涨了2%。 ||| 这张照片是由几张图像合成的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 作文, 创作, 组成
[化] 成分; 组成
ieltsWords.collocations: write a composition 写作文, chemical composition 化学成分, musical composition 音乐作品
ieltsWords.example: Students are required to write a composition on environmental protection. ||| The chemical composition of the substance is unknown. ||| Beethoven's compositions are still widely performed today.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生需要写一篇关于环境保护的作文。 ||| 该物质的化学成分未知。 ||| 贝多芬的作品至今仍被广泛演奏。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 混合物, 复合词, 化合物, 院子
a. 复合的, 混合的, 化合的
vi. 化合, 和解, 妥协
vt. 使复合, 使化合
ieltsWords.collocations: chemical compound 化合物, compound interest 复利, compound a problem 使问题恶化
ieltsWords.example: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen. ||| The bank offers compound interest on savings accounts. ||| His mistake only compounded the existing problems.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 水是氢和氧的化合物。 ||| 银行对储蓄账户提供复利。 ||| 他的错误只会加剧现有问题。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 压缩, 压紧
vi. 受压缩小
[计] 压缩程序
ieltsWords.collocations: compress data 压缩数据, compress time 压缩时间, compress a file 压缩文件
ieltsWords.example: The software can compress large files to save storage space. ||| The lecture was compressed into a one-hour session. ||| Apply a cold compress to reduce swelling.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该软件可以压缩大文件以节省存储空间。 ||| 讲座被压缩成一个小时的课程。 ||| 用冷敷来消肿。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 包含, 构成
ieltsWords.collocations: comprise of 由……组成, be comprised of 由……构成, comprise many parts 包含许多部分
ieltsWords.example: The committee comprises experts from various fields. ||| The collection comprises over 500 paintings. ||| The United Kingdom comprises England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 委员会由来自不同领域的专家组成。 ||| 这个收藏包括500多幅画作。 ||| 联合王国由英格兰、苏格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰组成。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 妥协, 折中, 折中方案, 和解
vi. 妥协处理
vt. 危害
ieltsWords.collocations: reach a compromise 达成妥协, compromise on 在……上妥协, compromise security 危及安全
ieltsWords.example: Both sides need to reach a compromise to end the dispute. ||| He refused to compromise on his principles. ||| Using weak passwords can compromise your online security.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 双方需要达成妥协以结束争端。 ||| 他拒绝在原则上妥协。 ||| 使用弱密码可能会危及你的网络安全。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 被强制的, 强迫的, 义务的
[经] 强迫的, 强制的
ieltsWords.collocations: compulsory education 义务教育, compulsory course 必修课, compulsory military service 义务兵役
ieltsWords.example: In many countries, education is compulsory for children up to age 16. ||| The course is compulsory for all first-year students. ||| Some nations have compulsory military service for young adults.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在许多国家，16岁以下儿童接受义务教育。 ||| 这门课是所有一年级学生的必修课。 ||| 一些国家要求年轻人服义务兵役。

ieltsWords.definition:
v. 计算, 估算
n. 计算, 估算
ieltsWords.collocations: compute the cost 计算成本, compute the average 计算平均值, compute accurately 精确计算
ieltsWords.example: The software can compute the total cost in seconds. ||| We need to compute the average score of the class. ||| The results were computed using a complex algorithm.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该软件可以在几秒钟内计算出总成本。 ||| 我们需要计算班级的平均分。 ||| 结果是用复杂算法计算出来的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 电脑, 电子计算机
[计] 计算机
ieltsWords.collocations: personal computer 个人电脑, computer program 计算机程序, computer science 计算机科学
ieltsWords.example: She works as a computer programmer for a tech company. ||| The computer crashed and I lost all my data. ||| Computer technology has advanced rapidly in recent decades.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在一家科技公司担任计算机程序员。 ||| 电脑死机了，我丢失了所有数据。 ||| 近几十年来，计算机技术发展迅速。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 隐藏, 掩盖, 隐瞒
[法] 隐瞒, 隐匿, 保守秘密
ieltsWords.collocations: conceal the truth 隐瞒真相, conceal a weapon 隐藏武器, conceal one's feelings 掩饰感情
ieltsWords.example: He tried to conceal his disappointment, but his face gave him away. ||| The spy concealed the documents in a secret compartment. ||| She could not conceal her anger at the unfair treatment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他试图掩饰失望，但脸色暴露了他。 ||| 间谍把文件藏在一个秘密隔层里。 ||| 她无法掩饰对不公正待遇的愤怒。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 承认, 退让
vi. 让步
ieltsWords.collocations: concede defeat 承认失败, concede a point 承认某点正确, concede to demands 让步于要求
ieltsWords.example: After a long debate, he finally conceded that he was wrong. ||| The candidate conceded the election after the results were clear. ||| The government conceded to the protesters' demands.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 经过长时间辩论，他终于承认自己错了。 ||| 结果明朗后，候选人承认选举失败。 ||| 政府对抗议者的要求做出了让步。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 构思, 认为
vi. 怀孕
ieltsWords.collocations: conceive an idea 构想一个想法, conceive of 想象, conceive a child 怀孕
ieltsWords.example: The architect conceived a brilliant design for the new museum. ||| I cannot conceive of living in such a remote place. ||| The couple was overjoyed when they conceived their first child.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 建筑师为新博物馆构想了一个出色的设计。 ||| 我无法想象住在如此偏远的地方。 ||| 这对夫妇在怀上第一个孩子时欣喜若狂。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 观念, 概念
[医] 妊娠, 受孕; 概念
ieltsWords.collocations: abstract conception 抽象概念, initial conception 最初构想, conception of beauty 美的观念
ieltsWords.example: His conception of justice differs from mine. ||| The project was still in its early conception stage. ||| The exact moment of conception is difficult to determine.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他对正义的理解与我的不同。 ||| 该项目仍处于早期构想阶段。 ||| 受孕的确切时刻很难确定。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 音乐会, 和声, 一致
vt. 协力, 协调
vi. 协力
[计] 美国北卡罗来纳州Internet网
ieltsWords.collocations: attend a concert 参加音乐会, in concert with 与…一致, rock concert 摇滚音乐会
ieltsWords.example: We attended a classical concert at the Royal Albert Hall. ||| The two countries acted in concert to address the climate crisis. ||| The band's concert was sold out within hours.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们在皇家阿尔伯特音乐厅参加了一场古典音乐会。 ||| 两国一致行动应对气候危机。 ||| 乐队的音乐会在几小时内售罄。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 特许, 让步, 认可
[经] 核准, 许可, 特殊(权)
ieltsWords.collocations: make a concession 做出让步, trade concession 贸易优惠, tax concession 税收减免
ieltsWords.example: The government made a concession to the protesters by reducing taxes. ||| The company obtained a mining concession in the region. ||| Students can get a concession on public transport fares.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府通过减税向抗议者做出让步。 ||| 该公司获得了该地区的采矿特许权。 ||| 学生可以享受公共交通票价优惠。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 简洁的, 简明的
ieltsWords.collocations: concise summary 简洁的总结, concise explanation 简明的解释, concise writing 简洁的写作
ieltsWords.example: The report should be concise and to the point. ||| She gave a concise overview of the project. ||| His concise speech impressed the audience.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 报告应该简洁明了。 ||| 她简要概述了项目。 ||| 他简洁的演讲给观众留下了深刻印象。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 结论, 结尾, 推论
[法] 缔结, 结论, 推论
ieltsWords.collocations: draw a conclusion 得出结论, in conclusion 总之, reach a conclusion 达成结论
ieltsWords.example: The researchers drew a conclusion based on the data. ||| In conclusion, the experiment was a success. ||| The conclusion of the movie was unexpected.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 研究人员根据数据得出了结论。 ||| 总之，实验是成功的。 ||| 电影的结局出人意料。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 凝结物, 混凝土
a. 具体的, 实在的, 混凝土的
v. (使)凝结, 用混凝土浇筑
ieltsWords.collocations: concrete evidence 具体证据, concrete proposal 具体建议, concrete example 具体例子
ieltsWords.example: We need concrete evidence to support the theory. ||| The architect designed a concrete building. ||| Can you give me a concrete example of what you mean?
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要具体证据来支持这个理论。 ||| 建筑师设计了一座混凝土建筑。 ||| 你能给我一个具体的例子来说明你的意思吗？

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 判刑, 责备, 谴责
[法] 定罪, 判刑, 宣告有罪
ieltsWords.collocations: condemn violence 谴责暴力, condemn someone to death 判处某人死刑, condemn to poverty 迫使陷入贫困
ieltsWords.example: The international community condemned the act of terrorism. ||| The judge condemned the criminal to life imprisonment. ||| Poor education condemns many children to a life of poverty.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 国际社会谴责了恐怖主义行为。 ||| 法官判处罪犯终身监禁。 ||| 不良教育使许多孩子一生贫困。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使浓缩, 使压缩, 缩短
vi. 浓缩, 凝结
ieltsWords.collocations: condense a report 压缩报告, condense milk 浓缩牛奶, condense into 浓缩成
ieltsWords.example: The article was condensed into a few paragraphs. ||| Steam condenses into water when it cools. ||| The author condensed the novel for a film adaptation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这篇文章被压缩成了几段。 ||| 蒸汽冷却时凝结成水。 ||| 作者为电影改编精简了小说。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 情况, 条件
vt. 使健康, 以...为条件, 决定, 使适应
[计] 条件
ieltsWords.collocations: living conditions 生活条件, on condition that 在…条件下, medical condition 医疗状况
ieltsWords.example: The car is in excellent condition. ||| He agreed to help on condition that I pay him. ||| The patient's condition is improving.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这辆车状况极佳。 ||| 他同意帮忙，条件是我付钱给他。 ||| 病人的状况正在好转。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 授予, 带来
vi. 协商
ieltsWords.collocations: confer a degree 授予学位, confer with someone 与某人商议, confer benefits 带来好处
ieltsWords.example: The university conferred an honorary degree on the scientist. ||| The manager conferred with the team before making a decision. ||| Regular exercise confers many health benefits.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大学授予这位科学家荣誉学位。 ||| 经理在做出决定前与团队商议。 ||| 定期锻炼带来许多健康益处。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 承认, 坦白, 忏悔, 供认
ieltsWords.collocations: confess to a crime 认罪, confess one's feelings 坦白感情, confess one's sins 忏悔罪过
ieltsWords.example: The suspect confessed to the robbery. ||| She confessed her love for him. ||| He went to church to confess his sins.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 嫌疑人承认了抢劫罪。 ||| 她坦白了对他的爱。 ||| 他去教堂忏悔自己的罪过。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 信心
[电] 可靠
ieltsWords.collocations: have confidence in 对…有信心, gain confidence 获得信心, vote of confidence 信任投票
ieltsWords.example: She has great confidence in her abilities. ||| The team gained confidence after winning the match. ||| The government won a vote of confidence in parliament.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对自己的能力很有信心。 ||| 球队赢得比赛后获得了信心。 ||| 政府在议会赢得了信任投票。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 机密的, 获他人信赖的, 易于信任他人的
[经] 秘密件
ieltsWords.collocations: confidential information 机密信息, confidential document 机密文件, confidential agreement 保密协议
ieltsWords.example: This document is confidential and should not be shared. ||| The lawyer kept all client details confidential. ||| They signed a confidential agreement before the merger.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这份文件是机密的，不应分享。 ||| 律师对所有客户信息保密。 ||| 他们在合并前签署了保密协议。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 结构, 表面配置, 外形, 配置
[计] 配置
ieltsWords.collocations: computer configuration 计算机配置, network configuration 网络配置, room configuration 房间布局
ieltsWords.example: The software requires a specific hardware configuration. ||| The network configuration was optimized for speed. ||| The room configuration can be adjusted for different events.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该软件需要特定的硬件配置。 ||| 网络配置针对速度进行了优化。 ||| 房间布局可根据不同活动调整。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 限制, 使不外出, 禁闭
vi. 邻接, 交界
n. 边缘, 范围, 区域
ieltsWords.collocations: confine to 局限于, confine in prison 关押在监狱, confine oneself to 使自己局限于
ieltsWords.example: The disease was confined to a small area. ||| The prisoner was confined to his cell for 23 hours a day. ||| Please confine your comments to the topic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 疾病局限于一个小区域。 ||| 囚犯每天被关在牢房里23小时。 ||| 请将你的评论局限于主题。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 证实, 证明, 批准, 确认
[计] 确认
ieltsWords.collocations: receive confirmation 收到确认, written confirmation 书面确认, confirmation letter 确认函
ieltsWords.example: We are waiting for confirmation of the booking. ||| The experiment provided confirmation of the theory. ||| Please send a written confirmation of your order.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们在等待预订的确认。 ||| 实验证实了该理论。 ||| 请发送订单的书面确认。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使一致, 使遵守, 使符合
vi. 一致, 符合, 适应
ieltsWords.collocations: conform to rules 遵守规则, conform with standards 符合标准, conform to society 顺应社会
ieltsWords.example: All products must conform to safety standards. ||| He refused to conform to the dress code. ||| Teenagers often feel pressure to conform to their peers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 所有产品必须符合安全标准。 ||| 他拒绝遵守着装规定。 ||| 青少年常常感到要顺应同伴的压力。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使面对, 对抗, 遭遇, 使对质, 比较
[法] 对证, 使对质, 比较
ieltsWords.collocations: confront a problem 面对问题, confront someone 与某人对质, be confronted with 面临
ieltsWords.example: We must confront the challenges of climate change. ||| She confronted her boss about the unfair treatment. ||| The country is confronted with an economic crisis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们必须面对气候变化的挑战。 ||| 她就不公平待遇与老板对质。 ||| 该国面临经济危机。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使混乱, 使狼狈, 使困惑
[法] 混淆
ieltsWords.collocations: confuse A with B 混淆A和B, confuse the issue 混淆问题, confuse someone 使某人困惑
ieltsWords.example: The instructions confused many users. ||| I often confuse him with his brother. ||| Don't confuse the issue with irrelevant details.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 说明使许多用户感到困惑。 ||| 我经常把他和他哥哥搞混。 ||| 不要用无关细节混淆问题。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 混乱, 混淆, 无秩序
[计] 含混
ieltsWords.collocations: cause confusion 引起混乱, in confusion 困惑地, confusion over/about 对…的困惑
ieltsWords.example: There was confusion over the new policy. ||| The sudden change caused confusion among the staff. ||| He looked at me in confusion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 对新政策存在困惑。 ||| 突然的变化在员工中引起了混乱。 ||| 他困惑地看着我。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 拥挤, 充血
[计] 拥挤, 拥塞
ieltsWords.collocations: traffic congestion 交通拥堵, nasal congestion 鼻塞, congestion charge 拥堵费
ieltsWords.example: Traffic congestion is a major problem in big cities. ||| The cold caused nasal congestion. ||| The city introduced a congestion charge to reduce traffic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 交通拥堵是大城市的主要问题。 ||| 感冒引起了鼻塞。 ||| 该市引入了拥堵费以减少交通量。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 国会, 会议, 讨论会
[医] 会议, 会合
ieltsWords.collocations: Congress member 国会议员, congress session 国会会议, party congress 党代会
ieltsWords.example: The Congress passed a new law on environmental protection. ||| He was elected to Congress last year. ||| The party congress will be held in March.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 国会通过了一项关于环境保护的新法律。 ||| 他去年当选为国会议员。 ||| 党代会将于三月举行。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 连接词, 联合, 结合
[计] 合取
ieltsWords.collocations: in conjunction with 与…一起, coordinating conjunction 并列连词, subordinating conjunction 从属连词
ieltsWords.example: The word 'and' is a common conjunction. ||| The project was completed in conjunction with local authorities. ||| The conjunction of events led to a crisis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 单词'and'是一个常见的连词。 ||| 该项目与当地政府合作完成。 ||| 事件的结合导致了危机。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 良心
[法] 良心, 道德感, 正义感
ieltsWords.collocations: clear conscience 问心无愧, guilty conscience 内疚, social conscience 社会良知
ieltsWords.example: She followed her conscience and told the truth. ||| He had a guilty conscience about lying. ||| The company has a strong social conscience.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她凭良心说了实话。 ||| 他对撒谎感到内疚。 ||| 这家公司有很强的社会良知。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 有责任心的, 负责的, 本着良心的
[法] 凭良心做的, 有道德感的
ieltsWords.collocations: conscientious worker 尽职尽责的员工, conscientious attitude 认真的态度, conscientious effort 尽心尽力的努力
ieltsWords.example: She is a conscientious student who always completes her homework on time. ||| The conscientious doctor checked every detail of the patient's condition. ||| His conscientious approach to work earned him a promotion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她是个认真的学生，总是按时完成作业。 ||| 这位尽责的医生检查了病人状况的每一个细节。 ||| 他勤恳的工作态度为他赢得了晋升。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 有意识的, 知觉的, 觉察的
[医] 有意识的, 清醒的
ieltsWords.collocations: conscious decision 有意识的决定, conscious effort 刻意的努力, become conscious of 意识到
ieltsWords.example: He made a conscious effort to improve his English. ||| The patient was conscious after the surgery. ||| She is very conscious of her appearance.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他有意识地努力提高英语水平。 ||| 手术后病人神志清醒。 ||| 她非常在意自己的外表。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 连续的, 联贯的
[计] 连续的; 连接的
ieltsWords.collocations: consecutive days 连续几天, consecutive numbers 连续数字, consecutive wins 连胜
ieltsWords.example: It rained for five consecutive days. ||| The team achieved three consecutive victories. ||| Please number the pages in consecutive order.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 连续下了五天雨。 ||| 该队取得了三连胜。 ||| 请按顺序给页码编号。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 合意, 一致, 同感
[计] 合意
ieltsWords.collocations: reach a consensus 达成共识, general consensus 普遍共识, consensus view 一致看法
ieltsWords.example: The committee reached a consensus on the budget. ||| There is a general consensus that climate change is real. ||| The consensus view is that education is key to development.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 委员会就预算达成了共识。 ||| 普遍共识是气候变化是真实的。 ||| 一致看法是教育是发展的关键。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 同意, 许可
vi. 同意, 赞同
ieltsWords.collocations: give consent 给予同意, written consent 书面同意, consent to 同意
ieltsWords.example: She consented to the surgery. ||| You need parental consent to go on the trip. ||| He gave his consent for the project to proceed.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她同意了手术。 ||| 你需要父母同意才能去旅行。 ||| 他同意项目继续进行。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 随后发生的事情, 结果
a. 作为结果的, 合乎逻辑的
ieltsWords.collocations: consequent upon 因…而起, consequent effect 随之而来的影响, consequent loss 随之而来的损失
ieltsWords.example: The economic crisis and consequent unemployment affected many families. ||| The rise in prices consequent on inflation is worrying. ||| The consequent damage was extensive.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 经济危机及随之而来的失业影响了许多家庭。 ||| 通货膨胀导致的价格上涨令人担忧。 ||| 随之而来的损害是广泛的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 保护, 保存
[医] 保存
ieltsWords.collocations: wildlife conservation 野生动物保护, energy conservation 节能, conservation area 保护区
ieltsWords.example: The government promotes energy conservation. ||| Wildlife conservation is crucial for biodiversity. ||| This area is a conservation zone.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府提倡节能。 ||| 野生动物保护对生物多样性至关重要。 ||| 这个区域是保护区。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 保守的, 守旧的, 有保存力的
[化] 防腐剂; 保存剂
ieltsWords.collocations: conservative estimate 保守估计, conservative party 保守党, conservative view 保守观点
ieltsWords.example: He holds conservative views on social issues. ||| The conservative estimate of the cost is $1 million. ||| She is a conservative in politics.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他在社会问题上持保守观点。 ||| 成本的保守估计是100万美元。 ||| 她在政治上是个保守派。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 相当的, 可观的, 重要的
ieltsWords.collocations: considerable amount 大量, considerable effort 相当大的努力, considerable influence 相当大的影响
ieltsWords.example: She has considerable experience in teaching. ||| The project requires a considerable amount of money. ||| He made considerable progress in his studies.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她有相当丰富的教学经验。 ||| 该项目需要大量资金。 ||| 他在学习上取得了相当大的进步。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 体贴的, 体谅的, 考虑周到的
ieltsWords.collocations: considerate person 体贴的人, considerate behavior 体贴的行为, be considerate of 体谅
ieltsWords.example: It was considerate of you to help me. ||| She is a very considerate neighbor. ||| He is always considerate of others' feelings.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你帮助我真是太体贴了。 ||| 她是个非常体贴的邻居。 ||| 他总是体谅别人的感受。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 交付, 储蓄, 委托, 寄存
[经] 托卖, 寄存, 寄销
ieltsWords.collocations: consign to 交付给, consign goods 托运货物, consign to oblivion 被遗忘
ieltsWords.example: The goods were consigned to the warehouse. ||| She consigned her old clothes to charity. ||| The idea was consigned to history.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 货物被托运到仓库。 ||| 她把旧衣服交给慈善机构。 ||| 这个想法被历史遗忘了。

ieltsWords.definition: vi. 组成, 存在于, 一致
ieltsWords.collocations: consist of 由…组成, consist in 在于, consist with 与…一致
ieltsWords.example: The team consists of five members. ||| Happiness consists in contentment. ||| His actions do not consist with his words.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 团队由五名成员组成。 ||| 幸福在于知足。 ||| 他的言行不一致。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 安慰, 藉慰
n. 控制台
[计] 控制台
ieltsWords.collocations: console someone 安慰某人, game console 游戏机, control console 控制台
ieltsWords.example: She tried to console him after his loss. ||| The game console is very popular among teenagers. ||| The pilot operated the control console.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他失败后她试图安慰他。 ||| 这款游戏机在青少年中很受欢迎。 ||| 飞行员操作控制台。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 巩固, 使联合, 统一
vi. 巩固
[计] 合并计算
ieltsWords.collocations: consolidate power 巩固权力, consolidate debt 合并债务, consolidate position 巩固地位
ieltsWords.example: The company consolidated its position in the market. ||| They consolidated several departments into one. ||| He consolidated his knowledge by reviewing regularly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司巩固了其市场地位。 ||| 他们将几个部门合并为一个。 ||| 他通过定期复习巩固了知识。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 显著的, 显眼的, 出众的
ieltsWords.collocations: conspicuous consumption 炫耀性消费, conspicuous place 显眼的地方, conspicuous absence 明显缺席
ieltsWords.example: She wore a conspicuous red dress to the party. ||| His absence was conspicuous at the meeting. ||| The monument is in a conspicuous location.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她穿了一条显眼的红裙子去派对。 ||| 他在会议上的缺席很显眼。 ||| 纪念碑位于显眼的位置。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 同谋, 阴谋, 阴谋集团
[法] 阴谋, 通谋, 共谋
ieltsWords.collocations: conspiracy theory 阴谋论, conspiracy to commit 共谋犯罪, conspiracy charge 阴谋指控
ieltsWords.example: They were accused of conspiracy to defraud the bank. ||| Many people believe in conspiracy theories about the moon landing. ||| The conspiracy was uncovered by the police.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们被指控共谋诈骗银行。 ||| 许多人相信关于登月的阴谋论。 ||| 阴谋被警方揭露了。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 成分, 选民, 构成物
a. 构成的, 组织的, 选举的
ieltsWords.collocations: constituent parts 组成部分, constituent assembly 制宪会议, chemical constituent 化学成分
ieltsWords.example: The senator met with his constituents. ||| Oxygen is a constituent of air. ||| The constituent elements of the compound were analyzed.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 参议员会见了他的选民。 ||| 氧气是空气的组成部分。 ||| 分析了该化合物的组成元素。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 构成, 宪法, 体格
[医] 体质; 结构, 组织
ieltsWords.collocations: written constitution 成文宪法, physical constitution 体质, constitution of the committee 委员会构成
ieltsWords.example: The country's constitution guarantees freedom of speech. ||| He has a strong constitution and rarely gets sick. ||| The constitution of the committee includes representatives from all departments.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该国宪法保障言论自由。 ||| 他体质强健，很少生病。 ||| 委员会的构成包括所有部门的代表。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 强迫, 限制, 关押
ieltsWords.collocations: constrain by rules 受规则约束, constrain development 限制发展, constrain someone to do 强迫某人做
ieltsWords.example: Lack of funding constrains the project's progress. ||| The contract constrains them from disclosing confidential information. ||| He felt constrained to accept the offer.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 资金缺乏限制了项目的进展。 ||| 合同约束他们不得泄露机密信息。 ||| 他感到被迫接受了这个提议。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 建筑, 构造, 建筑物
[化] 施工
ieltsWords.collocations: construction industry 建筑业, under construction 正在建设中, construction of meaning 意义建构
ieltsWords.example: The construction of the new bridge will take two years. ||| The building is a modern construction made of glass and steel. ||| The court's construction of the law was controversial.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新桥的建设将耗时两年。 ||| 这座建筑是玻璃和钢材的现代建筑。 ||| 法院对该法律的解释存在争议。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 商讨, 商量, 协商, 会诊
vt. 向...请教, 查阅, 考虑
ieltsWords.collocations: consult a doctor 咨询医生, consult a dictionary 查阅字典, consult with colleagues 与同事商量
ieltsWords.example: You should consult a lawyer before signing the contract. ||| He consulted the map to find the shortest route. ||| The manager consulted with the team before making a decision.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 签合同前你应该咨询律师。 ||| 他查阅地图以找到最短路线。 ||| 经理在做决定前与团队商量了。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 顾问, 征询意见者
[医] 顾问医师
ieltsWords.collocations: management consultant 管理顾问, independent consultant 独立顾问, consultant firm 咨询公司
ieltsWords.example: The company hired a consultant to improve efficiency. ||| She works as a financial consultant for a large bank. ||| The consultant recommended a new marketing strategy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位顾问来提高效率。 ||| 她在一家大银行担任财务顾问。 ||| 顾问推荐了一种新的营销策略。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 消费者
[经] 消费者, 用户
ieltsWords.collocations: consumer goods 消费品, consumer rights 消费者权益, consumer behavior 消费者行为
ieltsWords.example: Consumer spending drives economic growth. ||| The new law protects consumer rights. ||| Companies study consumer behavior to improve products.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 消费者支出推动经济增长。 ||| 新法律保护消费者权益。 ||| 公司研究消费者行为以改进产品。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 消费, 消费量, 痨病
[化] 消耗量; 耗量
ieltsWords.collocations: energy consumption 能源消耗, consumption pattern 消费模式, domestic consumption 国内消费
ieltsWords.example: The government aims to reduce energy consumption. ||| Consumption of fast food has increased in recent years. ||| The report analyzes household consumption patterns.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府旨在减少能源消耗。 ||| 近年来快餐消费增加了。 ||| 报告分析了家庭消费模式。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 容器, 集装箱
[化] 集装箱; 贮存箱; 容器(任何一种)
ieltsWords.collocations: plastic container 塑料容器, shipping container 航运集装箱, container ship 集装箱船
ieltsWords.example: Store the food in an airtight container. ||| The goods were transported in large containers. ||| The port handles thousands of containers daily.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 将食物存放在密封容器中。 ||| 货物用大型集装箱运输。 ||| 该港口每天处理数千个集装箱。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 弄污, 弄脏, 污染, 毒害
[化] 污染
ieltsWords.collocations: contaminate water 污染水源, contaminate food 污染食物, contaminate the environment 污染环境
ieltsWords.example: Industrial waste can contaminate rivers. ||| The bacteria contaminated the milk supply. ||| Chemicals from farms contaminate groundwater.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 工业废物会污染河流。 ||| 细菌污染了牛奶供应。 ||| 农场的化学物质污染地下水。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 注视, 沉思, 盘算
vi. 冥思苦想
ieltsWords.collocations: contemplate the future 思考未来, contemplate a change 考虑改变, contemplate quitting 打算辞职
ieltsWords.example: She sat by the window, contemplating the meaning of life. ||| The company is contemplating a merger with a rival. ||| He contemplated moving to a bigger city.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边，沉思生命的意义。 ||| 公司正在考虑与竞争对手合并。 ||| 他打算搬到一个更大的城市。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 轻视, 轻蔑
[法] 藐视, 侮辱, 轻视
ieltsWords.collocations: hold in contempt 蔑视, contempt of court 藐视法庭, show contempt for 对…表示蔑视
ieltsWords.example: He spoke with contempt for his opponents. ||| The lawyer was charged with contempt of court. ||| She felt nothing but contempt for his dishonesty.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他轻蔑地谈论对手。 ||| 该律师被指控藐视法庭。 ||| 她对她的不诚实只有蔑视。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 奋斗, 斗争, 竞争
vt. 为...斗争
ieltsWords.collocations: contend for a prize 争夺奖项, contend with difficulties 与困难作斗争, contend that 声称
ieltsWords.example: Several teams are contending for the championship. ||| He had to contend with many obstacles. ||| The lawyer contended that his client was innocent.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 几支队伍在争夺冠军。 ||| 他不得不应对许多障碍。 ||| 律师声称他的当事人是无辜的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 内容, 满足, 意义, 要旨
a. 满足的, 满意的
vt. 使...满足, 使...安心
[计] 内容
ieltsWords.collocations: table of contents 目录, content of the article 文章内容, be content with 对…满足
ieltsWords.example: The content of the report was very informative. ||| Please refer to the table of contents for chapter details. ||| She is content with her current job.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 报告的内容信息量很大。 ||| 请参阅目录了解章节详情。 ||| 她对目前的工作很满意。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 争论, 争辩, 所持的论点
[计] 争用
ieltsWords.collocations: bone of contention 争论焦点, main contention 主要论点, in contention 在竞争中
ieltsWords.example: The main contention of the article is that climate change is urgent. ||| The border dispute is a bone of contention between the two countries. ||| Several players are still in contention for the title.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 文章的主要论点是气候变化很紧迫。 ||| 边界争端是两国争论的焦点。 ||| 几名选手仍在争夺冠军。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 竞赛, 争论
vt. 竞争, 争取, 争辩
vi. 竞争
ieltsWords.collocations: beauty contest 选美比赛, contest winner 比赛获胜者, contest for power 权力争夺
ieltsWords.example: She won first prize in the singing contest. ||| The contest attracted participants from all over the world. ||| There is a fierce contest for the leadership position.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。 ||| 比赛吸引了来自世界各地的参与者。 ||| 领导职位的争夺非常激烈。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 上下文, 背景, 来龙去脉
n. 上下文
[计] 上下文
ieltsWords.collocations: in context 在上下文中, historical context 历史背景, social context 社会环境
ieltsWords.example: It is important to consider the historical context of the event. ||| The meaning of a word depends on its context. ||| The policy was developed in the context of economic recession.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 考虑事件的历史背景很重要。 ||| 单词的意思取决于其上下文。 ||| 该政策是在经济衰退的背景下制定的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 偶然性, 可能性, 意外事故
[经] 意外事故, 意外开支, 偶然事故
ieltsWords.collocations: contingency plan 应急计划, contingency fund 应急基金, contingency fee 成功酬金
ieltsWords.example: The company has a contingency plan in case of a natural disaster. ||| We set aside a contingency fund for unexpected expenses. ||| The lawyer works on a contingency fee basis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司有应对自然灾害的应急计划。 ||| 我们留出了一笔应急基金用于意外开支。 ||| 律师按成功酬金制收费。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 连续性
[化] 连续性
ieltsWords.collocations: business continuity 业务连续性, continuity of care 护理连续性, sense of continuity 连续感
ieltsWords.example: The continuity of the project was threatened by funding cuts. ||| The film's continuity was maintained by careful editing. ||| There is a lack of continuity in the government's policy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 项目的连续性受到资金削减的威胁。 ||| 通过精心剪辑保持了电影的连续性。 ||| 政府的政策缺乏连续性。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 合约, 婚约, 契约
vt. 使皱缩, 使缩短, 感染, 订约, 缔结
vi. 皱缩, 订约, 收缩
ieltsWords.collocations: sign a contract 签订合同, contract law 合同法, contract terms 合同条款
ieltsWords.example: Both parties signed the contract after negotiations. ||| The contract specifies the delivery date and payment terms. ||| Muscles contract when they are used.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 双方在谈判后签订了合同。 ||| 合同规定了交货日期和付款条件。 ||| 肌肉在使用时会收缩。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 反驳, 与...抵触, 与...矛盾
vi. 反驳
ieltsWords.collocations: contradict oneself 自相矛盾, contradict a statement 反驳声明, contradict evidence 与证据矛盾
ieltsWords.example: His actions contradict his words. ||| The witness contradicted the earlier testimony. ||| Don't contradict your boss in public.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他的行为与他的话矛盾。 ||| 证人反驳了先前的证词。 ||| 不要在公共场合反驳你的老板。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 反驳, 矛盾
[法] 矛盾, 否认, 反驳
ieltsWords.collocations: in contradiction to 与...矛盾, a contradiction in terms 术语矛盾, self-contradiction 自相矛盾
ieltsWords.example: There is a clear contradiction between his words and actions. ||| The theory is full of contradictions and lacks consistency. ||| She pointed out the contradiction in his argument.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他的言行之间存在明显的矛盾。 ||| 这个理论充满矛盾，缺乏一致性。 ||| 她指出了他论点中的矛盾之处。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 差别, 对比, 对照物
vt. 使对比
vi. 成对照
[计] 反差; 对比度
ieltsWords.collocations: in contrast to 与...形成对比, by contrast 相比之下, contrast with 与...对比
ieltsWords.example: In contrast to the city, the countryside is peaceful and quiet. ||| The contrast between the two cultures is striking. ||| Her cheerful mood contrasted sharply with his gloom.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 与城市相比，乡村宁静而平和。 ||| 两种文化之间的对比非常显著。 ||| 她愉快的情绪与他的沮丧形成了鲜明对比。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 捐助, 捐助之物, 贡献
[经] 贡献, 捐款, 补助品
ieltsWords.collocations: make a contribution to 对...做出贡献, significant contribution 重大贡献, financial contribution 财务捐款
ieltsWords.example: His contribution to the project was invaluable. ||| The company made a generous contribution to the charity. ||| Each member's contribution is essential for the team's success.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他对这个项目的贡献是无价的。 ||| 公司向慈善机构慷慨捐款。 ||| 每个成员的贡献对团队的成功都至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 发明, 设计, 图谋
ieltsWords.collocations: contrive to do 设法做, contrive a plan 策划一个计划, contrive an escape 策划逃跑
ieltsWords.example: He contrived a way to escape from the prison. ||| She contrived a meeting between the two rivals. ||| They contrived to finish the project on time despite the difficulties.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他设法逃出了监狱。 ||| 她策划了两个对手之间的会面。 ||| 尽管困难重重，他们还是设法按时完成了项目。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 控制, 管理, 克制, 控制器, 操纵装置
vt. 控制, 操纵, 抑制
[计] 控制; 控制器
ieltsWords.collocations: under control 处于控制之下, take control of 控制, lose control of 失去对...的控制
ieltsWords.example: The government has taken control of the situation. ||| He lost control of the car and crashed into a tree. ||| The experiment was conducted under strict control conditions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府已经控制了局势。 ||| 他失去了对汽车的控制，撞到了一棵树上。 ||| 实验在严格的控制条件下进行。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 争论的, 论争的, 被议论的
ieltsWords.collocations: controversial issue 有争议的问题, highly controversial 极具争议的, controversial figure 有争议的人物
ieltsWords.example: The new policy is highly controversial among the public. ||| He is a controversial figure in the field of politics. ||| The decision to build the dam was controversial.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新政策在公众中极具争议。 ||| 他是政治领域一个有争议的人物。 ||| 建造大坝的决定是有争议的。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 集合, 召集, 召唤
vi. 聚集, 集合
ieltsWords.collocations: convene a meeting 召开会议, convene a conference 召集会议, convene a committee 召集委员会
ieltsWords.example: The president convened an emergency meeting to discuss the crisis. ||| The committee will convene next Monday. ||| The students convened in the hall for the lecture.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 总统召集紧急会议讨论危机。 ||| 委员会将于下周一召开会议。 ||| 学生们在大厅集合听讲座。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 方便, 便利的事物, 方便的时候
ieltsWords.collocations: for convenience 为了方便, at your convenience 在您方便的时候, convenience store 便利店
ieltsWords.example: The hotel offers all modern conveniences. ||| Please reply at your earliest convenience. ||| For convenience, the supermarket is located near the station.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家酒店提供所有现代化便利设施。 ||| 请在您方便时尽早回复。 ||| 为了方便，超市位于车站附近。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 会话, 说话, 交谈
[法] 交谈, 社交, 性交
ieltsWords.collocations: have a conversation 进行交谈, in conversation 在谈话中, strike up a conversation 开始交谈
ieltsWords.example: We had a long conversation about the future. ||| He struck up a conversation with a stranger on the train. ||| The conversation turned to the topic of education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们就未来进行了长时间的交谈。 ||| 他在火车上和一个陌生人攀谈起来。 ||| 谈话转向了教育话题。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 转变, 转换, 改变宗教信仰, 换位法
[计] 转换
ieltsWords.collocations: conversion rate 转化率, conversion to 转换为, religious conversion 宗教皈依
ieltsWords.example: The conversion of the old factory into a museum took two years. ||| The website's conversion rate has increased by 20%. ||| His conversion to Buddhism surprised his family.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 旧工厂改造成博物馆花了两年时间。 ||| 网站的转化率提高了20%。 ||| 他皈依佛教让家人感到惊讶。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 皈依者, 改变宗教信仰者
vt. 使改变信仰, 转换, 兑换, 倒置
vi. 皈依
[计] 转换
ieltsWords.collocations: convert into 转换成, convert to 转变为, convert someone to 使某人皈依
ieltsWords.example: We converted the spare room into a study. ||| She converted to Islam after her marriage. ||| The software can convert files from PDF to Word.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们把空房间改成了书房。 ||| 她婚后皈依了伊斯兰教。 ||| 这个软件可以将文件从PDF转换为Word。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 传达, 运输, 转让
[经] 转让(财产等), 搬运
ieltsWords.collocations: convey a message 传达信息, convey meaning 表达意思, convey goods 运输货物
ieltsWords.example: His tone conveyed a sense of urgency. ||| The pipeline conveys natural gas across the country. ||| She struggled to convey her feelings in words.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他的语气传达了一种紧迫感。 ||| 这条管道将天然气输送到全国各地。 ||| 她难以用语言表达自己的感受。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 囚犯, 罪犯
vt. 宣告有罪, 使知罪
ieltsWords.collocations: convict someone of 判定某人有...罪, convicted criminal 已定罪的罪犯, convict prison 监狱
ieltsWords.example: He was convicted of murder and sentenced to life imprisonment. ||| The evidence was enough to convict him. ||| The convict escaped from prison last night.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他被判犯有谋杀罪，处以终身监禁。 ||| 证据足以给他定罪。 ||| 那名罪犯昨晚越狱了。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 定罪, 信服, 坚信
[法] 定罪, 证明有罪, 判罪
ieltsWords.collocations: strong conviction 坚定的信念, criminal conviction 刑事定罪, with conviction 坚定地
ieltsWords.example: She spoke with conviction about the need for change. ||| His conviction for theft ruined his reputation. ||| It is my conviction that education is the key to success.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她坚定地谈论变革的必要性。 ||| 他因盗窃被定罪，毁了他的声誉。 ||| 我坚信教育是成功的关键。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 合作, 协力, 配合
[化] 合作
ieltsWords.collocations: in cooperation with 与...合作, international cooperation 国际合作, close cooperation 密切合作
ieltsWords.example: The project was successful thanks to the cooperation of all parties. ||| International cooperation is essential to combat climate change. ||| We are working in close cooperation with the local authorities.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于各方的合作，项目取得了成功。 ||| 国际合作对于应对气候变化至关重要。 ||| 我们正在与地方当局密切合作。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 兴奋剂, 补品
a. 热忱的, 诚恳的, 有兴奋作用的
ieltsWords.collocations: cordial welcome 热诚欢迎, cordial relationship 友好关系, cordial invitation 诚挚邀请
ieltsWords.example: The host gave us a cordial welcome. ||| They maintained a cordial relationship despite their differences. ||| I received a cordial invitation to the wedding.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 主人热诚地欢迎了我们。 ||| 尽管有分歧，他们仍保持着友好的关系。 ||| 我收到了参加婚礼的诚挚邀请。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 公司, 合作, 法人团体
[法] 法人团体, 社团, 法人
ieltsWords.collocations: multinational corporation 跨国公司, corporation tax 公司税, public corporation 公共公司
ieltsWords.example: The corporation reported a significant increase in profits. ||| She works for a large multinational corporation. ||| The corporation is responsible for managing the city's water supply.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家公司报告利润大幅增长。 ||| 她在一家大型跨国公司工作。 ||| 这家公司负责管理城市的供水。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 军, 队, 部队, 兵种
[医] 对, 团; 体, 物体
ieltsWords.collocations: peace corps 和平队, marine corps 海军陆战队, press corps 记者团
ieltsWords.example: He served in the Marine Corps for ten years. ||| The press corps gathered outside the White House. ||| The diplomatic corps attended the ceremony.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他在海军陆战队服役了十年。 ||| 记者团聚集在白宫外。 ||| 外交使团出席了仪式。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 尸体
[医] 尸体
ieltsWords.collocations: dead corpse 死尸, corpse of a victim 受害者尸体, corpse disposal 尸体处理
ieltsWords.example: The police found a corpse in the abandoned building. ||| The corpse was identified as that of a missing woman. ||| The sight of the corpse horrified the onlookers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方在废弃建筑中发现了一具尸体。 ||| 尸体被确认为一名失踪女性。 ||| 看到尸体让旁观者感到恐惧。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 有相互关系的东西, 相关物
vt. 使有相互关系
vi. 相关
ieltsWords.collocations: correlate with 与...相关, correlate to 与...关联, be correlated 相关
ieltsWords.example: The study found that stress levels correlate with sleep quality. ||| There is a strong correlation between education and income. ||| The data correlate well with our predictions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 研究发现压力水平与睡眠质量相关。 ||| 教育与收入之间存在很强的相关性。 ||| 数据与我们的预测高度相关。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 相符, 通信, 信件
[医] 对应, 相对
ieltsWords.collocations: business correspondence 商务信函, personal correspondence 私人通信, correspondence course 函授课程
ieltsWords.example: The company maintains a large volume of business correspondence with overseas clients. ||| There is a close correspondence between the two theories. ||| She enrolled in a correspondence course to improve her English.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司与海外客户保持大量商务信函往来。 ||| 这两种理论之间有密切的对应关系。 ||| 她报名参加了一门函授课程来提高英语水平。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 通讯记者, 通信者
[经] 客户, 代理商行, 代理银行
ieltsWords.collocations: foreign correspondent 驻外记者, war correspondent 战地记者, special correspondent 特派记者
ieltsWords.example: The BBC's foreign correspondent reported live from the capital. ||| He worked as a war correspondent in the Middle East for many years. ||| The bank's correspondent in London handled the transaction.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 英国广播公司的驻外记者从首都进行现场报道。 ||| 他在中东做了多年的战地记者。 ||| 该银行在伦敦的代理行处理了这笔交易。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使腐蚀, 侵蚀, 破坏
vi. 被侵蚀, 起腐蚀作用
ieltsWords.collocations: corrode metal 腐蚀金属, corrode away 腐蚀掉, corrode confidence 削弱信心
ieltsWords.example: Acid rain can corrode metal structures over time. ||| The constant criticism began to corrode her self-esteem. ||| Salt water corroded the ship's hull, causing leaks.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 酸雨会逐渐腐蚀金属结构。 ||| 不断的批评开始削弱她的自尊心。 ||| 海水腐蚀了船体，导致漏水。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 腐败的, 贪污的, 讹误充斥的
vt. 使腐烂, 腐蚀, 使恶化
vi. 腐烂, 堕落
ieltsWords.collocations: corrupt government 腐败政府, corrupt practices 腐败行为, corrupt data 损坏的数据
ieltsWords.example: The corrupt official was sentenced to ten years in prison. ||| The file is corrupt and cannot be opened. ||| Corrupt business practices harm the economy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 那名腐败官员被判处十年监禁。 ||| 文件已损坏，无法打开。 ||| 腐败的商业行为损害经济。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 宇宙的, 宇宙航行的, 无限的, 有秩序的
[医] 宇宙的
ieltsWords.collocations: cosmic radiation 宇宙辐射, cosmic dust 宇宙尘埃, cosmic scale 宇宙尺度
ieltsWords.example: The telescope allows us to observe cosmic phenomena billions of light-years away. ||| The explosion was of cosmic proportions. ||| Cosmic rays constantly bombard the Earth's atmosphere.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 望远镜使我们能够观测数十亿光年外的宇宙现象。 ||| 那次爆炸规模极其巨大。 ||| 宇宙射线不断轰击地球大气层。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 世界主义的, 世界性的, 全世界的, 遍生的, 不偏狭的, 卓有见识的
n. 世界主义者, 世界性
ieltsWords.collocations: cosmopolitan city 国际化大都市, cosmopolitan atmosphere 国际化氛围, cosmopolitan outlook 全球视野
ieltsWords.example: London is a cosmopolitan city with residents from all over the world. ||| She has a cosmopolitan outlook, having lived in five different countries. ||| The restaurant offers a cosmopolitan menu featuring dishes from various cuisines.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 伦敦是一个国际化大都市，居民来自世界各地。 ||| 她曾在五个不同的国家生活过，因此具有全球视野。 ||| 这家餐厅提供国际化的菜单，汇集了各种菜系的菜肴。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 昂贵的, 奢华的, 费用大的
ieltsWords.collocations: costly mistake 代价高昂的错误, costly procedure 昂贵的程序, costly delay 代价高昂的延误
ieltsWords.example: The delay proved costly for the construction project. ||| Buying a house in the city center is very costly. ||| The company learned from its costly mistake and improved its strategy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这次延误给建筑项目造成了巨大损失。 ||| 在市中心买房非常昂贵。 ||| 公司从代价高昂的错误中吸取教训，改进了策略。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 装束, 服装
ieltsWords.collocations: traditional costume 传统服装, costume party 化妆舞会, costume design 服装设计
ieltsWords.example: The actors wore elaborate costumes for the historical play. ||| She bought a Halloween costume online. ||| The museum displays traditional costumes from different cultures.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 演员们为这部历史剧穿着精致的戏服。 ||| 她在网上买了一套万圣节服装。 ||| 博物馆展示了来自不同文化的传统服装。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 小屋, 茅舍
ieltsWords.collocations: cottage industry 家庭手工业, cottage cheese 白软干酪, holiday cottage 度假小屋
ieltsWords.example: They rented a cozy cottage in the countryside for the weekend. ||| The region is known for its cottage industries producing handmade crafts. ||| The cottage had a thatched roof and a beautiful garden.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们在乡下租了一间舒适的小屋度周末。 ||| 该地区以生产手工制品的家庭手工业闻名。 ||| 小屋有茅草屋顶和一个美丽的花园。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 会议, 委员会
[经] 委员会
ieltsWords.collocations: city council 市议会, security council 安全理事会, council meeting 委员会会议
ieltsWords.example: The city council voted to increase funding for public schools. ||| The United Nations Security Council held an emergency session. ||| She was elected to the student council last year.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 市议会投票决定增加对公立学校的拨款。 ||| 联合国安理会召开了紧急会议。 ||| 她去年当选为学生委员会成员。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 商议, 忠告, 法律顾问
v. 商议, 劝告
ieltsWords.collocations: legal counsel 法律顾问, counsel for the defense 辩护律师, seek counsel 寻求建议
ieltsWords.example: The defendant was represented by experienced legal counsel. ||| She sought counsel from her financial advisor before investing. ||| The counsel for the prosecution presented strong evidence.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 被告由经验丰富的法律顾问代理。 ||| 她在投资前向财务顾问寻求了建议。 ||| 控方律师出示了强有力的证据。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 计算器, 计算者, 柜台, 筹码
a. 反方向的, 相反的
adv. 反方向地, 相反地
[计] 计数器; 计数字
ieltsWords.collocations: checkout counter 收银台, counter argument 反驳论点, counter measure 对策
ieltsWords.example: The customer paid for the goods at the checkout counter. ||| The government introduced new measures to counter inflation. ||| She made a counter offer to the seller's asking price.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 顾客在收银台付了货款。 ||| 政府推出了新措施来应对通货膨胀。 ||| 她对卖家的要价提出了还价。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 副本, 复本, 配对物, 相应物
[经] 副本, 正副二份中之一
ieltsWords.collocations: foreign counterpart 外国同行, direct counterpart 直接对应物, female counterpart 女性对应者
ieltsWords.example: The CEO met with his Chinese counterpart to discuss the partnership. ||| The British Prime Minister spoke with his French counterpart on the phone. ||| The new model is more efficient than its predecessor counterpart.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 首席执行官与他的中国同行会面讨论合作事宜。 ||| 英国首相与法国总统通了电话。 ||| 新型号比之前的对应型号更高效。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 息票, 赠券
[经] 息票, 利息单, 联票
ieltsWords.collocations: discount coupon 折扣券, coupon code 优惠码, food coupon 食品券
ieltsWords.example: She used a coupon to get 20% off her purchase. ||| The store offers digital coupons that can be scanned from a phone. ||| During the war, people had to use ration coupons for food.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她用了一张优惠券，购物享受八折优惠。 ||| 这家商店提供可以从手机扫描的电子优惠券。 ||| 战争期间，人们必须使用配给券购买食品。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 课程, 路线, 过程, 一道菜, 道路
v. 追, (使)跑
ieltsWords.collocations: training course 培训课程, course of action 行动方案, main course 主菜
ieltsWords.example: She enrolled in an online course to learn programming. ||| The course of the river was altered by the earthquake. ||| The dinner consisted of three courses: appetizer, main course, and dessert.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她报名参加了一门在线课程学习编程。 ||| 地震改变了河流的流向。 ||| 晚餐包括三道菜：开胃菜、主菜和甜点。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 礼貌, 谦恭, 好意
[法] 优待, 礼貌, 恩惠
ieltsWords.collocations: common courtesy 基本礼貌, courtesy call 礼节性拜访, courtesy of 承蒙……的好意
ieltsWords.example: It is common courtesy to hold the door open for the person behind you. ||| The company provided a courtesy shuttle bus for its guests. ||| He paid a courtesy visit to his new neighbors.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 为身后的人扶住门是基本的礼貌。 ||| 公司为客人提供免费班车服务。 ||| 他对新邻居进行了礼节性拜访。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 覆盖的范围, 保险总额, 新闻报导
[化] 可达范围; 覆盖度
ieltsWords.collocations: media coverage 媒体报道, insurance coverage 保险范围, network coverage 网络覆盖
ieltsWords.example: The event received extensive media coverage worldwide. ||| Check your insurance coverage before traveling abroad. ||| The mobile network has good coverage in rural areas.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该事件获得了全球媒体的广泛报道。 ||| 出国旅行前检查你的保险范围。 ||| 移动网络在农村地区覆盖良好。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 裂缝, 爆裂声
v. (使)爆裂, (使)裂开, (使)发出爆裂声
a. 第一流的
adv. 啪地一声
ieltsWords.collocations: crack down on 打击, crack a code 破解密码, crack a joke 讲笑话
ieltsWords.example: The glass cracked when hot water was poured into it. ||| The police are cracking down on drug trafficking. ||| He cracked a joke to lighten the mood.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 倒入热水时玻璃杯裂开了。 ||| 警方正在严厉打击毒品贩运。 ||| 他讲了个笑话来缓和气氛。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 摇篮, 发祥地, 孩提时代
vt. 放在摇篮内, 抚育
vi. 刈割

ieltsWords.collocations: regular customer 老顾客, customer service 客户服务, customer satisfaction 客户满意度
ieltsWords.example: The store values its regular customers. ||| Good customer service is essential for business. ||| Customer satisfaction surveys help improve services.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家商店重视老顾客。 ||| 良好的客户服务对业务至关重要。 ||| 客户满意度调查有助于改进服务。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 切口, 割伤, 降低, 切, 割, 砍, 削, 伤口, 削减, 缩短, 删节, 通路
a. 经切割的, 缩减的
vt. 切, 割, 减少, 刺痛, 开辟, 雕刻, 删节, 缩短, 停止, 排斥, 切断, 关, 显出
vi. 切, 割, 砍, 刺痛, 相交, 抄近路, 剪辑
[计] 剪切
ieltsWords.collocations: cut costs 削减成本, cut off 切断, cut down 减少
ieltsWords.example: The company plans to cut costs by 10%. ||| He cut off the electricity supply. ||| You should cut down on sugar.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司计划削减成本10%。 ||| 他切断了电力供应。 ||| 你应该减少糖的摄入。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 周期, 循环, 自行车, 一段时间, 整套
vi. 循环, 轮转, 骑自行车
vt. 使循环, 使轮转
[计] 环路; 周期; 循环
ieltsWords.collocations: life cycle 生命周期, business cycle 商业周期, cycle path 自行车道
ieltsWords.example: The water cycle is essential for life. ||| The economy goes through a business cycle. ||| There is a cycle path along the river.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 水循环对生命至关重要。 ||| 经济经历商业周期。 ||| 河边有一条自行车道。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 骑脚踏车兜风, 骑脚踏车消遣
[机] 循环操作
ieltsWords.collocations: go cycling 去骑自行车, cycling lane 自行车道, cycling race 自行车比赛
ieltsWords.example: Cycling is an excellent way to stay fit and reduce carbon emissions. ||| The city has invested heavily in new cycling lanes to encourage eco-friendly transport. ||| He won a gold medal in the cycling race at the Olympics.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 骑自行车是保持健康和减少碳排放的绝佳方式。 ||| 该市大力投资新建自行车道，以鼓励环保出行。 ||| 他在奥运会自行车比赛中获得了金牌。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 圆筒, 圆筒状物, 汽缸, 柱面
[计] 柱面
ieltsWords.collocations: gas cylinder 煤气罐, cylinder head 汽缸盖, cylinder block 汽缸体
ieltsWords.example: The engine has six cylinders, providing powerful performance. ||| A graduated cylinder is used to measure liquid volumes in the lab. ||| The sculpture was a perfect cylinder carved from marble.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这台发动机有六个汽缸，提供强劲性能。 ||| 量筒用于在实验室中测量液体体积。 ||| 这座雕塑是用大理石雕刻而成的完美圆柱体。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 愤世嫉俗的, 讽刺的, 冷嘲的
ieltsWords.collocations: cynical attitude 愤世嫉俗的态度, cynical view 悲观的看法, cynical remark 冷嘲热讽的话
ieltsWords.example: His cynical attitude towards politics made him unpopular among colleagues. ||| She gave a cynical laugh when he promised to change. ||| Many young people become cynical after being disappointed by broken promises.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他对政治的愤世嫉俗态度使他在同事中不受欢迎。 ||| 当他承诺改变时，她发出一声冷笑。 ||| 许多年轻人在被失信失望后变得愤世嫉俗。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 牛奶公司, 乳品店, 乳牛场
ieltsWords.collocations: dairy products 乳制品, dairy farm 奶牛场, dairy industry 乳品业
ieltsWords.example: She is lactose intolerant, so she avoids all dairy products. ||| The dairy farm produces fresh milk and cheese for the local market. ||| Dairy consumption has increased significantly in developing countries.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她乳糖不耐受，所以避免所有乳制品。 ||| 这家奶牛场为当地市场生产新鲜牛奶和奶酪。 ||| 发展中国家的乳制品消费显著增加。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 水坝, 障碍
v. 控制, 筑坝
[计] 直接存取法
ieltsWords.collocations: build a dam 建造水坝, hydroelectric dam 水电站大坝, dam construction 大坝建设
ieltsWords.example: The dam was built to control flooding and generate electricity. ||| Environmentalists argue that the dam will disrupt local ecosystems. ||| The Three Gorges Dam is one of the largest hydroelectric projects in the world.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座水坝是为了防洪和发电而建造的。 ||| 环保主义者认为大坝会破坏当地生态系统。 ||| 三峡大坝是世界上最大的水电项目之一。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 损害, 伤害
v. 损害
ieltsWords.collocations: cause damage 造成损害, severe damage 严重损坏, damage control 损害控制
ieltsWords.example: The storm caused extensive damage to crops and property. ||| Smoking can damage your lungs and lead to serious diseases. ||| The company is trying to repair the damage to its reputation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 暴风雨对农作物和财产造成了广泛损害。 ||| 吸烟会损害肺部并导致严重疾病。 ||| 该公司正试图修复对其声誉的损害。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 潮湿, 湿气
a. 潮湿的
vt. 使潮湿, 使阻尼, 抑止
vi. 变潮湿, 衰减
ieltsWords.collocations: damp weather 潮湿天气, damp cloth 湿布, dampen spirits 使情绪低落
ieltsWords.example: The basement is always damp, so we need a dehumidifier. ||| Damp conditions can cause mold to grow on walls. ||| The rain dampened their enthusiasm for the outdoor picnic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 地下室总是潮湿，所以我们需要除湿机。 ||| 潮湿的环境会导致墙壁上长霉菌。 ||| 雨水浇灭了他们对户外野餐的热情。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 破晓, 黎明
vi. 破晓
ieltsWords.collocations: at dawn 在黎明, dawn on 开始理解, new dawn 新的开端
ieltsWords.example: We set off at dawn to avoid the traffic. ||| It dawned on her that she had left her keys at home. ||| The discovery marked the dawn of a new era in medicine.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们在黎明出发以避开交通拥堵。 ||| 她突然意识到她把钥匙忘在家里了。 ||| 这一发现标志着医学新时代的开始。

ieltsWords.definition:
v. (使)眼花, 炫耀
n. 耀眼
ieltsWords.collocations: dazzle the audience 使观众惊叹, dazzling light 耀眼的光芒, dazzle with brilliance 才华横溢
ieltsWords.example: The fireworks display dazzled the crowd with its vibrant colors. ||| She dazzled everyone with her exceptional singing talent. ||| The sun's glare can dazzle drivers, causing accidents.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 烟花表演以其鲜艳的色彩使人群目眩神迷。 ||| 她以非凡的歌唱才华惊艳了所有人。 ||| 太阳的强光会使司机目眩，导致事故。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 最后期限, 截止期限
[经] 截止日期
ieltsWords.collocations: meet the deadline 赶上截止日期, deadline extension 延期, tight deadline 紧迫的期限
ieltsWords.example: We need to finish the project before the deadline next Friday. ||| The journalist worked all night to meet the deadline for the article. ||| The teacher granted a deadline extension due to the holiday.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要在下周五的截止日期前完成项目。 ||| 记者通宵工作以赶上文章的截稿时间。 ||| 由于假期，老师批准了截止日期的延长。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 致命的, 致死的
adv. 非常, 如死一般地
ieltsWords.collocations: deadly disease 致命疾病, deadly weapon 致命武器, deadly serious 极其严肃
ieltsWords.example: The virus proved deadly, killing thousands of people. ||| He made a deadly mistake by ignoring the warning signs. ||| The silence in the room was deadly, making everyone uneasy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这种病毒被证明是致命的，导致数千人死亡。 ||| 他忽视了警告信号，犯了一个致命的错误。 ||| 房间里的寂静令人窒息，让每个人都不安。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 碎片, 残骸
[医] 碎屑
ieltsWords.collocations: debris removal 碎片清理, space debris 太空垃圾, debris from the explosion 爆炸碎片
ieltsWords.example: After the earthquake, the streets were filled with debris from collapsed buildings. ||| The cleanup crew worked for hours to remove the debris from the highway. ||| Space debris poses a serious threat to satellites and spacecraft.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 地震后，街道上满是倒塌建筑的碎片。 ||| 清洁人员花了几个小时清理高速公路上的碎片。 ||| 太空垃圾对卫星和航天器构成严重威胁。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 债务, 罪过
[经] 借款, 欠款, 债务
ieltsWords.collocations: pay off debt 还清债务, national debt 国债, in debt 负债
ieltsWords.example: Many students graduate with a large amount of debt from student loans. ||| The government is trying to reduce the national debt by cutting spending. ||| He is deeply in debt and struggles to make ends meet.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多学生毕业时背负着巨额学生贷款债务。 ||| 政府正试图通过削减支出来减少国债。 ||| 他负债累累，难以维持生计。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 衰退, 腐败
v. (使)衰退, (使)腐败
ieltsWords.collocations: tooth decay 蛀牙, urban decay 城市衰败, radioactive decay 放射性衰变
ieltsWords.example: Sugar consumption is a major cause of tooth decay. ||| The old building was left to decay due to lack of maintenance. ||| The decay of moral values in society is a growing concern.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 糖的摄入是蛀牙的主要原因。 ||| 由于缺乏维护，这座旧建筑被任其腐烂。 ||| 社会道德价值观的衰退日益令人担忧。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 欺骗, 行骗
ieltsWords.collocations: deceive someone 欺骗某人, deceive oneself 自欺欺人, deliberately deceive 故意欺骗
ieltsWords.example: He deceived his investors by falsifying the financial reports. ||| Don't deceive yourself into thinking that cheating is acceptable. ||| The magician's trick deceived the audience into believing he had vanished.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他通过伪造财务报告欺骗了投资者。 ||| 不要自欺欺人地认为作弊是可以接受的。 ||| 魔术师的把戏欺骗了观众，让他们以为他消失了。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 有分寸的, 得体的, 大方的
ieltsWords.collocations: decent job 体面的工作, decent living 体面的生活, decent person 正派的人
ieltsWords.example: Everyone deserves a decent job with fair wages. ||| The hotel offered decent accommodation at a reasonable price. ||| He is a decent man who always helps others in need.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 每个人都应该有一份工资公平的体面工作。 ||| 这家酒店以合理的价格提供了像样的住宿。 ||| 他是一个正派的人，总是帮助有需要的人。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 十进位的, 小数的
n. 十进制, 小数
[计] 十进制, 小数点
ieltsWords.collocations: decimal system 十进制, decimal point 小数点, decimal fraction 小数
ieltsWords.example: The metric system is based on the decimal system, making conversions easy. ||| In mathematics, we often round numbers to two decimal places. ||| The decimal point separates the whole number from the fractional part.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公制基于十进制，使换算变得容易。 ||| 在数学中，我们经常将数字四舍五入到两位小数。 ||| 小数点将整数部分与小数部分分开。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 决定, 决心, 决断
[计] 判定
ieltsWords.collocations: make a decision 做决定, decision-making 决策, final decision 最终决定
ieltsWords.example: After careful consideration, she made the decision to study abroad. ||| The court's decision was met with widespread approval. ||| Effective decision-making is a crucial skill for managers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 经过仔细考虑，她决定出国留学。 ||| 法院的判决得到了广泛认可。 ||| 有效的决策是管理者的关键技能。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 甲板, (汽车后部的)行李仓
vt. 装饰, 打扮, 装甲板
[计] 纸牌背面图案
ieltsWords.collocations: on deck 在甲板上, deck of cards 一副牌, deck the halls 装饰大厅
ieltsWords.example: The passengers gathered on the deck to watch the sunset. ||| He shuffled the deck of cards and dealt them to the players. ||| They decked the room with flowers and balloons for the party.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 乘客们聚集在甲板上观看日落。 ||| 他洗了牌，然后发给了玩家。 ||| 他们用鲜花和气球装饰房间以举办派对。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 宣告, 说明, 宣布
[计] 说明
ieltsWords.collocations: declaration of independence 独立宣言, customs declaration 海关申报, formal declaration 正式声明
ieltsWords.example: The Declaration of Independence was signed in 1776. ||| You must fill out a customs declaration form when entering the country. ||| The president made a formal declaration of war.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 《独立宣言》于1776年签署。 ||| 入境时必须填写海关申报表。 ||| 总统正式宣战。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 宣布, 声明, 申报, 断言
ieltsWords.collocations: declare war 宣战, declare bankruptcy 宣布破产, declare income 申报收入
ieltsWords.example: The government declared a state of emergency after the earthquake. ||| You must declare all your income on the tax form. ||| He declared his intention to run for president.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 地震后政府宣布进入紧急状态。 ||| 你必须在税表上申报所有收入。 ||| 他宣布了竞选总统的意图。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 分解, (使)腐烂
ieltsWords.collocations: decompose into 分解成, decompose organic matter 分解有机物, decompose naturally 自然分解
ieltsWords.example: The dead leaves decompose and enrich the soil. ||| Water can be decomposed into hydrogen and oxygen. ||| The chemical decomposes rapidly when exposed to sunlight.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 枯叶腐烂后使土壤肥沃。 ||| 水可以分解成氢和氧。 ||| 这种化学物质暴露在阳光下会迅速分解。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 装饰
ieltsWords.collocations: decorate with 用...装饰, decorate a room 装饰房间, decorate a soldier 授予士兵勋章
ieltsWords.example: They decorated the hall with balloons and ribbons for the party. ||| The soldier was decorated for bravery in battle. ||| She loves to decorate her house with fresh flowers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们用气球和彩带装饰大厅以举办派对。 ||| 这名士兵因战斗英勇而被授予勋章。 ||| 她喜欢用鲜花装饰她的房子。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 装饰, 装饰品
ieltsWords.collocations: Christmas decoration 圣诞装饰, interior decoration 室内装饰, award a decoration 授予勋章
ieltsWords.example: The Christmas decorations made the whole street look festive. ||| She studied interior decoration at college. ||| He received a decoration for his service in the war.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 圣诞装饰让整条街看起来充满节日气氛。 ||| 她在大学学习室内装饰。 ||| 他因在战争中的服役而获得了一枚勋章。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 减少, 减少量
v. 减少
ieltsWords.collocations: decrease in 在...方面减少, decrease by 减少了, a sharp decrease 急剧减少
ieltsWords.example: The number of students has decreased significantly this year. ||| There has been a decrease in crime rates in the city. ||| The company plans to decrease its carbon emissions by 20%.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 今年的学生人数显著减少了。 ||| 该市的犯罪率有所下降。 ||| 该公司计划将碳排放减少20%。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 法令, 判决, 天意
vt. 颁布, 判决
vi. 发布命令
ieltsWords.collocations: issue a decree 颁布法令, royal decree 皇家法令, decree that 法令规定
ieltsWords.example: The king issued a decree banning the use of plastic bags. ||| The court decreed that the property should be divided equally. ||| By presidential decree, the new policy will take effect next month.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 国王颁布了一项禁止使用塑料袋的法令。 ||| 法院判决财产应平均分配。 ||| 根据总统令，新政策将于下月生效。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 献出, 贡献
ieltsWords.collocations: dedicate to 致力于, dedicate oneself to 献身于, dedicate a book to 把书献给
ieltsWords.example: She dedicated her life to helping the poor. ||| The author dedicated the book to his parents. ||| He dedicated himself to scientific research.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她一生致力于帮助穷人。 ||| 作者将这本书献给了他的父母。 ||| 他献身于科学研究。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 奉献, 献身, 献辞
[计] 专用
ieltsWords.collocations: hard work and dedication 努力和奉献, dedication to 对...的奉献, a book's dedication 书的题献
ieltsWords.example: Her dedication to her students is truly admirable. ||| The project required a lot of time and dedication. ||| The dedication in the front of the book was written by the author.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对学生的奉献精神确实令人钦佩。 ||| 这个项目需要大量的时间和奉献。 ||| 书前的题献词是作者写的。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 推论, 演绎出
[法] 推断, 推出, 演绎
ieltsWords.collocations: deduce from 从...推断, deduce that 推断出, deduce a conclusion 得出结论
ieltsWords.example: From the evidence, the detective deduced that the thief had entered through the window. ||| We can deduce from the data that the economy is improving. ||| It is possible to deduce the meaning of the word from its context.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 根据证据，侦探推断小偷是从窗户进入的。 ||| 从数据我们可以推断经济正在改善。 ||| 可以从上下文推断出这个词的意思。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 扣除, 减去
[经] 扣除, 减去, 折扣
ieltsWords.collocations: deduct from 从...扣除, deduct tax 扣税, deduct expenses 扣除费用
ieltsWords.example: The cost of the meal will be deducted from your salary. ||| You can deduct business expenses from your taxable income. ||| The bank deducted a fee for the transaction.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 餐费将从你的工资中扣除。 ||| 你可以从应税收入中扣除业务费用。 ||| 银行扣除了交易手续费。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 认为, 相信
ieltsWords.collocations: deem necessary 认为必要, deem appropriate 认为合适, deem it important 认为重要
ieltsWords.example: The committee deemed the proposal unacceptable. ||| She deemed it wise to remain silent. ||| The court deemed the evidence inadmissible.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 委员会认为该提议不可接受。 ||| 她认为保持沉默是明智的。 ||| 法院认为该证据不可采纳。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 违约, 不履行责任, 缺席, 默认值
v. 疏怠职责, 缺席, 拖欠, 默认
[计] 默认; 默认值; 缺省值
ieltsWords.collocations: in default of 因缺少, default on a loan 拖欠贷款, by default 默认情况下
