ieltsWords.example: If you default on your loan, the bank may seize your property. ||| The computer will use the default settings unless you change them. ||| He won the game by default because his opponent failed to show up.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 如果你拖欠贷款，银行可能会没收你的财产。 ||| 除非你更改，否则计算机将使用默认设置。 ||| 他因对手缺席而自动获胜。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 败北, 失败
vt. 击败, 使落空
ieltsWords.collocations: suffer a defeat 遭受失败, defeat an enemy 击败敌人, admit defeat 认输
ieltsWords.example: The army defeated the rebels after a long battle. ||| The team suffered a humiliating defeat in the final. ||| She refused to admit defeat and kept trying.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 军队在长期战斗后击败了叛军。 ||| 该队在决赛中遭受了耻辱性的失败。 ||| 她拒绝认输，继续尝试。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 缺点
[医] 缺损, 缺陷
ieltsWords.collocations: birth defect 先天缺陷, a defect in 在...方面的缺陷, defect to 叛逃到
ieltsWords.example: The product was recalled due to a manufacturing defect. ||| He defected to the enemy during the war. ||| The software has a serious security defect.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该产品因制造缺陷被召回。 ||| 他在战争期间叛逃到敌方。 ||| 该软件有一个严重的安全缺陷。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 防卫, 防卫设备
[经] (诉讼程序中的)辩护
ieltsWords.collocations: in defence of 为...辩护, defence mechanism 防御机制, national defence 国防
ieltsWords.example: The lawyer presented a strong defence for her client. ||| The country increased its defence spending. ||| The immune system is the body's defence against infection.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 律师为她的当事人进行了强有力的辩护。 ||| 该国增加了国防开支。 ||| 免疫系统是身体对抗感染的防御机制。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 被告
[经] 被告方
ieltsWords.collocations: the defendant in the case 案件中的被告, defendant's lawyer 被告律师, innocent defendant 无辜的被告
ieltsWords.example: The defendant pleaded not guilty to the charges. ||| The court found the defendant guilty of theft. ||| The defendant's lawyer argued that there was insufficient evidence.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 被告对指控拒不认罪。 ||| 法院判定被告犯有盗窃罪。 ||| 被告律师辩称证据不足。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 推迟, 延期, 听从
vt. 使推迟, 使延期
ieltsWords.collocations: defer to 遵从, defer payment 延期付款, defer a decision 推迟决定
ieltsWords.example: The meeting was deferred until next week. ||| I defer to your expertise in this matter. ||| The student requested to defer his enrollment for a year.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 会议推迟到了下周。 ||| 在这件事上我听从你的专业意见。 ||| 该学生请求推迟入学一年。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 缺乏, 不足
[医] 缺乏, 不足
ieltsWords.collocations: vitamin deficiency 维生素缺乏, deficiency in 在...方面不足, iron deficiency 缺铁
ieltsWords.example: A deficiency of vitamin C can cause scurvy. ||| The report highlighted deficiencies in the current system. ||| She suffers from an iron deficiency and needs supplements.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 缺乏维生素C会导致坏血病。 ||| 报告强调了当前系统的缺陷。 ||| 她患有缺铁症，需要补充剂。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 赤字, 不足额
[医] 短缺
ieltsWords.collocations: budget deficit 预算赤字, trade deficit 贸易逆差, deficit spending 赤字支出
ieltsWords.example: The government is trying to reduce the budget deficit. ||| The country has a large trade deficit with its neighbors. ||| The project ran into a deficit and required additional funding.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府正试图减少预算赤字。 ||| 该国与其邻国存在巨大的贸易逆差。 ||| 该项目出现赤字，需要额外资金。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 限定词
a. 限定的, 决定性的
ieltsWords.collocations: definitive answer 最终答案, definitive guide 权威指南, definitive proof 确凿证据
ieltsWords.example: The court's ruling is definitive and cannot be appealed. ||| This book is considered the definitive work on the subject. ||| We need definitive proof before we can take action.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 法院的裁决是最终的，不可上诉。 ||| 这本书被认为是该主题的权威著作。 ||| 我们需要确凿的证据才能采取行动。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 放气, 抽出空气, 使缩小
vi. 缩小
ieltsWords.collocations: deflate a tire 给轮胎放气, deflate the economy 紧缩经济, deflate someone's ego 打击某人的自信心
ieltsWords.example: The mechanic had to deflate the tire before repairing it. ||| The government's policy aims to deflate the overheated housing market. ||| His criticism completely deflated my enthusiasm for the project.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 修理工在修理前必须先给轮胎放气。 ||| 政府的政策旨在给过热的房地产市场降温。 ||| 他的批评彻底打消了我对这个项目的热情。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 转移, 使偏斜
vi. 偏斜
ieltsWords.collocations: deflect a ball 使球转向, deflect attention 转移注意力, deflect criticism 转移批评
ieltsWords.example: The goalkeeper managed to deflect the ball with his fingertips. ||| She tried to deflect attention from her mistake by changing the subject. ||| The company's spokesperson attempted to deflect criticism about the product recall.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 守门员用指尖将球挡开。 ||| 她试图通过转移话题来掩盖自己的错误。 ||| 公司发言人试图转移对产品召回事件的批评。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 欺骗
[经] 骗取, 诈取, 欺骗
ieltsWords.collocations: defraud someone of money 骗取某人的钱, defraud the government 欺骗政府, defraud investors 欺骗投资者
ieltsWords.example: He was convicted of attempting to defraud the insurance company. ||| The accountant defrauded the company of millions of dollars over several years. ||| They devised a scheme to defraud elderly people out of their savings.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他被判企图欺骗保险公司。 ||| 这名会计在几年内骗取了公司数百万美元。 ||| 他们设计了一个骗局来骗取老年人的积蓄。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 藐视, 挑衅, 使落空
n. 挑战
ieltsWords.collocations: defy authority 违抗权威, defy the law 无视法律, defy description 难以描述
ieltsWords.example: The protesters defied the government's ban on public gatherings. ||| Her courage in the face of danger defies belief. ||| The beauty of the landscape defies description.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 抗议者无视政府禁止公众集会的禁令。 ||| 她在危险面前的勇气令人难以置信。 ||| 这风景的美难以用语言描述。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 堕落的
vi. 退化, 堕落
vt. 使变质, 使退化
ieltsWords.collocations: degenerate into chaos 陷入混乱, degenerate into violence 演变成暴力, degenerate behavior 堕落行为
ieltsWords.example: The peaceful protest degenerated into a violent confrontation with the police. ||| Without proper maintenance, the building's condition degenerated rapidly. ||| His health degenerated after years of poor diet and lack of exercise.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 和平抗议演变成了与警察的暴力冲突。 ||| 缺乏适当维护，这栋建筑的状况迅速恶化。 ||| 多年不良饮食和缺乏运动后，他的健康每况愈下。

ieltsWords.definition: v. (使)降级, (使)退化
ieltsWords.collocations: degrade the environment 破坏环境, degrade someone's dignity 贬低某人的尊严, degrade into 退化为
ieltsWords.example: The use of plastic bags degrades the environment over time. ||| He felt degraded by the way his boss spoke to him in front of colleagues. ||| The material will degrade naturally if exposed to sunlight.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 使用塑料袋会逐渐破坏环境。 ||| 老板在同事面前对他说话的方式让他感到受辱。 ||| 这种材料暴露在阳光下会自然降解。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 程度, 度数, 学位, 度
[医] 度, 程度
ieltsWords.collocations: to a large degree 在很大程度上, a degree in economics 经济学学位, 90 degrees 90度
ieltsWords.example: To a certain degree, his argument is valid. ||| She earned a degree in environmental science from a prestigious university. ||| Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在某种程度上，他的论点是有道理的。 ||| 她在一所著名大学获得了环境科学学位。 ||| 在海平面上，水在100摄氏度时沸腾。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 耽搁, 迟滞
v. 耽搁, 延迟
[计] 延迟, 延时
ieltsWords.collocations: delay the flight 延误航班, delay the decision 推迟决定, without delay 毫不拖延地
ieltsWords.example: The flight was delayed due to bad weather conditions. ||| We decided to delay the meeting until next week. ||| Please respond to the email without delay.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于恶劣天气，航班延误了。 ||| 我们决定把会议推迟到下周。 ||| 请立即回复邮件，不要拖延。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 代表
vt. 委派...为代表
ieltsWords.collocations: delegate tasks 分配任务, delegate authority 授权, conference delegate 会议代表
ieltsWords.example: A good manager knows how to delegate tasks effectively. ||| She was delegated to represent the company at the international conference. ||| Each delegate was given a chance to speak at the forum.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 好的管理者懂得如何有效分配任务。 ||| 她被委派代表公司参加国际会议。 ||| 每位代表都有机会在论坛上发言。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 删除
[计] 删除
ieltsWords.collocations: delete a file 删除文件, delete an email 删除邮件, delete data 删除数据
ieltsWords.example: Please delete the unnecessary files to free up disk space. ||| He accidentally deleted the entire document before saving it. ||| You can delete your account by contacting customer support.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请删除不必要的文件以释放磁盘空间。 ||| 他在保存之前不小心删除了整个文档。 ||| 你可以联系客服删除账户。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 深思熟虑的, 故意的, 从容的
v. 仔细考虑
ieltsWords.collocations: a deliberate decision 深思熟虑的决定, deliberate over 仔细考虑, deliberate act 故意行为
ieltsWords.example: The government made a deliberate effort to reduce pollution. ||| The jury deliberated for three days before reaching a verdict. ||| His slow and deliberate movements showed his confidence.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府有意努力减少污染。 ||| 陪审团审议了三天才达成裁决。 ||| 他缓慢而从容的动作显示出他的自信。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 细致优雅的, 微妙的, 美味的
[医] 柔弱的
ieltsWords.collocations: delicate balance 微妙的平衡, delicate skin 娇嫩的皮肤, delicate situation 微妙的局势
ieltsWords.example: The negotiations require a delicate balance between the two parties. ||| She has very delicate skin that is easily irritated. ||| The delicate flower was damaged by the strong wind.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 谈判需要双方之间微妙的平衡。 ||| 她的皮肤非常娇嫩，容易受刺激。 ||| 那朵娇嫩的花被强风损坏了。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 美味的
ieltsWords.collocations: delicious food 美味的食物, delicious aroma 诱人的香味, taste delicious 尝起来美味
ieltsWords.example: The restaurant serves delicious Italian cuisine. ||| The delicious aroma of freshly baked bread filled the kitchen. ||| This homemade soup tastes absolutely delicious.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家餐厅提供美味的意大利菜。 ||| 新鲜出炉的面包的诱人香味充满了厨房。 ||| 这碗自制的汤尝起来非常美味。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 递送, 陈述, 释放, 发表, 引渡, 投递, 交付
[经] 交运
ieltsWords.collocations: deliver a speech 发表演讲, deliver goods 送货, deliver a baby 接生
ieltsWords.example: The postman delivers mail every morning. ||| She delivered an inspiring speech at the graduation ceremony. ||| The doctor delivered the baby safely at the hospital.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 邮递员每天早上送信。 ||| 她在毕业典礼上发表了鼓舞人心的演讲。 ||| 医生在医院安全地接生了婴儿。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 递送, 交付, 分娩, 交货, 引渡
[化] 交货额
ieltsWords.collocations: delivery service 送货服务, delivery time 交货时间, express delivery 快递
ieltsWords.example: The online store offers free delivery for orders over $50. ||| The delivery of the package was delayed due to the holiday. ||| His delivery was so engaging that the audience listened attentively.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家网店对超过50美元的订单提供免费送货。 ||| 由于假期，包裹的递送被延误了。 ||| 他的演讲方式非常吸引人，观众都聚精会神地听。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 民主政治, 民主主义
[法] 民主, 民主政治, 民主政体
ieltsWords.collocations: democracy and human rights 民主与人权, representative democracy 代议制民主, democratic process 民主进程
ieltsWords.example: Democracy is based on the principle of majority rule. ||| The country has a long tradition of parliamentary democracy. ||| Free and fair elections are essential for a functioning democracy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 民主基于多数统治的原则。 ||| 这个国家有着悠久的议会民主传统。 ||| 自由公正的选举是民主运作的关键。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 毁坏, 破坏, 粉碎
ieltsWords.collocations: demolish a building 拆除建筑物, demolish an argument 驳倒论点, demolish the opposition 彻底击败对手
ieltsWords.example: The old factory was demolished to make way for a new shopping mall. ||| The lawyer demolished the prosecution's case with strong evidence. ||| The team demolished their rivals in the final match, winning 5-0.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 旧工厂被拆除，以便建造新的购物中心。 ||| 律师用强有力的证据推翻了检方的指控。 ||| 这支球队在决赛中以5比0彻底击败了对手。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 示范, 实证
[医] 示教, 实物教授
ieltsWords.collocations: a demonstration of support 支持的表示, a practical demonstration 实际演示, a peaceful demonstration 和平示威
ieltsWords.example: The teacher gave a demonstration of the chemical experiment. ||| Thousands of people took part in a peaceful demonstration for climate action. ||| The results are a clear demonstration of the effectiveness of the new policy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师演示了化学实验。 ||| 数千人参加了要求气候行动的和平示威。 ||| 这些结果清楚地证明了新政策的有效性。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 否认
[法] 否定, 否认, 拒绝接受
ieltsWords.collocations: in denial 否认事实, denial of access 拒绝进入, denial of responsibility 否认责任
ieltsWords.example: The suspect issued a strong denial of all charges. ||| He is in denial about the seriousness of his illness. ||| The denial of visas to the researchers caused an international outcry.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 嫌疑人强烈否认所有指控。 ||| 他拒绝接受自己病情的严重性。 ||| 拒绝向研究人员发放签证引起了国际抗议。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 指示, 表示
ieltsWords.collocations: denote a change 表示变化, denote ownership 表示所有权, denote a meaning 表示含义
ieltsWords.example: In mathematics, the symbol π denotes the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. ||| A red light denotes that the machine is in operation. ||| The word 'home' denotes a place where one lives, but also connotes warmth and comfort.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在数学中，符号π表示圆的周长与直径之比。 ||| 红灯表示机器正在运行。 ||| 单词'home'表示一个人居住的地方，但也暗示温暖和舒适。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 告发, 抨击, 谴责
[法] 谴责, 斥责, 告发
ieltsWords.collocations: denounce corruption 谴责腐败, denounce violence 谴责暴力, denounce a policy 谴责政策
ieltsWords.example: The government denounced the terrorist attack in the strongest terms. ||| Many activists denounce the new law as a violation of human rights. ||| He was denounced as a traitor by his former colleagues.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府以最强烈的言辞谴责了这次恐怖袭击。 ||| 许多活动家谴责新法律侵犯人权。 ||| 他被前同事告发为叛徒。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 密集的, 浓厚的
ieltsWords.collocations: dense population 人口稠密, dense forest 密林, dense fog 浓雾
ieltsWords.example: The city has a dense population, leading to severe traffic congestion. ||| The dense fog made it impossible to see more than a few meters ahead. ||| He is so dense that he cannot understand simple instructions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个城市人口稠密，导致严重的交通拥堵。 ||| 浓雾使得能见度只有几米。 ||| 他太愚钝了，连简单的指示都理解不了。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 牙科医生
[医] 牙医师
ieltsWords.collocations: visit the dentist 看牙医, dentist appointment 牙医预约, dentist clinic 牙科诊所
ieltsWords.example: I have a dentist appointment tomorrow to get my teeth cleaned. ||| The dentist recommended that I floss daily to prevent cavities. ||| Many people feel anxious when they have to visit the dentist.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我明天约了牙医洗牙。 ||| 牙医建议我每天用牙线预防蛀牙。 ||| 很多人去看牙医时会感到焦虑。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 否认, 拒绝
ieltsWords.collocations: deny allegations 否认指控, deny access 拒绝访问, deny a request 拒绝请求
ieltsWords.example: The suspect denied all charges brought against him. ||| They were denied entry to the country because of visa issues. ||| She denied having any knowledge of the stolen documents.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 嫌疑人否认了对他的所有指控。 ||| 他们因签证问题被拒绝入境。 ||| 她否认知道被盗文件的事。

ieltsWords.definition: vi. 离开, 出发, 背离, 违反, 去世
ieltsWords.collocations: depart from 从……离开, depart for 前往, depart from tradition 背离传统
ieltsWords.example: The flight departs at 6 a.m. sharp, so we need to be at the airport early. ||| His actions depart significantly from the company's code of conduct. ||| The train departs from platform 3 in ten minutes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 航班早上6点准时起飞，所以我们需要早点到机场。 ||| 他的行为严重背离了公司的行为准则。 ||| 火车将于十分钟后从3号站台出发。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 部门, 系, 机关
[医] 部, 科
ieltsWords.collocations: department store 百货商店, human resources department 人力资源部, department head 部门主管
ieltsWords.example: She works in the marketing department of a multinational corporation. ||| The English department offers a wide range of courses for students. ||| Please contact the finance department for reimbursement procedures.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在一家跨国公司的市场部工作。 ||| 英语系为学生提供广泛的课程。 ||| 请联系财务部了解报销流程。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 依赖他人者
a. 依赖的, 从属的
ieltsWords.collocations: dependent on 依赖于, dependent children 受抚养子女, dependent variable 因变量
ieltsWords.example: The country's economy is heavily dependent on oil exports. ||| He is still financially dependent on his parents. ||| The success of the project is dependent on adequate funding.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该国经济严重依赖石油出口。 ||| 他在经济上仍然依赖父母。 ||| 项目的成功取决于充足的资金。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 耗尽, 使衰竭
[医] 排除, 减少
ieltsWords.collocations: deplete resources 耗尽资源, deplete reserves 耗尽储备, deplete energy 耗尽精力
ieltsWords.example: Overfishing has depleted the fish stocks in the ocean. ||| The long drought depleted the reservoir's water supply. ||| Continuous stress can deplete your physical and mental energy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 过度捕捞耗尽了海洋中的鱼类资源。 ||| 长期干旱耗尽了水库的供水。 ||| 持续的压力会耗尽你的身心精力。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 消耗, 耗尽, 放血
[医] 排除, 缺失(液体), 衰竭[状态](由于缺液)
ieltsWords.collocations: resource depletion 资源枯竭, ozone depletion 臭氧消耗, depletion of funds 资金耗尽
ieltsWords.example: The depletion of natural resources is a major concern for future generations. ||| Ozone depletion has led to increased UV radiation reaching the Earth. ||| The rapid depletion of the country's foreign reserves caused an economic crisis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 自然资源的枯竭是后代面临的一个重大问题。 ||| 臭氧消耗导致到达地球的紫外线辐射增加。 ||| 该国外汇储备的迅速枯竭引发了经济危机。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 悲悼, 哀叹, 对...深感遗憾
ieltsWords.collocations: deplore violence 谴责暴力, deplore the situation 痛惜局势, deplore the decision 反对决定
ieltsWords.example: The international community deplored the use of chemical weapons. ||| Many people deplore the loss of traditional values in modern society. ||| She deplored the government's decision to cut funding for education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 国际社会谴责使用化学武器。 ||| 许多人痛惜现代社会传统价值观的丧失。 ||| 她强烈反对政府削减教育经费的决定。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使沮丧, 压低, 降低, 使萧条
[化] 推下
ieltsWords.collocations: depress the economy 使经济萧条, depress prices 压低价格, depress mood 使情绪低落
ieltsWords.example: The bad news depressed him for the rest of the day. ||| High interest rates can depress economic growth. ||| The oversupply of oil has depressed global prices.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个坏消息让他一整天都情绪低落。 ||| 高利率会抑制经济增长。 ||| 石油供应过剩压低了全球价格。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 不景气, 消沉, 沮丧, 洼地
[医] 抑郁[症], 阻抑, 压低, 凹, 窝, 衰退, 俯角
ieltsWords.collocations: economic depression 经济萧条, suffer from depression 患抑郁症, great depression 大萧条
ieltsWords.example: The Great Depression of the 1930s caused widespread unemployment. ||| She has been struggling with depression for years. ||| The landscape was dotted with small depressions filled with water.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 20世纪30年代的大萧条导致了大规模失业。 ||| 她多年来一直与抑郁症作斗争。 ||| 地面上散布着充满水的小洼地。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 剥夺, 使丧失
[法] 剥夺, 剥夺, 夺去
ieltsWords.collocations: deprive of 剥夺, deprive someone of rights 剥夺某人的权利, deprive of sleep 剥夺睡眠
ieltsWords.example: The prisoners were deprived of basic human rights. ||| Lack of education can deprive children of future opportunities. ||| The new law would deprive citizens of their right to free speech.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 囚犯被剥夺了基本人权。 ||| 缺乏教育会剥夺孩子们未来的机会。 ||| 新法律将剥夺公民的言论自由权。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 副手，代理人
ieltsWords.collocations: deputy director 副主任, deputy manager 副经理, deputy sheriff 副警长
ieltsWords.example: The deputy manager will be in charge while the manager is away. ||| He was elected as a deputy to the National People's Congress. ||| The sheriff appointed a deputy to assist with the investigation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 经理不在时由副经理负责。 ||| 他当选为全国人大代表。 ||| 警长任命了一名副手协助调查。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 下降, 世代相传, 屈尊, 袭击
vt. 下降
ieltsWords.collocations: descend from 从……下来, descend into 陷入, descend on 突然降临
ieltsWords.example: The plane began to descend as it approached the airport. ||| The country descended into chaos after the coup. ||| Tourists descend on the city every summer for the festival.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 飞机接近机场时开始下降。 ||| 政变后该国陷入混乱。 ||| 每年夏天游客蜂拥而至参加这个城市的节日。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 降落, 家系, 侵袭, 血统
[医] 下降, 世代, 血统
ieltsWords.collocations: steep descent 陡峭的下坡, of Irish descent 爱尔兰血统, descent into chaos 陷入混乱
ieltsWords.example: The road makes a steep descent into the valley. ||| She is of Chinese descent but was born in Canada. ||| The country's rapid descent into civil war shocked the world.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这条路陡峭地向下延伸至山谷。 ||| 她是华裔，但在加拿大出生。 ||| 该国迅速陷入内战震惊了世界。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 描述, 说明, 种类
[经] 说明书(物品), 品名种类, 货物名称
ieltsWords.collocations: detailed description 详细描述, job description 职位描述, beyond description 难以形容
ieltsWords.example: The witness gave a detailed description of the suspect. ||| Please read the job description carefully before applying. ||| The beauty of the scenery was beyond description.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 目击者详细描述了嫌疑人的特征。 ||| 申请前请仔细阅读职位描述。 ||| 风景之美难以形容。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 沙漠, 应得的赏罚, 功劳
a. 沙漠的, 不毛的
vt. 放弃, 遗弃, 擅离
vi. 逃掉
ieltsWords.collocations: desert climate 沙漠气候, desert landscape 沙漠景观, desert island 荒岛
ieltsWords.example: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world. ||| Many animals have adapted to survive in the harsh desert environment. ||| They were stranded on a desert island for a month.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 撒哈拉沙漠是世界上最大的热带沙漠。 ||| 许多动物已经适应了严酷的沙漠环境。 ||| 他们被困在一个荒岛上一个月。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 设计, 图样, 方案, 企图
v. 设计, 计划
ieltsWords.collocations: design a product 设计产品, graphic design 平面设计, by design 故意地
ieltsWords.example: The architect designed a sustainable building with solar panels. ||| She studied fashion design at university. ||| The error was not accidental; it was done by design.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 建筑师设计了一座带有太阳能板的可持续建筑。 ||| 她在大学学习时装设计。 ||| 这个错误不是偶然的，而是故意的。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 指定, 指明, 称呼
a. 已选出而未上任的
ieltsWords.collocations: designate as 指定为, designate a leader 指定领导, designate an area 划定区域
ieltsWords.example: The president designated him as the new ambassador to France. ||| This area has been designated as a national park. ||| The signs designate the emergency exits clearly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 总统任命他为新任驻法国大使。 ||| 这个区域已被指定为国家公园。 ||| 标志清楚地标明了紧急出口。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 令人想望的, 可取的
ieltsWords.collocations: highly desirable 非常理想的, desirable location 理想位置, desirable outcome 理想结果
ieltsWords.example: A good education is highly desirable for career success. ||| The house is in a desirable neighborhood with excellent schools. ||| It is desirable to arrive early to secure good seats.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 良好的教育对职业成功非常理想。 ||| 这栋房子位于一个拥有优秀学校的理想社区。 ||| 提前到达以确保好座位是可取的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 欲望, 要求
vt. 想要, 请求
vi. 渴望
ieltsWords.collocations: strong desire 强烈愿望, desire for success 对成功的渴望, burning desire 炽热的欲望
ieltsWords.example: She has a strong desire to travel the world. ||| His desire for knowledge led him to study many subjects. ||| The desire to improve living conditions drives innovation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她有环游世界的强烈愿望。 ||| 他对知识的渴望促使他学习了许多学科。 ||| 改善生活条件的愿望推动创新。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 荒凉的
ieltsWords.collocations: desolate landscape 荒凉的景观, desolate area 荒凉地区, feel desolate 感到凄凉
ieltsWords.example: The earthquake left the city desolate and in ruins. ||| They crossed a desolate desert with no signs of life. ||| After losing his job, he felt desolate and alone.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 地震使这座城市荒凉且沦为废墟。 ||| 他们穿越了一片毫无生命迹象的荒凉沙漠。 ||| 失业后，他感到凄凉和孤独。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 绝望, 失望
vi. 绝望
ieltsWords.collocations: in despair 绝望中, deep despair 深深的绝望, overcome despair 克服绝望
ieltsWords.example: He was in despair after failing the exam again. ||| The refugees lived in a state of deep despair. ||| She managed to overcome her despair and start anew.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 再次考试失败后，他陷入了绝望。 ||| 难民们生活在深深的绝望之中。 ||| 她设法克服了绝望，重新开始。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 不顾一切的, 危急的, 令人绝望的, 极渴望的
ieltsWords.collocations: desperate need 极度需要, desperate attempt 拼命的尝试, desperate situation 绝望的处境
ieltsWords.example: The family was in desperate need of food and water. ||| He made a desperate attempt to escape from the burning building. ||| The situation became desperate as supplies ran out.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家人极度需要食物和水。 ||| 他拼命试图逃离燃烧的大楼。 ||| 随着补给耗尽，情况变得绝望。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 轻视
ieltsWords.collocations: despise someone 鄙视某人, despise dishonesty 厌恶不诚实, openly despise 公开鄙视
ieltsWords.example: She despises people who lie to get ahead. ||| He openly despises the corruption in the government. ||| Many people despise the idea of animal cruelty.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她鄙视那些为了成功而撒谎的人。 ||| 他公开鄙视政府中的腐败。 ||| 许多人厌恶虐待动物的想法。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 目的地, 目标, 目的
[计] 目的文件, 目的单元
ieltsWords.collocations: final destination 最终目的地, popular destination 热门目的地, travel destination 旅游目的地
ieltsWords.example: Paris is a popular destination for tourists worldwide. ||| We finally reached our destination after a long journey. ||| The package was sent to the wrong destination.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 巴黎是全球游客的热门目的地。 ||| 经过长途旅行，我们终于到达了目的地。 ||| 包裹被寄错了目的地。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 注定, 预定
ieltsWords.collocations: destine for 注定要, destine to be 注定成为, be destined 注定
ieltsWords.example: He seemed destined for greatness from a young age. ||| The project was destined to fail due to lack of funding. ||| She felt she was destined to become a teacher.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他从小似乎就注定要成就伟业。 ||| 由于缺乏资金，该项目注定失败。 ||| 她觉得自己注定要成为一名教师。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 命运, 定数
ieltsWords.collocations: control one's destiny 掌控命运, meet one's destiny 面对命运, destiny of a nation 国家的命运
ieltsWords.example: Some people believe that destiny is predetermined. ||| She took control of her own destiny by working hard. ||| The destiny of the country depends on its leaders.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 有些人相信命运是注定的。 ||| 她通过努力工作掌控了自己的命运。 ||| 国家的命运取决于其领导人。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 毁灭性的, 破坏的, 有害的
[医] 破坏的, 毁坏的
ieltsWords.collocations: destructive force 破坏力, destructive behavior 破坏性行为, destructive criticism 破坏性批评
ieltsWords.example: The earthquake had a destructive impact on the city. ||| His destructive behavior led to the end of his relationship. ||| Destructive criticism can harm a person's confidence.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 地震对这座城市造成了破坏性影响。 ||| 他的破坏性行为导致关系结束。 ||| 破坏性批评会损害一个人的自信。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使分离, 分遣
[机] 摘下, 分离, 卸下
ieltsWords.collocations: detach from 从...分离, detach oneself 使自己超然, easily detach 容易拆开
ieltsWords.example: You can detach the handle from the pan for easy storage. ||| He tried to detach himself from the emotional turmoil. ||| The sticker is designed to detach easily without leaving residue.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你可以将手柄从锅上拆下以便存放。 ||| 他试图让自己从情感动荡中超脱出来。 ||| 这种贴纸设计成容易撕下而不留残留物。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 细节, 详情
vt. 详述, 选派
vi. 画详图
[计] 详细数据
ieltsWords.collocations: in detail 详细地, attention to detail 注重细节, go into detail 深入细节
ieltsWords.example: Please explain the plan in detail. ||| She has great attention to detail in her work. ||| He didn't go into detail about the accident.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请详细解释这个计划。 ||| 她在工作中非常注重细节。 ||| 他没有详细说明事故的经过。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 扣留, 扣押, 耽搁
[法] 拘留, 扣押, 留住
ieltsWords.collocations: detain someone 拘留某人, detain for questioning 扣留审问, be detained 被拘留
ieltsWords.example: The police detained the suspect for further questioning. ||| He was detained at the airport for several hours. ||| The meeting detained me longer than expected.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方拘留了嫌疑人以进一步审问。 ||| 他在机场被扣留了几个小时。 ||| 会议耽搁了我比预期更长的时间。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 发现, 察觉, 探测
[法] 发现, 查明, 探测
ieltsWords.collocations: detect a problem 发现问题, detect changes 察觉变化, detect signals 探测信号
ieltsWords.example: The system can detect early signs of disease. ||| She detected a hint of sarcasm in his voice. ||| Radar is used to detect aircraft in the sky.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该系统可以检测疾病的早期迹象。 ||| 她察觉到他声音中有一丝讽刺。 ||| 雷达用于探测天空中的飞机。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 侦探
a. 侦探的
ieltsWords.collocations: private detective 私家侦探, detective story 侦探故事, detective work 侦探工作
ieltsWords.example: The detective solved the mystery after months of investigation. ||| She hired a private detective to find her missing brother. ||| He enjoys reading detective stories in his free time.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 经过数月的调查，侦探解开了这个谜团。 ||| 她雇了一名私家侦探寻找失踪的弟弟。 ||| 他喜欢在空闲时间读侦探故事。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 制止, 吓住, 威慑
ieltsWords.collocations: deter crime 威慑犯罪, deter someone from 阻止某人做, deter potential threats 威慑潜在威胁
ieltsWords.example: The high cost of living deters many people from moving to the city. ||| Strict laws can deter potential criminals. ||| Nothing could deter her from pursuing her dream.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 高昂的生活成本阻止了许多人搬到城市。 ||| 严格的法律可以威慑潜在的罪犯。 ||| 没有什么能阻止她追求梦想。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 清洁剂
[化] 洗涤剂
ieltsWords.collocations: laundry detergent 洗衣液, dish detergent 洗洁精, liquid detergent 液体洗涤剂
ieltsWords.example: Use a mild detergent to wash delicate fabrics. ||| She bought a new brand of laundry detergent. ||| The detergent effectively removes grease from dishes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 使用温和的洗涤剂清洗精致面料。 ||| 她买了一个新品牌的洗衣液。 ||| 这种洗洁精能有效去除餐具上的油污。

ieltsWords.definition: v. (使)恶化
ieltsWords.collocations: deteriorate rapidly 迅速恶化, health deteriorates 健康恶化, condition deteriorates 状况恶化
ieltsWords.example: His health began to deteriorate after the accident. ||| The economic situation continues to deteriorate. ||| Without maintenance, the building will deteriorate over time.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 事故后，他的健康开始恶化。 ||| 经济形势持续恶化。 ||| 没有维护，建筑物会随时间退化。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 决心, 果断
[化] 判定; 测定
ieltsWords.collocations: strong determination 坚定的决心, show determination 显示决心, determination to succeed 成功的决心
ieltsWords.example: Her determination to succeed helped her overcome many obstacles. ||| The team showed great determination in the final match. ||| The determination of the cause of the fire took several days.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她成功的决心帮助她克服了许多障碍。 ||| 团队在决赛中表现出了极大的决心。 ||| 确定火灾原因花了几天时间。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 有害的
ieltsWords.collocations: detrimental effect 有害影响, detrimental to health 对健康有害, be detrimental 有害的
ieltsWords.example: Smoking is detrimental to your health. ||| The policy had a detrimental effect on the economy. ||| Lack of sleep can be detrimental to academic performance.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的健康有害。 ||| 该政策对经济产生了不利影响。 ||| 睡眠不足可能对学业表现有害。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 毁坏
[法] 使荒废, 毁灭, 掠夺
ieltsWords.collocations: devastate the city 摧毁城市, devastate the economy 破坏经济, devastate the environment 破坏环境
ieltsWords.example: The earthquake devastated the entire region, leaving thousands homeless. ||| The news of his death devastated his family and friends. ||| The war devastated the country's infrastructure and economy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 地震摧毁了整个地区，导致数千人无家可归。 ||| 他去世的消息使他的家人和朋友悲痛欲绝。 ||| 战争摧毁了该国的基础设施和经济。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 毁灭性的, (非正式)很好的, 引人注目的
ieltsWords.collocations: devastating effect 毁灭性影响, devastating blow 毁灭性打击, devastating criticism 严厉的批评
ieltsWords.example: The hurricane had a devastating impact on the coastal communities. ||| Her devastating critique of the policy led to its revision. ||| The team suffered a devastating defeat in the final match.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 飓风对沿海社区造成了毁灭性的影响。 ||| 她对政策的严厉批评促使其进行了修订。 ||| 该队在决赛中遭受了毁灭性的失败。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 发展
[化] 展开
ieltsWords.collocations: economic development 经济发展, sustainable development 可持续发展, research and development 研发
ieltsWords.example: The government is focusing on the development of renewable energy sources. ||| The rapid development of technology has changed our daily lives. ||| There have been new developments in the case that may lead to an arrest.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府正专注于可再生能源的开发。 ||| 技术的快速发展改变了我们的日常生活。 ||| 案件有了新进展，可能导致逮捕。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 脱离, 偏离
vt. 使偏离
a. 脱离常规的
n. 脱离常规的人
ieltsWords.collocations: deviate from the plan 偏离计划, deviate from the norm 偏离常规, deviate from the truth 偏离真相
ieltsWords.example: The plane deviated from its original flight path due to bad weather. ||| He never deviates from his principles, no matter the circumstances. ||| The experiment results deviated significantly from our expectations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于恶劣天气，飞机偏离了原定航线。 ||| 无论情况如何，他从不背离自己的原则。 ||| 实验结果与我们的预期有显著偏差。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 设计, 发明, 图谋, 遗赠给
n. 遗赠
ieltsWords.collocations: devise a plan 制定计划, devise a strategy 制定策略, devise a system 设计系统
ieltsWords.example: The engineers devised a new method to reduce energy consumption. ||| They devised a clever scheme to raise funds for the charity. ||| We need to devise a solution that satisfies all parties involved.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 工程师们设计了一种降低能耗的新方法。 ||| 他们策划了一个巧妙的方案为慈善机构筹款。 ||| 我们需要想出一个让所有相关方都满意的解决方案。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 诊断
ieltsWords.collocations: diagnose a disease 诊断疾病, diagnose a problem 诊断问题, diagnose a fault 诊断故障
ieltsWords.example: The doctor diagnosed her with a rare genetic disorder. ||| It took the mechanic several hours to diagnose the engine problem. ||| Early diagnosis is crucial for successful treatment of cancer.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 医生诊断她患有一种罕见的遗传性疾病。 ||| 机械师花了几个小时才诊断出发动机的问题。 ||| 早期诊断对癌症的成功治疗至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 图表；图解
ieltsWords.collocations: draw a diagram 画图表, flow diagram 流程图, circuit diagram 电路图
ieltsWords.example: The teacher drew a diagram on the board to explain the process. ||| The report includes a diagram showing the company's organizational structure. ||| Please refer to the diagram on page 5 for a visual representation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师在黑板上画了一个图表来解释这个过程。 ||| 报告包含一个显示公司组织结构的图表。 ||| 请参考第5页的图表以获取直观表示。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 刻度盘, 钟面, 转盘
v. 拨
ieltsWords.collocations: dial a number 拨号码, dial the phone 打电话, dial 911 拨打911
ieltsWords.example: He dialed the wrong number and apologized to the stranger. ||| You need to dial the area code before the phone number. ||| In an emergency, dial 110 for the police.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他拨错了号码，向陌生人道了歉。 ||| 你需要先拨区号再拨电话号码。 ||| 紧急情况下，拨打110报警。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 方言, 同源语
ieltsWords.collocations: local dialect 当地方言, regional dialect 地区方言, speak a dialect 说方言
ieltsWords.example: The novel is written in the local dialect of the region. ||| Although they speak the same language, their dialects are quite different. ||| Many young people are losing the ability to speak their native dialect.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这部小说是用当地方言写的。 ||| 尽管他们说同一种语言，但方言差异很大。 ||| 许多年轻人正在失去说母语方言的能力。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 直径
[医] 直经, 径
ieltsWords.collocations: diameter of a circle 圆的直径, outer diameter 外径, inner diameter 内径
ieltsWords.example: The diameter of the Earth is about 12,742 kilometers. ||| Measure the diameter of the pipe before cutting it. ||| The telescope has a lens with a diameter of 10 meters.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 地球的直径约为12,742公里。 ||| 在切割管道之前先测量其直径。 ||| 这台望远镜的透镜直径为10米。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 日记
[经] 日记簿
ieltsWords.collocations: keep a diary 写日记, personal diary 个人日记, travel diary 旅行日记
ieltsWords.example: She keeps a diary to record her thoughts and experiences. ||| I found an old diary in the attic that belonged to my grandmother. ||| His diary entries reveal the struggles he faced during the war.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她写日记记录自己的想法和经历。 ||| 我在阁楼里找到了一本属于我祖母的旧日记。 ||| 他的日记内容揭示了他在战争期间面临的挣扎。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 听写, 口述, 口授
vt. 口述, 使听写, 命令
n. 命令, 指挥, 指令
ieltsWords.collocations: dictate a letter 口述信件, dictate terms 规定条件, dictate policy 制定政策
ieltsWords.example: The boss dictated a memo to his secretary. ||| No country has the right to dictate to others how to run their affairs. ||| The rules dictate that all participants must wear safety gear.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老板向秘书口述了一份备忘录。 ||| 任何国家都无权支配其他国家如何管理自己的事务。 ||| 规定要求所有参与者必须穿戴安全装备。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 日常饮食, 议会
vt. 照规定饮食
vi. 忌食
ieltsWords.collocations: balanced diet 均衡饮食, go on a diet 节食, healthy diet 健康饮食
ieltsWords.example: A balanced diet is essential for maintaining good health. ||| She went on a strict diet to lose weight before the wedding. ||| The doctor recommended a diet low in salt and fat.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 均衡饮食对保持健康至关重要。 ||| 她在婚礼前严格节食以减肥。 ||| 医生建议低盐低脂饮食。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 不一致, 不同
[机] 差异, 不同
ieltsWords.collocations: differ from 与...不同, differ in 在...方面不同, differ with 与...意见不同
ieltsWords.example: The two proposals differ significantly in their approach. ||| I differ with you on that point. ||| Languages differ in their grammatical structures.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两个提案在方法上显著不同。 ||| 在那一点上我与你意见不同。 ||| 语言在语法结构上有所不同。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 不同, 差异
[计] 差分
ieltsWords.collocations: make a difference 有影响, difference between 两者之间的差异, cultural difference 文化差异
ieltsWords.example: There is a significant difference in temperature between day and night. ||| Your support can make a real difference to the success of the project. ||| They managed to settle their differences through negotiation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 白天和夜晚的温度有显著差异。 ||| 你的支持对项目的成功可以产生真正的影响。 ||| 他们通过谈判解决了分歧。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 不同的
[机] 差动, 微分的, 差速器
ieltsWords.collocations: different from 与...不同, different types 不同类型, different ways 不同方式
ieltsWords.example: This approach is different from the one we used before. ||| There are many different types of renewable energy sources. ||| People from different cultures may have different customs.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这种方法与我们之前使用的不同。 ||| 有许多不同类型的可再生能源。 ||| 来自不同文化的人可能有不同的习俗。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 区别, 区分
ieltsWords.collocations: differentiate between 区分, differentiate from 与...区分, differentiate products 区分产品
ieltsWords.example: It is important to differentiate between facts and opinions. ||| The company differentiates itself from competitors by offering superior customer service. ||| The teacher helped students differentiate the two similar concepts.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 区分事实和观点很重要。 ||| 该公司通过提供卓越的客户服务来与竞争对手区分开来。 ||| 老师帮助学生区分这两个相似的概念。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 困难, 难点
ieltsWords.collocations: have difficulty 有困难, face difficulty 面临困难, overcome difficulty 克服困难
ieltsWords.example: She had difficulty finding a job after graduation. ||| The team faced many difficulties during the expedition. ||| With determination, we can overcome any difficulty.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她毕业后找工作有困难。 ||| 探险队面临许多困难。 ||| 只要有决心，我们就能克服任何困难。

ieltsWords.definition:
v. 散播, 传播
a. 散开的, 弥漫的
ieltsWords.collocations: diffuse light 漫射光, diffuse knowledge 传播知识, diffuse tension 缓解紧张
ieltsWords.example: The light from the lamp diffuses softly through the room. ||| The organization aims to diffuse scientific knowledge among the public. ||| His calm words helped to diffuse the tense situation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 灯光柔和地漫射到房间里。 ||| 该组织旨在向公众传播科学知识。 ||| 他平静的话语有助于缓解紧张局势。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 文摘
vi. 消化
vt. 消化, 理解
[计] 摘要
ieltsWords.collocations: digest food 消化食物, digest information 消化信息, digest a book 消化一本书
ieltsWords.example: It takes time for the body to digest fatty foods. ||| I need some time to digest all the information from the meeting. ||| She read the article slowly to digest its main points.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 身体消化高脂肪食物需要时间。 ||| 我需要一些时间来消化会议上的所有信息。 ||| 她慢慢地阅读文章以理解其要点。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 数字显示的, 数字的
n. 数字仪表, 数字式电子表(或时钟)
[计] 数字, 数字式
ieltsWords.collocations: digital technology 数字技术, digital age 数字时代, digital transformation 数字化转型
ieltsWords.example: The digital revolution has transformed the way we communicate. ||| Many companies are investing heavily in digital marketing. ||| Digital literacy is essential for modern students.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 数字革命改变了我们的交流方式。 ||| 许多公司正在大力投资数字营销。 ||| 数字素养对现代学生至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 尊严, 高贵
[法] 尊严, 高位, 高贵
ieltsWords.collocations: human dignity 人类尊严, with dignity 有尊严地, preserve dignity 维护尊严
ieltsWords.example: Everyone deserves to be treated with dignity and respect. ||| He maintained his dignity throughout the difficult situation. ||| The ceremony was conducted with great dignity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 每个人都应受到有尊严和尊重的对待。 ||| 他在困境中始终保持尊严。 ||| 仪式以庄严的方式进行。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 困境, (进退两难的)窘境
ieltsWords.collocations: ethical dilemma 道德困境, face a dilemma 面临两难, resolve a dilemma 解决困境
ieltsWords.example: She faced a moral dilemma when she discovered her friend's secret. ||| The government is in a dilemma over how to handle the crisis. ||| Choosing between career and family is a common dilemma.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 当她发现朋友的秘密时，她面临一个道德困境。 ||| 政府在如何处理危机上陷入两难。 ||| 在事业和家庭之间做选择是一个常见的困境。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 勤勉的, 用功的
ieltsWords.collocations: diligent student 勤奋的学生, diligent work 勤奋工作, be diligent in 在...方面勤奋
ieltsWords.example: A diligent student always completes assignments on time. ||| Through diligent effort, she achieved her goals. ||| He is diligent in his research and often works late.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 勤奋的学生总是按时完成作业。 ||| 通过勤奋努力，她实现了目标。 ||| 他勤奋研究，经常工作到很晚。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 冲淡, 稀释
a. 淡的, 稀释的
ieltsWords.collocations: dilute with water 用水稀释, dilute the effect 削弱效果, dilute concentration 稀释浓度
ieltsWords.example: You should dilute the juice with water before drinking. ||| Adding too many new members may dilute the team's culture. ||| The chemical must be diluted to a safe concentration.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你应该在喝之前用水稀释果汁。 ||| 增加太多新成员可能会削弱团队文化。 ||| 这种化学品必须稀释到安全浓度。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 用正餐, 进餐
vt. 宴请
ieltsWords.collocations: dine out 外出就餐, dine in 在家用餐, dine with 与...共餐
ieltsWords.example: We decided to dine out at a new restaurant. ||| They often dine with their neighbors on weekends. ||| The hotel offers a fine dining experience.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们决定去一家新餐馆外出就餐。 ||| 他们周末常与邻居一起用餐。 ||| 这家酒店提供精致的用餐体验。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 正餐, 宴会
ieltsWords.collocations: dining room 餐厅, dining table 餐桌, fine dining 精致餐饮
ieltsWords.example: The dining room is spacious and elegantly decorated. ||| They prefer casual dining to formal restaurants. ||| The hotel offers both indoor and outdoor dining options.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 餐厅宽敞且装饰优雅。 ||| 他们更喜欢休闲餐饮而非正式餐厅。 ||| 酒店提供室内和室外就餐选择。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 文凭, 毕业证书
[医] 文凭
ieltsWords.collocations: high school diploma 高中文凭, college diploma 大学文凭, diploma course 文凭课程
ieltsWords.example: She earned her diploma in nursing last year. ||| A high school diploma is often required for entry-level jobs. ||| He completed a diploma course in business management.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她去年获得了护理文凭。 ||| 高中文凭通常是入门级工作的要求。 ||| 他完成了一门商业管理文凭课程。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 外交官, 有外交手腕的人
[法] 外交家, 外交官, 有权谋的人
ieltsWords.collocations: career diplomat 职业外交官, skilled diplomat 老练的外交官, diplomat in residence 常驻外交官
ieltsWords.example: The diplomat negotiated a peace treaty between the two countries. ||| She is a skilled diplomat who can handle difficult situations. ||| Many diplomats live abroad for years at a time.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位外交官在两国之间谈判了一项和平条约。 ||| 她是一位能处理棘手局面的老练外交官。 ||| 许多外交官一次在国外生活多年。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 外交的, 老练的
[法] 外交的, 外交上的, 文献上的
ieltsWords.collocations: diplomatic relations 外交关系, diplomatic solution 外交解决方案, diplomatic immunity 外交豁免权
ieltsWords.example: The two countries have established diplomatic relations. ||| He gave a diplomatic answer to avoid offending anyone. ||| They are seeking a diplomatic solution to the conflict.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 两国已建立外交关系。 ||| 他给出了一个圆滑的回答以避免冒犯任何人。 ||| 他们正在寻求冲突的外交解决方案。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 目录, 工商名录, 指南
[计] 目录
ieltsWords.collocations: telephone directory 电话簿, business directory 企业名录, directory assistance 查号服务
ieltsWords.example: You can find his number in the telephone directory. ||| The online directory lists all local restaurants. ||| She consulted the employee directory to find his email.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你可以在电话簿里找到他的号码。 ||| 在线名录列出了所有当地餐馆。 ||| 她查阅了员工名录以找到他的邮箱。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使失去能力, 使残废, (律)使无资格
[计] 使无效, 禁止, 关闭
ieltsWords.collocations: disable the function 禁用功能, disable a device 禁用设备, permanently disable 永久性致残
ieltsWords.example: You can disable the automatic update feature in settings. ||| The accident disabled him for life. ||| Please disable the alarm before entering the room.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你可以在设置中禁用自动更新功能。 ||| 那场事故使他终身残疾。 ||| 进入房间前请关闭警报。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 残废的, 有缺陷的, 失效的
[计] 失效的
ieltsWords.collocations: disabled people 残疾人, disabled access 无障碍通道, disabled parking 残疾人停车位
ieltsWords.example: The building has disabled access ramps. ||| She works with disabled children at a special school. ||| The button is disabled until you fill in all fields.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该建筑设有无障碍坡道。 ||| 她在一所特殊学校与残疾儿童一起工作。 ||| 在填写所有字段之前，该按钮是禁用的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 不合, 争论, 不一致
[法] 不一致, 不同意, 陪审团的意见不一
ieltsWords.collocations: strong disagreement 强烈分歧, resolve a disagreement 解决分歧, in disagreement with 与...意见不合
ieltsWords.example: There was a disagreement over the budget allocation. ||| They had a disagreement but later resolved it. ||| I am in disagreement with his proposal.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在预算分配上存在分歧。 ||| 他们有过争论，但后来解决了。 ||| 我不同意他的提议。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 灾祸, 不幸, 彻底失败
ieltsWords.collocations: natural disaster 自然灾害, disaster relief 救灾, disaster management 灾害管理
ieltsWords.example: The earthquake was one of the worst natural disasters in history. ||| The project was a complete disaster due to poor planning. ||| Emergency services are trained for disaster response.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 那次地震是历史上最严重的自然灾害之一。 ||| 由于规划不善，该项目彻底失败。 ||| 紧急服务部门接受过灾害应对培训。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 丢弃, 抛弃
vi. 垫牌
n. 垫牌, 抛弃
ieltsWords.collocations: discard old clothes 丢弃旧衣服, discard outdated ideas 抛弃过时的想法, discard waste 丢弃废物
ieltsWords.example: Please discard any expired food items. ||| It's time to discard these outdated theories. ||| He discarded the broken vase in the trash.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请丢弃任何过期的食品。 ||| 是时候抛弃这些过时的理论了。 ||| 他把破碎的花瓶丢进了垃圾桶。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 辨别, 看清楚, 了解
ieltsWords.collocations: discern the difference 辨别差异, discern a pattern 识别模式, discern truth 辨别真相
ieltsWords.example: It is difficult to discern the difference between the two versions. ||| She could discern a hint of sadness in his voice. ||| Experts can discern authentic artworks from forgeries.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 很难辨别这两个版本之间的差异。 ||| 她能听出他声音中一丝悲伤。 ||| 专家能辨别真品艺术品和赝品。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 卸下, 放出, 解雇, 拔染, 履行, 放电
vi. 卸货, 流出
n. 卸货, 流出, 放电
ieltsWords.collocations: discharge waste 排放废物, discharge a patient 让病人出院, discharge duties 履行职责
ieltsWords.example: Factories must not discharge toxic chemicals into rivers. ||| He was discharged from the hospital after a week. ||| She discharged her responsibilities with great care.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 工厂不得向河流排放有毒化学物质。 ||| 一周后他出院了。 ||| 她非常谨慎地履行了自己的职责。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 揭露, 透露
[法] 揭发, 揭露, 公开
ieltsWords.collocations: disclose information 披露信息, disclose a secret 泄露秘密, disclose details 透露细节
ieltsWords.example: The company refused to disclose its financial records. ||| He disclosed the truth to his family. ||| The report discloses serious flaws in the system.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司拒绝披露其财务记录。 ||| 他向家人透露了真相。 ||| 该报告揭露了系统中的严重缺陷。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 夜总会, 迪斯科, 的士高
ieltsWords.collocations: disco music 迪斯科音乐, disco dancing 迪斯科舞, disco club 迪斯科俱乐部
ieltsWords.example: They went to a disco on Saturday night. ||| Disco was popular in the 1970s. ||| The disco had flashing lights and loud music.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们周六晚上去了迪斯科舞厅。 ||| 迪斯科在20世纪70年代很流行。 ||| 迪斯科舞厅有闪烁的灯光和响亮的音乐。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 折扣, 贴现率
vt. 打折扣
vi. 贴现
ieltsWords.collocations: discount rate 贴现率, discount store 折扣店, offer a discount 提供折扣
ieltsWords.example: Students can get a 10% discount on all books. ||| We should not discount the possibility of a delay. ||| The store discounts all items by 20% during the sale.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生购买所有书籍可享受10%的折扣。 ||| 我们不应低估延误的可能性。 ||| 促销期间，该店所有商品打八折。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 发现, 被发现的事物
[法] 要求告知, 发现, 发觉
ieltsWords.collocations: make a discovery 做出发现, scientific discovery 科学发现, discovery process 发现过程
ieltsWords.example: The discovery of penicillin revolutionized medicine. ||| Her discovery of the error saved the company millions. ||| The voyage led to the discovery of new lands.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 青霉素的发现彻底改变了医学。 ||| 她发现这个错误为公司节省了数百万。 ||| 这次航行导致了新大陆的发现。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 不符合, 差异, 不相符之处
[化] 不符值; 偏差值
ieltsWords.collocations: discrepancy between ...之间的差异, significant discrepancy 显著差异, resolve a discrepancy 解决差异
ieltsWords.example: There is a discrepancy between the two reports. ||| The accountant noticed a discrepancy in the figures. ||| We need to resolve this discrepancy before proceeding.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两份报告之间存在差异。 ||| 会计注意到数字上的不一致。 ||| 在继续之前，我们需要解决这个矛盾。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 区别, 差别待遇
ieltsWords.collocations: discriminate against 歧视, discriminate between 区分, racial discrimination 种族歧视
ieltsWords.example: It is illegal to discriminate against someone based on their gender. ||| Young children cannot discriminate between right and wrong easily. ||| The law prohibits discrimination in the workplace.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 基于性别歧视他人是违法的。 ||| 幼儿不容易辨别是非。 ||| 法律禁止工作场所的歧视。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 讨论
ieltsWords.collocations: have a discussion 进行讨论, group discussion 小组讨论, under discussion 正在讨论中
ieltsWords.example: We had a lively discussion about climate change. ||| The proposal is still under discussion. ||| Group discussions can help generate new ideas.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们就气候变化进行了热烈的讨论。 ||| 该提案仍在讨论中。 ||| 小组讨论有助于产生新想法。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 蔑视
vt. 蔑视, 鄙弃
ieltsWords.collocations: disdain for 对...的鄙视, treat with disdain 轻蔑对待, express disdain 表示蔑视
ieltsWords.example: He looked at the offer with disdain. ||| She disdains any form of dishonesty. ||| His disdain for modern art is well known.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他轻蔑地看着这个提议。 ||| 她鄙视任何形式的不诚实。 ||| 他对现代艺术的鄙视是众所周知的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 疾病, 弊病
[医] [疾]病
ieltsWords.collocations: infectious disease 传染病, chronic disease 慢性病, disease prevention 疾病预防
ieltsWords.example: Regular exercise can help prevent heart disease. ||| The disease spreads through contaminated water. ||| Advances in medicine have reduced the impact of many diseases.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 定期锻炼有助于预防心脏病。 ||| 这种疾病通过受污染的水传播。 ||| 医学进步减轻了许多疾病的影响。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 假面目, 假装
vt. 假装, 隐瞒
ieltsWords.collocations: in disguise 伪装的, disguise oneself as 把自己伪装成, a blessing in disguise 因祸得福
ieltsWords.example: He disguised himself as a security guard. ||| She made no disguise of her disappointment. ||| The failure turned out to be a blessing in disguise.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他伪装成保安。 ||| 她毫不掩饰自己的失望。 ||| 这次失败结果却是因祸得福。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 厌恶, 嫌恶
vi. 令人厌恶
vt. 使作呕
ieltsWords.collocations: in disgust 厌恶地, feel disgust 感到厌恶, express disgust 表示反感
ieltsWords.example: The smell filled her with disgust. ||| He walked away in disgust. ||| The violence in the movie disgusted many viewers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 那气味让她充满厌恶。 ||| 他厌恶地走开了。 ||| 电影中的暴力使许多观众反感。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 沮丧
vt. 使惊愕, 使气馁
ieltsWords.collocations: to one's dismay 令某人沮丧的是, in dismay 惊慌地, express dismay 表示沮丧
ieltsWords.example: To her dismay, the flight was cancelled. ||| He looked at the results in dismay. ||| The news dismayed the entire community.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 令她沮丧的是，航班取消了。 ||| 他沮丧地看着结果。 ||| 这个消息使整个社区感到惊愕。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 解散, 开除, 解职
vi. 解散
[计] 解散
ieltsWords.collocations: dismiss an idea 摒弃一个想法, dismiss a case 驳回案件, dismiss an employee 解雇员工
ieltsWords.example: The manager dismissed the employee for misconduct. ||| The judge dismissed the case due to lack of evidence. ||| She dismissed his suggestion as impractical.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 经理因行为不端解雇了该员工。 ||| 法官因证据不足驳回了案件。 ||| 她认为他的建议不切实际而不予考虑。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 杂乱, 混乱
vt. 扰乱, 使失调
ieltsWords.collocations: mental disorder 精神障碍, in disorder 混乱地, eating disorder 饮食失调
ieltsWords.example: The room was in complete disorder. ||| He suffers from a rare genetic disorder. ||| Stress can lead to sleep disorders.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 房间一片混乱。 ||| 他患有罕见的遗传性疾病。 ||| 压力会导致睡眠障碍。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 派遣
n. 派遣, 急件
[计] 调度
ieltsWords.collocations: dispatch a message 发送消息, dispatch a team 派遣团队, dispatch quickly 迅速处理
ieltsWords.example: The company dispatched a technician to fix the problem. ||| The goods were dispatched yesterday. ||| He dispatched the task with great efficiency.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司派了一名技术人员来解决问题。 ||| 货物已于昨天发出。 ||| 他非常高效地完成了任务。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 驱散, 驱逐
ieltsWords.collocations: dispel doubts 消除疑虑, dispel fears 驱散恐惧, dispel a myth 破除迷思
ieltsWords.example: The evidence dispelled all doubts about his innocence. ||| A walk in the sun dispelled her gloom. ||| The report dispelled the myth that the project was failing.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 证据消除了对他清白的所有怀疑。 ||| 在阳光下散步驱散了她的忧郁。 ||| 报告破除了项目正在失败的迷思。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 分散, 传播, 散开
vi. 分散
a. 分散的
[计] 分散
ieltsWords.collocations: disperse the crowd 驱散人群, disperse evenly 均匀分散, disperse information 传播信息
ieltsWords.example: The police used tear gas to disperse the protesters. ||| The clouds dispersed after the storm. ||| Seeds are dispersed by wind and animals.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警察使用催泪瓦斯驱散抗议者。 ||| 暴风雨过后云层散开了。 ||| 种子通过风和动物传播。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 移置, 替换, 转移
ieltsWords.collocations: displace workers 取代工人, displace population 迫使人口迁移, be displaced by 被...取代
ieltsWords.example: Automation has displaced many factory workers. ||| The war displaced thousands of families. ||| The new dam displaced the local community.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 自动化取代了许多工厂工人。 ||| 战争迫使成千上万的家庭流离失所。 ||| 新水坝迫使当地社区搬迁。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 丢掉, 处理, 排列, 销毁, 布置
[医] 处理, 处置
ieltsWords.collocations: waste disposal 废物处理, at one's disposal 由某人支配, disposal of assets 资产处置
ieltsWords.example: Proper waste disposal is essential for the environment. ||| I have a car at my disposal for the trip. ||| The company announced the disposal of its subsidiary.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 适当的废物处理对环境至关重要。 ||| 这次旅行我有一辆车可供使用。 ||| 公司宣布出售其子公司。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 处理, 排列, 布置
vi. 处置
ieltsWords.collocations: dispose of 处理掉, dispose waste 处理废物, dispose someone to 使某人倾向于
ieltsWords.example: We need to dispose of this hazardous material safely. ||| His experience disposes him to be cautious. ||| The court disposed of the case quickly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要安全地处理掉这些危险材料。 ||| 他的经历使他倾向于谨慎。 ||| 法院迅速处理了此案。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 性情, 处置, 处理, 布置
[医] 素因, 性情
ieltsWords.collocations: cheerful disposition 开朗的性格, natural disposition 天性, disposition of property 财产处置
ieltsWords.example: She has a cheerful disposition that makes her popular. ||| He showed a disposition to help others. ||| The will outlined the disposition of his estate.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她性格开朗，因此很受欢迎。 ||| 他表现出帮助他人的倾向。 ||| 遗嘱概述了他财产的处置方式。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 争论
v. 争论
ieltsWords.collocations: in dispute 在争论中, settle a dispute 解决争端, dispute a claim 质疑一项主张
ieltsWords.example: The two countries are in a territorial dispute. ||| They disputed the accuracy of the report. ||| The dispute was settled through negotiation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两个国家存在领土争端。 ||| 他们质疑报告的准确性。 ||| 争端通过谈判得以解决。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 忽视, 漠视
vt. 忽视, 不顾
ieltsWords.collocations: disregard for 对…的忽视, disregard safety 忽视安全, disregard rules 无视规则
ieltsWords.example: The driver was fined for his complete disregard of traffic laws. ||| She chose to disregard his rude comments and continued her presentation. ||| Environmentalists criticized the company's disregard for ecological balance.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这名司机因完全无视交通法规而被罚款。 ||| 她选择不理会他的粗鲁评论，继续她的演示。 ||| 环保人士批评该公司对生态平衡的忽视。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 分裂的, 中断的
vt. 使分裂, 使瓦解
ieltsWords.collocations: disrupt traffic 扰乱交通, disrupt communication 中断通信, disrupt the market 扰乱市场
ieltsWords.example: The protest disrupted the city's public transport system for hours. ||| New technology can disrupt traditional industries and create new opportunities. ||| A sudden power outage disrupted the online exam.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 抗议活动扰乱了该市的公共交通系统数小时。 ||| 新技术可以颠覆传统行业并创造新的机遇。 ||| 突然停电中断了在线考试。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 论文
ieltsWords.collocations: write a dissertation 写论文, doctoral dissertation 博士论文, dissertation topic 论文题目
ieltsWords.example: He spent three years researching and writing his doctoral dissertation. ||| Her dissertation on climate change was highly praised by the committee. ||| Choosing a suitable dissertation topic is crucial for academic success.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他花了三年时间研究和撰写博士论文。 ||| 她关于气候变化的论文得到了委员会的高度赞扬。 ||| 选择合适的论文题目对学术成功至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 溶解, 解散
ieltsWords.collocations: dissolve in water 溶于水, dissolve parliament 解散议会, dissolve the partnership 解散合作关系
ieltsWords.example: Salt dissolves easily in water, but oil does not. ||| The company decided to dissolve the joint venture due to financial losses. ||| The medication is designed to dissolve slowly in the stomach.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 盐容易溶于水，但油不会。 ||| 由于财务亏损，公司决定解散合资企业。 ||| 这种药物设计为在胃中缓慢溶解。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 距离, 远方, 遥远
[计] 位距
ieltsWords.collocations: long distance 长距离, keep distance 保持距离, distance learning 远程学习
ieltsWords.example: The distance between the two cities is about 200 kilometers. ||| In the distance, we could see the mountains covered with snow. ||| Online courses have made distance learning more accessible than ever.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两个城市之间的距离大约200公里。 ||| 在远处，我们可以看到白雪覆盖的山脉。 ||| 在线课程使远程学习比以往任何时候都更容易获得。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 远的, 疏远的
[经] 远期的
ieltsWords.collocations: distant relative 远亲, distant future 遥远的未来, distant memory 遥远的记忆
ieltsWords.example: She felt a distant connection to her ancestors through old photographs. ||| The distant sound of thunder warned of an approaching storm. ||| He remained distant and aloof during the meeting, avoiding eye contact.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 通过老照片，她感到与祖先有一种遥远的联系。 ||| 远处的雷声预示着暴风雨的来临。 ||| 他在会议中保持冷淡和疏远，避免眼神接触。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt.vi. 蒸馏, 提取...的精华, 用蒸馏法提取
vi. 滴下, 渗出
ieltsWords.collocations: distil water 蒸馏水, distil knowledge 提炼知识, distil essence 提取精华
ieltsWords.example: The process is used to distil pure alcohol from fermented grains. ||| She managed to distil complex theories into simple, understandable concepts. ||| The company distils essential oils from natural plants for cosmetics.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个过程用于从发酵谷物中蒸馏出纯酒精。 ||| 她成功地将复杂的理论提炼成简单易懂的概念。 ||| 该公司从天然植物中蒸馏精油用于化妆品。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 区别
ieltsWords.collocations: make a distinction 区分, clear distinction 明显区别, academic distinction 学术荣誉
ieltsWords.example: It is important to make a distinction between facts and opinions. ||| She graduated with distinction, earning the highest honors in her class. ||| There is a clear distinction between the two policies in terms of effectiveness.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 区分事实和观点很重要。 ||| 她以优异成绩毕业，获得了班级最高荣誉。 ||| 这两项政策在效果上有明显区别。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 扭曲, 歪曲
[法] 歪区, 曲解, 纂改
ieltsWords.collocations: distort the truth 歪曲事实, distort image 扭曲图像, distort reality 扭曲现实
ieltsWords.example: The media sometimes distorts the truth to attract more viewers. ||| The funhouse mirrors distort your reflection, making you look taller or shorter. ||| His biased report distorted the actual situation of the event.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 媒体有时为了吸引更多观众而歪曲事实。 ||| 哈哈镜扭曲你的倒影，让你看起来更高或更矮。 ||| 他有偏见的报告歪曲了事件的实际情况。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 转移, 分心, 使发狂
ieltsWords.collocations: distract attention 分散注意力, distract from 从…分心, easily distracted 容易分心
ieltsWords.example: Loud noises outside the classroom can distract students from their studies. ||| She tried to distract herself from the pain by watching a movie. ||| Using a phone while driving can distract the driver and cause accidents.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 教室外的噪音会分散学生的学习注意力。 ||| 她试图通过看电影来分散对疼痛的注意力。 ||| 开车时使用手机会分散司机注意力并导致事故。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 娱乐, 分心的事物, 分心
[医] 注意力分散, 内脱位, 牙弓过宽
ieltsWords.collocations: cause distraction 引起分心, major distraction 主要干扰, welcome distraction 受欢迎的消遣
ieltsWords.example: Social media is a major distraction for many employees during work hours. ||| He needed a distraction from the stress of his job, so he took up painting. ||| The constant noise from construction was a constant distraction in the office.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 社交媒体是许多员工工作时间的主要干扰。 ||| 他需要从工作压力中分散注意力，于是开始学画画。 ||| 建筑工地持续的噪音是办公室中持续的分心因素。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 苦恼, 贫困, 痛苦
vt. 使苦恼
a. 亏本出售的
ieltsWords.collocations: in distress 处于困境, emotional distress 情绪困扰, financial distress 财务困难
ieltsWords.example: The charity provides aid to families in financial distress. ||| She was in great distress after losing her job and her home. ||| The ship sent out a distress signal when it began to sink.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该慈善机构为经济困难的家庭提供援助。 ||| 失去工作和家园后，她处于极大的痛苦中。 ||| 船开始下沉时发出了求救信号。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 分配
[计] 分布
ieltsWords.collocations: income distribution 收入分配, distribution network 分销网络, distribution of resources 资源分配
ieltsWords.example: The company has an efficient distribution network that reaches remote areas. ||| Unequal distribution of wealth is a major social issue. ||| The distribution of the new product will begin next month.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司拥有高效的分销网络，覆盖偏远地区。 ||| 财富分配不均是主要的社会问题。 ||| 新产品的分发将于下个月开始。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 扰乱, 妨碍, 使不安
[法] 滋扰, 扰乱
ieltsWords.collocations: disturb the peace 扰乱安宁, disturb sleep 打扰睡眠, disturb balance 打破平衡
ieltsWords.example: Please do not disturb the students while they are taking the exam. ||| The loud music from the party disturbed the neighbors' sleep. ||| Human activities can disturb the natural balance of ecosystems.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生考试时请勿打扰。 ||| 派对上的大声音乐打扰了邻居的睡眠。 ||| 人类活动会破坏生态系统的自然平衡。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 扰乱, 不安, 忧虑
[化] 扰动; 干扰; 失调
ieltsWords.collocations: cause disturbance 引起骚乱, emotional disturbance 情绪障碍, minor disturbance 轻微干扰
ieltsWords.example: The police were called to deal with a disturbance in the street. ||| Any disturbance to the experiment could affect the results. ||| Children with emotional disturbances may need special support at school.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警察被叫来处理街上的骚乱。 ||| 对实验的任何干扰都可能影响结果。 ||| 有情绪障碍的儿童可能需要在学校获得特殊支持。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 转移
[医] 转向
ieltsWords.collocations: traffic diversion 交通绕行, create a diversion 制造转移注意, a pleasant diversion 愉快的消遣
ieltsWords.example: Due to road construction, a diversion was set up for drivers. ||| The thief created a diversion to distract the security guard. ||| Reading is a pleasant diversion from the daily routine.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于道路施工，为司机设置了绕行路线。 ||| 小偷制造了一个转移注意力的举动来分散保安的注意力。 ||| 阅读是日常生活中的一种愉快消遣。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 转移, 使欢娱
vi. 转移
ieltsWords.collocations: divert traffic 疏导交通, divert attention 转移注意力, divert funds 挪用资金
ieltsWords.example: The police diverted traffic away from the accident scene. ||| She tried to divert the conversation to a less sensitive topic. ||| The company was accused of diverting funds for personal use.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警察将车辆从事故现场引开。 ||| 她试图将谈话转向一个不那么敏感的话题。 ||| 该公司被指控挪用资金供个人使用。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 被除数, 股利
[计] 被除数
ieltsWords.collocations: pay dividends 支付股息, stock dividend 股票红利, dividend yield 股息率
ieltsWords.example: The company announced an increase in its annual dividend. ||| Investors expect a steady dividend from blue-chip stocks. ||| Hard work and dedication often pay dividends in the long run.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司宣布增加年度股息。 ||| 投资者期望从蓝筹股中获得稳定的股息。 ||| 努力和奉献从长远来看往往会带来回报。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 神的, 神圣的, 非凡的
n. 神学家
ieltsWords.collocations: divine intervention 神的干预, divine beauty 非凡的美, divine right 神权
ieltsWords.example: Many people believe in divine intervention during times of crisis. ||| The sunset over the ocean was a divine sight. ||| The king claimed to rule by divine right.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多人相信在危机时刻有神的干预。 ||| 海上的日落是绝美的景象。 ||| 国王声称以神权统治。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 离婚
vt. 与...离婚
ieltsWords.collocations: get a divorce 离婚, divorce rate 离婚率, divorce settlement 离婚协议
ieltsWords.example: The divorce rate has increased significantly in recent decades. ||| They decided to get a divorce after years of conflict. ||| The divorce settlement included custody of the children.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 近几十年来离婚率显著上升。 ||| 经过多年的冲突，他们决定离婚。 ||| 离婚协议包括孩子的监护权。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 晕眩的, 眼花缭乱的
vt. 使晕眩
ieltsWords.collocations: feel dizzy 感到头晕, dizzy spell 一阵头晕, dizzy height 令人眩晕的高度
ieltsWords.example: After spinning around, she felt dizzy and had to sit down. ||| The dizzy height of the skyscraper made him nervous. ||| He suffered a dizzy spell and nearly fainted.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 转了几圈后，她感到头晕，不得不坐下。 ||| 摩天大楼令人眩晕的高度让他紧张。 ||| 他一阵头晕，差点晕倒。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 码头, 船坞, 被告席, 尾巴的骨肉部分
vt. 使靠码头, 使(船)进港, 剪短
vi. 进港
ieltsWords.collocations: loading dock 装卸码头, dock worker 码头工人, in the dock 在被告席上
ieltsWords.example: The ship is scheduled to arrive at the dock tomorrow morning. ||| The suspect stood in the dock, awaiting trial. ||| Trucks were backed up to the loading dock for unloading.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这艘船预计明早抵达码头。 ||| 嫌疑人站在被告席上等待审判。 ||| 卡车倒车至装卸码头准备卸货。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 教条, 学说
[医] 学说
ieltsWords.collocations: religious doctrine 宗教教义, political doctrine 政治学说, military doctrine 军事原则
ieltsWords.example: The church's doctrine emphasizes compassion and forgiveness. ||| The Monroe Doctrine was a key U.S. foreign policy. ||| The new military doctrine focuses on rapid response.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该教会的教义强调同情和宽恕。 ||| 门罗主义是美国外交政策的关键。 ||| 新的军事原则侧重于快速反应。

ieltsWords.definition:
v. 避开, 躲避
n. 诡计, 躲藏
ieltsWords.collocations: dodge a question 回避问题, dodge a bullet 躲过子弹, dodge traffic 躲避车辆
ieltsWords.example: He managed to dodge the oncoming car by jumping aside. ||| Politicians often dodge difficult questions during interviews. ||| She dodged the ball just in time.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他跳向一旁，躲过了迎面驶来的汽车。 ||| 政客们在采访中常常回避棘手的问题。 ||| 她及时躲开了球。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 领域, 领土, 产业, 范围
[计] 域, 区域, 支配命令
ieltsWords.collocations: public domain 公共领域, domain name 域名, in the domain of 在…领域
ieltsWords.example: This problem falls within the domain of physics. ||| The company registered a new domain name for its website. ||| The work is now in the public domain and can be freely used.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个问题属于物理学领域。 ||| 该公司为其网站注册了一个新域名。 ||| 该作品现已进入公共领域，可自由使用。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 圆顶
vt. 加圆顶
vi. 成圆顶状
ieltsWords.collocations: dome structure 穹顶结构, geodesic dome 网格穹顶, dome of the sky 天穹
ieltsWords.example: The cathedral's dome is a masterpiece of architecture. ||| The stadium has a retractable dome roof. ||| The observatory is housed under a large dome.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大教堂的圆顶是建筑杰作。 ||| 体育场有一个可伸缩的穹顶。 ||| 天文台设在一个大圆顶下。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 捐赠
ieltsWords.collocations: donate money 捐款, donate blood 献血, donate to charity 捐给慈善机构
ieltsWords.example: Many people donate money to disaster relief funds. ||| He decided to donate his organs after death. ||| The company donated computers to the local school.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多人向救灾基金捐款。 ||| 他决定死后捐献器官。 ||| 该公司向当地学校捐赠了电脑。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 捐赠物, 捐款, 捐赠
[经] 赠品, 捐款, 捐赠
ieltsWords.collocations: make a donation 捐款, charitable donation 慈善捐款, blood donation 献血
ieltsWords.example: She made a generous donation to the hospital. ||| All donations are tax-deductible. ||| The blood donation drive was a great success.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她向医院慷慨捐款。 ||| 所有捐款均可抵税。 ||| 献血活动非常成功。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 厄运, 不幸, 法律, 宣告, 判决, 死亡
vt. 命中注定, 判决
ieltsWords.collocations: face doom 面临厄运, doom and gloom 悲观失望, seal one's doom 注定失败
ieltsWords.example: The prophecy spoke of the kingdom's impending doom. ||| Despite the doom and gloom, the economy recovered. ||| His reckless actions sealed his doom.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 预言提到了王国即将面临的厄运。 ||| 尽管悲观失望，经济还是复苏了。 ||| 他的鲁莽行为注定了他的失败。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 剂量, 服用量
vt. 给药, (用药)医治
vi. 服药
ieltsWords.collocations: daily dose 每日剂量, lethal dose 致死剂量, dose of medicine 一剂药
ieltsWords.example: The doctor prescribed a low dose of the medication. ||| A lethal dose of the poison can kill within minutes. ||| He took his daily dose of vitamins.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 医生开了低剂量的药。 ||| 致死剂量的毒药可在几分钟内致命。 ||| 他服用了每日剂量的维生素。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 可疑的, 疑心的, 不明确的
[法] 怀疑的, 有疑问的, 未确的
ieltsWords.collocations: doubtful about 对…怀疑, doubtful look 怀疑的表情, doubtful outcome 不确定的结果
ieltsWords.example: She was doubtful about the accuracy of the report. ||| The outcome of the negotiations remains doubtful. ||| He gave me a doubtful look when I explained my plan.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她怀疑报告的准确性。 ||| 谈判的结果仍不确定。 ||| 当我解释我的计划时，他投来怀疑的目光。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 无疑的, 确定的
adv. 无疑地, 确定地
ieltsWords.collocations: doubtless will 无疑会, doubtless true 无疑是真的
ieltsWords.example: She will doubtless succeed in her career. ||| The news is doubtless true, as it comes from an official source. ||| He is doubtless the best candidate for the job.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她无疑会在事业上成功。 ||| 这消息无疑是真的，因为它来自官方渠道。 ||| 他无疑是这份工作的最佳人选。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 气流, 草稿, 汇票, 草案
vt. 起草, 征兵
[计] 草稿
ieltsWords.collocations: first draft 初稿, draft plan 草案, draft beer 生啤酒, feel a draft 感到有穿堂风
ieltsWords.example: I need to revise the first draft of my essay. ||| The committee approved the draft plan. ||| He was called up for military draft.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我需要修改我论文的初稿。 ||| 委员会批准了草案。 ||| 他被征召入伍。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 排水沟, 消耗, 排水
vt. 排出, 喝光, 耗尽
vi. 排水, 流干
ieltsWords.collocations: drain water 排水, drain resources 耗尽资源, drain away 流走
ieltsWords.example: The plumber fixed the pipe to drain the water. ||| The long war drained the country's resources. ||| She drained the pasta and added sauce.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 水管工修好了管道以排水。 ||| 长期的战争耗尽了国家的资源。 ||| 她把意大利面沥干，然后加了酱汁。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 排水
[医] 引流[法], 导液[法], 排水[设备]
ieltsWords.collocations: drainage system 排水系统, drainage basin 流域, poor drainage 排水不良
ieltsWords.example: The city's drainage system is outdated. ||| Poor drainage caused flooding in the streets. ||| The Amazon drainage basin is the largest in the world.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座城市的排水系统已经过时。 ||| 排水不良导致街道被淹。 ||| 亚马逊河流域是世界上最大的。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 戏剧, 戏剧艺术
ieltsWords.collocations: TV drama 电视剧, drama series 剧集, drama queen 戏剧女王（指小题大做的人）
ieltsWords.example: She starred in a popular TV drama. ||| The courtroom was full of drama. ||| He studied drama at university.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她主演了一部热门电视剧。 ||| 法庭上充满了戏剧性。 ||| 他在大学学习戏剧。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 戏剧性的, 生动的
ieltsWords.collocations: dramatic change 巨大变化, dramatic effect 戏剧效果, dramatic increase 急剧增长
ieltsWords.example: There has been a dramatic increase in sales this year. ||| The sunset was a dramatic display of colors. ||| Her dramatic entrance caught everyone's attention.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 今年销售额急剧增长。 ||| 日落呈现了引人注目的色彩。 ||| 她戏剧性的出场吸引了所有人的注意。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 激烈的
[医] 峻泻药, 剧烈的
ieltsWords.collocations: drastic measures 严厉措施, drastic change 剧烈变化, drastic reduction 大幅削减
ieltsWords.example: The government took drastic measures to control inflation. ||| There has been a drastic change in the weather. ||| The company announced a drastic reduction in staff.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府采取了严厉措施控制通货膨胀。 ||| 天气发生了剧烈变化。 ||| 公司宣布大幅裁员。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 缺点, 退税
[法] 退款, 退税
ieltsWords.collocations: major drawback 主要缺点, overcome a drawback 克服缺点, have a drawback 有缺点
ieltsWords.example: The main drawback of living in the city is the high cost. ||| One drawback of the plan is its lack of flexibility. ||| We need to overcome this drawback to succeed.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 住在城市的主要缺点是生活成本高。 ||| 该计划的一个缺点是缺乏灵活性。 ||| 我们需要克服这个缺点才能成功。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 恐惧, 可怕的人(或事)
a. 可怕的, 可怖的
v. 恐惧, 害怕
ieltsWords.collocations: dread doing 害怕做, dread the thought 害怕想到, live in dread 生活在恐惧中
ieltsWords.example: I dread going to the dentist. ||| She dreaded the thought of losing her job. ||| Many people live in dread of natural disasters.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我害怕去看牙医。 ||| 她害怕想到失去工作。 ||| 许多人生活在自然灾害的恐惧中。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 可怕的
ieltsWords.collocations: dreadful experience 可怕的经历, dreadful weather 糟糕的天气, dreadful consequences 可怕的后果
ieltsWords.example: The traffic in the city center was dreadful this morning. ||| She had a dreadful headache and couldn't concentrate on her studies. ||| The film received dreadful reviews from critics.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 今天早上市中心的交通糟糕透了。 ||| 她头痛得厉害，无法集中精力学习。 ||| 这部电影遭到了评论家的恶评。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 漂流物, 漂流, 动向
v. (使)漂流
ieltsWords.collocations: drift apart 逐渐疏远, drift into 陷入, continental drift 大陆漂移
ieltsWords.example: The boat began to drift slowly downstream. ||| Many young people drift into cities in search of better opportunities. ||| The general drift of the argument was that education needs reform.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 船开始慢慢向下游漂流。 ||| 许多年轻人涌入城市寻找更好的机会。 ||| 争论的主要大意是教育需要改革。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 钻孔机, 钻子, 播种机, 粗斜纹布
v. 训练, 钻孔
ieltsWords.collocations: drill hole 钻孔, fire drill 消防演习, drill sergeant 训练教官
ieltsWords.example: The workers used a power drill to make holes in the wall. ||| The school conducts a fire drill every month. ||| The teacher drilled the students on grammar rules.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 工人们用电钻在墙上钻孔。 ||| 学校每个月进行一次消防演习。 ||| 老师反复训练学生语法规则。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 干旱, 缺乏
ieltsWords.collocations: severe drought 严重干旱, drought-resistant 抗旱的, drought relief 抗旱救济
ieltsWords.example: The prolonged drought has caused severe water shortages in the region. ||| Farmers are struggling to cope with the effects of the drought. ||| Drought-resistant crops are essential for agriculture in arid areas.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 长期干旱导致该地区严重缺水。 ||| 农民们正在努力应对干旱的影响。 ||| 抗旱作物对于干旱地区的农业至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 淹死
vt. 把...淹死, 淹没
ieltsWords.collocations: drown out 淹没（声音）, drown in 沉浸于, drown one's sorrows 借酒浇愁
ieltsWords.example: The loud music drowned out their conversation. ||| He nearly drowned while swimming in the rough sea. ||| She tried to drown her sorrows in work after the breakup.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 嘈杂的音乐淹没了他们的谈话。 ||| 他在波涛汹涌的海里游泳时差点淹死。 ||| 分手后，她试图用工作来麻痹自己。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 双重的, 双的
n. 双数
ieltsWords.collocations: dual purpose 双重目的, dual nationality 双重国籍, dual role 双重角色
ieltsWords.example: The device has a dual function as a phone and a camera. ||| She holds dual citizenship in Canada and the UK. ||| The professor played a dual role as teacher and researcher.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个设备具有手机和相机的双重功能。 ||| 她拥有加拿大和英国的双重国籍。 ||| 这位教授扮演着教师和研究者的双重角色。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 可疑的, 不确定的
ieltsWords.collocations: dubious about 对…怀疑, dubious reputation 可疑的名声, dubious distinction 可疑的荣誉
ieltsWords.example: I am dubious about the effectiveness of this new policy. ||| The company has a dubious reputation for unethical practices. ||| He has the dubious distinction of being the only student to fail the exam.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我对这项新政策的有效性持怀疑态度。 ||| 这家公司因不道德行为而名声可疑。 ||| 他有着唯一一个考试不及格的学生的可疑荣誉。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 应得的东西, 应付款
a. 到期的, 应得的, 应付的, 约定的
ieltsWords.collocations: due to 由于, due date 到期日, in due course 在适当的时候
ieltsWords.example: The project was delayed due to bad weather. ||| The rent is due on the first of every month. ||| She finally received the recognition that was due to her.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 项目因天气恶劣而延误。 ||| 租金每月一号到期。 ||| 她终于得到了应得的认可。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 哑的, 不说话的, 无声音的
[医] 哑的
ieltsWords.collocations: dumb luck 傻人有傻福, dumb down 降低难度, dumb question 愚蠢的问题
ieltsWords.example: He was struck dumb with astonishment. ||| That was a dumb thing to do. ||| The textbook has been dumbed down for younger students.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他惊讶得说不出话来。 ||| 那是一件蠢事。 ||| 这本教科书为低年级学生降低了难度。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 垃圾场
vt. 倾倒, 倾销
vi. 倒垃圾, 倾销商品
[计] 转出; 转储; 倾卸; 切断电源
ieltsWords.collocations: dump waste 倾倒废物, dump site 垃圾场, dump truck 自卸卡车
ieltsWords.example: Illegal dumping of waste is harmful to the environment. ||| He dumped all his old clothes in the charity bin. ||| The company was accused of dumping cheap goods on the market.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 非法倾倒废物对环境有害。 ||| 他把所有旧衣服都扔进了慈善箱。 ||| 该公司被指控向市场倾销廉价商品。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 副本, 复本, 复制品
a. 复制的, 二重的
vt. 复制, 使加倍
[计] 复制
ieltsWords.collocations: duplicate copy 副本, duplicate key 备用钥匙, duplicate effort 重复劳动
ieltsWords.example: Please make a duplicate of the document for our records. ||| The experiment was duplicated to verify the results. ||| We should avoid duplicating work that has already been done.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请复印一份文件作为我们的记录。 ||| 重复了实验以验证结果。 ||| 我们应该避免重复已经完成的工作。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 持久的, 耐用的
ieltsWords.collocations: durable goods 耐用品, durable material 耐用材料, durable relationship 持久的关系
ieltsWords.example: These shoes are made of durable leather and last for years. ||| The company is known for producing durable household appliances. ||| A durable peace requires mutual understanding and cooperation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这些鞋子由耐用皮革制成，可以穿好几年。 ||| 这家公司以生产耐用的家用电器而闻名。 ||| 持久的和平需要相互理解与合作。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 责任, 关税, 职务, 尊敬
[化] 职责
ieltsWords.collocations: duty-free 免税的, on duty 值班, sense of duty 责任感
ieltsWords.example: It is our duty to protect the environment. ||| The customs officer asked if I had anything to declare for duty. ||| She is on duty tonight at the hospital.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 保护环境是我们的责任。 ||| 海关官员问我是否有东西要申报纳税。 ||| 她今晚在医院值班。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 矮子, 侏儒
v. (使)变矮小
ieltsWords.collocations: dwarf planet 矮行星, dwarf star 矮星, dwarfed by 被…比下去
ieltsWords.example: The new skyscraper dwarfs all the surrounding buildings. ||| Pluto is classified as a dwarf planet. ||| The dwarf trees in the garden are perfect for small spaces.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新的摩天大楼使周围所有建筑相形见绌。 ||| 冥王星被归类为矮行星。 ||| 花园里的矮树非常适合小空间。

ieltsWords.definition: vi. 居住, 居住(于), 存在(于)
ieltsWords.collocations: dwell on 细想；详述, dwell in 居住在, dwell upon 深思
ieltsWords.example: They dwell in a small village in the mountains. ||| Don't dwell on past mistakes; focus on the future. ||| The speaker dwelled upon the importance of education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们居住在山中的一个小村庄里。 ||| 不要沉湎于过去的错误，要着眼于未来。 ||| 演讲者详细阐述了教育的重要性。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 减少, 缩小, 衰落
vt. 使缩小
ieltsWords.collocations: dwindle away 逐渐减少, dwindle to 减少到, dwindle in number 数量减少
ieltsWords.example: The population of the village has dwindled to just a few hundred. ||| As the resources dwindled, the team had to work harder. ||| His savings dwindled away after he lost his job.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个村庄的人口已减少到只有几百人。 ||| 随着资源减少，团队不得不更加努力。 ||| 他失业后积蓄逐渐耗尽。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 安乐, 安逸, 悠闲
vt. 使安乐, 使安心, 减轻, 放松
vi. 减轻, 放松, 灵活地移动
ieltsWords.collocations: with ease 轻松地, at ease 自在, ease off 减轻
ieltsWords.example: She passed the exam with ease. ||| The medicine helped ease his pain. ||| He felt completely at ease during the interview.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她轻松地通过了考试。 ||| 药物帮助减轻了他的疼痛。 ||| 面试时他感到完全自在。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 东方人, 东正教徒
a. 东方的, 向东的, 自东的
ieltsWords.collocations: eastern culture 东方文化, eastern Europe 东欧, eastern coast 东海岸
ieltsWords.example: Eastern philosophy emphasizes harmony with nature. ||| The eastern part of the country is more developed. ||| They traveled along the eastern coast of Australia.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 东方哲学强调与自然的和谐。 ||| 该国东部地区更为发达。 ||| 他们沿着澳大利亚东海岸旅行。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 怪人, 偏心圆
a. 古怪的, 反常的, 不同圆心的
ieltsWords.collocations: eccentric behavior 古怪行为, eccentric person 古怪的人, eccentric orbit 偏心轨道
ieltsWords.example: The old man was known for his eccentric habits. ||| She has an eccentric taste in clothing. ||| The planet follows an eccentric orbit around the star.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位老人以古怪的习惯闻名。 ||| 她在衣着方面有古怪的品味。 ||| 这颗行星沿着偏心轨道绕恒星运行。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 回声, 回音, 回波
vi. 发回声, 随声附和
vt. 摹仿, 重复, 反射
[计] 回显; DOS批处理命令:控制MS-DOS命令是否在屏幕上显示
ieltsWords.collocations: echo chamber 回音室, echo back 回响, echo with 回荡着
ieltsWords.example: The sound of footsteps echoed through the empty hall. ||| His speech echoed the sentiments of many people. ||| The canyon echoed with the sound of the waterfall.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 脚步声在空旷的大厅里回响。 ||| 他的演讲附和了许多人的情感。 ||| 峡谷里回荡着瀑布的声音。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 日食, 月食, (地位名誉等的)消失
vt. 引起日食, 引起月食, 使黯然失色
ieltsWords.collocations: solar eclipse 日食, lunar eclipse 月食, total eclipse 全食
ieltsWords.example: A solar eclipse occurs when the moon passes between the sun and the earth. ||| The team's success was an eclipse of their previous achievements. ||| Ancient civilizations often interpreted eclipses as omens.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 当月球经过太阳和地球之间时，就会发生日食。 ||| 该队的成功使他们之前的成就黯然失色。 ||| 古代文明常将日食解释为预兆。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 生态学, 社会生态学
[化] 生态学
ieltsWords.collocations: ecology system 生态系统, human ecology 人类生态学, ecology balance 生态平衡
ieltsWords.example: The study of ecology helps us understand the relationships between organisms and their environment. ||| Deforestation has a devastating impact on the local ecology. ||| Ecology is a key subject in environmental science courses.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 生态学研究帮助我们理解生物与其环境之间的关系。 ||| 森林砍伐对当地生态造成了毁灭性影响。 ||| 生态学是环境科学课程中的关键学科。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 经济上的, 实用的, 节省的
[经] 经济的
ieltsWords.collocations: economic growth 经济增长, economic policy 经济政策, economic development 经济发展
ieltsWords.example: The government implemented new economic policies to stimulate growth. ||| Economic inequality is a major issue in many countries. ||| The economic downturn led to widespread unemployment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府实施了新的经济政策以刺激增长。 ||| 经济不平等是许多国家的一个主要问题。 ||| 经济衰退导致了广泛的失业。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 节俭的, 经济的, 合算的
[经] 经济的, 节约的
ieltsWords.collocations: economical car 经济型汽车, economical way 节约的方式, be economical with 节省
ieltsWords.example: Buying in bulk is often more economical than purchasing small quantities. ||| This car is very economical on fuel. ||| She is economical with her time and never wastes a moment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 批量购买通常比少量购买更经济。 ||| 这辆车非常省油。 ||| 她很节约时间，从不浪费一刻。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 经济学
[经] 经济学
ieltsWords.collocations: study economics 学习经济学, economics professor 经济学教授, macroeconomics 宏观经济学
ieltsWords.example: He decided to major in economics at university. ||| The economics of the project need to be carefully evaluated. ||| Keynesian economics has influenced many government policies.
