ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他决定在大学主修经济学。 ||| 这个项目的经济因素需要仔细评估。 ||| 凯恩斯经济学影响了许多政府政策。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 边缘, 尖锐, 刀刃, 优势
vt. 使锐利, 挤进, 镶边
vi. 缓缓移动
ieltsWords.collocations: competitive edge 竞争优势, on the edge 在边缘, cutting edge 前沿
ieltsWords.example: The company has a competitive edge in the market due to its innovative products. ||| He stood at the edge of the cliff, looking out at the sea. ||| The knife has a sharp edge.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家公司因其创新产品在市场上具有竞争优势。 ||| 他站在悬崖边缘，眺望大海。 ||| 这把刀刀刃锋利。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 食品, 食物
a. 可食用的
ieltsWords.collocations: edible mushrooms 食用蘑菇, edible oil 食用油, edible plants 可食用植物
ieltsWords.example: Not all mushrooms are edible; some are poisonous. ||| The label indicates that the product is edible. ||| Edible flowers are often used to garnish salads.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 并非所有蘑菇都可食用，有些是有毒的。 ||| 标签显示该产品是可食用的。 ||| 可食用花卉常用于装饰沙拉。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 编辑, 编校, 修订, 剪辑
[计] 编辑; DOS外部命令:该命令是一个用于编辑文本文件的全屏幕编辑程序
ieltsWords.collocations: edit a document 编辑文档, edit a video 剪辑视频, edit out 删掉
ieltsWords.example: She spent hours editing her essay to make it perfect. ||| The film was edited to remove controversial scenes. ||| He edits the school newspaper every week.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她花了几个小时编辑她的文章，使其完美。 ||| 这部电影经过剪辑，删除了有争议的场景。 ||| 他每周编辑校报。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 版本, 版, 翻版
ieltsWords.collocations: first edition 第一版, limited edition 限量版, special edition 特别版
ieltsWords.example: The first edition of the book sold out within a week. ||| This is a limited edition print, signed by the artist. ||| The new edition includes updated information.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这本书的第一版在一周内售罄。 ||| 这是一幅限量版印刷品，由艺术家签名。 ||| 新版包含了更新的信息。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 编者, 编辑, 主笔, 编辑器, 编辑装置
[计] 编辑器
ieltsWords.collocations: editor in chief 主编, news editor 新闻编辑, text editor 文本编辑器
ieltsWords.example: The editor corrected several errors in the manuscript. ||| She works as a fashion editor for a magazine. ||| The editor in chief approved the final draft.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 编辑纠正了手稿中的几个错误。 ||| 她在一家杂志社担任时尚编辑。 ||| 主编批准了最终稿。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 社论, 评论
a. 编辑的, 主笔的, 社论的
ieltsWords.collocations: editorial board 编辑委员会, editorial policy 编辑政策, editorial comment 社论评论
ieltsWords.example: The newspaper's editorial policy is to remain impartial. ||| She wrote an editorial about climate change. ||| The editorial team meets every morning to discuss the day's stories.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家报纸的编辑政策是保持公正。 ||| 她写了一篇关于气候变化的社论。 ||| 编辑团队每天早上开会讨论当天的报道。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 教育, 训练, 教育学
[医] 教育, 训练
ieltsWords.collocations: higher education 高等教育, compulsory education 义务教育, education system 教育体系
ieltsWords.example: Access to quality education is a fundamental right. ||| She has a degree in education from a prestigious university. ||| The government is investing more in early childhood education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 获得优质教育是一项基本权利。 ||| 她拥有著名大学的教育学学位。 ||| 政府正在加大对幼儿教育的投入。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 教育的, 教育性的
ieltsWords.collocations: educational institution 教育机构, educational program 教育项目, educational experience 教育经历
ieltsWords.example: The museum offers many educational programs for children. ||| Watching documentaries can be both entertaining and educational. ||| She works in an educational institution as a teacher.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 博物馆为儿童提供许多教育项目。 ||| 观看纪录片既有趣又有教育意义。 ||| 她在一所教育机构担任教师。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 结果, 影响, 效果, 印象
vt. 实行, 引起, 完成
[计] 效果
ieltsWords.collocations: side effect 副作用, cause and effect 因果, have an effect on 对……有影响
ieltsWords.example: The new law had a positive effect on the economy. ||| Some medications have unpleasant side effects. ||| The effect of the speech was immediate and powerful.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新法律对经济产生了积极影响。 ||| 有些药物有令人不快的副作用。 ||| 演讲的效果立竿见影且强大。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 有效的, 有力的, 实际的
n. 有生力量
ieltsWords.collocations: effective method 有效方法, effective communication 有效沟通, effective date 生效日期
ieltsWords.example: This is an effective way to reduce stress. ||| The new policy will become effective next month. ||| Effective communication is key to a successful team.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这是一种减轻压力的有效方法。 ||| 新政策将于下个月生效。 ||| 有效沟通是团队成功的关键。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 有效率的, 能干的
ieltsWords.collocations: efficient system 高效系统, energy efficient 节能的, cost efficient 成本效益高的
ieltsWords.example: The new machine is more efficient than the old one. ||| She is an efficient worker who always meets deadlines. ||| Energy-efficient appliances help reduce electricity bills.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新机器比旧机器效率更高。 ||| 她是一名高效的员工，总能按时完成任务。 ||| 节能电器有助于减少电费。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 逐放, 放逐, 喷射
[化] 排出
ieltsWords.collocations: eject from 从……弹出, eject a disc 弹出光盘, eject a passenger 驱逐乘客
ieltsWords.example: The pilot ejected from the plane just before it crashed. ||| The DVD player will eject the disc automatically. ||| The security guard ejected the troublemaker from the building.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 飞行员在飞机坠毁前弹射出来。 ||| DVD播放器会自动弹出光盘。 ||| 保安将闹事者逐出了大楼。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 精细的, 详尽的, 精心计划(或制作)的
vt. 详细地说明, 用心地制作, 发挥
vi. 变复杂, 作详细说明
ieltsWords.collocations: elaborate plan 精心策划, elaborate design 精心设计, elaborate explanation 详尽解释
ieltsWords.example: The architect presented an elaborate design for the new building. ||| She gave an elaborate explanation of the scientific process. ||| The party decorations were elaborate and beautiful.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 建筑师为新建筑展示了一个精心设计。 ||| 她对科学过程做了详尽解释。 ||| 派对装饰精致而美丽。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 松紧带, 橡皮筋
a. 有弹性的, 能伸缩的, 可通融的
ieltsWords.collocations: elastic band 橡皮筋, elastic material 弹性材料, elastic demand 弹性需求
ieltsWords.example: The waistband is made of elastic material for comfort. ||| The demand for luxury goods is more elastic than for necessities. ||| She used an elastic band to hold the papers together.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 腰带由弹性材料制成，穿着舒适。 ||| 奢侈品的需求比必需品更具弹性。 ||| 她用橡皮筋把文件绑在一起。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 手肘, 弯头, 扶手
v. 用手肘推开, 推挤
ieltsWords.collocations: elbow joint 肘关节, elbow room 活动空间, tennis elbow 网球肘
ieltsWords.example: He rested his elbows on the table. ||| The bus was so crowded that there was no elbow room. ||| She injured her elbow while playing tennis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他把肘部放在桌子上。 ||| 公交车太挤了，没有活动空间。 ||| 她打网球时伤了肘部。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 过了中年的, 稍老的
ieltsWords.collocations: elderly people 老年人, elderly care 老年护理, elderly population 老年人口
ieltsWords.example: The government provides subsidies for elderly care. ||| An increasing number of elderly people live alone. ||| The elderly population is growing rapidly in many countries.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府为老年护理提供补贴。 ||| 越来越多的老年人独居。 ||| 许多国家的老年人口正在快速增长。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 电的, 有关电的
[医] 电的
ieltsWords.collocations: electrical equipment 电气设备, electrical engineering 电气工程, electrical system 电气系统
ieltsWords.example: All electrical equipment must be checked regularly. ||| He studied electrical engineering at university. ||| The electrical system in the building needs an upgrade.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 所有电气设备必须定期检查。 ||| 他在大学学习电气工程。 ||| 大楼的电气系统需要升级。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 电学家, 电气技师, 电工
[化] 电工; 电气工人
ieltsWords.collocations: call an electrician 叫电工, qualified electrician 合格电工, work as an electrician 做电工
ieltsWords.example: We need to call an electrician to fix the wiring. ||| A qualified electrician should handle all repairs. ||| He works as an electrician for a construction company.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要叫电工来修理线路。 ||| 所有维修应由合格电工处理。 ||| 他在一家建筑公司做电工。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 电, 电流, 电学, 热情, 电力供应
[化] 电学; 电
ieltsWords.collocations: electricity supply 电力供应, generate electricity 发电, electricity bill 电费
ieltsWords.example: The electricity supply was cut off during the storm. ||| Solar panels are used to generate electricity. ||| The electricity bill has increased significantly this month.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 暴风雨期间电力供应被切断。 ||| 太阳能电池板用于发电。 ||| 这个月的电费大幅上涨。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 电子的
[计] 电子工业协会接口
ieltsWords.collocations: electronic device 电子设备, electronic commerce 电子商务, electronic payment 电子支付
ieltsWords.example: Electronic devices should be recycled properly. ||| Electronic commerce has transformed the retail industry. ||| Many people prefer electronic payment over cash.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 电子设备应妥善回收。 ||| 电子商务改变了零售业。 ||| 许多人更喜欢电子支付而非现金。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 电子学
[计] 电子学
ieltsWords.collocations: consumer electronics 消费电子产品, electronics industry 电子工业, electronics engineer 电子工程师
ieltsWords.example: The consumer electronics market is highly competitive. ||| She works in the electronics industry as a designer. ||| He is an electronics engineer specializing in circuit design.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 消费电子产品市场竞争激烈。 ||| 她在电子工业担任设计师。 ||| 他是一名专攻电路设计的电子工程师。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 优雅的, 端庄的, 高雅的
ieltsWords.collocations: elegant design 优雅设计, elegant solution 优雅解决方案, elegant appearance 优雅外观
ieltsWords.example: The building has an elegant design that attracts many visitors. ||| She proposed an elegant solution to the complex problem. ||| The dress has an elegant appearance suitable for formal occasions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座建筑有优雅的设计，吸引了许多游客。 ||| 她提出了一个优雅的解决方案来解决这个复杂问题。 ||| 这件连衣裙外观优雅，适合正式场合。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 初步的, 基本的
[医] 元素的, 基础的, 初级的
ieltsWords.collocations: elementary school 小学, elementary education 初等教育, elementary level 初级水平
ieltsWords.example: Children start elementary school at age six. ||| Elementary education is compulsory in most countries. ||| This course is designed for students at an elementary level.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 孩子们六岁开始上小学。 ||| 大多数国家实行初等义务教育。 ||| 这门课程是为初级水平的学生设计的。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 举起, 提拔, 鼓舞
ieltsWords.collocations: elevate the status 提升地位, elevate the level 提高水平, elevate the quality 提高质量
ieltsWords.example: The new policy aims to elevate the status of teachers. ||| Regular training can elevate the level of employee performance. ||| We need to elevate the quality of our products to compete globally.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新政策旨在提升教师的地位。 ||| 定期培训可以提高员工的表现水平。 ||| 我们需要提高产品质量以在全球竞争。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 电梯, 升降机
[化] 提升机
ieltsWords.collocations: take the elevator 乘电梯, elevator shaft 电梯井, elevator attendant 电梯服务员
ieltsWords.example: Please take the elevator to the 10th floor. ||| The elevator shaft is under maintenance. ||| In some old buildings, there is still an elevator attendant.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请乘电梯到10楼。 ||| 电梯井正在维修。 ||| 在一些老建筑里，仍有电梯服务员。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 引出, 推导出, 引起
ieltsWords.collocations: elicit a response 引出回应, elicit information 获取信息, elicit support 获得支持
ieltsWords.example: The teacher's question elicited a thoughtful response from the student. ||| The survey was designed to elicit information about consumer preferences. ||| The charity event elicited widespread support from the community.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师的问题引出了学生深思熟虑的回答。 ||| 这项调查旨在获取关于消费者偏好的信息。 ||| 这次慈善活动获得了社区的广泛支持。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 有资格当选的, 合格的
n. 有资格者, 合格者, 适任者
ieltsWords.collocations: eligible for 有资格获得, eligible candidate 合格候选人, eligible voter 合格选民
ieltsWords.example: Only citizens over 18 are eligible to vote. ||| She is an eligible candidate for the scholarship. ||| You are eligible for a refund if the product is defective.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 只有18岁以上的公民才有资格投票。 ||| 她是奖学金的合格候选人。 ||| 如果产品有缺陷，你有资格获得退款。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 精华, 精锐, 中坚分子
ieltsWords.collocations: elite group 精英群体, elite university 精英大学, political elite 政治精英
ieltsWords.example: The elite group controls most of the country's wealth. ||| He attended an elite university in the United States. ||| The political elite often make decisions that affect the entire population.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个精英群体控制着国家的大部分财富。 ||| 他上了一所美国的精英大学。 ||| 政治精英经常做出影响全体人口的决定。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 雄辩的, 有口才的, 有说服力的
ieltsWords.collocations: eloquent speech 雄辩的演讲, eloquent speaker 有口才的演讲者, eloquent expression 清晰的表达
ieltsWords.example: The politician delivered an eloquent speech that moved the audience. ||| She is an eloquent speaker who can persuade anyone. ||| His eloquent expression of the idea made it easy to understand.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位政治家发表了雄辩的演讲，感动了观众。 ||| 她是一位有口才的演讲者，能说服任何人。 ||| 他对这个想法的清晰表达使其易于理解。

ieltsWords.definition: adv. 在别处
ieltsWords.collocations: go elsewhere 去别处, find elsewhere 在别处找到, look elsewhere 在别处寻找
ieltsWords.example: If you can't find what you need here, try looking elsewhere. ||| The data is stored elsewhere in the system. ||| Many young people move elsewhere for better job opportunities.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 如果你在这里找不到所需的东西，试试去别处找。 ||| 数据存储在系统的别处。 ||| 许多年轻人搬到别处寻找更好的工作机会。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 电子信函
ieltsWords.collocations: send an email 发送电子邮件, email address 电子邮件地址, check email 查收电子邮件
ieltsWords.example: Please send me an email with the details. ||| What is your email address? ||| I check my email every morning.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请给我发一封包含详细信息的电子邮件。 ||| 你的电子邮件地址是什么？ ||| 我每天早上查收电子邮件。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 封港令, 禁运
vt. 禁止出入港口, 禁运
ieltsWords.collocations: trade embargo 贸易禁运, impose an embargo 实施禁运, lift an embargo 解除禁运
ieltsWords.example: The country imposed a trade embargo on its neighbor. ||| The embargo was lifted after negotiations. ||| The trade embargo affected the economy severely.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该国对其邻国实施了贸易禁运。 ||| 经过谈判，禁运被解除。 ||| 贸易禁运严重影响了经济。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 乘船, 着手, 从事, 上飞机
vt. 使上船, 使上飞机, 使从事
ieltsWords.collocations: embark on 开始, embark upon 着手, embark on a journey 开始旅程
ieltsWords.example: The company will embark on a new project next month. ||| They embarked upon a journey across the continent. ||| She decided to embark on a career in medicine.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司下个月将开始一个新项目。 ||| 他们开始了穿越大陆的旅程。 ||| 她决定开始从事医学事业。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 使困窘, 使局促不安, 阻碍
ieltsWords.collocations: embarrass someone 使某人尴尬, feel embarrassed 感到尴尬, embarrassing situation 尴尬的局面
ieltsWords.example: His mistake embarrassed him in front of the whole class. ||| She felt embarrassed when she forgot the speech. ||| It was an embarrassing situation for everyone involved.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他的错误使他在全班面前尴尬。 ||| 她忘记演讲时感到尴尬。 ||| 对每个参与者来说，这都是一个尴尬的局面。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 大使馆, 大使馆全体人员
[经] 大使馆
ieltsWords.collocations: embassy staff 大使馆工作人员, embassy building 大使馆建筑, contact the embassy 联系大使馆
ieltsWords.example: The embassy staff helped the citizens during the crisis. ||| The embassy building is located in the city center. ||| If you lose your passport, contact the embassy immediately.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大使馆工作人员在危机期间帮助了公民。 ||| 大使馆建筑位于市中心。 ||| 如果你丢失了护照，请立即联系大使馆。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使插入, 使嵌入, 使深留脑中
[计] 嵌入
ieltsWords.collocations: embed in 嵌入在, deeply embedded 根深蒂固的, embed a chip 嵌入芯片
ieltsWords.example: The journalist embedded herself in the community to report on local issues. ||| These values are deeply embedded in our culture. ||| The software allows you to embed videos in your presentation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 记者深入社区报道当地问题。 ||| 这些价值观深深植根于我们的文化中。 ||| 该软件允许你在演示文稿中嵌入视频。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 具体表达, 使具体化
[经] 合并, 具体化, 具体表现
ieltsWords.collocations: embody the spirit 体现精神, embody principles 体现原则, embody a vision 体现愿景
ieltsWords.example: The new law embodies the government's commitment to environmental protection. ||| She embodies all the qualities of a great leader. ||| The sculpture embodies the artist's emotions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新法律体现了政府对环境保护的承诺。 ||| 她体现了伟大领袖的所有品质。 ||| 这座雕塑体现了艺术家的情感。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 拥抱
vt. 拥抱, 互相拥抱, 包含, 收买
vi. 拥抱
ieltsWords.collocations: embrace change 拥抱变化, embrace diversity 接受多样性, embrace an opportunity 抓住机会
ieltsWords.example: Many companies now embrace remote work as a permanent option. ||| The community embraced the new policy with enthusiasm. ||| His speech embraced a wide range of topics.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多公司现在将远程工作作为永久选择。 ||| 社区热情地接受了新政策。 ||| 他的演讲涵盖了广泛的话题。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 紧急状况, 紧急事件, 紧急需要
[化] 紧急情况
ieltsWords.collocations: emergency room 急诊室, emergency plan 应急预案, state of emergency 紧急状态
ieltsWords.example: In case of emergency, break the glass. ||| The government declared a state of emergency after the earthquake. ||| She was rushed to the emergency room with severe injuries.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 紧急情况下，打碎玻璃。 ||| 地震后政府宣布进入紧急状态。 ||| 她因重伤被紧急送往急诊室。

ieltsWords.definition: v. (使)移居, (使)移民
ieltsWords.collocations: emigrate to 移居到, emigrate from 从…移出, emigrate for economic reasons 因经济原因移民
ieltsWords.example: Many people emigrated to Australia in search of a better life. ||| He emigrated from Ireland during the famine. ||| The decision to emigrate is often difficult.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多人移居澳大利亚寻求更好的生活。 ||| 他在饥荒期间从爱尔兰移居国外。 ||| 移居国外的决定往往很艰难。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 显赫的, 杰出的, 有名的
ieltsWords.collocations: eminent scholar 著名学者, eminent domain 征用权, eminent scientist 杰出科学家
ieltsWords.example: The conference was attended by several eminent professors. ||| She is an eminent figure in the field of medicine. ||| The government used eminent domain to acquire the land.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 几位著名教授出席了会议。 ||| 她是医学界的杰出人物。 ||| 政府利用征用权获得了这块土地。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 发出, 放射, 发表(意见等), 散发, 发行
[化] 放射
ieltsWords.collocations: emit light 发光, emit carbon dioxide 排放二氧化碳, emit a sound 发出声音
ieltsWords.example: The factory emits large amounts of smoke into the air. ||| The sun emits both light and heat. ||| The device emits a low-frequency hum.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 工厂向空气中排放大量烟雾。 ||| 太阳发出光和热。 ||| 该设备发出低频嗡嗡声。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 情绪, 激动, 强烈的情感
[医] 情绪, 情感
ieltsWords.collocations: strong emotion 强烈情感, express emotion 表达情感, control emotions 控制情绪
ieltsWords.example: She could not hide her emotions when she heard the news. ||| Music can evoke a wide range of emotions. ||| It is important to manage your emotions in stressful situations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 听到这个消息时，她无法掩饰自己的情绪。 ||| 音乐能唤起各种情感。 ||| 在压力大的情况下管理好自己的情绪很重要。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 皇帝, 君主
ieltsWords.collocations: Roman emperor 罗马皇帝, emperor penguin 帝企鹅, emperor's palace 皇宫
ieltsWords.example: The emperor ruled the vast empire for decades. ||| Emperor penguins are the largest of all penguin species. ||| The emperor's decree was obeyed throughout the land.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位皇帝统治了庞大的帝国数十年。 ||| 帝企鹅是所有企鹅中体型最大的。 ||| 皇帝的诏令在全国得到遵守。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 强调, 加强语气, 着重
ieltsWords.collocations: emphasize the importance 强调重要性, emphasize a point 强调一点, emphasize the need 强调需求
ieltsWords.example: The teacher emphasized the importance of regular practice. ||| He emphasized that everyone must follow the rules. ||| The report emphasizes the need for immediate action.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师强调了定期练习的重要性。 ||| 他强调每个人都必须遵守规则。 ||| 报告强调了立即采取行动的必要性。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 完全跟据经验的, 经验主义的
[医] 经验主义的
ieltsWords.collocations: empirical evidence 经验证据, empirical research 实证研究, empirical data 经验数据
ieltsWords.example: The theory is supported by strong empirical evidence. ||| Empirical research is essential for scientific progress. ||| They collected empirical data from hundreds of participants.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该理论得到了强有力的经验证据支持。 ||| 实证研究对科学进步至关重要。 ||| 他们从数百名参与者那里收集了经验数据。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 职员, 员工, 受雇人员
[化] 职工; 雇员
ieltsWords.collocations: full-time employee 全职员工, employee benefits 员工福利, employee satisfaction 员工满意度
ieltsWords.example: The company has over 500 employees. ||| Employee benefits include health insurance and paid leave. ||| A happy employee is more productive.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司有500多名员工。 ||| 员工福利包括健康保险和带薪休假。 ||| 快乐的员工工作效率更高。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 雇主, 老板
[经] 雇主, 业主
ieltsWords.collocations: employer brand 雇主品牌, employer liability 雇主责任, employer contribution 雇主缴款
ieltsWords.example: The employer is responsible for providing a safe workplace. ||| Many employers offer flexible working hours. ||| The employer-employee relationship is based on mutual trust.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 雇主有责任提供安全的工作场所。 ||| 许多雇主提供弹性工作时间。 ||| 雇主与雇员的关系建立在相互信任的基础上。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 雇用, 职业, 工作
[经] 职业, 雇用, 职工招请
ieltsWords.collocations: full employment 充分就业, employment rate 就业率, employment contract 雇佣合同
ieltsWords.example: The government aims to achieve full employment. ||| She found employment as a software engineer. ||| The employment rate has risen steadily over the past year.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府的目标是实现充分就业。 ||| 她找到了一份软件工程师的工作。 ||| 过去一年就业率稳步上升。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 空的, 空虚的, 空腹的, 空洞的
n. 空的东西, 空车
vt. 倒空, 使变空, 使排出
vi. 流空
[计] 空
ieltsWords.collocations: empty space 空空间, empty promise 空头承诺, empty stomach 空腹
ieltsWords.example: The room was completely empty. ||| He made empty promises that he never kept. ||| It is not good to exercise on an empty stomach.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 房间完全是空的。 ||| 他做出了从未兑现的空头承诺。 ||| 空腹锻炼不好。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 围绕, 圈起, 放入封套, 附上
ieltsWords.collocations: enclose with 随信附上, enclosed area 封闭区域, enclose a garden 围住花园
ieltsWords.example: Please enclose a copy of your ID with the application. ||| The garden is enclosed by a high wall. ||| I enclose a cheque for the full amount.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请随申请附上身份证复印件。 ||| 花园被高墙围住。 ||| 我附上一张全额支票。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 附件, 围墙, 围绕
[化] 机壳; 外壳
ieltsWords.collocations: enclosure movement 圈地运动, enclosure wall 围墙, enclosure for animals 动物围场
ieltsWords.example: The enclosure movement changed the landscape of rural England. ||| Please find the document in the enclosure. ||| The zoo has a large enclosure for the elephants.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 圈地运动改变了英国乡村的面貌。 ||| 请查收附件中的文件。 ||| 动物园有一个大象的大围场。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 百科全书
ieltsWords.collocations: online encyclopedia 在线百科全书, encyclopedia entry 百科全书条目, encyclopedia of science 科学百科全书
ieltsWords.example: Wikipedia is the most popular online encyclopedia. ||| He consulted an encyclopedia to find the answer. ||| The encyclopedia contains thousands of articles.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 维基百科是最受欢迎的在线百科全书。 ||| 他查阅百科全书寻找答案。 ||| 这本百科全书包含数千篇文章。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 支持, 赞同, 背书于, 签署
[经] 赞成, 背书
ieltsWords.collocations: endorse a candidate 支持候选人, endorse a product 代言产品, endorse a policy 支持政策
ieltsWords.example: The committee endorsed the proposal unanimously. ||| Many celebrities endorse beauty products on social media. ||| The president endorsed the new trade agreement.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 委员会一致赞同该提案。 ||| 许多名人在社交媒体上代言美容产品。 ||| 总统支持新的贸易协定。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 捐赠, 捐助, 赋予
[法] 赠送财产给, 分给寡妇一份遗产, 授与
ieltsWords.collocations: endow with 赋予, endow a scholarship 捐赠奖学金, endow a university 资助大学
ieltsWords.example: She was endowed with great musical talent. ||| The billionaire endowed a new research center at the university. ||| The foundation endows scholarships for underprivileged students.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她天生具有音乐天赋。 ||| 这位亿万富翁在大学捐赠了一个新的研究中心。 ||| 该基金会为贫困学生提供奖学金。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 忍耐, 忍耐力, 耐性
[机] 持九性
ieltsWords.collocations: physical endurance 身体耐力, mental endurance 心理耐力, endurance test 耐力测试
ieltsWords.example: Marathon runners need incredible physical endurance to complete the race. ||| The project was a test of mental endurance for the entire team. ||| The car's endurance is proven by its ability to run for thousands of miles without major repairs.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 马拉松运动员需要惊人的身体耐力才能完成比赛。 ||| 这个项目对整个团队来说是一次心理耐力的考验。 ||| 这辆车的耐久性通过其能够行驶数千英里而无需大修得到证明。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 强迫, 执行, 坚持
[经] 予以强制执行
ieltsWords.collocations: enforce the law 执法, enforce rules 执行规则, enforce a policy 实施政策
ieltsWords.example: The police are responsible for enforcing the law in the city. ||| Schools must enforce strict rules to maintain discipline. ||| The government decided to enforce a new policy on carbon emissions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警察负责在城市中执法。 ||| 学校必须执行严格的规则以维持纪律。 ||| 政府决定实施一项关于碳排放的新政策。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 诺言, 约会, 婚约, 交战
[医] 衔接
ieltsWords.collocations: engagement ring 订婚戒指, public engagement 公众参与, military engagement 军事交战
ieltsWords.example: She showed off her beautiful engagement ring to her friends. ||| The company focuses on customer engagement through social media. ||| The two armies prepared for a major engagement at dawn.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她向朋友们展示了她美丽的订婚戒指。 ||| 该公司通过社交媒体专注于客户参与。 ||| 两支军队准备在黎明时分进行一场大规模交战。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 引擎, 发动机, 机车
vt. 安装发动机于
ieltsWords.collocations: car engine 汽车发动机, search engine 搜索引擎, steam engine 蒸汽机
ieltsWords.example: The car's engine started making a strange noise. ||| Google is the most popular search engine in the world. ||| The invention of the steam engine revolutionized transportation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 汽车的发动机开始发出奇怪的声音。 ||| 谷歌是世界上最受欢迎的搜索引擎。 ||| 蒸汽机的发明彻底改变了交通运输。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 工程师, 工兵
vt. 设计, 监造, 精明地处理, 策划
ieltsWords.collocations: civil engineer 土木工程师, software engineer 软件工程师, mechanical engineer 机械工程师
ieltsWords.example: My brother works as a software engineer for a tech company. ||| The civil engineer designed the new bridge over the river. ||| Mechanical engineers often work on improving manufacturing processes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我哥哥在一家科技公司做软件工程师。 ||| 土木工程师设计了河上的新桥。 ||| 机械工程师通常致力于改进制造工艺。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 工程学, 工程, 操纵
[化] 机器; 机器学
ieltsWords.collocations: civil engineering 土木工程, mechanical engineering 机械工程, electrical engineering 电气工程
ieltsWords.example: She decided to study civil engineering at university. ||| Mechanical engineering involves designing and manufacturing machines. ||| Advances in electrical engineering have led to better energy efficiency.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她决定在大学学习土木工程。 ||| 机械工程涉及设计和制造机器。 ||| 电气工程的进步带来了更好的能源效率。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 刻上, 雕刻, 铭记
ieltsWords.collocations: engrave a name 刻名字, engrave on metal 在金属上雕刻, engrave in memory 铭记在心
ieltsWords.example: The jeweler engraved the couple's names on the wedding rings. ||| The artist engraved a beautiful landscape on the copper plate. ||| The tragic event was engraved in her memory forever.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 珠宝商将这对夫妇的名字刻在结婚戒指上。 ||| 艺术家在铜板上雕刻了一幅美丽的风景画。 ||| 那场悲剧事件永远铭刻在她的记忆中。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 教育, 启发, 启蒙, 开导, 教导
ieltsWords.collocations: enlighten someone 启发某人, enlighten the public 启迪公众, enlighten about 使明白
ieltsWords.example: The teacher's words enlightened the students about the importance of critical thinking. ||| The documentary aims to enlighten the public on environmental issues. ||| Reading great literature can enlighten the mind and broaden horizons.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师的话启发了学生们批判性思维的重要性。 ||| 这部纪录片旨在启迪公众对环境问题的认识。 ||| 阅读伟大的文学作品可以启迪心智，开阔视野。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 使富足, 使肥沃
ieltsWords.collocations: enrich one's life 丰富生活, enrich the soil 肥沃土壤, enrich uranium 浓缩铀
ieltsWords.example: Traveling to different countries can enrich your life experience. ||| Adding compost will enrich the soil for better plant growth. ||| The company specializes in enriching uranium for nuclear power plants.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 去不同的国家旅行可以丰富你的生活经历。 ||| 添加堆肥将使土壤肥沃，促进植物生长。 ||| 这家公司专门为核电站浓缩铀。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 登记, 注册, 入伍
[经] 登记, 注册
ieltsWords.collocations: school enrollment 学校入学, enrollment fee 注册费, enrollment rate 入学率
ieltsWords.example: The university saw a significant increase in enrollment this year. ||| Students must pay an enrollment fee before the start of the semester. ||| The government aims to raise the enrollment rate in rural areas.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这所大学今年的入学人数显著增加。 ||| 学生必须在学期开始前支付注册费。 ||| 政府旨在提高农村地区的入学率。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 全体, 合唱曲, (女人的)全套服装
[化] 总体; 整体; 系综
ieltsWords.collocations: musical ensemble 音乐合奏团, ensemble cast 全体演员, ensemble piece 合奏曲
ieltsWords.example: The jazz ensemble performed at the concert hall last night. ||| The film features an ensemble cast of famous actors. ||| The ensemble piece required perfect coordination among all musicians.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 爵士合奏团昨晚在音乐厅演出。 ||| 这部电影由一群著名演员组成全体演员阵容。 ||| 这首合奏曲需要所有音乐家之间的完美配合。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 跟着发生, 继起
vt. 追求
ieltsWords.collocations: ensue from 由...引起, chaos ensues 混乱随之而来, debate ensues 辩论接着发生
ieltsWords.example: After the announcement, a heated debate ensued among the audience. ||| If the policy is implemented, economic growth will ensue. ||| The accident caused a traffic jam that ensued for hours.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 宣布之后，观众中展开了一场激烈的辩论。 ||| 如果这项政策得以实施，经济增长将随之而来。 ||| 事故导致了持续数小时的交通堵塞。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 娱乐, 款待, 娱乐表演
ieltsWords.collocations: entertainment industry 娱乐业, live entertainment 现场娱乐, entertainment center 娱乐中心
ieltsWords.example: The city offers a wide range of entertainment options for tourists. ||| The entertainment industry has been greatly affected by the pandemic. ||| They enjoyed live entertainment at the local theater.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座城市为游客提供了各种各样的娱乐选择。 ||| 娱乐业受到了疫情的严重影响。 ||| 他们在当地剧院欣赏了现场娱乐表演。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 狂热的, 热心的, 热烈的
ieltsWords.collocations: enthusiastic about 对...热情, enthusiastic support 热情支持, enthusiastic response 热烈反响
ieltsWords.example: She is very enthusiastic about learning new languages. ||| The proposal received enthusiastic support from the community. ||| The audience gave an enthusiastic response to the performance.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对学习新语言非常热情。 ||| 该提案得到了社区的热情支持。 ||| 观众对表演给予了热烈的反响。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 给...权利, 取名为, 给予名称, 叫做
[法] 给...权利, 使有资格, 称呼
ieltsWords.collocations: entitle someone to 使某人有资格, be entitled to 有权, entitled to vote 有权投票
ieltsWords.example: This ticket entitles you to a free drink at the bar. ||| All citizens are entitled to equal rights under the law. ||| The book is entitled 'The Great Gatsby'.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这张票使你有权在酒吧免费喝一杯。 ||| 所有公民在法律下都有权享有平等权利。 ||| 这本书名为《了不起的盖茨比》。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 实体, 实存物, 存在
[计] 实体
ieltsWords.collocations: business entity 商业实体, legal entity 法律实体, separate entity 独立实体
ieltsWords.example: The company is a separate legal entity from its owners. ||| Each department operates as a distinct entity within the organization. ||| The government recognized the tribe as a sovereign entity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司是一个独立于其所有者的法律实体。 ||| 每个部门在组织内作为一个独特的实体运作。 ||| 政府承认该部落为一个主权实体。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 入口, 进入点, 入场, 入学, 进入, 开始(阶段), 就任
vt. 使出神, 使入迷
[计] 入口
ieltsWords.collocations: main entrance 主入口, entrance exam 入学考试, entrance fee 入场费
ieltsWords.example: The main entrance to the building is on the left. ||| She passed the entrance exam and was admitted to the university. ||| Visitors must pay an entrance fee to enter the museum.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大楼的主入口在左边。 ||| 她通过了入学考试并被大学录取。 ||| 游客必须支付入场费才能进入博物馆。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 企业家, 主办人
[经] 承包商, 企业家
ieltsWords.collocations: successful entrepreneur 成功企业家, young entrepreneur 年轻创业者, serial entrepreneur 连续创业者
ieltsWords.example: The entrepreneur started her own tech company at the age of 25. ||| Many young entrepreneurs are turning to social media for marketing. ||| He is a serial entrepreneur who has founded several successful businesses.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位企业家在25岁时创办了自己的科技公司。 ||| 许多年轻创业者正在利用社交媒体进行营销。 ||| 他是一位连续创业者，创立了多家成功的企业。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 登录, 条目, 进入, 入口, 报关
[计] 登录项, 输入项, 条目
ieltsWords.collocations: entry into 进入, entry level 入门级, diary entry 日记条目
ieltsWords.example: The country restricted entry for foreign travelers during the pandemic. ||| She applied for an entry-level position at the company. ||| He wrote a detailed entry in his diary about the day's events.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 疫情期间，该国限制外国游客入境。 ||| 她申请了该公司的入门级职位。 ||| 他在日记中详细记录了当天的事件。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 周围的, 环境的
[经] 环境的, 环保的
ieltsWords.collocations: environmental protection 环境保护, environmental issues 环境问题, environmental impact 环境影响
ieltsWords.example: The government is taking steps to address environmental issues. ||| Environmental protection is a global concern. ||| The new factory will have a significant environmental impact on the area.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府正在采取措施解决环境问题。 ||| 环境保护是一个全球性的关注点。 ||| 新工厂将对当地产生重大的环境影响。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 面对, 正视, 想象
ieltsWords.collocations: envisage a future 展望未来, envisage doing sth 设想做某事, envisage a scenario 设想一个场景
ieltsWords.example: The government envisages a significant increase in funding for education. ||| It is difficult to envisage how the situation will improve. ||| The project was envisaged as a long-term investment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府设想大幅增加教育经费。 ||| 很难设想情况会如何改善。 ||| 该项目被设想为一项长期投资。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 传染病, 流行病
a. 流行的, 传染性的
ieltsWords.collocations: an epidemic of flu 流感流行, a global epidemic 全球性流行病, an epidemic of crime 犯罪泛滥
ieltsWords.example: The outbreak of the epidemic caused widespread panic. ||| There is an epidemic of obesity in many developed countries. ||| The government took measures to contain the epidemic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 流行病的爆发引起了广泛的恐慌。 ||| 许多发达国家肥胖问题泛滥。 ||| 政府采取措施控制疫情。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 插曲, 插话, 有趣的事件, 一段情节
[医] 插话, 插曲, 发作
ieltsWords.collocations: a TV episode 电视剧的一集, a depressive episode 抑郁发作, an episode in history 历史事件
ieltsWords.example: The final episode of the series attracted millions of viewers. ||| She suffered from a brief episode of anxiety. ||| This episode in his life shaped his future career.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该系列的最后一集吸引了数百万观众。 ||| 她经历了一段短暂的焦虑发作。 ||| 他生命中的这段经历塑造了他未来的职业生涯。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 新纪元, 时代, 时期
ieltsWords.collocations: a new epoch 新时代, an epoch-making discovery 划时代的发现, the colonial epoch 殖民时代
ieltsWords.example: The invention of the internet marked a new epoch in communication. ||| The Renaissance was an epoch of great cultural achievement. ||| We are living in an epoch of rapid technological change.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 互联网的发明标志着通信的新纪元。 ||| 文艺复兴是一个文化成就辉煌的时代。 ||| 我们生活在一个技术快速变革的时代。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 对手, 匹敌, 同辈
a. 相等的, 平等的, 胜任的, 合适的, 平静的, 不相上下的
vt. 等于, 比得上
[计] 等长度编码
ieltsWords.collocations: equal rights 平等权利, equal opportunity 平等机会, equal to the task 胜任任务
ieltsWords.example: All citizens are equal under the law. ||| The two teams are equal in strength. ||| She proved equal to the challenge.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 法律面前所有公民一律平等。 ||| 两队实力相当。 ||| 她证明了自己能应对挑战。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 相等, 等式, 平衡
[化] 方程式; 等式; 反应式; 公式
ieltsWords.collocations: solve an equation 解方程, a mathematical equation 数学方程式, a chemical equation 化学方程式
ieltsWords.example: The students learned how to solve quadratic equations. ||| The equation of supply and demand determines prices. ||| This factor must be included in the equation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生们学会了如何解二次方程。 ||| 供需平衡决定价格。 ||| 这个因素必须纳入考虑。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 赤道
[医] 赤道, 中纬线
ieltsWords.collocations: the equator 赤道, near the equator 赤道附近, cross the equator 穿越赤道
ieltsWords.example: The equator divides the Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres. ||| Countries near the equator have a tropical climate. ||| The ship crossed the equator at midnight.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 赤道将地球分为北半球和南半球。 ||| 赤道附近的国家属于热带气候。 ||| 船在午夜穿越了赤道。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 平衡, 平静, 均衡
[化] 平衡
ieltsWords.collocations: reach equilibrium 达到平衡, in equilibrium 处于平衡, economic equilibrium 经济均衡
ieltsWords.example: The ecosystem maintains a delicate equilibrium. ||| The market is in equilibrium when supply equals demand. ||| He struggled to maintain his emotional equilibrium.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 生态系统维持着微妙的平衡。 ||| 当供给等于需求时，市场处于均衡。 ||| 他努力保持情绪稳定。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 公平的, 公正的
[法] 公平的, 公正的, 平衡法的
ieltsWords.collocations: equitable distribution 公平分配, equitable treatment 公平对待, an equitable solution 公平的解决方案
ieltsWords.example: The government aims to achieve equitable access to healthcare. ||| An equitable tax system is essential for social justice. ||| The judge made an equitable decision.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府旨在实现医疗服务的公平获取。 ||| 公平的税收制度对社会正义至关重要。 ||| 法官做出了公正的判决。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 公平, 公正
[经] 权益, 产权
ieltsWords.collocations: social equity 社会公平, gender equity 性别平等, equity capital 股本
ieltsWords.example: The company issued new equity to raise funds. ||| The principle of equity is fundamental to a just society. ||| Home equity loans are popular among homeowners.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司发行新股以筹集资金。 ||| 公平原则是公正社会的基础。 ||| 房屋净值贷款在房主中很受欢迎。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 根除, 扑灭, 根绝, 消灭
ieltsWords.collocations: eradicate poverty 消除贫困, eradicate disease 根除疾病, eradicate corruption 根除腐败
ieltsWords.example: The government is committed to eradicating illiteracy. ||| Smallpox has been completely eradicated worldwide. ||| Efforts to eradicate the virus have been successful.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府致力于扫除文盲。 ||| 天花已在全球范围内被彻底根除。 ||| 根除病毒的努力取得了成功。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 抹去, 擦掉
[计] 清洗; 擦除; 抹除; DOS内部命令:从磁盘上删除一个或多个文件
ieltsWords.collocations: erase a memory 抹去记忆, erase data 删除数据, erase a mistake 消除错误
ieltsWords.example: He erased the whiteboard with a cloth. ||| The file was accidentally erased from the computer. ||| Time cannot erase the pain of losing a loved one.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他用布擦掉了白板。 ||| 文件意外地从电脑中被删除了。 ||| 时间无法抹去失去亲人的痛苦。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 直立的, 竖立的, 笔直的
vt. 使竖立, 使直立, 树立, 建立
vi. 勃起
ieltsWords.collocations: erect a building 建造大楼, erect a monument 竖立纪念碑, erect a fence 竖起篱笆
ieltsWords.example: The city plans to erect a new library in the park. ||| They erected a tent for the camping trip. ||| A statue was erected in honor of the hero.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该市计划在公园里建造一座新图书馆。 ||| 他们为露营旅行搭起了帐篷。 ||| 为纪念英雄竖立了一座雕像。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 腐蚀, 冲蚀, 侵蚀
[化] 磨耗; 侵蚀
ieltsWords.collocations: soil erosion 土壤侵蚀, coastal erosion 海岸侵蚀, erosion of confidence 信心削弱
ieltsWords.example: Deforestation leads to severe soil erosion. ||| The cliffs are subject to constant erosion by the sea. ||| There has been a gradual erosion of public trust in the media.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 森林砍伐导致严重的土壤侵蚀。 ||| 悬崖不断受到海水的侵蚀。 ||| 公众对媒体的信任逐渐削弱。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 古怪的人, 漂泊无定的人
a. 不稳定的, 奇怪的
ieltsWords.collocations: erratic behavior 反复无常的行为, erratic weather 变化无常的天气, erratic performance 不稳定的表现
ieltsWords.example: The stock market has been erratic this month. ||| His erratic driving worried the passengers. ||| The patient's heartbeat was erratic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 本月股市一直不稳定。 ||| 他忽快忽慢的驾驶让乘客担心。 ||| 病人的心跳不规律。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 爆发
vt. 喷出
ieltsWords.collocations: volcano erupts 火山喷发, erupt in anger 勃然大怒, conflict erupts 冲突爆发
ieltsWords.example: The volcano erupted after decades of dormancy. ||| Violence erupted during the protest. ||| The crowd erupted in cheers when the goal was scored.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 火山在沉寂了几十年后喷发了。 ||| 抗议期间爆发了暴力事件。 ||| 进球时人群爆发出欢呼声。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 逐步扩大, 逐步升高, 逐步增强
vt. 使逐步上升
ieltsWords.collocations: escalate a conflict 使冲突升级, escalate tensions 加剧紧张局势, escalate costs 成本上升
ieltsWords.example: The dispute escalated into a full-scale war. ||| The company's losses escalated rapidly. ||| The government fears the protests may escalate.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 争端升级为全面战争。 ||| 公司的亏损迅速加剧。 ||| 政府担心抗议活动可能升级。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 护送者, 护卫者, 护航舰
vt. 护卫, 护送
ieltsWords.collocations: escort someone home 送某人回家, escort a convoy 护送车队, under escort 在护送下
ieltsWords.example: The police escorted the VIP to the airport. ||| She was escorted out of the building by security. ||| The convoy was escorted by military vehicles.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警察护送贵宾前往机场。 ||| 她被保安护送出了大楼。 ||| 车队由军用车辆护送。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 随笔, 短文, 评论, 企图
vt. 试图
ieltsWords.collocations: write an essay 写文章, a critical essay 评论文章, a personal essay 个人随笔
ieltsWords.example: She wrote an essay on the effects of climate change. ||| The essay was well-structured and persuasive. ||| He submitted his essay for the competition.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她写了一篇关于气候变化影响的文章。 ||| 这篇文章结构清晰，有说服力。 ||| 他提交了参赛论文。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 实质, 本质, 香精
[化] 香精
ieltsWords.collocations: the essence of life 生命的本质, in essence 本质上, capture the essence 抓住精髓
ieltsWords.example: The essence of democracy is freedom of choice. ||| In essence, the argument is about fairness. ||| The perfume captures the essence of roses.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 民主的本质是选择自由。 ||| 本质上，争论是关于公平。 ||| 这款香水捕捉了玫瑰的精华。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 不动产, (人生的)阶段, 阶层, 财产
[经] 房地产, 遗产, 财产
ieltsWords.collocations: real estate 房地产, estate agent 房地产经纪人, estate tax 遗产税
ieltsWords.example: He inherited a large estate from his grandfather. ||| The company invests heavily in real estate. ||| The estate includes a mansion and several acres of land.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他从祖父那里继承了一大笔遗产。 ||| 这家公司大量投资于房地产。 ||| 这个庄园包括一座豪宅和几英亩土地。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 尊敬, 尊重
vt. 尊敬, 尊重, 认为
ieltsWords.collocations: hold in high esteem 非常尊重, self-esteem 自尊, esteem highly 高度评价
ieltsWords.example: She is held in high esteem by her colleagues. ||| Low self-esteem can affect a person's mental health. ||| We esteem him as a great leader.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她深受同事们的尊重。 ||| 低自尊会影响一个人的心理健康。 ||| 我们尊他为伟大的领袖。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 估计, 判断
vt. 估计, 评价, 判断
vi. 估计
ieltsWords.collocations: rough estimate 粗略估计, estimate the cost 估算成本, estimate at 估计为
ieltsWords.example: The contractor gave us an estimate for the renovation. ||| It is difficult to estimate the number of participants. ||| The damage was estimated at millions of dollars.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 承包商给了我们一个翻新的估价。 ||| 很难估计参与者的数量。 ||| 损失估计达数百万美元。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 永恒的, 永远的, 不灭的
ieltsWords.collocations: eternal life 永生, eternal love 永恒的爱, eternal truth 永恒的真理
ieltsWords.example: Many religions promise eternal life after death. ||| Their love seemed eternal, but it ended in tragedy. ||| The search for eternal youth is a common theme in literature.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多宗教承诺死后永生。 ||| 他们的爱似乎是永恒的，但以悲剧告终。 ||| 对永恒青春的追求是文学中常见的主题。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 人种的, 种族的
[医] 人种的
ieltsWords.collocations: ethnic group 族群, ethnic minority 少数民族, ethnic conflict 种族冲突
ieltsWords.example: The country is home to many different ethnic groups. ||| Ethnic minorities often face discrimination in the job market. ||| The restaurant serves a variety of ethnic cuisines.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个国家有许多不同的族群。 ||| 少数民族在就业市场上经常面临歧视。 ||| 这家餐厅提供各种民族特色菜肴。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 礼仪, 礼节, 成规
[法] 规则, 成规, 礼节
ieltsWords.collocations: social etiquette 社交礼仪, business etiquette 商务礼仪, table etiquette 餐桌礼仪
ieltsWords.example: It is important to observe proper etiquette in formal settings. ||| Business etiquette varies from country to country. ||| She was taught table etiquette from a young age.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在正式场合遵守适当的礼仪很重要。 ||| 商务礼仪因国家而异。 ||| 她从小就被教导餐桌礼仪。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 疏散, 撤出, 排泄
ieltsWords.collocations: evacuate the building 疏散大楼, evacuate residents 疏散居民, evacuate the area 撤离该区域
ieltsWords.example: The entire building was evacuated due to a fire alarm. ||| Residents were evacuated from the flood zone. ||| The army helped evacuate civilians from the war zone.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于火警，整栋大楼被疏散。 ||| 居民从洪水区撤离。 ||| 军队帮助疏散了战区的平民。

ieltsWords.definition: v. (巧妙地)逃脱, 规避, 逃避
ieltsWords.collocations: evade taxes 逃税, evade the question 回避问题, evade capture 逃避抓捕
ieltsWords.example: Some companies try to evade taxes through loopholes. ||| The politician evaded the reporter's question skillfully. ||| The fugitive managed to evade the police for weeks.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一些公司试图通过漏洞逃税。 ||| 这位政治家巧妙地回避了记者的提问。 ||| 逃犯设法躲避了警察数周。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 蒸发, 失去水分, 消失
vt. 使蒸发, 使脱水, 使消失
ieltsWords.collocations: evaporate quickly 迅速蒸发, evaporate into thin air 消失得无影无踪, evaporate water 蒸发水
ieltsWords.example: The water in the puddle evaporated under the hot sun. ||| His hopes of winning the lottery evaporated when he lost the ticket. ||| The solvent evaporates, leaving a thin film on the surface.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 水坑里的水在烈日下蒸发了。 ||| 当他丢了彩票时，他中奖的希望破灭了。 ||| 溶剂蒸发后，在表面留下一层薄膜。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 平坦的, 相等的, 连贯的, 均等的, 公平的, 偶数的, 平均的, 平衡的, 恰好的
vt. 使平坦, 使相等
vi. 变平, 成为相等
adv. 甚至, 实际上, 完全, 十分
n. 偶数, 偶校验
[计] 偶数, 偶校验
ieltsWords.collocations: even though 即使, even if 即使, even number 偶数, even surface 平坦的表面
ieltsWords.example: Even though it rained, we still went for a walk. ||| The scores were even at halftime. ||| She is even more talented than her sister.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 即使下雨了，我们还是去散步了。 ||| 半场时比分持平。 ||| 她甚至比她姐姐更有才华。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 事件, 结果, 事情的进程, 竞赛项目
[计] 事件
ieltsWords.collocations: current events 时事, special event 特殊事件, sporting event 体育赛事
ieltsWords.example: The conference was a major event in the academic calendar. ||| The Olympic Games include many different events. ||| The event attracted thousands of visitors from around the world.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这次会议是学术日历中的一项重要活动。 ||| 奥运会包括许多不同的比赛项目。 ||| 该活动吸引了来自世界各地的数千名游客。

ieltsWords.definition: adv. 最后, 终于
ieltsWords.collocations: eventually succeed 最终成功, eventually realize 最终意识到, eventually arrive 最终到达
ieltsWords.example: After years of hard work, he eventually achieved his goal. ||| The lost hikers were eventually found by the rescue team. ||| She eventually decided to pursue a career in medicine.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 经过多年的努力，他终于实现了目标。 ||| 迷路的徒步者最终被救援队找到。 ||| 她最终决定从事医学事业。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 根据, 证据, 迹象
[经] 证据, 凭证
ieltsWords.collocations: strong evidence 强有力的证据, evidence of 的证据, provide evidence 提供证据
ieltsWords.example: The police found evidence linking the suspect to the crime. ||| There is growing evidence that exercise improves mental health. ||| The scientist presented evidence to support her theory.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方发现了将嫌疑人与犯罪联系起来的证据。 ||| 越来越多的证据表明锻炼可以改善心理健康。 ||| 科学家提供了支持她理论的证据。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 唤起, 引起, 召(魂)
[法] 提审, 移送
ieltsWords.collocations: evoke memories 唤起回忆, evoke emotions 引发情感, evoke a response 引起反应
ieltsWords.example: The old photograph evoked memories of her childhood. ||| The music evoked a sense of nostalgia in the audience. ||| His speech evoked a strong emotional response from the crowd.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这张老照片唤起了她童年的回忆。 ||| 音乐在观众中引发了一种怀旧感。 ||| 他的演讲引起了人群强烈的情感反应。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 进化, 发展, 进展, (气体)放出, 开方
[医] 进化, 演化, 旋出
ieltsWords.collocations: theory of evolution 进化论, evolution of technology 技术演变, gradual evolution 逐步演变
ieltsWords.example: Darwin's theory of evolution revolutionized biology. ||| The evolution of smartphones has changed the way we communicate. ||| The company has undergone a significant evolution in its business model.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 达尔文的进化论彻底改变了生物学。 ||| 智能手机的演变改变了我们的沟通方式。 ||| 该公司的商业模式经历了重大演变。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 夸大, 夸张
ieltsWords.collocations: exaggerate the truth 夸大事实, exaggerate the importance 夸大重要性, exaggerate a story 夸大故事
ieltsWords.example: He tends to exaggerate his achievements to impress others. ||| The media often exaggerates the risks of certain activities. ||| Don't exaggerate; it's not that bad.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他倾向于夸大自己的成就以给人留下深刻印象。 ||| 媒体经常夸大某些活动的风险。 ||| 别夸张了，没那么糟。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 考试, 测验, 审查
[医] 检查, 诊察
ieltsWords.collocations: final examination 期末考试, medical examination 体检, examination paper 试卷
ieltsWords.example: Students are preparing for the final examination. ||| The doctor performed a thorough examination of the patient. ||| The examination of the evidence took several hours.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生们正在准备期末考试。 ||| 医生对病人进行了彻底检查。 ||| 对证据的审查花了几个小时。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 例子, 样本, 实例
[化] 实例
ieltsWords.collocations: for example 例如, set an example 树立榜样, example of 的例子
ieltsWords.example: For example, regular exercise can improve your health. ||| She set a good example for her younger siblings. ||| This painting is a classic example of Renaissance art.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 例如，定期锻炼可以改善你的健康。 ||| 她为弟弟妹妹树立了好榜样。 ||| 这幅画是文艺复兴艺术的经典范例。

ieltsWords.definition: adv. 极端地, 极度地, 非常
ieltsWords.collocations: exceedingly difficult 极其困难, exceedingly rare 极其罕见, exceedingly important 极其重要
ieltsWords.example: The task was exceedingly difficult, but she managed to complete it. ||| This species is exceedingly rare in the wild. ||| It is exceedingly important to follow the safety instructions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这项任务极其困难，但她设法完成了。 ||| 这个物种在野外极其罕见。 ||| 遵循安全说明极其重要。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 胜过, 优于, 擅长
vi. 胜过其他
ieltsWords.collocations: excel at 擅长, excel in 在...方面出色, excel oneself 超越自己
ieltsWords.example: She excels at mathematics and science. ||| He excelled in sports during his school years. ||| The team excelled themselves in the championship game.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她擅长数学和科学。 ||| 他在学生时代在体育方面表现出色。 ||| 这支队伍在冠军赛中超越了自我。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 例外的, 异常的, 特别的
ieltsWords.collocations: exceptional talent 卓越的才能, exceptional circumstances 特殊情况, exceptional performance 出色的表现
ieltsWords.example: She has an exceptional ability to solve complex problems. ||| The school provides support for students with exceptional needs. ||| His exceptional performance earned him a promotion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她具有解决复杂问题的卓越能力。 ||| 学校为有特殊需求的学生提供支持。 ||| 他出色的表现为他赢得了晋升。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 摘录
v. 引用, 摘录
ieltsWords.collocations: excerpt from a book 书中摘录, read an excerpt 阅读摘录, publish an excerpt 发表摘录
ieltsWords.example: The teacher read an excerpt from the novel to the class. ||| The magazine published an excerpt of the interview. ||| She chose an excerpt that best represented the author's style.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师给全班读了小说中的一个片段。 ||| 杂志刊登了采访的摘录。 ||| 她选择了最能代表作者风格的摘录。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 交换, (电话)交换局, 交换机, 汇兑, 交易所
v. 交换, 交易, 兑换
[计] 交换; 电话局
ieltsWords.collocations: exchange ideas 交流想法, exchange rate 汇率, exchange program 交换项目
ieltsWords.example: We exchanged contact information after the meeting. ||| The exchange rate between the dollar and the euro has fluctuated. ||| She participated in a cultural exchange program in Japan.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 会议后我们交换了联系方式。 ||| 美元和欧元之间的汇率波动了。 ||| 她参加了日本的文化交流项目。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 刺激, 兴奋
[医] 兴奋, 激动
ieltsWords.collocations: great excitement 极大的兴奋, cause excitement 引起兴奋, with excitement 兴奋地
ieltsWords.example: The children were filled with excitement on Christmas morning. ||| The announcement caused great excitement among the employees. ||| She could hardly contain her excitement when she heard the news.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 孩子们在圣诞节早晨充满了兴奋。 ||| 这个公告在员工中引起了极大的兴奋。 ||| 听到这个消息时，她几乎无法抑制自己的兴奋。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 令人兴奋的, 刺激的
[电] 激磁
ieltsWords.collocations: exciting news 令人兴奋的消息, exciting opportunity 激动人心的机会, exciting experience 令人兴奋的经历
ieltsWords.example: It was an exciting match that kept the audience on the edge of their seats. ||| She found the prospect of traveling abroad very exciting. ||| The company announced an exciting new product launch.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这是一场激动人心的比赛，让观众紧张不已。 ||| 她觉得出国旅行的前景非常令人兴奋。 ||| 公司宣布了一个激动人心的新产品发布。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 大叫, 呼喊, 大声叫
ieltsWords.collocations: exclaim in surprise 惊讶地呼喊, exclaim with joy 高兴地呼喊, exclaim loudly 大声呼喊
ieltsWords.example: "What a beautiful view!" she exclaimed as she looked out the window. ||| He exclaimed in surprise when he saw the unexpected gift. ||| The children exclaimed with joy when they saw the snow.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: “多美的景色啊！”她看着窗外喊道。 ||| 看到意想不到的礼物时，他惊讶地叫了起来。 ||| 孩子们看到雪时高兴地欢呼起来。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 排外的, 独占的, 唯一的
[计] 独占的
ieltsWords.collocations: exclusive right 专有权, exclusive interview 独家采访, exclusive club 高级俱乐部
ieltsWords.example: The hotel offers exclusive access to a private beach. ||| She gave an exclusive interview to the magazine. ||| The club is very exclusive and only accepts members by invitation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家酒店提供私人海滩的独家使用权。 ||| 她接受了该杂志的独家采访。 ||| 这个俱乐部非常排外，只接受邀请会员。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 远足, 游览圆, 短程旅行
[医] 移动, 离轨, 逸出
ieltsWords.collocations: go on an excursion 去远足, school excursion 学校远足, excursion ticket 游览票
ieltsWords.example: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend. ||| The school organized an excursion to the science museum. ||| The excursion included a guided tour of the ancient ruins.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 上周末我们去山里远足了。 ||| 学校组织了一次去科学博物馆的远足。 ||| 这次短途旅行包括对古代遗址的导游参观。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 原谅, 申辩, 做为...的托辞
n. 致歉, 理由, 饶恕, 借口
ieltsWords.collocations: make an excuse 找借口, excuse me 对不起, accept an excuse 接受道歉
ieltsWords.example: He made a weak excuse for being late. ||| Excuse me, could you tell me the way to the station? ||| She excused herself from the meeting due to a headache.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他为迟到找了一个牵强的借口。 ||| 对不起，你能告诉我去车站的路吗？ ||| 她因头痛而请求离开会议。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 执行, 实行, 完成, 处死, 制成
[计] 执行
ieltsWords.collocations: execute a plan 执行计划, execute a command 执行命令, execute a prisoner 处决囚犯
ieltsWords.example: The team executed the project flawlessly. ||| The computer executed the instructions quickly. ||| The king ordered the traitor to be executed.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 团队完美地执行了项目。 ||| 计算机快速执行了指令。 ||| 国王下令处决叛徒。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 实行, 完成, 执行, 死刑
[计] 执行
ieltsWords.collocations: plan execution 计划执行, execution of duties 职责履行, stay of execution 缓期执行
ieltsWords.example: The execution of the strategy was carried out efficiently. ||| The prisoner's execution was scheduled for dawn. ||| The musician's execution of the piece was flawless.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该战略的执行效率很高。 ||| 囚犯的处决定在黎明时分。 ||| 这位音乐家对这首曲子的演奏完美无瑕。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 执行部门, 执行委员会, 执行者, 经理主管人员
a. 执行的, 善于执行的, 善于经营的
[计] 执行程序
ieltsWords.collocations: executive director 执行董事, executive summary 执行摘要, chief executive officer 首席执行官
ieltsWords.example: She works as a senior executive in a multinational company. ||| The executive committee made the final decision. ||| He has strong executive skills and leads the team effectively.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在一家跨国公司担任高级主管。 ||| 执行委员会做出了最终决定。 ||| 他具有很强的执行能力，能有效领导团队。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 例证, 例示
[法] 制作经公章证明的誊本, 例证
ieltsWords.collocations: exemplify a point 举例说明观点, exemplify a trend 体现趋势, exemplify excellence 体现卓越
ieltsWords.example: This case exemplifies the challenges faced by small businesses. ||| Her dedication exemplifies the spirit of volunteerism. ||| The architect's work exemplifies modern design principles.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个案例说明了小企业面临的挑战。 ||| 她的奉献精神体现了志愿精神。 ||| 这位建筑师的作品体现了现代设计原则。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 免税者, 被免除义务者
a. 免除的
vt. 使免除, 豁免
ieltsWords.collocations: exempt from tax 免税, exempt from duty 免职, exempt status 豁免身份
ieltsWords.example: Students from low-income families are exempt from tuition fees. ||| The charity is exempt from paying taxes. ||| He was exempted from military service due to a medical condition.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 来自低收入家庭的学生免交学费。 ||| 该慈善机构免于纳税。 ||| 他因健康原因被免除兵役。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 行使, 执行, 运动, 练习, 作业
vt. 运用, 练习, 运动
vi. 练习, 锻炼
ieltsWords.collocations: do exercise 做运动, physical exercise 体育锻炼, exercise caution 谨慎行事
ieltsWords.example: Regular exercise is essential for good health. ||| The teacher gave the students a grammar exercise to complete. ||| Citizens should exercise their right to vote.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 定期锻炼对健康至关重要。 ||| 老师给学生布置了语法练习。 ||| 公民应行使投票权。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 发挥, 运用, 施以影响
[法] 施加, 产生, 行使
ieltsWords.collocations: exert pressure 施加压力, exert influence 施加影响, exert oneself 尽力
ieltsWords.example: Parents should not exert too much pressure on their children. ||| She exerted all her strength to lift the heavy box. ||| The organization exerts significant influence on government policy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 父母不应给孩子施加过多压力。 ||| 她使出全身力气去搬那个重箱子。 ||| 该组织对政府政策施加了重大影响。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 排气, 排气装置, 废气
vt. 抽完, 用尽, 耗尽, 使精疲力尽
vi. 排气
ieltsWords.collocations: exhaust resources 耗尽资源, exhaust oneself 筋疲力尽, exhaust pipe 排气管
ieltsWords.example: The long journey exhausted the travelers. ||| We have exhausted all possible options. ||| The car's exhaust system needs to be replaced.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 长途旅行使旅行者筋疲力尽。 ||| 我们已经用尽了所有可能的选择。 ||| 汽车的排气系统需要更换。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 表现, 展览会, 展览品
[医] 投药, 展览, 展出
ieltsWords.collocations: art exhibition 艺术展览, hold an exhibition 举办展览, exhibition hall 展览厅
ieltsWords.example: There is an exhibition of modern art at the gallery. ||| The exhibition attracted thousands of visitors. ||| His behavior was an exhibition of poor manners.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 画廊里有一个现代艺术展览。 ||| 这次展览吸引了成千上万的参观者。 ||| 他的行为是缺乏礼貌的表现。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 放逐, 流放, 被放逐者
vt. 放逐, 流放, 使背井离乡
ieltsWords.collocations: live in exile 流亡生活, go into exile 流亡, political exile 政治流亡者
ieltsWords.example: The dictator was forced into exile after the revolution. ||| He spent many years in exile in a foreign country. ||| The writer was exiled for his political views.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 革命后，独裁者被迫流亡。 ||| 他在异国他乡流亡多年。 ||| 这位作家因政治观点被流放。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 存在, 生存
[法] 存在, 存在状态, 实体
ieltsWords.collocations: come into existence 产生, in existence 存在的, struggle for existence 生存斗争
ieltsWords.example: The company has been in existence for over a century. ||| Many species are threatened with extinction and may cease to exist. ||| He led a simple existence in the countryside.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家公司已经存在了一个多世纪。 ||| 许多物种面临灭绝威胁，可能不复存在。 ||| 他在乡下过着简朴的生活。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 存在的, 生存的, 现存的
[医] 生存者
ieltsWords.collocations: existent problem 存在的问题, existent data 现有数据, currently existent 目前存在的
ieltsWords.example: The existent evidence supports the theory. ||| We need to address the existent issues in the system. ||| The existent laws are insufficient to regulate new technologies.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 现有的证据支持这个理论。 ||| 我们需要解决系统中存在的问题。 ||| 现有的法律不足以规范新技术。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 异国的, 外来的
n. 外来人, 外来物, 舶来品
ieltsWords.collocations: exotic species 外来物种, exotic cuisine 异国美食, exotic destination 异国目的地
ieltsWords.example: The zoo has a collection of exotic animals from around the world. ||| She enjoys cooking exotic dishes from different cultures. ||| Exotic plants can sometimes become invasive in new environments.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 动物园里收藏了来自世界各地的奇异动物。 ||| 她喜欢烹饪来自不同文化的异国菜肴。 ||| 外来植物有时会在新环境中变得具有侵略性。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 扩充, 开展, 膨胀
[计] 扩展
ieltsWords.collocations: economic expansion 经济扩张, urban expansion 城市扩张, expansion plan 扩张计划
ieltsWords.example: The company's rapid expansion led to increased profits. ||| Urban expansion often results in loss of farmland. ||| The expansion of the universe is a key concept in cosmology.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司的快速扩张带来了利润的增长。 ||| 城市扩张常常导致农田的损失。 ||| 宇宙膨胀是宇宙学中的一个关键概念。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 期待, 期望的事物, 嘱望, 希望, 期望, 预期
[医] 预期
ieltsWords.collocations: life expectancy 预期寿命, expectancy of success 成功的期望, market expectancy 市场预期
ieltsWords.example: Life expectancy has increased significantly over the past century. ||| There is a general expectancy that the economy will improve. ||| The team played with a sense of expectancy before the final match.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 过去一个世纪里，预期寿命显著增加。 ||| 普遍预期经济将会改善。 ||| 球队在决赛前带着期待的心情比赛。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 远征, 探险队, 迅速
ieltsWords.collocations: scientific expedition 科学考察, expedition team 探险队, mountaineering expedition 登山探险
ieltsWords.example: The expedition to the Arctic was fraught with danger. ||| They organized a scientific expedition to study the rainforest. ||| The mountaineering expedition successfully reached the summit.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 北极探险充满了危险。 ||| 他们组织了一次科学考察来研究雨林。 ||| 登山探险队成功登顶。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 驱逐, 逐出, 排出, 开除
[医] 排除, 迫出
ieltsWords.collocations: expel a student 开除学生, expel air 排出空气, expel an invader 驱逐入侵者
ieltsWords.example: The school decided to expel the student for cheating. ||| The lungs expel carbon dioxide when we breathe out. ||| The government expelled the foreign diplomat for spying.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学校决定开除那个作弊的学生。 ||| 当我们呼气时，肺部排出二氧化碳。 ||| 政府因间谍活动驱逐了外国外交官。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 花费, 消耗, 用光
ieltsWords.collocations: expend energy 消耗能量, expend resources 消耗资源, expend effort 花费精力
ieltsWords.example: The project will expend a large amount of financial resources. ||| Athletes expend a lot of energy during training. ||| We should not expend too much effort on trivial matters.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个项目将消耗大量的财政资源。 ||| 运动员在训练中消耗大量能量。 ||| 我们不应该在琐事上花费太多精力。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 开支, 费用, 用光, 消费额
[经] 支出, 费用, 消费
ieltsWords.collocations: government expenditure 政府支出, household expenditure 家庭支出, capital expenditure 资本支出
ieltsWords.example: The government has reduced expenditure on defense. ||| Household expenditure on food has decreased over the years. ||| The company's capital expenditure on new equipment was substantial.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府减少了国防支出。 ||| 多年来家庭在食品上的支出有所减少。 ||| 公司在新设备上的资本支出相当大。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 贵的, 奢华的, 费用浩大的, 乱化钱的
[经] 高价的, 昂贵的, 浪费的
ieltsWords.collocations: expensive car 昂贵的汽车, expensive taste 高品味, expensive mistake 代价高昂的错误
ieltsWords.example: Living in the city center is more expensive than in the suburbs. ||| She has expensive taste in clothing and accessories. ||| Making a wrong decision can be an expensive mistake for the company.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 住在市中心比住在郊区更昂贵。 ||| 她在服装和配饰方面品味很高。 ||| 做出错误决定对公司来说可能是一个代价高昂的错误。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 专家意见, 专门技术
[法] 专门知识, 专家意见
ieltsWords.collocations: technical expertise 技术专长, professional expertise 专业能力, expertise in finance 金融专业知识
ieltsWords.example: The consultant brought a wealth of expertise to the project. ||| Her expertise in marketing helped the company grow. ||| We need to hire someone with expertise in data analysis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 顾问为项目带来了丰富的专业知识。 ||| 她在市场营销方面的专长帮助公司成长。 ||| 我们需要雇佣一位在数据分析方面有专长的人。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 期满, 呼气, 断气
vt. 呼出
ieltsWords.collocations: contract expires 合同到期, passport expires 护照过期, deadline expires 截止日期
ieltsWords.example: My passport will expire next year, so I need to renew it. ||| The offer expires at midnight tonight. ||| The patient expired peacefully in his sleep.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我的护照明年到期，所以我需要续签。 ||| 优惠今晚午夜截止。 ||| 病人在睡梦中安详地去世了。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 爆炸, 爆发, 激增
vt. 使爆炸
ieltsWords.collocations: bomb explodes 炸弹爆炸, population explodes 人口激增, explode with anger 勃然大怒
ieltsWords.example: The bomb exploded in the city center, causing widespread damage. ||| The population of the city has exploded in recent years. ||| He exploded with anger when he heard the news.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 炸弹在市中心爆炸，造成了广泛的破坏。 ||| 近年来该市人口激增。 ||| 他听到消息后勃然大怒。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 探险, 探测, 探究
ieltsWords.collocations: explore space 探索太空, explore options 探讨选项, explore a city 探索城市
ieltsWords.example: Scientists are exploring the possibility of life on Mars. ||| We need to explore all available options before making a decision. ||| Tourists love to explore the historic streets of the old town.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 科学家正在探索火星上存在生命的可能性。 ||| 在做决定之前，我们需要探讨所有可用的选项。 ||| 游客喜欢探索老城的历史街道。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 爆发, 激增, 爆炸(声)
[化] 爆炸
ieltsWords.collocations: gas explosion 瓦斯爆炸, population explosion 人口爆炸, explosion of data 数据激增
ieltsWords.example: The gas explosion destroyed several buildings in the area. ||| The population explosion in developing countries poses challenges. ||| There has been an explosion of data in the digital age.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 瓦斯爆炸摧毁了该地区的几栋建筑。 ||| 发展中国家的人口爆炸带来了挑战。 ||| 数字时代数据激增。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 炸药, 爆破音
a. 易爆发的, 爆炸的, 暴躁的
ieltsWords.collocations: explosive device 爆炸装置, explosive growth 爆炸性增长, explosive temper 暴躁脾气
ieltsWords.example: The police found an explosive device in the abandoned car. ||| The company experienced explosive growth in its first year. ||| He has an explosive temper and often loses his cool.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方在废弃的汽车里发现了一个爆炸装置。 ||| 该公司在第一年经历了爆炸性增长。 ||| 他脾气暴躁，经常失去冷静。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 输出品, 输出
vt. 输出, 出口
vi. 输出物资
[计] 导出
ieltsWords.collocations: export goods 出口货物, export market 出口市场, export revenue 出口收入
ieltsWords.example: The country exports a large amount of oil to other nations. ||| Export revenue has declined due to global economic slowdown. ||| They are looking for new export markets for their products.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该国向其他国家出口大量石油。 ||| 由于全球经济放缓，出口收入下降。 ||| 他们正在为产品寻找新的出口市场。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 阐述, 讲解, 说明, 博览会, 展览会
[经] 展览会, 集市, 义卖市场
ieltsWords.collocations: world exposition 世界博览会, art exposition 艺术展, exposition of ideas 观点阐述
ieltsWords.example: The world exposition attracted millions of visitors from around the globe. ||| The art exposition featured works by contemporary artists. ||| His exposition of the theory was clear and concise.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 世界博览会吸引了来自全球的数百万游客。 ||| 艺术展展出了当代艺术家的作品。 ||| 他对理论的阐述清晰而简洁。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 暴露, 揭发, 揭露
[化] 曝光量; 照射; 照射量
ieltsWords.collocations: sun exposure 日晒, exposure to risk 风险暴露, media exposure 媒体曝光
ieltsWords.example: Prolonged sun exposure can cause skin damage. ||| The workers had high exposure to harmful chemicals. ||| The scandal received widespread media exposure.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 长时间日晒会导致皮肤损伤。 ||| 工人们大量接触有害化学物质。 ||| 丑闻受到了广泛的媒体曝光。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 逐出, 开除, 驱逐, 排气
[医] 逼出
ieltsWords.collocations: expulsion from school 开除学籍, expulsion of air 空气排出, expulsion order 驱逐令
ieltsWords.example: The student faced expulsion for repeated violations of school rules. ||| The expulsion of waste gases is necessary for the engine to function. ||| The government issued an expulsion order against the illegal immigrants.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该学生因多次违反校规面临开除。 ||| 废气的排出是发动机运转所必需的。 ||| 政府发布了针对非法移民的驱逐令。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 精致的, 细腻的, 敏锐的
ieltsWords.collocations: exquisite craftsmanship 精湛工艺, exquisite taste 高雅品味, exquisite beauty 精美绝伦
ieltsWords.example: The necklace was made with exquisite craftsmanship. ||| She has an exquisite sense of style and elegance. ||| The garden was filled with exquisite flowers of every color.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这条项链制作工艺精湛。 ||| 她有着高雅时尚的品味。 ||| 花园里开满了各种颜色的精美花朵。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 延长, 扩充, 范围, 扩展名
a. 伸缩的
[计] 扩展名, 扩充名
ieltsWords.collocations: extension of time 时间延长, extension service 推广服务, extension cord 延长线
ieltsWords.example: The company applied for an extension of the deadline. ||| We built an extension to the house to create more space. ||| You can reach me at my desk extension.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司申请了截止日期的延期。 ||| 我们扩建了房子以创造更多空间。 ||| 你可以通过我的办公桌分机联系我。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 范围, 程度, 区域
[计] 范围
ieltsWords.collocations: to some extent 在某种程度上, to a large extent 在很大程度上, extent of damage 损害程度
ieltsWords.example: To some extent, the decision was based on financial considerations. ||| The extent of the forest fire was alarming. ||| We need to assess the full extent of the problem.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在某种程度上，这个决定是基于财务考虑。 ||| 森林火灾的范围令人震惊。 ||| 我们需要评估问题的全部程度。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 外部, 表面, 外貌
a. 外部的, 外在的, 表面的
ieltsWords.collocations: exterior wall 外墙, exterior design 外观设计, exterior paint 外墙涂料
ieltsWords.example: The exterior of the building is made of glass. ||| He maintained a calm exterior despite his anxiety. ||| Exterior paint needs to be weather-resistant.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座建筑的外部由玻璃制成。 ||| 尽管焦虑，他仍保持冷静的外表。 ||| 外墙涂料需要耐候。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 熄灭的, 灭绝的, 耗尽的
[法] 消灭了的, 过时的, 无效的
ieltsWords.collocations: extinct species 灭绝物种, become extinct 灭绝, extinct volcano 死火山
ieltsWords.example: Many species have become extinct due to human activity. ||| The volcano is considered extinct. ||| Efforts are being made to prevent the tiger from going extinct.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多物种因人类活动而灭绝。 ||| 这座火山被认为是死火山。 ||| 正在努力防止老虎灭绝。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 熄灭, 使消亡, 压制, 使减色
[医] 消灭
ieltsWords.collocations: extinguish a fire 灭火, extinguish hope 使希望破灭, extinguish a cigarette 熄灭香烟
ieltsWords.example: Firefighters quickly extinguished the blaze. ||| The news extinguished any hope of recovery. ||| Please extinguish all cigarettes before entering.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 消防员迅速扑灭了大火。 ||| 这个消息使任何恢复的希望破灭。 ||| 进入前请熄灭所有香烟。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 额外的事物, 另外的收费
a. 额外的, 特别的
adv. 额外地, 特别地, 非常地
ieltsWords.collocations: extra charge 额外费用, extra time 额外时间, extra work 额外工作
ieltsWords.example: There is an extra charge for checked baggage. ||| She works extra hours to earn more money. ||| The hotel offers extra services like laundry.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 托运行李需要额外收费。 ||| 她加班工作以赚更多钱。 ||| 酒店提供洗衣等额外服务。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 奢侈的, 挥霍无度的, 浪费的
ieltsWords.collocations: extravagant lifestyle 奢侈的生活方式, extravagant spending 挥霍, extravagant claims 过分的说法
ieltsWords.example: She has an extravagant taste in clothes. ||| The party was extravagant, with live music and gourmet food. ||| His extravagant claims were met with skepticism.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对衣服有奢侈的品味。 ||| 派对很奢侈，有现场音乐和美食。 ||| 他过分的说法遭到了怀疑。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 极端, 末端
a. 极端的, 尽头的, 极度的, 偏激的
ieltsWords.collocations: extreme weather 极端天气, extreme sports 极限运动, extreme poverty 极度贫困
ieltsWords.example: The region is experiencing extreme drought. ||| He enjoys extreme sports like bungee jumping. ||| The government must address extreme poverty.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该地区正经历极端干旱。 ||| 他喜欢蹦极等极限运动。 ||| 政府必须解决极度贫困问题。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 繁茂的, 丰富的, 生气勃勃的
[医] 生成过多的, 高度增生的
ieltsWords.collocations: exuberant personality 充满活力的个性, exuberant growth 茂盛生长, exuberant celebration 热烈的庆祝
ieltsWords.example: The children were exuberant at the party. ||| The garden is full of exuberant vegetation. ||| Her exuberant laughter filled the room.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 孩子们在派对上精力充沛。 ||| 花园里长满了茂盛的植物。 ||| 她热情洋溢的笑声充满了房间。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 织物, 布, 结构, 构造, 建筑物
[经] 组织, 建筑物, 工厂
ieltsWords.collocations: cotton fabric 棉织物, fabric of society 社会结构, synthetic fabric 合成纤维
ieltsWords.example: This fabric is made of 100% cotton. ||| The fabric of the building was damaged by the earthquake. ||| Social media has changed the fabric of communication.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这种布料是100%棉的。 ||| 建筑的结构被地震损坏了。 ||| 社交媒体改变了沟通的结构。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 制造, 建造, 装配, 伪造
ieltsWords.collocations: fabricate evidence 伪造证据, fabricate a story 编造故事, fabricate parts 制造零件
ieltsWords.example: The company fabricates metal components for cars. ||| He fabricated an excuse for being late. ||| The police accused him of fabricating evidence.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家公司制造汽车金属部件。 ||| 他为迟到编造了一个借口。 ||| 警方指控他伪造证据。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 传说的, 寓言般的, 难以置信的
ieltsWords.collocations: fabulous view 绝妙的景色, fabulous wealth 巨额财富, fabulous story 传说故事
ieltsWords.example: We had a fabulous time at the beach. ||| The hotel offers a fabulous view of the ocean. ||| He told us a fabulous story about his travels.
