ieltsWords.definition:
n. 容易, 灵巧, 设备
[计] 设施; 设备; 装备
ieltsWords.collocations: sports facility 体育设施, public facility 公共设施, facility with languages 语言才能
ieltsWords.example: The school has excellent sports facilities. ||| The facility is open to the public. ||| She has a great facility for learning languages.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学校有极好的体育设施。 ||| 该设施对公众开放。 ||| 她很有语言学习的天赋。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 工厂, 产生地, 代理店
[经] 工厂, 代理店, 商行在国外的代理处
ieltsWords.collocations: factory worker 工厂工人, factory production 工厂生产, car factory 汽车工厂
ieltsWords.example: The factory produces thousands of cars each year. ||| He works in a textile factory. ||| The factory was closed due to safety concerns.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家工厂每年生产数千辆汽车。 ||| 他在一家纺织厂工作。 ||| 由于安全问题，工厂被关闭了。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 才能, 能力, 全体教员, (大学的)系
[医] 能力, [大学]院系
ieltsWords.collocations: faculty member 教职员工, faculty of law 法学院, mental faculty 心智能力
ieltsWords.example: She is a member of the faculty at Harvard. ||| He has a faculty for making friends easily. ||| The faculty of medicine is renowned for its research.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她是哈佛大学的教员。 ||| 他有容易交朋友的天赋。 ||| 医学院以其研究而闻名。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 褪色, 消失, 凋谢
vt. 使褪色
n. 淡入, 淡出
a. 平淡的
ieltsWords.collocations: fade away 逐渐消失, fade out 淡出, colors fade 颜色褪去
ieltsWords.example: The colors of the painting have faded over time. ||| Her voice faded as she walked away. ||| The flowers will fade if not watered.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 画作的颜色随时间褪去了。 ||| 她走开时声音逐渐消失。 ||| 如果不浇水，花会凋谢。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 失败, 失败者, 不足, 缺乏, 破产
[计] 故障; 失效
ieltsWords.collocations: failure rate 失败率, heart failure 心力衰竭, crop failure 作物歉收
ieltsWords.example: The project ended in failure due to lack of funding. ||| He was a failure as a businessman. ||| The engine failure caused the plane to crash.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于缺乏资金，项目以失败告终。 ||| 作为一个商人，他是个失败者。 ||| 发动机故障导致飞机坠毁。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 昏厥, 昏倒
a. 模糊的, 微弱的, 无力的
vi. 昏倒, 变得微弱
ieltsWords.collocations: faint sound 微弱的声音, faint hope 微弱的希望, faint from hunger 饿晕
ieltsWords.example: There was a faint smell of smoke in the air. ||| She felt faint and had to sit down. ||| He fainted from the heat.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 空气中有一股微弱的烟味。 ||| 她感到头晕，不得不坐下。 ||| 他因中暑而昏倒。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 信心, 信任, 忠实, 保证
[法] 信任, 信仰, 信念
ieltsWords.collocations: have faith in 相信, religious faith 宗教信仰, keep faith 信守承诺
ieltsWords.example: She has faith in her ability to succeed. ||| People of different faiths live together peacefully. ||| He kept faith with his promises.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她相信自己有能力成功。 ||| 不同信仰的人和平共处。 ||| 他信守了诺言。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 假货, 欺骗, 诡计
a. 假的
vt. 假造, 仿造
vi. 伪装
ieltsWords.collocations: fake news 假新闻, fake ID 假身份证, fake smile 假笑
ieltsWords.example: He was arrested for using a fake passport. ||| She faked a smile to hide her disappointment. ||| The painting was discovered to be a fake.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他因使用假护照被捕。 ||| 她假笑以掩饰失望。 ||| 这幅画被发现是赝品。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 名望, 名声, 传说
ieltsWords.collocations: win fame 赢得声誉, seek fame 追求名声, rise to fame 成名
ieltsWords.example: The young artist rose to fame after her first exhibition. ||| He cared more about his work than personal fame. ||| Fame often brings both opportunities and challenges.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位年轻艺术家在首次展览后一举成名。 ||| 他更关心工作而非个人名声。 ||| 名声往往带来机遇和挑战。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 熟悉的, 常见的, 亲密的
n. 熟友, 常客
ieltsWords.collocations: familiar with 熟悉, familiar sight 熟悉的景象, become familiar 变得熟悉
ieltsWords.example: I am not familiar with this neighborhood. ||| The song has a familiar tune that everyone can hum. ||| She is familiar with several programming languages.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我对这个社区不熟悉。 ||| 这首歌的旋律很熟悉，大家都能哼唱。 ||| 她通晓几种编程语言。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 饥荒, 缺乏, 饥饿
ieltsWords.collocations: suffer famine 遭受饥荒, famine relief 饥荒救济, drought and famine 干旱与饥荒
ieltsWords.example: The region experienced a severe famine due to drought. ||| International aid helped alleviate the famine. ||| Famine can lead to mass migration and social unrest.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该地区因干旱遭遇严重饥荒。 ||| 国际援助帮助缓解了饥荒。 ||| 饥荒可能导致大规模移民和社会动荡。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 想象力, 幻想, 喜好
a. 想象的, 精美的, 新奇的, 奇特的, 高价的, 特级的
vt. 想象, 设想, 相信, 喜爱
vi. 想象, 幻想
ieltsWords.collocations: fancy oneself 自以为是, fancy doing 想要做, fancy that 想象
ieltsWords.example: Do you fancy going for a walk after dinner? ||| He fancies himself as a great writer. ||| I can't fancy living in such a remote place.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你想饭后去散步吗？ ||| 他自以为是伟大的作家。 ||| 我无法想象住在如此偏远的地方。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 奇妙的, 稀奇的, 空想的
ieltsWords.collocations: fantastic opportunity 绝佳机会, fantastic view 极好的景色, fantastic idea 绝妙的主意
ieltsWords.example: We had a fantastic time at the amusement park. ||| The view from the mountain top was fantastic. ||| She came up with a fantastic solution to the problem.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们在游乐园玩得非常开心。 ||| 山顶的景色美极了。 ||| 她想出了一个绝妙的解决方案。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 幻想, 想象的产物
[医] 幻想
ieltsWords.collocations: fantasy world 幻想世界, live in a fantasy 生活在幻想中, fantasy novel 奇幻小说
ieltsWords.example: Children often create a fantasy world in their play. ||| He lives in a fantasy where he is a famous actor. ||| The movie is a fantasy about dragons and magic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 孩子们在游戏中常创造幻想世界。 ||| 他生活在幻想中，觉得自己是著名演员。 ||| 这部电影是关于龙和魔法的奇幻片。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 费用, 旅客, 食物
vi. 进展, 进步, 经营, 过活
ieltsWords.collocations: bus fare 公交车费, air fare 机票价格, fare increase 票价上涨
ieltsWords.example: The bus fare has increased by 10% this year. ||| How much is the fare to the airport? ||| The restaurant offers traditional local fare.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 今年公交车费上涨了10%。 ||| 到机场的车费是多少？ ||| 这家餐厅提供传统的地方食物。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 辞别, 再见, 再会
interj. 再会
ieltsWords.collocations: bid farewell 告别, farewell party 欢送会, farewell speech 告别演说
ieltsWords.example: They held a farewell party for their colleague. ||| He bid farewell to his hometown and moved abroad. ||| The farewell speech was touching and emotional.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们为同事举办了欢送会。 ||| 他告别家乡移居国外。 ||| 告别演说感人至深。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 令人入神, 使着迷
vi. 入迷
ieltsWords.collocations: fascinate by 被…迷住, fascinate with 对…着迷, continue to fascinate 持续吸引
ieltsWords.example: The ancient ruins fascinate tourists from around the world. ||| I am fascinated by the complexity of the human brain. ||| Her stories never fail to fascinate the children.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 古代遗址吸引着世界各地的游客。 ||| 我对人脑的复杂性着迷。 ||| 她的故事总能吸引孩子们。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 迷人的, 吸引人的, 使人神魂颠倒的
ieltsWords.collocations: fascinating story 迷人的故事, fascinating subject 有趣的科目, absolutely fascinating 绝对迷人
ieltsWords.example: I found the documentary about space exploration fascinating. ||| She gave a fascinating lecture on ancient civilizations. ||| The museum has a fascinating collection of artifacts.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我觉得关于太空探索的纪录片非常有趣。 ||| 她做了一个关于古代文明的迷人讲座。 ||| 博物馆收藏了迷人的文物。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 流行, 风尚, 时样
vt. 形成, 造, 作
ieltsWords.collocations: fashion industry 时尚产业, fashion show 时装秀, in fashion 流行
ieltsWords.example: She always follows the latest fashion trends. ||| The fashion show featured designs from young artists. ||| In a similar fashion, we can solve the next problem.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她总是追随最新的时尚潮流。 ||| 时装秀展示了年轻艺术家的设计。 ||| 以类似的方式，我们可以解决下一个问题。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 致命的, 重大的, 命运注定的, 粗心的, 不幸的
[医] 致命的, 致死的
ieltsWords.collocations: fatal accident 致命事故, fatal mistake 致命错误, fatal blow 致命打击
ieltsWords.example: The driver was killed in a fatal car crash. ||| Making a fatal error in the experiment ruined the results. ||| The disease can be fatal if not treated early.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 司机在致命车祸中丧生。 ||| 实验中的致命错误毁了结果。 ||| 这种疾病若不早期治疗可能致命。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 疲乏, 疲劳
vt. 使疲劳, 使心智衰弱
vi. 疲劳
a. 疲劳的
ieltsWords.collocations: mental fatigue 精神疲劳, physical fatigue 身体疲劳, chronic fatigue 慢性疲劳
ieltsWords.example: After a long day at work, he felt extreme fatigue. ||| Lack of sleep can lead to chronic fatigue. ||| The soldiers were suffering from combat fatigue.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 工作一整天后，他感到极度疲劳。 ||| 睡眠不足会导致慢性疲劳。 ||| 士兵们正遭受战斗疲劳。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 过错, 故障, 毛病
vt. 挑剔
vi. 产生断层, 弄错
[计] 故障
ieltsWords.collocations: find fault 挑剔, at fault 有过错, fault line 断层线
ieltsWords.example: It's not my fault that the train was delayed. ||| She always finds fault with my work. ||| The earthquake occurred along a fault line.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 火车晚点不是我的错。 ||| 她总是挑剔我的工作。 ||| 地震沿着断层线发生。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 好意, 喜爱
vt. 赐予, 支持, 喜欢, 证实
ieltsWords.collocations: do a favor 帮忙, in favor of 支持, ask a favor 请求帮忙
ieltsWords.example: Could you do me a favor and open the window? ||| The majority voted in favor of the new policy. ||| He asked a favor of his friend to lend him money.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你能帮我个忙打开窗户吗？ ||| 多数人投票支持新政策。 ||| 他请求朋友帮忙借钱给他。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 喜欢的事物, 幸运儿
a. 特别受喜爱的, 喜爱的, 宠爱的, 中意的
ieltsWords.collocations: favorite food 最喜欢的食物, favorite subject 最喜欢的科目, favorite pastime 最喜欢的消遣
ieltsWords.example: Pizza is my favorite food. ||| Her favorite subject in school is history. ||| Reading is his favorite pastime on weekends.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 比萨是我最喜欢的食物。 ||| 她在学校最喜欢的科目是历史。 ||| 阅读是他周末最喜欢的消遣。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 宴会, 酒席, 享受, 节日
vt. 款待, 享乐, 请客
vi. 参加宴会, 尽情地吃, 享受
ieltsWords.collocations: wedding feast 婚宴, feast on 尽情享用, feast of 盛宴
ieltsWords.example: They prepared a grand feast for the wedding. ||| The family feasted on turkey during Thanksgiving. ||| The feast of Diwali is celebrated with lights and sweets.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们为婚礼准备了盛大的宴会。 ||| 家人在感恩节尽情享用火鸡。 ||| 排灯节以灯光和甜点庆祝。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 壮举, 功绩, 技艺表演
a. 灵巧的, 合适的, 整洁的
ieltsWords.collocations: remarkable feat 非凡壮举, achieve a feat 实现壮举, engineering feat 工程壮举
ieltsWords.example: Climbing Mount Everest is a remarkable feat. ||| The bridge is an engineering feat. ||| He performed a feat of strength by lifting the heavy stone.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 攀登珠穆朗玛峰是了不起的壮举。 ||| 这座桥是一项工程壮举。 ||| 他举起巨石展示了力量壮举。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 联邦, 联合, 联盟
[法] 联邦, 联盟, 联邦政府
ieltsWords.collocations: federation of states 国家联盟, sports federation 体育联合会, trade federation 贸易联合会
ieltsWords.example: The Russian Federation is the largest country in the world. ||| The International Football Federation organizes the World Cup. ||| The federation of labor unions negotiated better wages.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 俄罗斯联邦是世界上最大的国家。 ||| 国际足球联合会组织世界杯。 ||| 工会联合会谈判争取更高工资。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 费用, 小费, 封地, 所有权
vt. 付费给
ieltsWords.collocations: tuition fee 学费, membership fee 会员费, service fee 服务费
ieltsWords.example: The university tuition fee has increased this year. ||| You need to pay an annual membership fee to join the club. ||| The lawyer charged a high fee for his services.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 今年大学学费上涨了。 ||| 加入俱乐部需支付年费。 ||| 律师收取了高额服务费。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 反馈, 反应
[计] 反馈
ieltsWords.collocations: provide feedback 提供反馈, positive feedback 正面反馈, constructive feedback 建设性反馈
ieltsWords.example: The teacher gave us constructive feedback on our essays. ||| Customer feedback is essential for improving our services. ||| We need to collect feedback from all participants after the workshop.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师对我们的论文给出了建设性的反馈。 ||| 客户反馈对于改进我们的服务至关重要。 ||| 我们需要在研讨会后收集所有参与者的反馈。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 女性, 女人, 雌性动物
a. 女性的, 女子的
ieltsWords.collocations: female student 女学生, female population 女性人口, female role 女性角色
ieltsWords.example: The company aims to increase the number of female employees in leadership positions. ||| Female athletes often face more challenges in sports funding. ||| The study focused on the health issues of the female population in rural areas.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司旨在增加担任领导职务的女性员工数量。 ||| 女运动员在体育资助方面常常面临更多挑战。 ||| 这项研究关注农村地区女性人口的健康问题。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 渡船, 渡口
[法] 摆渡营业权, 轮渡
ieltsWords.collocations: take a ferry 乘坐渡轮, ferry service 渡轮服务, cross by ferry 乘渡轮过河
ieltsWords.example: We took a ferry to cross the river and enjoy the scenic view. ||| The ferry service between the islands runs every hour. ||| Many tourists prefer to travel by ferry to experience the coastal beauty.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们乘坐渡轮过河，欣赏风景。 ||| 岛屿之间的渡轮服务每小时一班。 ||| 许多游客喜欢乘渡轮旅行，体验海岸美景。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 可繁殖的, 肥沃的, 生产多的
[医] 能生育的
ieltsWords.collocations: fertile soil 肥沃的土壤, fertile land 肥沃的土地, fertile imagination 丰富的想象力
ieltsWords.example: The fertile soil in this region allows farmers to grow a variety of crops. ||| Her fertile imagination led to many creative ideas for the project. ||| The valley is known for its fertile land and abundant harvests.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该地区肥沃的土壤使农民能够种植多种作物。 ||| 她丰富的想象力为这个项目带来了许多创意。 ||| 这个山谷以其肥沃的土地和丰收而闻名。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 节日的, 喜庆的, 快乐的
n. 节日, 庆祝, 欢宴
ieltsWords.collocations: music festival 音乐节, cultural festival 文化节, celebrate a festival 庆祝节日
ieltsWords.example: The music festival attracts thousands of visitors every year. ||| During the Spring Festival, families gather together to celebrate. ||| The cultural festival showcases traditional dances and foods from around the world.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个音乐节每年吸引成千上万的游客。 ||| 春节期间，家人聚在一起庆祝。 ||| 这个文化节展示了来自世界各地的传统舞蹈和美食。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 取得, 拿, 诡计, 魂
vt. 接来, 取来, 售得, 带来, 推出, 引出, 杀死, 吸引, 到达
vi. 取物, 前进
[计] 取
ieltsWords.collocations: fetch water 取水, fetch a doctor 请医生, fetch a good price 卖得好价钱
ieltsWords.example: Could you fetch me a glass of water from the kitchen? ||| The old painting fetched a high price at the auction. ||| She went to fetch her son from school.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你能去厨房给我拿杯水吗？ ||| 这幅旧画在拍卖会上卖出了高价。 ||| 她去学校接儿子。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 发烧, 发热, 热病
[医] 发热, 热
ieltsWords.collocations: have a fever 发烧, high fever 高烧, reduce fever 退烧
ieltsWords.example: The child has a high fever and needs to see a doctor. ||| Election fever is sweeping the country as the voting day approaches. ||| You should drink plenty of water when you have a fever.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 孩子发高烧，需要看医生。 ||| 随着投票日的临近，选举热席卷全国。 ||| 发烧时应该多喝水。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 纤维, 构造, 纤维制品
[化] 纤维
ieltsWords.collocations: dietary fiber 膳食纤维, fiber optic 光纤, muscle fiber 肌纤维
ieltsWords.example: Foods rich in dietary fiber are good for digestion. ||| Fiber optic cables transmit data at high speeds. ||| Regular exercise helps maintain healthy muscle fibers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 富含膳食纤维的食物有助于消化。 ||| 光纤电缆以高速传输数据。 ||| 定期锻炼有助于保持健康的肌纤维。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 凶猛的, 猛烈的, 热烈的, 暴躁的
ieltsWords.collocations: fierce competition 激烈竞争, fierce attack 猛烈攻击, fierce wind 狂风
ieltsWords.example: There is fierce competition among companies to develop new technology. ||| The fierce storm caused widespread damage to the coastal area. ||| The lion is known for its fierce nature.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司之间在开发新技术方面存在激烈竞争。 ||| 猛烈的风暴对沿海地区造成了广泛的破坏。 ||| 狮子以其凶猛的天性而闻名。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 数字, 价格, 图形, 形状
vt. 描绘, 表示, 演算, 认为
vi. 计算, 出现, 估计

ieltsWords.example: She is a key figure in the field of environmental science. ||| Can you figure out the solution to this problem? ||| The report includes figures on population growth.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她是环境科学领域的关键人物。 ||| 你能想出这个问题的解决方案吗？ ||| 报告包含了人口增长的数据。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 档案, 公文箱, 文件夹, 文件, 卷宗, 锉刀
vi. 列队行进, 用锉刀做
vt. 归档, 申请, 锉, 琢磨
[计] 文件
ieltsWords.collocations: file a complaint 提出投诉, file a report 提交报告, file folder 文件夹
ieltsWords.example: Please file the documents in the appropriate folder. ||| She decided to file a complaint about the poor service. ||| The police have a file on the suspect.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请将文件归档到相应的文件夹中。 ||| 她决定就糟糕的服务提出投诉。 ||| 警方有关于嫌疑人的档案。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 滤波器, 过滤器, 滤光器, 过滤嘴, 去尘器
vt. 过滤, 渗透, 走漏
vi. 滤过, 渗入
[计] 过滤器, 筛选
ieltsWords.collocations: water filter 净水器, air filter 空气过滤器, filter out 过滤掉
ieltsWords.example: The water filter removes impurities from tap water. ||| You should change the air filter in your car regularly. ||| The software can filter out spam emails.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 净水器去除自来水中的杂质。 ||| 你应该定期更换汽车里的空气过滤器。 ||| 这个软件可以过滤掉垃圾邮件。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 污秽, 不洁, 猥亵
[法] 污秽, 污物, 淫猥
ieltsWords.collocations: live in filth 生活在肮脏中, filth and grime 污垢, moral filth 道德败坏
ieltsWords.example: The streets were covered in filth after the parade. ||| The government is taking measures to clean up the filth in the river. ||| The book was banned for its filth and obscenity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 游行过后，街道上满是污秽。 ||| 政府正在采取措施清理河流中的污物。 ||| 这本书因其淫秽内容被禁。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 期末考试, 结局, 决赛
a. 最后的, 终极的, 决定性的
ieltsWords.collocations: final exam 期末考试, final decision 最终决定, final stage 最后阶段
ieltsWords.example: The final exam will cover all the topics we studied this semester. ||| After much discussion, they reached a final decision. ||| The project is in its final stage of development.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 期末考试将涵盖我们本学期学习的所有主题。 ||| 经过多次讨论，他们做出了最终决定。 ||| 该项目处于开发的最后阶段。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 财政的, 金融的
[经] 财政的, 金融的, 财务的
ieltsWords.collocations: financial aid 经济援助, financial crisis 金融危机, financial market 金融市场
ieltsWords.example: Many students rely on financial aid to pay for college. ||| The financial crisis led to a global recession. ||| She works as a financial analyst for a large bank.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多学生依靠经济援助来支付大学费用。 ||| 金融危机导致了全球衰退。 ||| 她在一家大银行担任财务分析师。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 发现, 发现物, 决定, 裁决
[法] 调查结果, 对事实的认定, 判定的要素
ieltsWords.collocations: research findings 研究发现, key finding 关键发现, report findings 报告结果
ieltsWords.example: The research findings were published in a scientific journal. ||| One key finding of the study is that exercise improves mental health. ||| The committee will discuss the findings of the investigation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 研究结果发表在科学期刊上。 ||| 该研究的一个关键发现是运动能改善心理健康。 ||| 委员会将讨论调查结果。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 有限的, 有穷的, 限定的
n. 有限物
ieltsWords.collocations: finite resources 有限资源, finite number 有限数量, finite verb 限定动词
ieltsWords.example: We must use our finite resources wisely. ||| The universe is believed to be finite in size. ||| There is a finite number of possible combinations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们必须明智地使用有限的资源。 ||| 宇宙被认为在大小上是有限的。 ||| 可能的组合数量是有限的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 公司, 商号
a. 坚定的, 坚强的, 牢固的, 结实的, 坚硬的, 坚挺的, 严格的, 确定的
vt. 使牢固, 使坚定
vi. 变稳固, 变坚实
adv. 稳固地
ieltsWords.collocations: law firm 律师事务所, consulting firm 咨询公司, accounting firm 会计事务所
ieltsWords.example: She works for a prestigious law firm in New York. ||| The consulting firm advised the company on its expansion strategy. ||| He joined an accounting firm after graduating from university.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在纽约一家著名的律师事务所工作。 ||| 这家咨询公司为公司的扩张战略提供建议。 ||| 他大学毕业后加入了一家会计事务所。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 适合, 合宜, 合理, 恰当, 健康
[医] 适合性, 适应性
ieltsWords.collocations: fitness center 健身中心, physical fitness 身体健康, fitness test 体能测试
ieltsWords.example: Regular exercise is important for maintaining physical fitness. ||| She goes to the fitness center three times a week. ||| The job requires a high level of fitness.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 定期锻炼对保持身体健康很重要。 ||| 她每周去健身中心三次。 ||| 这份工作需要很高的体能水平。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 固定(状态), 固定物, 设备
[计] 夹具
ieltsWords.collocations: light fixture 灯具, plumbing fixture 管道设备, permanent fixture 永久固定物
ieltsWords.example: The bathroom has new plumbing fixtures. ||| He has become a permanent fixture at the local pub. ||| The light fixture in the living room needs to be replaced.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 浴室有新的管道设备。 ||| 他已成为当地酒吧的常客。 ||| 客厅的灯具需要更换。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 标志, 旗标, 旗子, 信号旗, 菖蒲
vt. 悬旗, 打旗号, 铺石板
vi. 无力地下垂
[计] 标志; 属性标记命令
ieltsWords.collocations: national flag 国旗, flag down 挥手示意停下, raise a flag 升旗
ieltsWords.example: The national flag was raised during the ceremony. ||| He flagged down a taxi to get to the airport. ||| The red flag indicates a warning for swimmers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 仪式上升起了国旗。 ||| 他挥手拦下一辆出租车去机场。 ||| 红旗表示对游泳者的警告。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 火焰, 火舌, 热情, 光辉
vt. 焚烧, 用火焰给...灭菌, 用火焰传送(信号), 点燃, 激动
vi. 燃烧, 爆发, 闪耀
[计] 无聊邮件, 无益邮件
ieltsWords.collocations: burst into flames 突然燃烧起来, flame of passion 激情之火, flame retardant 阻燃剂
ieltsWords.example: The building burst into flames within minutes. ||| His flame of passion for art never died. ||| The candle flame flickered in the breeze.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大楼在几分钟内就燃烧起来。 ||| 他对艺术的热情之火从未熄灭。 ||| 烛光在微风中闪烁。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 闪光, 闪耀
vi. 闪光, 闪耀
vt. 用发光信号发出, 使闪耀, 使张开
ieltsWords.collocations: flare up 突然爆发, solar flare 太阳耀斑, flare out 向外展开
ieltsWords.example: The conflict flared up again after a brief ceasefire. ||| The match flared briefly before going out. ||| Her temper flared when she heard the news.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 短暂停火后冲突再次爆发。 ||| 火柴短暂地燃烧后熄灭了。 ||| 她听到消息时勃然大怒。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 闪光, 闪现, 一瞬间
vi. 闪光, 闪现, 反射
vt. 使闪光, 反射
ieltsWords.collocations: flash a smile 闪现笑容, flash memory 闪存, flash of inspiration 灵光一闪
ieltsWords.example: A brilliant idea flashed through his mind. ||| The lightning flashed across the dark sky. ||| She flashed her ID card at the security guard.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一个绝妙的想法闪过他的脑海。 ||| 闪电划过黑暗的天空。 ||| 她向保安快速出示了身份证。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 缺点, 裂纹, 瑕疵, 一阵狂风
[化] 划痕; 裂缝; 裂纹
ieltsWords.collocations: design flaw 设计缺陷, fatal flaw 致命缺陷, flaw in the argument 论点中的漏洞
ieltsWords.example: There is a flaw in the diamond that reduces its value. ||| The plan had a fatal flaw that led to its failure. ||| His argument contains a logical flaw.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这颗钻石有一个瑕疵，降低了它的价值。 ||| 这个计划有一个致命缺陷，导致了它的失败。 ||| 他的论点存在逻辑漏洞。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 逃避, 逃跑, 逃走
vi. 逃, 消失
ieltsWords.collocations: flee from danger 逃离危险, flee the country 逃离国家, flee persecution 逃离迫害
ieltsWords.example: Many residents fled the city before the hurricane hit. ||| The thief fled when he saw the police. ||| They fled the war-torn region seeking safety.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多居民在飓风来袭前逃离了城市。 ||| 小偷看到警察就逃跑了。 ||| 他们逃离了战乱地区寻求安全。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 舰队, 港湾, 小河
a. 快速的, 敏捷的, 浅的, 短暂的
adv. 浅
vi. 疾驰, 飞逝, 掠过
vt. 消磨, 变换船(或船员)的位置
ieltsWords.collocations: fleet of ships 船队, fleet of vehicles 车队, merchant fleet 商船队
ieltsWords.example: The company operates a fleet of delivery trucks. ||| The naval fleet was deployed to the Pacific. ||| A fleet of taxis waited outside the airport.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司运营着一支送货卡车车队。 ||| 海军舰队被部署到太平洋。 ||| 一队出租车在机场外等候。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 肉, 肉体, 肉欲, 人性, 亲属, 人类, 众生, 人体
vt. 以肉喂, 激起...的杀戳情绪, 使肥, 赋以血肉
vi. 长胖
ieltsWords.collocations: flesh and blood 血肉之躯, in the flesh 亲自, flesh out 充实
ieltsWords.example: The wound exposed the flesh beneath the skin. ||| He is my own flesh and blood, so I must help him. ||| The author fleshed out the characters in the novel.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 伤口露出了皮肤下的肉。 ||| 他是我的亲骨肉，所以我必须帮助他。 ||| 作者充实了小说中的人物形象。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 飞行, 射程, 逃走, 飞跃, 飞机航程, 班机, 迁徙, 飞逝
vi. 迁徙
vt. 射击(飞禽), 为(箭)装上羽毛, 使惊飞
ieltsWords.collocations: flight attendant 空乘人员, flight of stairs 一段楼梯, take flight 逃走
ieltsWords.example: Our flight was delayed due to bad weather. ||| The bird took flight when it heard the noise. ||| She climbed three flights of stairs to reach her apartment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们的航班因恶劣天气延误了。 ||| 鸟听到声音就飞走了。 ||| 她爬了三段楼梯才到达公寓。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 投掷, 急冲, 嘲弄
vt. 投, 丢下, 抛弃, 使陷入, 挥动, 嘲笑, 扫视
vi. 猛冲
ieltsWords.collocations: fling open 猛地打开, fling oneself into 投身于, have a fling 放纵一下
ieltsWords.example: He flung his coat onto the chair and sat down. ||| She flung herself into her studies to forget the pain. ||| The door was flung open by the wind.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他把外套扔到椅子上坐了下来。 ||| 她全身心投入学习以忘记痛苦。 ||| 门被风猛地吹开了。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 掷, 弹, 轻击, 空翻
vi. 用指轻弹, 抽打, 蹦跳
n. 抛, 弹, 筋斗
a. 无礼的
[计] 翻转
ieltsWords.collocations: flip a coin 抛硬币, flip through 浏览, flip over 翻转
ieltsWords.example: They flipped a coin to decide who would go first. ||| She flipped through the magazine while waiting. ||| The pancake was flipped over in the pan.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们抛硬币决定谁先走。 ||| 她等待时浏览了杂志。 ||| 煎饼在锅里被翻了个面。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 漂流物, 浮舟, 漂浮, 浮萍, 彩车
vi. 浮动, 飘动, 散播, 摇摆, 动摇, 浮动
vt. 使漂浮, 容纳, 淹没, 发行, 实行
[计] 浮动
ieltsWords.collocations: float on water 浮在水上, float an idea 提出想法, float in the air 在空中漂浮
ieltsWords.example: A leaf floated gently down the stream. ||| The company decided to float its shares on the stock market. ||| He floated the idea of a team outing to boost morale.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一片叶子顺流缓缓漂浮。 ||| 公司决定在股市上市。 ||| 他提出了团队出游以提高士气的想法。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 兽群, 鸟群, 一群人, 大量, 棉束
vi. 成群而行, 聚集
vt. 用棉束填满
ieltsWords.collocations: flock of birds 一群鸟, flock of sheep 一群羊, flock to 涌向
ieltsWords.example: A flock of birds flew south for the winter. ||| Tourists flock to the beach during summer. ||| The shepherd led his flock of sheep to the pasture.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一群鸟飞往南方过冬。 ||| 夏天游客涌向海滩。 ||| 牧羊人带着他的羊群去了牧场。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 繁荣, 茂盛, 活跃, 手舞足蹈
vt. 挥舞, 夸耀
n. 挥舞, 炫耀, 茂盛, 兴旺, 华丽词藻
ieltsWords.collocations: flourish in business 生意兴隆, flourish in the wild 在野外繁茂, flourish a sword 挥舞剑
ieltsWords.example: The economy flourished after the reforms. ||| These plants flourish in a sunny environment. ||| He flourished the letter triumphantly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 改革后经济繁荣发展。 ||| 这些植物在阳光充足的环境中生长茂盛。 ||| 他得意洋洋地挥舞着那封信。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 流利的, 流畅的
ieltsWords.collocations: fluent in English 英语流利, fluent speech 流利的演讲, fluent writer 文笔流畅的作家
ieltsWords.example: She is fluent in three languages. ||| His fluent presentation impressed the audience. ||| The dancer's movements were fluent and graceful.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她能流利地说三种语言。 ||| 他流利的演讲给观众留下了深刻印象。 ||| 舞者的动作流畅而优雅。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 液体, 分泌液, 流体
a. 流动的, 可改变的
ieltsWords.collocations: body fluid 体液, brake fluid 刹车油, fluid dynamics 流体动力学
ieltsWords.example: The doctor drained the excess fluid from his lungs. ||| Water is the most common fluid on Earth. ||| The car's brake fluid needs to be checked regularly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 医生排出了他肺部多余的液体。 ||| 水是地球上最常见的流体。 ||| 汽车的刹车油需要定期检查。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 流溢, 面红, 旺盛, 发烧, 惊飞的鸟, 同花牌
a. 丰足的, 齐平的, 满盈的, 泛滥的
adv. 齐平地, 直接地
vi. 脸发红, 奔涌, 旺盛, 惊飞
vt. 淹没, 冲洗, 使脸红, 使激动, 使齐平, 使惊飞
ieltsWords.collocations: flush the toilet 冲马桶, flush with embarrassment 尴尬脸红, flush out 冲洗掉
ieltsWords.example: Remember to flush the toilet after use. ||| She flushed with embarrassment when she realized her mistake. ||| The plumber flushed out the blocked pipe.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 使用后记得冲马桶。 ||| 她意识到自己的错误时尴尬得脸红了。 ||| 水管工冲洗了堵塞的管道。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 摆动, 鼓翼, 烦扰
vi. 摆动, 鼓翼, 烦扰
vt. 拍(翅), 使焦急
[计] 颤动
ieltsWords.collocations: flutter in the wind 在风中飘动, butterfly flutter 蝴蝶振翅, heart flutter 心跳加速
ieltsWords.example: The curtains fluttered in the gentle breeze. ||| Butterflies fluttered from flower to flower. ||| Her heart fluttered with excitement when she saw him.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 窗帘在微风中飘动。 ||| 蝴蝶在花丛间飞舞。 ||| 她看到他时激动得心跳加速。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 箔, 烘托, 衬托
vt. 贴箔于, 衬托, 阻止, 挡开, 挫败
ieltsWords.collocations: foil a plot 挫败阴谋, foil an attempt 阻止企图, foil to 衬托
ieltsWords.example: The police foiled the robbery attempt. ||| Her quiet nature was a perfect foil to his loud personality. ||| The hero foiled the villain's evil plan.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方挫败了抢劫企图。 ||| 她安静的性格与他喧闹的个性形成了完美的衬托。 ||| 英雄挫败了恶棍的邪恶计划。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 最初的, 最重要的
adv. 在最前
ieltsWords.collocations: foremost expert 最重要的专家, first and foremost 首先, foremost concern 首要关注
ieltsWords.example: She is one of the foremost scientists in her field. ||| First and foremost, we need to ensure safety. ||| The foremost concern is the health of the patients.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她是她领域中最著名的科学家之一。 ||| 首先，我们需要确保安全。 ||| 首要关注的是患者的健康。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 先驱, 前兆
ieltsWords.collocations: forerunner of ...的先驱, forerunner in ...领域的先驱, be a forerunner to 是...的前身
ieltsWords.example: The steam engine was a forerunner of modern transportation. ||| These early experiments were forerunners in the field of genetics. ||| The economic downturn was a forerunner to the financial crisis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 蒸汽机是现代交通的先驱。 ||| 这些早期实验是遗传学领域的先驱。 ||| 经济衰退是金融危机的预兆。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 预见, 预知
ieltsWords.collocations: foresee the future 预见未来, foresee problems 预见问题, as foreseen 正如所预见的
ieltsWords.example: It is difficult to foresee the long-term effects of climate change. ||| The company failed to foresee the market downturn. ||| As foreseen, the new policy led to increased efficiency.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 很难预见气候变化的长期影响。 ||| 该公司未能预见市场低迷。 ||| 正如所预见的，新政策提高了效率。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 林学, 森林地
[法] 林地, 林学, 林业
ieltsWords.collocations: forestry management 林业管理, forestry industry 林业产业, sustainable forestry 可持续林业
ieltsWords.example: Sustainable forestry practices help preserve biodiversity. ||| He studied forestry at university and now works for a conservation agency. ||| The government invested in forestry to combat deforestation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 可持续的林业实践有助于保护生物多样性。 ||| 他在大学学习林业，现在一家保护机构工作。 ||| 政府投资林业以应对森林砍伐。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 没收物, 罚金, 丧失
vt. 没收, 丧失
a. 丧失了的
ieltsWords.collocations: forfeit a right 丧失权利, forfeit a deposit 没收押金, pay a forfeit 支付罚金
ieltsWords.example: If you break the rules, you may forfeit your place in the competition. ||| The company had to forfeit its illegal profits. ||| He had to pay a forfeit for arriving late.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 如果你违反规则，可能会丧失比赛资格。 ||| 该公司不得不交出非法所得。 ||| 他因迟到而支付了罚金。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 熔炉, 铁工厂
vt. 打制, 锻造, 伪造
vi. 锻造, 伪造
ieltsWords.collocations: forge a relationship 建立关系, forge ahead 稳步前进, forge a signature 伪造签名
ieltsWords.example: The two countries forged a strong economic partnership. ||| Despite difficulties, the team forged ahead with the project. ||| He was arrested for forging documents.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 两国建立了牢固的经济伙伴关系。 ||| 尽管困难重重，团队仍稳步推进项目。 ||| 他因伪造文件被捕。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 原谅, 宽恕, 免除
[法] 免除, 宽恕, 原谅
ieltsWords.collocations: forgive someone for something 原谅某人某事, forgive and forget 既往不咎, forgive a debt 免除债务
ieltsWords.example: She forgave him for his mistake. ||| It is important to learn to forgive and forget. ||| The bank forgave part of the loan.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她原谅了他的错误。 ||| 学会既往不咎很重要。 ||| 银行免除了部分贷款。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 形状, 形体, 类型, 方式, 表格, 形式
v. 形成, 排列, (使)组成
n. 表单
[计] 表单
ieltsWords.collocations: in the form of 以...的形式, fill out a form 填写表格, form a habit 养成习惯
ieltsWords.example: The information is presented in the form of a chart. ||| Please fill out this application form. ||| Regular exercise helps form healthy habits.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 信息以图表形式呈现。 ||| 请填写这份申请表。 ||| 定期锻炼有助于养成健康习惯。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 正式的, 形式的, 礼仪的, 拘于礼节的, 拘谨的
n. 正式的社交活动
ieltsWords.collocations: formal education 正规教育, formal occasion 正式场合, formal agreement 正式协议
ieltsWords.example: Formal education is important for career development. ||| A suit is appropriate for a formal occasion. ||| The two parties signed a formal agreement.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 正规教育对职业发展很重要。 ||| 西装适合正式场合。 ||| 双方签署了正式协议。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 开本, 版式, 形式, 格式
vt. 格式化
[计] 格式; DOS外部命令:对磁盘进行格式化
ieltsWords.collocations: file format 文件格式, in a different format 以不同格式, format a document 格式化文档
ieltsWords.example: The report is available in PDF format. ||| You can save the image in a different format. ||| Please format the document according to the guidelines.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 报告以PDF格式提供。 ||| 你可以以不同格式保存图像。 ||| 请按照指南格式化文档。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 从前的, 前者的
n. 起形成作用的人(或物), 模型, 样板
ieltsWords.collocations: former president 前总统, former colleague 前同事, the former 前者
ieltsWords.example: The former president gave a speech at the conference. ||| I met my former colleague at the airport. ||| Between the two options, I prefer the former.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 前总统在会议上发表了演讲。 ||| 我在机场遇到了前同事。 ||| 两个选项中，我更喜欢前者。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 巨大的, 优秀的, 可怕的, 艰难的
ieltsWords.collocations: formidable challenge 巨大挑战, formidable opponent 强大的对手, formidable task 艰巨的任务
ieltsWords.example: Climate change is a formidable challenge for humanity. ||| The team faced a formidable opponent in the final. ||| Completing the project on time was a formidable task.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 气候变化是人类面临的巨大挑战。 ||| 该队在决赛中遇到了强大的对手。 ||| 按时完成项目是一项艰巨的任务。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 客套语, 公式, 准则
[计] 公式
ieltsWords.collocations: mathematical formula 数学公式, secret formula 秘密配方, formula for success 成功秘诀
ieltsWords.example: The mathematical formula is used to calculate the area. ||| The company's secret formula gives it a competitive edge. ||| There is no simple formula for success in business.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个数学公式用于计算面积。 ||| 公司的秘密配方使其具有竞争优势。 ||| 商业成功没有简单的秘诀。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 用公式表示, 明确叙述, 制订
[机] 公式化, 公式表示
ieltsWords.collocations: formulate a plan 制定计划, formulate a theory 阐述理论, formulate a policy 制定政策
ieltsWords.example: The government formulated a new economic policy. ||| Scientists formulated a theory to explain the phenomenon. ||| We need to formulate a clear strategy for the project.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府制定了新的经济政策。 ||| 科学家阐述了一种理论来解释这一现象。 ||| 我们需要为项目制定明确的策略。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 即将来临的
n. 来临
ieltsWords.collocations: forthcoming event 即将到来的事件, forthcoming book 即将出版的书, be forthcoming with information 乐于提供信息
ieltsWords.example: The forthcoming election will determine the country's future. ||| Her forthcoming book is about climate change. ||| The witness was not forthcoming with details.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 即将到来的选举将决定国家的未来。 ||| 她即将出版的书是关于气候变化的。 ||| 证人不愿意提供细节。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 设要塞于, 加强, 使坚强, 增加
vi. 筑防御工事
ieltsWords.collocations: fortify a city 加固城市防御, fortify the immune system 增强免疫系统, fortify with vitamins 添加维生素强化
ieltsWords.example: The city was fortified with high walls. ||| Eating well can fortify your immune system. ||| The cereal is fortified with vitamins and minerals.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座城市用高墙加固。 ||| 吃得好可以增强免疫系统。 ||| 这种麦片添加了维生素和矿物质。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 两星期
ieltsWords.collocations: in a fortnight 两周后, a fortnight ago 两周前, for a fortnight 持续两周
ieltsWords.example: I will be on holiday for a fortnight. ||| The project must be completed within a fortnight. ||| She visited her parents a fortnight ago.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我将休假两周。 ||| 项目必须在两周内完成。 ||| 她两周前拜访了父母。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 论坛, 公开讨论的广场, 法庭, 讨论会
[法] 讨论会, 专题讨论, 公共论坛
ieltsWords.collocations: online forum 在线论坛, public forum 公共论坛, forum for discussion 讨论的论坛
ieltsWords.example: The online forum allows users to share ideas. ||| The conference provided a forum for debate. ||| The issue was discussed in a public forum.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在线论坛允许用户分享想法。 ||| 会议提供了一个辩论的论坛。 ||| 这个问题在公共论坛上进行了讨论。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 化石, 古物
a. 化石的, 陈腐的, 守旧的
ieltsWords.collocations: fossil fuel 化石燃料, fossil record 化石记录, living fossil 活化石
ieltsWords.example: Burning fossil fuels contributes to global warming. ||| The fossil record shows the evolution of species. ||| The coelacanth is considered a living fossil.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 燃烧化石燃料导致全球变暖。 ||| 化石记录显示了物种的进化。 ||| 腔棘鱼被认为是活化石。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 收养的, 养育的
vt. 养育, 抚育, 培养, 鼓励, 抱(希望)
ieltsWords.collocations: foster a child 收养孩子, foster development 促进发展, foster care 寄养照顾
ieltsWords.example: The program aims to foster creativity in students. ||| They decided to foster a child from the orphanage. ||| Good communication fosters a positive work environment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该项目旨在培养学生的创造力。 ||| 他们决定从孤儿院收养一个孩子。 ||| 良好的沟通促进积极的工作环境。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 污秽的, 邪恶的, 恶臭的, 肮脏的, 恶劣的, 淤塞的
vt. 弄脏, 妨害, 污蔑, 犯规, 淤塞
vi. 腐烂, 犯规, 缠结
adv. 违反规则地, 不正当地
n. 犯规, 缠绕
ieltsWords.collocations: foul play 犯规行为, foul smell 恶臭, commit a foul 犯规
ieltsWords.example: The referee called a foul on the player. ||| There was a foul smell coming from the garbage. ||| The police suspected foul play in the accident.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 裁判判该球员犯规。 ||| 垃圾堆传来恶臭。 ||| 警方怀疑事故中有犯规行为。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 水源, 源, 喷泉, 泉水, 本源
[医] 泉
ieltsWords.collocations: water fountain 饮水机, fountain pen 钢笔, fountain of youth 青春之泉
ieltsWords.example: The park has a beautiful fountain that attracts many tourists. ||| She is considered a fountain of knowledge in the field of biology. ||| The ancient city was built around a natural fountain.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公园里有一个美丽的喷泉，吸引了许多游客。 ||| 她被认为是生物学领域的知识源泉。 ||| 这座古城围绕着一个天然泉水而建。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 小部分, 破片, 分数
[医] 部分, 成分, 分散
ieltsWords.collocations: a fraction of 一小部分, fraction of a second 一瞬间, decimal fraction 小数
ieltsWords.example: Only a fraction of the population supports the new policy. ||| He solved the problem in a fraction of the time it took others. ||| The fraction 3/4 is equivalent to 0.75.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 只有一小部分人口支持这项新政策。 ||| 他只用别人所需时间的一小部分就解决了问题。 ||| 分数3/4等于0.75。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 破碎, 骨折
v. (使)破碎, (使)破裂
ieltsWords.collocations: bone fracture 骨折, stress fracture 应力性骨折, fracture zone 断裂带
ieltsWords.example: The X-ray showed a hairline fracture in his wrist. ||| The earthquake caused a fracture in the earth's crust. ||| The metal pipe fractured under the extreme pressure.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: X光片显示他的手腕有一处发丝状骨折。 ||| 地震导致地壳出现裂缝。 ||| 金属管在极端压力下断裂了。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 易碎的, 脆的
[医] 脆弱的, 脆的
ieltsWords.collocations: fragile economy 脆弱的经济, fragile ecosystem 脆弱的生态系统, fragile health 虚弱的身体
ieltsWords.example: The fragile glass vase must be handled with care. ||| The country's fragile economy is heavily dependent on foreign aid. ||| After the illness, she remained in a fragile state for weeks.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个易碎的玻璃花瓶必须小心搬运。 ||| 该国脆弱的经济严重依赖外国援助。 ||| 病后，她连续几周都处于虚弱状态。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 碎片, 破片, 片段
[计] 段落; 片段; 分段
ieltsWords.collocations: fragment of glass 玻璃碎片, fragment of memory 记忆片段, fragment into 分裂成
ieltsWords.example: Archaeologists found fragments of pottery at the site. ||| The conversation was recorded in fragments, making it hard to follow. ||| The rock fragmented into small pieces when it hit the ground.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 考古学家在现场发现了陶器碎片。 ||| 对话被片段式地记录下来，难以理解。 ||| 岩石撞击地面时碎裂成小块。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 芬芳, 香味
ieltsWords.collocations: fragrance of flowers 花香, sweet fragrance 甜香, fragrance-free 无香料的
ieltsWords.example: The fragrance of fresh coffee filled the room. ||| She prefers a light fragrance for everyday wear. ||| The garden is known for the fragrance of its roses.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新鲜咖啡的香气充满了房间。 ||| 她日常喜欢用淡香。 ||| 这个花园以其玫瑰的芬芳而闻名。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 欺骗, 欺诈, 诡计, 骗子
[经] 欺诈, 舞弊, 骗子
ieltsWords.collocations: credit card fraud 信用卡欺诈, tax fraud 税务欺诈, fraud detection 欺诈检测
ieltsWords.example: He was convicted of fraud and sentenced to five years in prison. ||| The company fell victim to an elaborate fraud scheme. ||| Online fraud is becoming increasingly common.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他被判犯有欺诈罪，入狱五年。 ||| 该公司陷入了一场精心策划的骗局。 ||| 网络欺诈变得越来越普遍。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 自由, 坦率, 特权
[法] 自由, 自主, 免除
ieltsWords.collocations: freedom of speech 言论自由, freedom of choice 选择自由, personal freedom 个人自由
ieltsWords.example: Freedom of the press is a fundamental right in a democracy. ||| She values her freedom to travel and explore new places. ||| The slaves fought for their freedom for many years.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新闻自由是民主国家的基本权利。 ||| 她珍视旅行和探索新地方的自由。 ||| 奴隶们为自由奋斗了许多年。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 船货, 运费, 货运
vt. 装货, 使充满, 以货运运送, 租(或出租)(船等)
ieltsWords.collocations: freight train 货运列车, freight charge 运费, air freight 空运
ieltsWords.example: The freight was transported by ship across the ocean. ||| Freight costs have increased due to rising fuel prices. ||| The company specializes in international freight forwarding.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 货物通过轮船跨洋运输。 ||| 由于燃料价格上涨，运费增加了。 ||| 该公司专门从事国际货运代理。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 频率, 频数
[计] 频率
ieltsWords.collocations: high frequency 高频, frequency of use 使用频率, radio frequency 无线电频率
ieltsWords.example: The frequency of earthquakes in this region is alarming. ||| The radio station broadcasts on a frequency of 100.5 MHz. ||| The frequency of his visits decreased over time.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该地区地震的频率令人担忧。 ||| 该广播电台以100.5兆赫的频率播出。 ||| 他来访的频率随着时间的推移减少了。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 时常发生的, 频繁的, 快速的
vt. 时常来访, 常常聚集, 常与...交往
ieltsWords.collocations: frequent visitor 常客, frequent occurrence 频繁发生, frequent flyer 飞行常客
ieltsWords.example: She is a frequent contributor to the local newspaper. ||| Power outages are frequent in this area during the summer. ||| He frequents the coffee shop on the corner every morning.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她是当地报纸的频繁投稿者。 ||| 这个地区夏天经常停电。 ||| 他每天早上都去街角的咖啡店。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 摩擦, 摩擦治疗, 不和
[医] 摩擦
ieltsWords.collocations: friction force 摩擦力, reduce friction 减少摩擦, cause friction 引起摩擦
ieltsWords.example: Friction between the two surfaces generates heat. ||| There has been some friction between the departments over budget allocation. ||| Oil is used to reduce friction in the engine.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 两个表面之间的摩擦产生热量。 ||| 部门之间在预算分配上存在一些摩擦。 ||| 机油用于减少发动机的摩擦。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 电冰箱
ieltsWords.collocations: fridge magnet 冰箱贴, fridge freezer 冷藏冷冻柜, fridge temperature 冰箱温度
ieltsWords.example: Please put the milk back in the fridge after use. ||| The fridge is fully stocked with fresh vegetables. ||| He opened the fridge to grab a cold drink.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 用完后请把牛奶放回冰箱。 ||| 冰箱里塞满了新鲜蔬菜。 ||| 他打开冰箱拿了一瓶冷饮。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 边缘, 端, 流苏, 穗, 初步
vt. 加穗于, 加饰边于
a. 边缘的, 附加的
ieltsWords.collocations: fringe benefit 附加福利, on the fringe 在边缘, fringe group 边缘群体
ieltsWords.example: The company offers generous fringe benefits including health insurance. ||| He lives on the fringe of the city, far from the center. ||| The festival features fringe theater performances.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司提供丰厚的附加福利，包括健康保险。 ||| 他住在城市边缘，远离市中心。 ||| 这个节日有边缘戏剧表演。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 边界, 边境
[法] 国境, 边境, 边界
ieltsWords.collocations: frontier town 边境城镇, frontier of science 科学前沿, frontier spirit 开拓精神
ieltsWords.example: The frontier between the two countries is heavily guarded. ||| Space exploration represents the new frontier of human endeavor. ||| The settlers moved westward to the frontier.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 两国之间的边境戒备森严。 ||| 太空探索代表了人类努力的新前沿。 ||| 定居者向西迁移到边疆。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 霜, 冰冻, 冷漠
vt. 覆着霜, 冻结, 结霜
vi. 受冻, 起霜
ieltsWords.collocations: frost damage 霜冻损害, frost heave 冻胀, frost-free 无霜的
ieltsWords.example: The ground was covered with a layer of frost this morning. ||| The cold weather frosted the windows of the car. ||| Farmers are worried about frost damaging their crops.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 今早地面覆盖着一层霜。 ||| 寒冷的天气使车窗结霜。 ||| 农民担心霜冻损害庄稼。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 皱眉
vi. 皱眉头
vt. 皱眉表示
ieltsWords.collocations: frown upon 不赞成, frown at 对…皱眉, deep frown 深深的皱眉
ieltsWords.example: She frowned when she heard the bad news. ||| The teacher frowned at the student's misbehavior. ||| He gave a frown of disapproval.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 听到坏消息时，她皱起了眉头。 ||| 老师对学生的行为不端皱起了眉头。 ||| 他露出不赞成的皱眉表情。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 水果, 果类, 结果
[医] 果实, 种实
ieltsWords.collocations: fruit juice 果汁, fruit tree 果树, bear fruit 结果；取得成果
ieltsWords.example: Eating fresh fruit is good for your health. ||| The tree bore fruit for the first time this year. ||| His efforts finally bore fruit when he got the promotion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 吃新鲜水果对健康有益。 ||| 这棵树今年第一次结果。 ||| 他的努力终于有了成果，他得到了晋升。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 挫败, 击败, 破坏
a. 无益的, 挫败的, 挫折的
ieltsWords.collocations: frustrate someone 使某人沮丧, feel frustrated 感到沮丧, frustrate plans 阻挠计划
ieltsWords.example: The constant delays frustrated the passengers. ||| His lack of progress frustrated his efforts to learn the language. ||| The bad weather frustrated our plans for a picnic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 不断的延误使乘客感到沮丧。 ||| 缺乏进展挫败了他学习语言的努力。 ||| 恶劣的天气使我们的野餐计划受挫。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 燃料, 木炭
vt. 加燃料, 供燃料
vi. 得到燃料
ieltsWords.collocations: fossil fuel 化石燃料, fuel consumption 燃料消耗, fuel efficiency 燃料效率
ieltsWords.example: The car runs on diesel fuel. ||| The rising prices fueled inflation. ||| The debate was fueled by conflicting reports.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这辆车使用柴油燃料。 ||| 价格上涨加剧了通货膨胀。 ||| 相互矛盾的报道加剧了辩论。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 葬礼, 出殡
ieltsWords.collocations: attend a funeral 参加葬礼, funeral service 葬礼仪式, funeral home 殡仪馆
ieltsWords.example: Many people attended the funeral to pay their last respects. ||| The funeral service was held at the local church. ||| He delivered a moving eulogy at his grandfather's funeral.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多人参加了葬礼以表达最后的敬意。 ||| 葬礼仪式在当地教堂举行。 ||| 他在祖父的葬礼上发表了感人的悼词。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 漏斗, 漏斗状的东西, 烟囱
[化] 漏斗
ieltsWords.collocations: funnel-shaped 漏斗形的, funnel cloud 漏斗云, sales funnel 销售漏斗
ieltsWords.example: She used a funnel to pour the oil into the bottle. ||| A funnel cloud was spotted near the town, indicating a possible tornado. ||| The marketing team analyzed the sales funnel to improve conversion rates.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她用漏斗把油倒进瓶子里。 ||| 镇附近发现漏斗云，表明可能有龙卷风。 ||| 营销团队分析了销售漏斗以提高转化率。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 毛皮
vt. 以毛皮制作, 使生苔, 使生水垢
vi. 生苔, 积水垢
ieltsWords.collocations: fur coat 毛皮大衣, fake fur 人造毛皮, fur trade 毛皮贸易
ieltsWords.example: The cat's fur was soft and shiny. ||| She wore a luxurious fur coat to the gala. ||| Many people now prefer fake fur to avoid animal cruelty.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 猫的毛柔软而有光泽。 ||| 她穿着一件奢华的毛皮大衣参加晚会。 ||| 许多人现在更喜欢人造毛皮以避免虐待动物。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 狂怒的, 激烈的, 吵闹的
ieltsWords.collocations: furious with sb 对某人大发雷霆, furious debate 激烈的辩论, furious pace 飞快的速度
ieltsWords.example: He was furious when he found out about the mistake. ||| There was a furious debate over the new policy. ||| The team worked at a furious pace to meet the deadline.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他发现错误后非常愤怒。 ||| 关于新政策有一场激烈的辩论。 ||| 团队以飞快的速度工作以赶上截止日期。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 火炉, 熔炉, 考验
vt. 在炉中烧
ieltsWords.collocations: blast furnace 鼓风炉, furnace room 锅炉房, furnace filter 炉子过滤器
ieltsWords.example: The furnace heats the entire building during winter. ||| Iron is smelted in a blast furnace at high temperatures. ||| The old furnace needs to be replaced with a more efficient one.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 冬天炉子给整栋楼供暖。 ||| 铁在鼓风炉中高温冶炼。 ||| 旧炉子需要换成更高效的。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 供给, 提供, 装设
[化] 供应; 供给; 配料
ieltsWords.collocations: furnish with 用...装备, furnish information 提供信息, furnish a room 布置房间
ieltsWords.example: The company will furnish all necessary equipment. ||| They furnished the apartment with modern furniture. ||| Please furnish us with your contact details.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司将提供所有必要的设备。 ||| 他们用现代家具布置了公寓。 ||| 请向我们提供您的联系方式。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 家具, 帆具
ieltsWords.collocations: piece of furniture 一件家具, furniture store 家具店, office furniture 办公家具
ieltsWords.example: They bought new furniture for the living room. ||| The antique furniture was worth a lot of money. ||| We need to assemble the furniture ourselves.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们为客厅买了新家具。 ||| 这件古董家具价值不菲。 ||| 我们需要自己组装家具。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 更远的, 此外的, 更多的
vt. 促进, 增进, 助长
adv. 更进一步地, 更远地, 此外
ieltsWords.collocations: further education 继续教育, further information 更多信息, further development 进一步发展
ieltsWords.example: We need to discuss this matter further. ||| The museum is further down the road. ||| She decided to pursue further studies abroad.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要进一步讨论这件事。 ||| 博物馆在这条路更远的地方。 ||| 她决定出国继续深造。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 愤怒, 狂暴, 狂怒的人
[医] 狂乱, 狂暴, 狂怒
ieltsWords.collocations: in a fury 愤怒地, blind fury 狂怒, fury of the storm 风暴的猛烈
ieltsWords.example: He slammed the door in a fury. ||| The fury of the hurricane caused widespread damage. ||| She couldn't contain her fury at the injustice.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他愤怒地摔门。 ||| 飓风的猛烈造成了广泛的破坏。 ||| 她无法抑制对不公正的愤怒。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 保险丝, 导火线
v. 熔化, 融合
ieltsWords.collocations: fuse together 融合在一起, blow a fuse 烧断保险丝, fuse box 保险丝盒
ieltsWords.example: The two companies decided to fuse into one. ||| The lights went out because a fuse blew. ||| The artist fused different styles in his painting.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 两家公司决定合并成一家。 ||| 灯灭了因为保险丝烧断了。 ||| 艺术家在他的画中融合了不同风格。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 熔合物, 结合, 熔合
[化] 熔融; 熔化; 聚变
ieltsWords.collocations: nuclear fusion 核聚变, fusion cuisine 融合菜, fusion of cultures 文化融合
ieltsWords.example: Nuclear fusion is a potential source of clean energy. ||| The restaurant serves fusion cuisine combining Asian and European flavors. ||| The fusion of different musical genres created a unique sound.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 核聚变是一种潜在的清洁能源。 ||| 这家餐厅提供融合亚洲和欧洲风味的融合菜。 ||| 不同音乐流派的融合创造了独特的声音。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 大惊小怪, 小题大作, 忙乱
vi. 无事自扰, 焦急, 焦燥, 忙乱
vt. 使激动, 使烦燥
ieltsWords.collocations: make a fuss 大惊小怪, fuss over 过分关心, without fuss 不麻烦地
ieltsWords.example: Don't make a fuss about such a small issue. ||| She fussed over the guests, making sure they had everything. ||| The event went smoothly without any fuss.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 不要为这么小的问题大惊小怪。 ||| 她过分关心客人，确保他们什么都有。 ||| 活动顺利进行，没有任何忙乱。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 未来, 将来
a. 将来的, 未来的
ieltsWords.collocations: in the future 在未来, bright future 光明的未来, future plans 未来计划
ieltsWords.example: We need to plan for the future. ||| She has a bright future ahead of her. ||| What are your future plans after graduation?
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要为未来做计划。 ||| 她前途光明。 ||| 你毕业后的未来计划是什么？

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 银河, 星系, 一群(显赫的人物)
[电] 银河系
ieltsWords.collocations: spiral galaxy 螺旋星系, galaxy of stars 群星, galaxy of talent 人才济济
ieltsWords.example: The Milky Way is the galaxy that contains our solar system. ||| There is a galaxy of stars in the night sky. ||| The conference attracted a galaxy of experts from around the world.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 银河系是包含我们太阳系的星系。 ||| 夜空中有一群星星。 ||| 会议吸引了来自世界各地的一群专家。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 走廊, 最高楼座, 画廊, 收集, 图库
[计] 图库
ieltsWords.collocations: art gallery 美术馆, gallery opening 画廊开幕, shooting gallery 射击场
ieltsWords.example: The art gallery exhibits works by local artists. ||| We walked along the long gallery of the palace. ||| The public gallery was full during the trial.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 美术馆展出当地艺术家的作品。 ||| 我们沿着宫殿的长廊走。 ||| 审判期间旁听席坐满了人。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 缝隙, 缺口, 间断, 间距, 通用汇编程序
vt. 打开缺口, 造成缝隙
vi. 豁开
[计] 通用汇编程序, 图形应用程序, 间距
ieltsWords.collocations: generation gap 代沟, gap year 间隔年, bridge the gap 弥合差距
ieltsWords.example: There is a wide gap between the rich and the poor. ||| She took a gap year to travel before university. ||| We need to bridge the gap in communication.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 贫富之间存在巨大差距。 ||| 她上大学前休了一年间隔年去旅行。 ||| 我们需要弥合沟通上的差距。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 车库, 汽车修理厂, 机库
vt. 把车送入修车场
ieltsWords.collocations: garage sale 车库拍卖, garage door 车库门, parking garage 停车场
ieltsWords.example: He parked his car in the garage. ||| The mechanic works at a local garage. ||| They held a garage sale to get rid of old items.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他把车停在车库里。 ||| 机械师在当地一家修车厂工作。 ||| 他们举办了一场车库拍卖来处理旧物。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 垃圾, 废物
[计] 无用信息
ieltsWords.collocations: garbage can 垃圾桶, garbage disposal 垃圾处理, garbage truck 垃圾车
ieltsWords.example: Please take out the garbage before it starts to smell. ||| The garbage truck comes every Monday morning. ||| Don't believe everything you read; some of it is just garbage.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请把垃圾拿出去，免得发臭。 ||| 垃圾车每周一早上来。 ||| 不要相信你读到的一切；有些只是废话。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 花园, 果园, 菜园
vi. 栽培花木
vt. 造园
a. 花园的, 普通的
ieltsWords.collocations: botanical garden 植物园, garden party 花园派对, garden shed 花园小屋
ieltsWords.example: She grows vegetables in her garden. ||| The botanical garden has a wide variety of plants. ||| They hosted a garden party for their anniversary.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在菜园里种蔬菜。 ||| 植物园里有各种各样的植物。 ||| 他们为结婚纪念日举办了一场花园派对。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 衣服, 衣装, 外表
ieltsWords.collocations: garment industry 服装工业, garment factory 服装厂, protective garment 防护服
ieltsWords.example: The garment industry employs many workers in developing countries. ||| She designs garments for a famous fashion brand. ||| Workers must wear protective garments in the laboratory.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 服装工业雇佣了许多发展中国家的工人。 ||| 她为一家著名时尚品牌设计服装。 ||| 工人在实验室必须穿防护服。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 喘气
vi. 喘气, 喘息, 渴望
vt. 气喘吁吁地说
ieltsWords.collocations: gasp for breath 喘不过气来, gasp in surprise 惊讶地倒吸一口气, last gasp 最后一口气
ieltsWords.example: She gasped for air after running up the stairs. ||| The audience gasped in shock at the magician's trick. ||| He let out a gasp of pain when he stubbed his toe.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她跑上楼梯后喘不过气来。 ||| 观众对魔术师的把戏惊讶得倒吸一口气。 ||| 他踢到脚趾时痛得倒抽一口气。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 标准度量, 计量器
vt. 精确计量, 估计
[计] 线规
ieltsWords.collocations: fuel gauge 油量表, pressure gauge 压力计, gauge the situation 评估形势
ieltsWords.example: The fuel gauge indicated that the tank was almost empty. ||| We need to gauge public opinion before making a decision. ||| The thickness of the wire is measured by a gauge.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 油量表显示油箱几乎空了。 ||| 在做决定之前，我们需要评估公众意见。 ||| 电线的厚度用标准尺寸测量。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 齿轮, 工具
vt. 以齿轮连起, 开动, 使适应, 安排
vi. 连接上, 适合
ieltsWords.collocations: change gear 换挡, camping gear 露营装备, gear up 准备好
ieltsWords.example: He shifted into a lower gear to climb the hill. ||| Make sure you have all the necessary gear for the hike. ||| The company is gearing up for the product launch.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他换到低挡以爬上山坡。 ||| 确保你有徒步旅行所需的所有装备。 ||| 公司正在为产品发布做准备。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 性
vt. 产生
ieltsWords.collocations: gender equality 性别平等, gender gap 性别差距, gender identity 性别认同
ieltsWords.example: The study examined gender differences in communication styles. ||| Gender equality is a fundamental human right. ||| The company promotes diversity regardless of gender.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这项研究考察了沟通风格上的性别差异。 ||| 性别平等是一项基本人权。 ||| 公司提倡不分性别的多样性。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 基因
[化] 基因(遗传因子)
ieltsWords.collocations: gene mutation 基因突变, gene therapy 基因治疗, dominant gene 显性基因
ieltsWords.example: Scientists have identified the gene responsible for the disease. ||| Gene therapy offers hope for treating genetic disorders. ||| Each person inherits genes from both parents.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 科学家已经确定了导致这种疾病的基因。 ||| 基因治疗为治疗遗传性疾病带来了希望。 ||| 每个人从父母双方继承基因。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 一般, 将军, 大体
a. 全面的, 大体的, 总的, 一般的, 普遍的
n. 常规
[计] 常规
ieltsWords.collocations: in general 一般来说, general public 公众, general manager 总经理
ieltsWords.example: In general, the weather is mild in this region. ||| The general public is concerned about environmental issues. ||| He was promoted to general after years of service.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一般来说，这个地区气候温和。 ||| 公众对环境问题感到担忧。 ||| 他服役多年后晋升为将军。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 一般化, 概括, 推广
vi. 形成概念, 笼统讲
ieltsWords.collocations: generalize from 从...中概括, generalize about 对...进行概括, overgeneralize 过度概括
ieltsWords.example: It is dangerous to generalize from a small sample. ||| The findings can be generalized to other populations. ||| We should not generalize about people based on stereotypes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 从小样本中概括是危险的。 ||| 这些发现可以推广到其他人群。 ||| 我们不应该基于刻板印象对人进行概括。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 属类的, 一般的
[计] 一般的
ieltsWords.collocations: generic drug 仿制药, generic term 通用术语, generic brand 普通品牌
ieltsWords.example: The doctor prescribed a generic version of the medication. ||| 'Furniture' is a generic term for items like tables and chairs. ||| Generic brands are often cheaper than name brands.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 医生开了这种药的仿制药。 ||| '家具'是桌子、椅子等物品的通用术语。 ||| 普通品牌通常比名牌便宜。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 创始的, 遗传的, 起源的, 遗传学的
[医] 生殖的, 遗传的
ieltsWords.collocations: genetic engineering 基因工程, genetic disorder 遗传性疾病, genetic code 遗传密码
ieltsWords.example: Genetic engineering has the potential to cure many diseases. ||| The child inherited a genetic disorder from his parents. ||| Scientists are decoding the genetic code of various species.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 基因工程有潜力治愈许多疾病。 ||| 这个孩子从父母那里遗传了一种遗传性疾病。 ||| 科学家正在解码各种物种的遗传密码。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 天才, 天赋, 精神, 神魔
[医] 特征
ieltsWords.collocations: a genius for 有...的天赋, work of genius 天才之作, sheer genius 纯粹的天才
ieltsWords.example: Einstein was a genius in the field of physics. ||| She has a genius for solving complex problems. ||| The painting is considered a work of genius.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 爱因斯坦是物理学领域的天才。 ||| 她有解决复杂问题的天赋。 ||| 这幅画被认为是天才之作。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 温和的, 文雅的
ieltsWords.collocations: gentle breeze 微风, gentle touch 轻柔的触摸, gentle nature 温和的性情
ieltsWords.example: A gentle breeze blew through the trees. ||| She gave the baby a gentle touch on the cheek. ||| He is known for his gentle nature and kindness.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一阵微风吹过树林。 ||| 她轻轻地摸了摸婴儿的脸颊。 ||| 他以温和的性情和善良而闻名。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 真正的, 真实的, 诚恳的
[医] 真性的
ieltsWords.collocations: genuine interest 真正的兴趣, genuine concern 真诚的关心, genuine leather 真皮
ieltsWords.example: She showed genuine interest in learning new languages. ||| His apology seemed genuine and heartfelt. ||| The handbag is made of genuine leather.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对学习新语言表现出真正的兴趣。 ||| 他的道歉显得真诚而发自内心。 ||| 这个手提包是真皮制成的。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 地理(学)的, 地区(性)的
ieltsWords.collocations: geographic location 地理位置, geographic distribution 地理分布, geographic features 地理特征
ieltsWords.example: The geographic location of the city makes it a major port. ||| The study examined the geographic distribution of the species. ||| Mountains and rivers are important geographic features.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座城市的地理位置使其成为主要港口。 ||| 这项研究考察了该物种的地理分布。 ||| 山脉和河流是重要的地理特征。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 地理学, 地理
[医] 地理
ieltsWords.collocations: human geography 人文地理, physical geography 自然地理, geography lesson 地理课
ieltsWords.example: She is studying geography at university. ||| Physical geography deals with natural features like mountains and rivers. ||| The geography of the region influences its climate.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在大学学习地理学。 ||| 自然地理学研究山脉和河流等自然特征。 ||| 该地区的地理影响其气候。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 地质学, 地质情况
ieltsWords.collocations: structural geology 构造地质学, geology department 地质系, geology field trip 地质实地考察
ieltsWords.example: Geology helps us understand the Earth's history. ||| The geology of the area is rich in minerals. ||| He majored in geology and now works for an oil company.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 地质学帮助我们了解地球的历史。 ||| 该地区的地质富含矿物。 ||| 他主修地质学，现在一家石油公司工作。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 几何学
[机] 几何学
ieltsWords.collocations: analytic geometry 解析几何, geometry problem 几何问题, plane geometry 平面几何
ieltsWords.example: Geometry is an important branch of mathematics. ||| The students are learning about angles in geometry class. ||| The building's design incorporates interesting geometry.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 几何学是数学的一个重要分支。 ||| 学生们在几何课上学习角度。 ||| 这座建筑的设计融入了有趣的几何形状。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 细菌, 种子, 生殖细胞, 根源
[医] 芽胞, 胚, 胚芽, 病菌
ieltsWords.collocations: germ theory 细菌理论, germ cell 生殖细胞, germ of an idea 想法的萌芽
ieltsWords.example: Washing hands helps prevent the spread of germs. ||| The germ of the idea came from a conversation with a friend. ||| Germ cells are involved in reproduction.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 洗手有助于防止细菌传播。 ||| 这个想法的萌芽来自与朋友的谈话。 ||| 生殖细胞参与繁殖。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 手势, 姿态
vi. 作手势, 作姿态
ieltsWords.collocations: make a gesture 做手势, symbolic gesture 象征性姿态, gesture of goodwill 善意的表示
ieltsWords.example: He made a gesture to indicate that he agreed. ||| The donation was a gesture of goodwill. ||| She gestured for him to come closer.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他做了一个手势表示同意。 ||| 这笔捐款是善意的表示。 ||| 她示意他靠近些。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 巨人般的, 巨大的
ieltsWords.collocations: gigantic task 巨大的任务, gigantic statue 巨大的雕像, gigantic effort 巨大的努力
ieltsWords.example: The construction of the bridge was a gigantic task. ||| They erected a gigantic statue in the city square. ||| Making the film required a gigantic effort from the crew.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座桥的建造是一项巨大的任务。 ||| 他们在城市广场上竖立了一座巨大的雕像。 ||| 制作这部电影需要剧组的巨大努力。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 要点, 要旨, 依据
[法] 依据, 要旨, 要点
ieltsWords.collocations: get the gist 抓住要点, main gist 主要大意, gist of the argument 争论的要点
ieltsWords.example: I didn't understand every word, but I got the gist of the speech. ||| The gist of the article is that climate change is urgent. ||| Can you summarize the gist of the discussion?
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我没有听懂每个词，但我抓住了演讲的要点。 ||| 文章的主旨是气候变化很紧迫。 ||| 你能总结一下讨论的要点吗？

ieltsWords.definition: n. 冰川
ieltsWords.collocations: glacier melting 冰川融化, glacier retreat 冰川退缩, alpine glacier 高山冰川
ieltsWords.example: The glacier has been retreating rapidly due to global warming. ||| Scientists are studying the glacier's movement to predict sea level rise. ||| The stunning blue ice of the glacier attracts many tourists.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于全球变暖，冰川正在迅速退缩。 ||| 科学家正在研究冰川的运动以预测海平面上升。 ||| 冰川令人惊叹的蓝冰吸引了众多游客。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 魅力, 迷人的美, 魔法
vt. 迷惑
ieltsWords.collocations: glamour industry 魅力产业, glamour model 魅力模特, touch of glamour 一丝魅力
ieltsWords.example: The city's nightlife has a certain glamour that draws young people. ||| She was captivated by the glamour of Hollywood. ||| The fashion show was full of glamour and excitement.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座城市的夜生活有一种吸引年轻人的魅力。 ||| 她被好莱坞的魅力所吸引。 ||| 时装秀充满了魅力和兴奋。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 腺, 密封套
[化] 衬片; 密封垫
ieltsWords.collocations: sweat gland 汗腺, thyroid gland 甲状腺, pituitary gland 脑垂体
ieltsWords.example: The sweat glands help regulate body temperature. ||| The thyroid gland produces hormones that control metabolism. ||| A malfunctioning gland can lead to various health issues.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 汗腺有助于调节体温。 ||| 甲状腺产生控制新陈代谢的激素。 ||| 腺体功能失调可能导致各种健康问题。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 闪耀光, 刺眼
vi. 发眩光, 瞪视
vt. 瞪眼表示
ieltsWords.collocations: glare at 怒视, glare of the sun 刺眼的阳光, reduce glare 减少眩光
ieltsWords.example: He glared at the driver who cut him off. ||| The glare from the snow made it hard to see. ||| Polarized sunglasses can reduce glare effectively.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他怒视着那个强行超车的司机。 ||| 雪地的反光让人难以看清。 ||| 偏光太阳镜可以有效减少眩光。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 玻璃, 玻璃杯, 透镜
vt. 装玻璃于, 反射, 反映
vi. 成玻璃状
ieltsWords.collocations: glass bottle 玻璃瓶, glass of water 一杯水, glass ceiling 玻璃天花板（比喻）
ieltsWords.example: The window is made of tempered glass for safety. ||| She poured herself a glass of orange juice. ||| Many women face a glass ceiling in corporate leadership.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 窗户由钢化玻璃制成，以确保安全。 ||| 她给自己倒了一杯橙汁。 ||| 许多女性在企业领导层面临玻璃天花板。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 光束, 微光, 反光
vi. 闪烁, 隐约地闪现
vt. 使发微光, 使闪烁
ieltsWords.collocations: gleam of light 一线光, gleam with 闪烁着, gleam in the dark 在黑暗中闪烁
ieltsWords.example: The polished floor gleamed under the chandelier. ||| A gleam of hope appeared in his eyes. ||| The car's headlights gleamed in the fog.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 抛光的地板在吊灯下闪闪发光。 ||| 他眼中闪过一丝希望。 ||| 汽车的前灯在雾中闪烁。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 滑动, 滑过, 流水
vi. 滑动, 滑翔, 溜走, 流逝
vt. 使滑动
ieltsWords.collocations: glide through 滑过, glide across 滑过, glide path 滑翔路径
ieltsWords.example: The swan glided gracefully across the lake. ||| The skater glided effortlessly on the ice. ||| The plane began to glide down to the runway.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 天鹅优雅地滑过湖面。 ||| 滑冰者在冰上毫不费力地滑行。 ||| 飞机开始滑向跑道。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 一瞥, 一闪
vi. 投以一瞥, 闪烁不定
vt. 瞥见
ieltsWords.collocations: catch a glimpse of 瞥见, brief glimpse 短暂一瞥, glimpse into 一瞥
ieltsWords.example: I caught a glimpse of the celebrity as she entered the building. ||| The documentary offers a glimpse into the lives of polar bears. ||| He glimpsed at the letter before putting it away.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 那位名人进入大楼时我瞥见了她。 ||| 这部纪录片让人一窥北极熊的生活。 ||| 他瞥了一眼信，然后把它收了起来。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 抑沉的, 忧闷的, 黑暗的, 悲观的
ieltsWords.collocations: gloomy weather 阴沉的天气, gloomy mood 忧郁的心情, gloomy outlook 悲观的前景
ieltsWords.example: The gloomy sky threatened rain all day. ||| He felt gloomy after receiving the bad news. ||| The economic forecast remains gloomy for the next quarter.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 阴沉的天空预示着整天都会下雨。 ||| 收到坏消息后他感到忧郁。 ||| 下一季度的经济前景仍然悲观。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 专业词典, 术语集, 词表
[计] 图文集
ieltsWords.collocations: glossary of terms 术语表, technical glossary 技术词汇表, glossary entry 词条
ieltsWords.example: The textbook includes a glossary at the end. ||| Please refer to the glossary for definitions of key terms. ||| The website provides a glossary of financial terms.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 教科书末尾附有词汇表。 ||| 请参考词汇表了解关键术语的定义。 ||| 该网站提供了金融术语词汇表。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 赤热, 光辉, 热情, 热烈, 红光
vi. 发红光, 红光焕发, 发热, 洋溢, 激动
ieltsWords.collocations: glow with 因...发光, warm glow 温暖的光芒, glow of health 健康的光泽
ieltsWords.example: The embers glowed in the fireplace. ||| Her skin glowed with health after the vacation. ||| The city lights glowed in the distance.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 余烬在壁炉中发光。 ||| 度假后她的皮肤焕发着健康的光泽。 ||| 城市的灯光在远处闪烁。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 目标, 终点, 得分, 球门, 守门员
vi. 攻门, 射门得分
ieltsWords.collocations: set a goal 设定目标, achieve a goal 实现目标, career goal 职业目标
ieltsWords.example: Her goal is to become a doctor. ||| The team scored a goal in the final minute. ||| Setting realistic goals is important for success.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她的目标是成为一名医生。 ||| 球队在最后一分钟进了一球。 ||| 设定现实的目标对成功很重要。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 华丽的, 灿烂的
ieltsWords.collocations: gorgeous view 壮丽的景色, gorgeous dress 华丽的连衣裙, gorgeous weather 极好的天气
ieltsWords.example: The sunset was absolutely gorgeous. ||| She wore a gorgeous gown to the party. ||| We had gorgeous weather during our vacation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 日落绝对壮丽。 ||| 她穿了一件华丽的礼服去参加派对。 ||| 我们度假期间天气极好。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 闲聊, 随笔, 流言, 爱讲闲话的人
vi. 说闲话, 闲聊
ieltsWords.collocations: spread gossip 散布谣言, idle gossip 无聊的闲话, gossip column 八卦专栏
ieltsWords.example: She loves to gossip about her neighbors. ||| Don't believe everything you hear in gossip. ||| The magazine is full of celebrity gossip.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她喜欢说邻居的闲话。 ||| 不要相信你在八卦中听到的一切。 ||| 这本杂志充满了名人八卦。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 政府, 内阁
[经] 政府, 政治, 政体
ieltsWords.collocations: government policy 政府政策, government agency 政府机构, local government 地方政府
ieltsWords.example: The government has introduced new environmental regulations. ||| She works for the local government. ||| The government is responsible for public services.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府出台了新的环境法规。 ||| 她在地方政府工作。 ||| 政府负责公共服务。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 抓握, 掠夺, 强占, 东方沿岸帆船
vi. 抓取, 抢去
vt. 攫取, 捕获, 霸占
ieltsWords.collocations: grab a bite 随便吃点, grab hold of 抓住, grab attention 吸引注意
ieltsWords.example: He grabbed my arm to stop me from falling. ||| Let's grab a coffee before the meeting. ||| The headline grabbed my attention immediately.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他抓住我的胳膊以防我摔倒。 ||| 开会前我们随便喝杯咖啡吧。 ||| 这个标题立刻吸引了我的注意。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 优雅, 风度, 慈悲, 恩惠, 体面, 赦免, 恩典, 谢恩祷告
vt. 使优美
ieltsWords.collocations: with grace 优雅地, grace period 宽限期, social graces 社交礼仪
ieltsWords.example: She danced with grace and poise. ||| The bank gave me a grace period of one month. ||| He graced the occasion with his presence.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她舞姿优雅而从容。 ||| 银行给了我一个月的宽限期。 ||| 他的出席为活动增光添彩。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 亲切的, 慈善的
ieltsWords.collocations: gracious host 亲切的主人, gracious manner 和蔼的态度, gracious living 优雅的生活
ieltsWords.example: The host was gracious and welcoming. ||| She thanked him with a gracious smile. ||| The hotel offers gracious accommodations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 主人亲切而热情。 ||| 她带着优雅的微笑向他道谢。 ||| 这家酒店提供优雅的住宿。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 等级, 年级, 阶段, 成绩, 程度, 坡度, 斜坡
vt. 分等, 分级, 评分
vi. 属于某等级, 逐渐变化
ieltsWords.collocations: grade point average 平均绩点, high-grade 高级的, grade school 小学
ieltsWords.example: She received a grade of A on the exam. ||| The eggs are sorted by grade. ||| Teachers grade students' work fairly.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她考试得了A。 ||| 鸡蛋按等级分类。 ||| 老师公平地评分学生的作业。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 谷粒, 颗粒, 谷类, 纹理, 本质
v. (使)成谷粒
ieltsWords.collocations: grain of rice 米粒, grain of truth 一丝真相, wood grain 木纹
ieltsWords.example: The farmer harvested the grain in autumn. ||| There is a grain of truth in his story. ||| The table has a beautiful wood grain.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 农民在秋天收割谷物。 ||| 他的故事中有一丝真相。 ||| 这张桌子有漂亮的木纹。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 庄重的, 壮观的, 显赫的, 重大的, 最高的, 雄伟的, 宏大的, 豪华的, 傲慢的
[法] 重大的, 主要的, 伟大的
ieltsWords.collocations: grand plan 宏伟计划, grand total 总计, grand gesture 大方的姿态
ieltsWords.example: The grand palace attracted thousands of tourists every year. ||| They made a grand entrance at the party. ||| The grand total of the expenses was over ten thousand dollars.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 宏伟的宫殿每年吸引成千上万的游客。 ||| 他们在派对上隆重登场。 ||| 费用的总计超过一万美元。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 授予, 授予物, 允许
vt. 允许, 承认, 授与
[计] 授权命令
ieltsWords.collocations: grant permission 授予许可, research grant 研究经费, take for granted 视为理所当然
ieltsWords.example: The government granted funds to support the new project. ||| She was granted a scholarship to study abroad. ||| We often take clean water for granted.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府拨款支持新项目。 ||| 她获得了出国留学的奖学金。 ||| 我们常常认为清洁的水是理所当然的。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 曲线图, 图表, 图形
[计] 图形
ieltsWords.collocations: line graph 折线图, bar graph 条形图, graph paper 坐标纸
ieltsWords.example: The graph shows a steady increase in sales over the year. ||| Please graph the data to make it easier to understand. ||| The line graph illustrates the temperature changes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 图表显示全年销售额稳步增长。 ||| 请将数据用图表表示，以便更容易理解。 ||| 折线图说明了温度的变化。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 生动的, 轮廓分明的, 绘画似的, 图解的
[计] 图形的
ieltsWords.collocations: graphic design 平面设计, graphic novel 图像小说, graphic description 生动的描述
ieltsWords.example: She works as a graphic designer for a publishing company. ||| The report included several graphics to illustrate the points. ||| He gave a graphic account of the accident.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在一家出版公司担任平面设计师。 ||| 报告包含几个图表来说明要点。 ||| 他生动地描述了事故经过。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 感激之情
ieltsWords.collocations: express gratitude 表达感激, deep gratitude 深深的感激, with gratitude 怀着感激
ieltsWords.example: I would like to express my sincere gratitude for your help. ||| She felt a deep gratitude towards her mentor. ||| He accepted the award with gratitude.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我想对你的帮助表示衷心的感谢。 ||| 她对导师怀有深深的感激之情。 ||| 他怀着感激接受了奖项。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 墓穴, 坟墓, 终结, 死亡
a. 庄重的, 严肃的, 重大的, 低沉的
vt. 雕刻
ieltsWords.collocations: grave concern 严重关切, grave situation 严峻形势, grave mistake 严重错误
ieltsWords.example: The grave was marked with a simple stone. ||| The doctor's face looked grave as he delivered the news. ||| This is a grave matter that requires immediate attention.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 坟墓上有一块简单的石碑。 ||| 医生在传达消息时表情严肃。 ||| 这是一个需要立即关注的严重问题。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 地心引力, 重力
[化] 重力
ieltsWords.collocations: center of gravity 重心, gravity of the situation 情况的严重性, law of gravity 万有引力定律
ieltsWords.example: Newton discovered the law of gravity. ||| The gravity of the problem was not fully understood. ||| The center of gravity of the object is located here.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 牛顿发现了万有引力定律。 ||| 问题的严重性没有被完全理解。 ||| 物体的重心位于此处。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 脂肪, 兽脂, 油脂, 贿赂
vt. 涂脂于, 贿赂
ieltsWords.collocations: grease the wheels 使顺利进行, elbow grease 费力的工作, grease stain 油渍
ieltsWords.example: The mechanic applied grease to the bearings. ||| You need to grease the pan before baking. ||| Money can grease the wheels of bureaucracy.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 机械师给轴承上了润滑油。 ||| 烤之前你需要给锅涂油。 ||| 金钱可以使官僚机构运转顺畅。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 贪婪的, 贪得的, 贪吃的
ieltsWords.collocations: greedy for power 贪图权力, greedy person 贪婪的人, greedy algorithm 贪心算法
ieltsWords.example: The greedy businessman exploited his workers. ||| She is greedy for attention and always seeks praise. ||| The greedy algorithm finds a local optimum but not necessarily the global one.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 那个贪婪的商人剥削他的工人。 ||| 她渴望关注，总是寻求表扬。 ||| 贪心算法找到局部最优解，但不一定是全局最优。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 绿色, 绿色颜料
a. 绿色的, 未成熟的, 新鲜的, 青春的, 无经验的, 脸色发青的
ieltsWords.collocations: green energy 绿色能源, green space 绿地, green hand 新手
ieltsWords.example: The city has many parks and green spaces. ||| He is still green at this job. ||| We should use more green energy to protect the environment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个城市有许多公园和绿地。 ||| 他对这份工作还不熟练。 ||| 我们应该使用更多绿色能源来保护环境。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 伤心, 忧愁, 悲痛, 不幸, 灾难
ieltsWords.collocations: deep grief 深深的悲伤, grief-stricken 悲痛欲绝, come to grief 遭遇不幸
ieltsWords.example: She was overcome with grief after losing her pet. ||| The family was grief-stricken by the news. ||| His plans came to grief when the funding was cut.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 失去宠物后，她悲痛不已。 ||| 这家人被这个消息弄得悲痛欲绝。 ||| 资金削减后，他的计划遭遇了失败。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使悲伤
vi. 悲痛, 伤心
ieltsWords.collocations: grieve for 为…悲伤, grieve over 因…而悲伤, grieve deeply 深感悲痛
ieltsWords.example: It grieves me to see you so unhappy. ||| They are still grieving for their lost son. ||| She grieved over the death of her grandmother.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 看到你这么不开心，我很伤心。 ||| 他们仍在为失去的儿子哀悼。 ||| 她因祖母去世而悲痛。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 烤架, 铁格子, 烤肉
v. 烧, 烤, 严加盘问, 给...装栅栏
ieltsWords.collocations: grill pan 烤盘, grill the steak 烤牛排, grill the suspect 盘问嫌疑人
ieltsWords.example: We cooked burgers on the grill. ||| He grilled the chicken until it was golden brown. ||| The police grilled him for hours about the crime.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们在烤架上做了汉堡。 ||| 他把鸡肉烤到金黄色。 ||| 警方就这起犯罪盘问了他几个小时。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 磨, 碾, 苦差, 摩擦声, 用功的学生
vt. 磨擦, 磨碎, 磨光, 折磨, 压榨
vi. 磨, 磨碎, 苦干
ieltsWords.collocations: grind coffee 磨咖啡, grind down 磨平, daily grind 日常苦工
ieltsWords.example: She grinds fresh coffee beans every morning. ||| The poverty ground down their spirits. ||| He is tired of the daily grind of commuting.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她每天早上磨新鲜的咖啡豆。 ||| 贫困消磨了他们的精神。 ||| 他厌倦了每天通勤的苦差事。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 紧握, 柄, 握力, 握手方式, 手提包, 掌握, 支配, 控制
vt. 抓紧, 抱住, 吸住, 掌握
vi. 握牢, 有吸引力
ieltsWords.collocations: get a grip 控制住, lose grip 失去控制, grip the audience 吸引观众
ieltsWords.example: He tightened his grip on the rope. ||| The speaker's words gripped the audience's attention. ||| She needs to get a grip on her emotions.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他抓紧了绳子。 ||| 演讲者的话吸引了观众的注意力。 ||| 她需要控制自己的情绪。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 总数, 总量
a. 总共的, 未打折扣的, 恶劣的, 粗野的
vt. 总共收入
ieltsWords.collocations: gross income 总收入, gross profit 毛利润, gross behavior 粗俗行为
ieltsWords.example: The company's gross profit increased by 10%. ||| That's gross! Don't eat food off the floor. ||| The movie grossed over $100 million worldwide.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司的毛利润增长了10%。 ||| 真恶心！别吃地板上的食物。 ||| 这部电影全球总收入超过1亿美元。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 土地, 战场, 场地, 地面, 范围
a. 土地的, 地面上的
vt. 放在地上, 使搁浅, 打基础, 给...以训练
vi. 搁浅, 落地, 根据, 基于
a. 磨过的
grind的过去式和过去分词
ieltsWords.collocations: ground floor 底层, common ground 共同点, ground rules 基本规则
ieltsWords.example: The plane was grounded due to bad weather. ||| We found common ground on the issue. ||| The theory is grounded in solid evidence.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于天气恶劣，飞机停飞了。 ||| 我们在这个问题上找到了共同点。 ||| 这个理论基于坚实的证据。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 生长, 栽培, 增长
[计] 等比级数
ieltsWords.collocations: economic growth 经济增长, population growth 人口增长, personal growth 个人成长
ieltsWords.example: The country has experienced rapid economic growth. ||| Adequate nutrition is essential for children's growth. ||| The company is focusing on sustainable growth.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个国家经历了快速的经济增长。 ||| 充足的营养对儿童成长至关重要。 ||| 公司正专注于可持续发展。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 看守者, 监护人, 保护人
a. 保护的
ieltsWords.collocations: legal guardian 法定监护人, guardian angel 守护天使, guardian of the law 法律的捍卫者
ieltsWords.example: The court appointed her as the legal guardian of the child. ||| He acted as a guardian of the environment. ||| My grandmother was my guardian after my parents died.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 法院指定她为孩子的法定监护人。 ||| 他充当了环境的保护者。 ||| 父母去世后，祖母是我的监护人。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 指导, 领导
[医] 导
ieltsWords.collocations: guidance counselor 指导顾问, career guidance 职业指导, under the guidance of 在…的指导下
ieltsWords.example: Students can seek guidance from their teachers. ||| The project was completed under the guidance of an expert. ||| She provided career guidance to young professionals.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生可以向老师寻求指导。 ||| 该项目在专家的指导下完成。 ||| 她为年轻专业人士提供职业指导。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 引导者, 导游, 指南, 路标
vt. 指导, 支配, 管理, 带领, 操纵
vi. 任向导
[计] 辅助线
ieltsWords.collocations: tour guide 导游, guide book 指南, guide sb through 引导某人通过
ieltsWords.example: A tour guide led us through the ancient city. ||| This book will guide you through the process of applying for a visa. ||| The guide provides useful tips for travelers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一位导游带领我们穿过了古城。 ||| 这本书将指导你完成签证申请的过程。 ||| 这本指南为旅行者提供了有用的建议。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 指导路线, 方针, 指标
[经] 指导路线, 方针, 准则
ieltsWords.collocations: follow guidelines 遵循准则, safety guidelines 安全指南, set guidelines 制定指导方针
ieltsWords.example: The government issued new guidelines for environmental protection. ||| All employees must follow the safety guidelines. ||| The guidelines help teachers design effective lessons.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府发布了新的环境保护指导方针。 ||| 所有员工必须遵守安全指南。 ||| 这些准则帮助教师设计有效的课程。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 吉他
ieltsWords.collocations: play the guitar 弹吉他, acoustic guitar 原声吉他, electric guitar 电吉他
ieltsWords.example: He has been playing the guitar since he was a child. ||| She bought an acoustic guitar for her music class. ||| The electric guitar produced a loud, distorted sound.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他从小就开始弹吉他。 ||| 她为音乐课买了一把原声吉他。 ||| 电吉他发出了响亮而失真的声音。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 突然一阵, 趣味, 爱好
ieltsWords.collocations: a gust of wind 一阵风, gust of anger 一阵怒火, sudden gust 突然的一阵风
ieltsWords.example: A sudden gust of wind blew the papers off the desk. ||| He felt a gust of anger when he heard the news. ||| The gust of wind was strong enough to knock over the sign.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 突然一阵风把文件从桌子上吹走了。 ||| 听到这个消息，他感到一阵怒火。 ||| 那阵强风足以吹倒标志牌。

ieltsWords.definition: n. +体育馆, 体育训练, 体育课, 体操
ieltsWords.collocations: go to the gym 去健身房, gym equipment 健身器材, gym class 体育课
ieltsWords.example: I go to the gym three times a week to stay fit. ||| The school has a new gym with modern equipment. ||| She prefers outdoor exercise to working out in a gym.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我每周去健身房三次以保持健康。 ||| 学校有一个配备现代化设备的新体育馆。 ||| 她更喜欢户外运动，而不是在健身房锻炼。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 门厅, 走廊, 会堂
ieltsWords.collocations: concert hall 音乐厅, town hall 市政厅, entrance hall 门厅
ieltsWords.example: The concert will be held in the main hall. ||| The town hall is a historic building in the city center. ||| Please leave your coat in the entrance hall.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 音乐会将在主厅举行。 ||| 市政厅是市中心的一座历史建筑。 ||| 请把外套放在门厅里。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 停止, 立定, 休息
vt. 使停止, 使立定
vi. 立定, 停止, 蹒跚, 踌躇, 有缺点
[计] 停止
ieltsWords.collocations: come to a halt 停下来, halt production 停止生产, call a halt 叫停
ieltsWords.example: The car came to a halt at the traffic lights. ||| The company decided to halt production due to low demand. ||| The manager called a halt to the meeting.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 汽车在红绿灯处停了下来。 ||| 由于需求低迷，公司决定停止生产。 ||| 经理叫停了会议。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 食篮, 阻碍物, 食盒
vt. 阻碍, 使困累, 妨碍, 牵制
ieltsWords.collocations: hamper progress 阻碍进展, hamper development 妨碍发展, be hampered by 受…阻碍
ieltsWords.example: Bad weather hampered the rescue efforts. ||| Lack of funding has hampered the project's development. ||| The heavy traffic hampered our journey.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 恶劣天气阻碍了救援工作。 ||| 缺乏资金阻碍了项目的发展。 ||| 交通拥堵妨碍了我们的行程。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 手册
[计] 手册
ieltsWords.collocations: employee handbook 员工手册, user handbook 用户手册, reference handbook 参考手册
ieltsWords.example: The employee handbook outlines company policies. ||| You can find instructions in the user handbook. ||| This handbook is a useful reference for students.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 员工手册概述了公司政策。 ||| 你可以在用户手册中找到说明。 ||| 这本手册对学生来说是很有用的参考。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 障碍, 困难, 不利条件
vt. 加障碍于, 妨碍
ieltsWords.collocations: physical handicap 身体残疾, mental handicap 智力障碍, be handicapped by 受…妨碍
ieltsWords.example: Despite his physical handicap, he became a successful athlete. ||| Lack of education can be a handicap in finding a job. ||| The team was handicapped by the absence of its star player.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 尽管有身体残疾，他成为了一名成功的运动员。 ||| 缺乏教育可能成为找工作的障碍。 ||| 该队因明星球员缺席而处于不利地位。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 处理
a. 操作的
ieltsWords.collocations: handling of complaints 投诉处理, data handling 数据处理, handling fee 手续费
ieltsWords.example: The company is known for its efficient handling of customer complaints. ||| Proper handling of chemicals is essential for safety. ||| There is an additional handling fee for international orders.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司以高效处理客户投诉而闻名。 ||| 正确处理化学品对安全至关重要。 ||| 国际订单需额外支付手续费。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 便利的, 敏捷的, 容易取得的
[化] 便于使用的; 易操作的
ieltsWords.collocations: come in handy 派上用场, handy tool 方便的工具, handy with 擅长使用
ieltsWords.example: This small knife will come in handy when camping. ||| A smartphone is a handy device for communication. ||| She is handy with a sewing machine.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这把小刀在露营时会派上用场。 ||| 智能手机是一种方便的通讯设备。 ||| 她擅长使用缝纫机。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 困扰, 烦扰, 烦恼
[法] 折磨, 骚扰, 侵扰
ieltsWords.collocations: sexual harassment 性骚扰, workplace harassment 职场骚扰, harassment policy 骚扰政策
ieltsWords.example: The company has a zero-tolerance policy for sexual harassment. ||| She reported the harassment to the human resources department. ||| Online harassment is a growing concern for social media platforms.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司对性骚扰采取零容忍政策。 ||| 她向人力资源部门报告了骚扰行为。 ||| 网络骚扰是社交媒体平台日益关注的问题。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 港, 避难所
v. 庇护, 藏匿, (使)入港停泊
ieltsWords.collocations: harbor a grudge 怀恨在心, harbor doubts 心存疑虑, natural harbor 天然港
