ieltsWords.example: The ship docked at the harbor after a long voyage. ||| She still harbors a grudge against him for what he said. ||| The city's natural harbor makes it an important trade center.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 经过长途航行，船停靠在港口。 ||| 她仍对他所说的话怀恨在心。 ||| 该市的天然港口使其成为重要的贸易中心。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 坚硬的, 硬的, 难的, 艰苦的, 困难的, 坚固的, 猛烈的, 艰难的, 结实的, 确实的
adv. 坚硬地, 努力地, 辛苦地, 接近地, 猛烈地, 牢固地
ieltsWords.collocations: hard work 艰苦的工作, hard time 困难时期, hard to believe 难以相信
ieltsWords.example: The exam was very hard, but I managed to pass. ||| He works hard to support his family. ||| The diamond is one of the hardest materials known.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 考试很难，但我设法通过了。 ||| 他努力工作以养家糊口。 ||| 钻石是已知最硬的材料之一。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 硬件, 五金器具, 零件
[计] 硬件
ieltsWords.collocations: computer hardware 计算机硬件, hardware store 五金店, hardware components 硬件组件
ieltsWords.example: The company specializes in computer hardware and software. ||| You can buy tools at the hardware store. ||| The hardware components of the system need to be upgraded.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该公司专门从事计算机硬件和软件业务。 ||| 你可以在五金店购买工具。 ||| 系统的硬件组件需要升级。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 难的, 艰苦的, 坚硬的, 勇敢的
adv. 努力地, 辛苦地, 坚硬地
ieltsWords.collocations: hardy plant 耐寒植物, hardy people 坚强的人, hardy spirit 勇敢精神
ieltsWords.example: These hardy plants can survive in harsh climates. ||| The hardy explorers endured extreme conditions. ||| He is a hardy individual who never complains.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这些耐寒植物能在恶劣气候中生存。 ||| 勇敢的探险家忍受了极端条件。 ||| 他是一个坚强的人，从不抱怨。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 有害的, 伤害的
ieltsWords.collocations: harmful effects 有害影响, harmful substances 有害物质, harmful to health 对健康有害
ieltsWords.example: Smoking is harmful to your health. ||| The chemical has harmful effects on the environment. ||| We should avoid foods containing harmful additives.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的健康有害。 ||| 这种化学物质对环境有有害影响。 ||| 我们应该避免含有有害添加剂的食物。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 马具, 挽具状带子, 甲胄
vt. 给...上挽具, 驾驭, 披上甲胄, 利用...以产生动力
ieltsWords.collocations: harness energy 利用能源, harness the power 利用力量, safety harness 安全带
ieltsWords.example: We need to harness solar energy more efficiently. ||| The team harnessed the power of social media to promote the event. ||| Workers must wear a safety harness when working at heights.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要更有效地利用太阳能。 ||| 该团队利用社交媒体的力量来推广活动。 ||| 工人在高处作业时必须佩戴安全带。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 粗糙的, 刺耳的, 严厉的
[法] 粗糙的, 严厉的, 苛刻的
ieltsWords.collocations: harsh punishment 严厉惩罚, harsh climate 严酷气候, harsh voice 刺耳的声音
ieltsWords.example: The judge gave a harsh sentence to the criminal. ||| The harsh winter caused many problems for farmers. ||| His harsh voice made the children cry.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 法官对罪犯判处了严厉的刑罚。 ||| 严酷的冬天给农民带来了许多问题。 ||| 他刺耳的声音把孩子们吓哭了。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 匆忙, 急忙
ieltsWords.collocations: in haste 匆忙地, make haste 赶快, more haste less speed 欲速则不达
ieltsWords.example: In his haste to leave, he forgot his keys. ||| More haste, less speed is a common saying. ||| The report was written in haste and contained many errors.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他匆忙离开时忘了带钥匙。 ||| 欲速则不达是一句常见的谚语。 ||| 这份报告是匆忙写成的，包含许多错误。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 匆匆的, 轻率的, 性怠的
ieltsWords.collocations: hasty decision 草率的决定, hasty retreat 仓促撤退, hasty conclusion 草率的结论
ieltsWords.example: He made a hasty decision without considering the consequences. ||| The army beat a hasty retreat under cover of darkness. ||| Don't jump to hasty conclusions based on limited information.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他未经考虑后果就做出了草率的决定。 ||| 军队在夜幕掩护下仓促撤退。 ||| 不要根据有限的信息就草率下结论。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 孵化, 舱口
vt. 孵, 孵出, 策划
vi. 孵化
ieltsWords.collocations: hatch an egg 孵蛋, hatch a plan 策划计划, hatch out 孵出
ieltsWords.example: The eggs will hatch in about three weeks. ||| They hatched a scheme to steal the painting. ||| The chicks have just hatched out of their shells.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这些蛋大约三周后孵化。 ||| 他们策划了一个偷画的阴谋。 ||| 小鸡刚刚从蛋壳里孵出来。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 用力拖拉, 拖运, 强拉, 捕获量, 拖运距离
vi. 拖, 拉, 改变方向, 改变主意
vt. 拖拉, 拖运
ieltsWords.collocations: haul away 拖走, haul up 拉上来, long haul 长途运输
ieltsWords.example: The truck was hauling a heavy load of bricks. ||| They hauled the boat up onto the beach. ||| It was a long haul to the top of the mountain.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 卡车正拖运一车沉重的砖块。 ||| 他们把船拖上了沙滩。 ||| 爬到山顶是一段漫长的路程。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 常到的地方, 生息地
vt. 常到, 出没于, 萦绕于
vi. 出没, 作祟
ieltsWords.collocations: haunt a place 常去某地, haunted house 鬼屋, be haunted by 被……困扰
ieltsWords.example: The old castle is said to be haunted by a ghost. ||| The memory of the accident still haunts her. ||| He used to haunt the local library when he was a student.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 据说那座古堡有鬼魂出没。 ||| 那次事故的记忆仍然萦绕在她心头。 ||| 他学生时代常去当地的图书馆。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 港, 避难所, 安息所
vt. 安置...于港中, 庇护, 入港
ieltsWords.collocations: safe haven 安全港, tax haven 避税天堂, haven of peace 安宁的避风港
ieltsWords.example: The park is a haven for wildlife. ||| Switzerland is often considered a tax haven. ||| After a long day, home is a haven of peace.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个公园是野生动物的庇护所。 ||| 瑞士常被视为避税天堂。 ||| 漫长的一天过后，家是安宁的避风港。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 大破坏, 蹂躏
vt. 严重破坏
ieltsWords.collocations: wreak havoc 造成严重破坏, cause havoc 引起混乱, play havoc with 扰乱
ieltsWords.example: The storm wreaked havoc on the coastal towns. ||| The children caused havoc in the classroom. ||| The new policy played havoc with our plans.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 暴风雨给沿海城镇造成了严重破坏。 ||| 孩子们在教室里引起了混乱。 ||| 新政策打乱了我们的计划。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 冒险, 危险, 机会
vt. 冒...的危险, 赌运气, 使冒危险
[计] 相关危险; 冒险
ieltsWords.collocations: health hazard 健康危害, fire hazard 火灾隐患, hazard warning 危险警告
ieltsWords.example: Smoking is a serious health hazard. ||| The broken glass on the floor is a hazard. ||| Drivers should be aware of potential hazards on the road.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 吸烟是严重的健康危害。 ||| 地板上的碎玻璃是个危险物。 ||| 司机应注意道路上的潜在危险。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 危险的, 冒险的, 碰运气的
[法] 危险的, 冒险的, 碰运气的
ieltsWords.collocations: hazardous waste 危险废物, hazardous material 危险物质, hazardous journey 危险的旅程
ieltsWords.example: The disposal of hazardous waste must be done carefully. ||| Mining can be a hazardous occupation. ||| The road conditions were hazardous due to ice.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 危险废物的处理必须小心进行。 ||| 采矿可能是一种危险的职业。 ||| 由于结冰，道路状况很危险。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 头痛, 令人头痛之事
[医] 头痛
ieltsWords.collocations: have a headache 头痛, cause a headache 引起头痛, a major headache 大麻烦
ieltsWords.example: I have a terrible headache and need to rest. ||| The traffic jam is a real headache for commuters. ||| Dealing with all these forms is a major headache.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我头痛得厉害，需要休息。 ||| 交通堵塞对通勤者来说真是件头痛的事。 ||| 处理所有这些表格是个大麻烦。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 标题, 起始字, 方向
[计] 上标题
ieltsWords.collocations: chapter heading 章节标题, under the heading of 在……标题下, heading towards 朝……方向
ieltsWords.example: The chapter heading is 'Introduction to Economics'. ||| The information is listed under the heading 'Safety'. ||| The ship was heading towards the port.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 章节标题是‘经济学导论’。 ||| 信息列在‘安全’标题下。 ||| 船正朝港口方向行驶。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 痊愈
vt. 使复原, 使和解, 治愈
ieltsWords.collocations: heal a wound 治愈伤口, heal the rift 弥合裂痕, heal quickly 快速愈合
ieltsWords.example: The cut on his finger healed within a few days. ||| Time can heal emotional wounds. ||| The two countries are trying to heal their differences.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他手指上的伤口几天内就愈合了。 ||| 时间可以治愈情感创伤。 ||| 两国正试图弥合分歧。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 健康, 卫生, 蓬勃, 健康状态
[医] 健康
ieltsWords.collocations: good health 健康, mental health 心理健康, public health 公共卫生
ieltsWords.example: Regular exercise is essential for good health. ||| Mental health is as important as physical health. ||| The government is investing in public health programs.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 定期锻炼对保持健康至关重要。 ||| 心理健康和身体健康同样重要。 ||| 政府正在投资公共卫生项目。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 医疗保健；卫生保健；健康护理, 健康服务
ieltsWords.collocations: healthcare system 医疗保健系统, healthcare provider 医疗保健提供者, healthcare reform 医疗改革
ieltsWords.example: Access to affordable healthcare is a basic right. ||| The healthcare system in this country is under strain. ||| Healthcare workers deserve our respect and support.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 获得负担得起的医疗保健是一项基本权利。 ||| 这个国家的医疗保健系统面临压力。 ||| 医疗保健工作者值得我们尊重和支持。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 堆, 许多, 累积
vt. 堆积, 装满
[计] 堆
ieltsWords.collocations: a heap of 一堆, heap up 堆积, rubbish heap 垃圾堆
ieltsWords.example: There was a heap of dirty clothes on the floor. ||| He heaped praise on his team for their hard work. ||| The leaves were heaped up in the corner of the garden.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 地板上有一堆脏衣服。 ||| 他对团队的辛勤工作大加赞扬。 ||| 树叶堆积在花园的角落里。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 听, 听觉, 听讯
[医] 听, 听觉
ieltsWords.collocations: hearing loss 听力损失, hearing aid 助听器, court hearing 法庭听证会
ieltsWords.example: Loud music can cause permanent hearing loss. ||| She wears a hearing aid to help her hear better. ||| The court hearing has been postponed until next month.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大声的音乐可能导致永久性听力损失。 ||| 她戴助听器以帮助听得更清楚。 ||| 法庭听证会已推迟到下个月。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 心, 心脏, 中心, 内心, 感情, 精神, 心情, 宝贝儿
vt. 鼓励
ieltsWords.collocations: heart disease 心脏病, at heart 本质上, learn by heart 记住
ieltsWords.example: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease. ||| She is a kind person at heart. ||| Students are required to learn the poem by heart.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 定期锻炼可以降低患心脏病的风险。 ||| 她本质上是个善良的人。 ||| 学生需要背诵这首诗。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 重的, 巨大的, 沉重的, 笨重的, 过度的
adv. 沉重地
n. 重物, 严肃角色
ieltsWords.collocations: heavy rain 大雨, heavy traffic 交通拥堵, heavy burden 沉重负担
ieltsWords.example: The heavy rain caused flooding in many areas. ||| I was stuck in heavy traffic for two hours. ||| The responsibility of caring for her parents is a heavy burden.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大雨导致许多地区洪水泛滥。 ||| 我堵在严重的交通拥堵中两个小时。 ||| 照顾父母的责任是个沉重的负担。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 脸上发红, 发热的, 潮热的, 肺病的
n. 脸红, 潮热病人
ieltsWords.collocations: hectic schedule 繁忙的日程, hectic pace 忙碌的节奏, hectic life 忙碌的生活
ieltsWords.example: The last week before the exam was hectic. ||| She leads a hectic life as a working mother. ||| The office was hectic with everyone preparing for the meeting.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 考试前的最后一周非常忙碌。 ||| 作为一名职业母亲，她过着忙碌的生活。 ||| 办公室里每个人都在为会议做准备，一片忙碌。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 树篱, 障碍, 套头交易
vt. 用树篱围, 套期保值, 妨碍, 两面下注以防...的损失
vi. 筑树篱, 躲闪, 两面下注以防损失
a. 树篱的, 偷偷摸摸的
ieltsWords.collocations: hedge fund 对冲基金, hedge against 防范, hedge one's bets 两面下注
ieltsWords.example: The garden is surrounded by a tall hedge. ||| Investors often use gold as a hedge against inflation. ||| To hedge his bets, he applied to several universities.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 花园被一道高高的树篱环绕。 ||| 投资者常用黄金作为对冲通胀的工具。 ||| 为了保险起见，他申请了好几所大学。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 高度, 海拔, 高地, 顶点
[化] 高度
ieltsWords.collocations: average height 平均身高, maximum height 最大高度, height of summer 盛夏
ieltsWords.example: The building reaches a height of 300 meters. ||| His height gives him an advantage in basketball. ||| The plane flew at a height of 10,000 feet.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座建筑高达300米。 ||| 他的身高在篮球运动中给了他优势。 ||| 飞机在10000英尺的高度飞行。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 增高, 提高, 加强
vi. 升高, 变大
ieltsWords.collocations: heighten awareness 提高意识, heighten tension 加剧紧张, heighten security 加强安保
ieltsWords.example: The new policy aims to heighten public safety. ||| The music heightened the emotional impact of the scene. ||| The conflict heightened tensions between the two countries.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新政策旨在加强公共安全。 ||| 音乐增强了场景的情感冲击力。 ||| 冲突加剧了两国之间的紧张局势。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 继承人, 嗣子, 后嗣
[法] 继承人, 后嗣
ieltsWords.collocations: legal heir 法定继承人, heir to the throne 王位继承人, sole heir 唯一继承人
ieltsWords.example: He is the sole heir to his father's fortune. ||| The prince is the heir to the throne. ||| The company is looking for an heir to the founder.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他是父亲财产的唯一继承人。 ||| 王子是王位继承人。 ||| 公司正在寻找创始人的继承人。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 直升机
vt. 由直升机运送
vi. 乘直升机
ieltsWords.collocations: helicopter ride 直升机之旅, helicopter pilot 直升机飞行员, rescue helicopter 救援直升机
ieltsWords.example: The helicopter landed on the rooftop of the hospital. ||| They took a helicopter tour over the Grand Canyon. ||| The rescue helicopter evacuated the injured hikers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 直升机降落在医院屋顶上。 ||| 他们乘坐直升机游览了大峡谷。 ||| 救援直升机疏散了受伤的徒步者。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 地狱, 邪恶势力, 苦境, 阴间, 毁坏, 训斥
vi. 狂饮, 飞驰
ieltsWords.collocations: go to hell 下地狱, living hell 人间地狱, hell on earth 人间地狱
ieltsWords.example: The war was a living hell for the civilians. ||| He went through hell during the exam preparation. ||| Some religions believe sinners go to hell after death.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 战争对平民来说是人间的活地狱。 ||| 他在备考期间经历了地狱般的折磨。 ||| 一些宗教认为罪人死后会下地狱。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 钢盔, 盔, 防护帽
vt. 给...戴头盔
ieltsWords.collocations: wear a helmet 戴头盔, bicycle helmet 自行车头盔, safety helmet 安全帽
ieltsWords.example: Cyclists should always wear a helmet for safety. ||| The construction worker put on his hard hat and helmet. ||| The soldier's helmet protected him from shrapnel.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 骑自行车的人应该始终戴头盔以确保安全。 ||| 建筑工人戴上了安全帽。 ||| 士兵的头盔保护他免受弹片伤害。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 半球, 地球的半面, 大脑半球
[医] 半球
ieltsWords.collocations: northern hemisphere 北半球, southern hemisphere 南半球, left hemisphere 左半球
ieltsWords.example: Australia is located in the southern hemisphere. ||| The brain's left hemisphere controls language. ||| The northern hemisphere experiences summer in June.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 澳大利亚位于南半球。 ||| 大脑的左半球控制语言。 ||| 北半球在六月经历夏季。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 药草, 香草
[医] 草, 草本, 草药
ieltsWords.collocations: medicinal herb 药草, herb garden 草药园, fresh herbs 新鲜香草
ieltsWords.example: She grows various herbs in her garden. ||| Traditional Chinese medicine uses many herbs. ||| The chef added fresh herbs to the sauce.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她在花园里种植各种香草。 ||| 中医使用许多草药。 ||| 厨师在酱汁中加入了新鲜香草。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 兽群, 人群, 牧人
vt. 群集, 使成群, 放牧
vi. 聚在一起
ieltsWords.collocations: a herd of cattle 一群牛, herd instinct 从众心理, herd immunity 群体免疫
ieltsWords.example: A herd of elephants crossed the river. ||| The shepherd herded the sheep into the pen. ||| People often follow the herd without thinking.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一群大象过河。 ||| 牧羊人把羊群赶进围栏。 ||| 人们常常不假思索地随大流。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 世袭的, 遗传的
[医] 遗传的
ieltsWords.collocations: hereditary disease 遗传病, hereditary title 世袭头衔, hereditary monarchy 世袭君主制
ieltsWords.example: Some cancers are hereditary. ||| The throne is hereditary in many countries. ||| He inherited a hereditary estate from his grandfather.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 有些癌症是遗传性的。 ||| 在许多国家，王位是世袭的。 ||| 他从祖父那里继承了一处世袭地产。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 遗产, 祖先遗留物, 继承物
[医] 遗传性
ieltsWords.collocations: cultural heritage 文化遗产, world heritage 世界遗产, natural heritage 自然遗产
ieltsWords.example: The Great Wall is a UNESCO World Heritage site. ||| We must preserve our cultural heritage for future generations. ||| The country has a rich musical heritage.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 长城是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。 ||| 我们必须为后代保护我们的文化遗产。 ||| 这个国家有丰富的音乐遗产。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 英雄, 超越常人者, 男主角
ieltsWords.collocations: national hero 民族英雄, action hero 动作英雄, hero worship 英雄崇拜
ieltsWords.example: He was hailed as a hero for saving the child. ||| The movie's hero is a brave firefighter. ||| Many children look up to sports heroes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他因救孩子而被誉为英雄。 ||| 电影的主角是一名勇敢的消防员。 ||| 许多孩子崇拜体育英雄。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 徒步旅行, 远足, 涨价, 提高
vi. 步行, 徒步旅行, 上升
vt. 使高涨, 拉起
ieltsWords.collocations: go for a hike 去远足, price hike 价格上涨, hike in wages 加薪
ieltsWords.example: We went for a hike in the mountains. ||| The government announced a tax hike. ||| They hiked through the forest for hours.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们去山里远足了。 ||| 政府宣布增税。 ||| 他们在森林里徒步了几个小时。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 后面的
v. 阻碍, 打扰
ieltsWords.collocations: hinder progress 阻碍进步, hinder development 妨碍发展, hinder communication 妨碍沟通
ieltsWords.example: Bad weather hindered the rescue efforts. ||| Lack of funding hindered the project's completion. ||| His shyness hindered his ability to make friends.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 恶劣天气阻碍了救援工作。 ||| 缺乏资金阻碍了项目的完成。 ||| 他的害羞妨碍了他交朋友的能力。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 暗示, 提示
v. 暗示, 示意
ieltsWords.collocations: give a hint 给提示, take a hint 领会暗示, subtle hint 微妙的暗示
ieltsWords.example: She dropped a hint about her birthday gift. ||| The teacher gave a hint to help solve the problem. ||| He didn't take the hint and kept talking.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她暗示了一下她的生日礼物。 ||| 老师给了一个提示来帮助解决问题。 ||| 他没有领会暗示，继续说话。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 历史学家, 记事者
ieltsWords.collocations: professional historian 专业历史学家, military historian 军事历史学家, art historian 艺术史学家
ieltsWords.example: The historian published a new book on ancient Rome. ||| Historians debate the causes of the war. ||| She is a renowned historian of the Renaissance.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位历史学家出版了一本关于古罗马的新书。 ||| 历史学家们争论战争的原因。 ||| 她是一位著名的文艺复兴历史学家。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 历史上著名的, 有历史性的
ieltsWords.collocations: historic moment 历史性时刻, historic building 历史建筑, historic event 历史事件
ieltsWords.example: The signing of the treaty was a historic moment. ||| They visited many historic sites in Europe. ||| The election resulted in a historic victory.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 条约的签署是一个历史性时刻。 ||| 他们参观了欧洲许多历史遗迹。 ||| 选举取得了历史性的胜利。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 历史的, 史实的, 历史上的
[法] 历史性的
ieltsWords.collocations: historical research 历史研究, historical novel 历史小说, historical context 历史背景
ieltsWords.example: The museum displays historical artifacts. ||| She enjoys reading historical novels. ||| We need to understand the historical context of the event.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 博物馆展示历史文物。 ||| 她喜欢读历史小说。 ||| 我们需要理解事件的历史背景。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 历史, 过去, 经历, 发展过程, 历史学, 过去的事, 历史记录
[计] 历史记录
ieltsWords.collocations: world history 世界历史, family history 家族史, medical history 病史
ieltsWords.example: History repeats itself. ||| She studied history at university. ||| The patient has a history of heart disease.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 历史重演。 ||| 她在大学学习历史。 ||| 病人有心脏病史。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 打击, 打, 冲撞, 讽刺
vt. 打, 打击, 碰撞, 打中, 袭击, 偶然碰上
vi. 打, 打中, 打击, 碰撞, 偶然碰上
[计] 击中; 找到; 瞬时打扰
ieltsWords.collocations: hit the target 击中目标, hit a record 创纪录, big hit 大热门
ieltsWords.example: The car hit a tree. ||| The song became a big hit. ||| He hit the ball out of the park.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 汽车撞上了一棵树。 ||| 这首歌成了大热门。 ||| 他把球打出了公园。

ieltsWords.definition: adv. 迄今, 至今
ieltsWords.collocations: hitherto unknown 迄今未知, hitherto unsolved 迄今未解决, hitherto neglected 迄今被忽视
ieltsWords.example: The problem has hitherto been ignored by the authorities. ||| This is a hitherto undiscovered species of plant. ||| Hitherto, the research has focused on urban areas.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个问题迄今为止一直被当局忽视。 ||| 这是一种迄今未被发现的植物物种。 ||| 迄今为止，研究主要集中在城市地区。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 嗜好, 癖好, 爱好
ieltsWords.collocations: pursue a hobby 追求爱好, favourite hobby 最喜欢的爱好, turn a hobby into a career 把爱好变成职业
ieltsWords.example: Gardening is a popular hobby among retirees. ||| She has a hobby of collecting vintage stamps. ||| Many people use their hobbies to relieve stress.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 园艺是退休人员中流行的爱好。 ||| 她有一个收集 vintage 邮票的爱好。 ||| 许多人利用爱好来缓解压力。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 升高, 起重机, 推动
v. 升起, 升高, 举起
ieltsWords.collocations: hoist a flag 升旗, hoist a sail 升帆, hoist equipment 吊装设备
ieltsWords.example: The workers hoisted the heavy crate onto the truck. ||| They hoisted the national flag during the ceremony. ||| The crane hoisted the steel beam into place.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 工人们把沉重的箱子吊到卡车上。 ||| 他们在仪式上升起了国旗。 ||| 起重机将钢梁吊装到位。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 家庭作业, 家里做的工作
[经] 家庭作业
ieltsWords.collocations: do homework 做作业, assign homework 布置作业, homework assignment 家庭作业任务
ieltsWords.example: Students should complete their homework before class. ||| The teacher gave us a lot of homework over the weekend. ||| He did his homework on the company before the interview.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 学生应该在课前完成家庭作业。 ||| 老师周末给我们布置了很多作业。 ||| 他在面试前对这家公司做了准备工作。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 同种的, 同质的, 齐性的
[医] 同种的, 纯一的, 同质的, 均匀的
ieltsWords.collocations: homogeneous group 同质群体, homogeneous mixture 均匀混合物, homogeneous society 同质社会
ieltsWords.example: The population of the small town is remarkably homogeneous. ||| A homogeneous mixture has the same composition throughout. ||| The team was not homogeneous; it included people from diverse backgrounds.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个小镇的人口非常同质。 ||| 均匀混合物各处的成分相同。 ||| 这个团队并非同质，成员背景多样。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 地平线, 眼界, (天)视地平
ieltsWords.collocations: broaden one's horizons 开阔眼界, on the horizon 在地平线上，即将出现, expand horizons 拓展视野
ieltsWords.example: The sun sank below the horizon. ||| Traveling abroad can broaden your horizons. ||| New opportunities are on the horizon for graduates.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 太阳沉到了地平线以下。 ||| 出国旅行可以开阔你的眼界。 ||| 毕业生即将迎来新的机会。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 可怕的, 遭透的, 极讨厌的
ieltsWords.collocations: horrible experience 可怕的经历, horrible weather 糟糕的天气, horrible accident 可怕的事故
ieltsWords.example: The food at the restaurant was horrible. ||| She had a horrible nightmare last night. ||| The traffic was horrible during rush hour.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 那家餐厅的食物糟透了。 ||| 她昨晚做了一个可怕的噩梦。 ||| 高峰时段的交通糟透了。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 水管, 橡皮软管, 长统袜
vt. 用水管浇
ieltsWords.collocations: garden hose 花园水管, fire hose 消防水带, hose pipe 软管
ieltsWords.example: He used a hose to water the plants. ||| The firefighter aimed the hose at the burning building. ||| The hose sprang a leak and water sprayed everywhere.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他用软管给植物浇水。 ||| 消防员将水带对准燃烧的建筑。 ||| 软管裂了个口子，水喷得到处都是。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 医院
[医] 医院
ieltsWords.collocations: in hospital 住院, go to hospital 去医院, hospital ward 医院病房
ieltsWords.example: He was taken to hospital after the accident. ||| She works as a nurse in a local hospital. ||| The hospital has state-of-the-art equipment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 事故后他被送往医院。 ||| 她在当地一家医院当护士。 ||| 这家医院拥有最先进的设备。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 款待, 亲切, 殷勤
ieltsWords.collocations: hospitality industry 酒店业, warm hospitality 热情款待, extend hospitality 提供款待
ieltsWords.example: The locals are known for their warm hospitality. ||| She works in the hospitality industry as a hotel manager. ||| We were overwhelmed by the hospitality of our hosts.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 当地人以其热情好客而闻名。 ||| 她在酒店业工作，担任酒店经理。 ||| 主人的热情款待让我们受宠若惊。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 主人, 旅馆老板, 节目主持人
vt. 当主人招待, 作...节目主持人
[计] 主机, 宿主机
ieltsWords.collocations: host country 主办国, host a party 举办派对, host family 寄宿家庭
ieltsWords.example: The host welcomed the guests at the door. ||| China will host the next Olympic Games. ||| She hosted a charity event last weekend.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 主人在门口欢迎客人。 ||| 中国将主办下一届奥运会。 ||| 她上周末主持了一场慈善活动。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 人质, 抵押品
[经] 人质, 抵押品
ieltsWords.collocations: take hostage 劫持人质, hostage situation 人质事件, hostage crisis 人质危机
ieltsWords.example: The terrorists took several hostages. ||| The hostage was released unharmed after negotiations. ||| The government refused to negotiate with hostage-takers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 恐怖分子劫持了几名人质。 ||| 经过谈判，人质被安全释放。 ||| 政府拒绝与劫持人质者谈判。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 敌人的, 怀敌意的, 敌对的
n. 敌对分子
ieltsWords.collocations: hostile attitude 敌对态度, hostile environment 恶劣环境, hostile takeover 恶意收购
ieltsWords.example: The audience was hostile to the speaker's views. ||| They had to survive in a hostile climate. ||| The company faced a hostile takeover bid.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 听众对演讲者的观点持敌对态度。 ||| 他们不得不在恶劣的气候中生存。 ||| 该公司面临恶意收购要约。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 旅馆, 客栈
ieltsWords.collocations: check into a hotel 入住酒店, hotel room 酒店房间, luxury hotel 豪华酒店
ieltsWords.example: We booked a hotel near the airport. ||| The hotel offers a complimentary breakfast. ||| He works as a concierge in a five-star hotel.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们预订了机场附近的一家酒店。 ||| 这家酒店提供免费早餐。 ||| 他在一家五星级酒店做门房。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 遮盖, 住房供给, 居留(处), 房屋, 装饰
[化] 外壳
ieltsWords.collocations: housing market 住房市场, affordable housing 经济适用房, housing shortage 住房短缺
ieltsWords.example: The government is trying to solve the housing crisis. ||| There is a shortage of affordable housing in big cities. ||| The housing market has been booming in recent years.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府正试图解决住房危机。 ||| 大城市缺乏经济适用房。 ||| 近年来住房市场一直繁荣。

ieltsWords.definition:
vi. 盘旋, 翱翔, 徘徊
vt. 孵
n. 翱翔
ieltsWords.collocations: hover over 盘旋在...上方, hover around 徘徊在...附近, hover between 在...之间摇摆
ieltsWords.example: A helicopter hovered over the building. ||| The temperature hovered around 30 degrees. ||| She hovered between accepting and rejecting the offer.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一架直升机在大楼上方盘旋。 ||| 温度在30度左右徘徊。 ||| 她在接受和拒绝提议之间摇摆不定。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 杂乱一团, 混乱, 拥挤
vt. 把...挤在一起, 乱堆, 草率了事, 蜷曲
vi. 挤作一团, 蜷缩
ieltsWords.collocations: huddle together 挤在一起, huddle up 蜷缩, in a huddle 聚在一起
ieltsWords.example: The children huddled together for warmth. ||| They huddled around the fire to keep warm. ||| The team had a quick huddle before the game.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 孩子们挤在一起取暖。 ||| 他们围在火边取暖。 ||| 比赛前球队快速聚在一起商量。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 人, 人类
a. 人类的, 似人类的, 人性的, 有同情心的
ieltsWords.collocations: human being 人类, human rights 人权, human nature 人性
ieltsWords.example: Every human being deserves respect. ||| The organization fights for human rights. ||| It is human nature to make mistakes.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 每个人都值得尊重。 ||| 该组织为人权而战。 ||| 犯错是人的天性。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 人性, 人类, 博爱
ieltsWords.collocations: crimes against humanity 反人类罪, sense of humanity 人道精神, the whole of humanity 全人类
ieltsWords.example: The war was a crime against humanity. ||| We must treat animals with humanity. ||| The disaster united people across humanity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这场战争是反人类罪。 ||| 我们必须人道地对待动物。 ||| 这场灾难团结了全人类。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 低下的, 谦逊的, 粗陋的
vt. 使...卑下, 降低...地位, 贬抑
ieltsWords.collocations: humble opinion 拙见, humble beginnings 卑微的出身, humble oneself 谦卑
ieltsWords.example: He remained humble despite his success. ||| She came from humble beginnings but achieved great things. ||| The experience humbled him and made him more compassionate.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 尽管成功了，他仍然保持谦虚。 ||| 她出身卑微但成就斐然。 ||| 这次经历使他谦卑，也让他更有同情心。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 湿气, 潮湿, 湿度
[计] 湿度
ieltsWords.collocations: high humidity 高湿度, low humidity 低湿度, relative humidity 相对湿度
ieltsWords.example: The high humidity made the weather feel even hotter. ||| Plants in the rainforest thrive in constant humidity. ||| The humidity level dropped significantly after the rain stopped.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 高湿度让天气感觉更热。 ||| 雨林中的植物在持续的湿度中茁壮成长。 ||| 雨停后湿度水平显著下降。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 使丢脸, 使蒙羞, 屈辱
ieltsWords.collocations: humiliate someone 羞辱某人, feel humiliated 感到羞辱, publicly humiliate 公开羞辱
ieltsWords.example: The teacher's harsh criticism humiliated the student in front of the class. ||| He felt humiliated when he failed the simple test. ||| No one should be humiliated because of their background.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师严厉的批评在全班同学面前羞辱了那个学生。 ||| 当他没通过简单的测试时，他感到羞辱。 ||| 任何人都不应因背景而受到羞辱。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 狩猎, 追捕, 搜寻, 猎区
vt. 狩猎, 打猎, 搜索
vi. 打猎, 猎食, 搜寻
ieltsWords.collocations: hunt for 寻找, go hunting 去打猎, job hunt 找工作
ieltsWords.example: They went hunting in the forest early in the morning. ||| The police are hunting for the escaped prisoner. ||| After graduation, he started a job hunt that lasted several months.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们一大早就去森林里打猎。 ||| 警方正在搜寻逃犯。 ||| 毕业后，他开始了持续数月的求职。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 狩猎, 猎狐, 探求
[计] 寻找平衡; 寻找
ieltsWords.collocations: hunting season 狩猎季节, hunting ground 猎场, job hunting 求职
ieltsWords.example: Hunting is strictly regulated in many countries to protect wildlife. ||| He spends his weekends hunting in the mountains. ||| Online job hunting has become increasingly popular.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多国家严格管制打猎以保护野生动物。 ||| 他周末在山上打猎。 ||| 在线求职变得越来越流行。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 飓风, 暴风, 暴风雨
ieltsWords.collocations: hurricane force 飓风强度, hurricane season 飓风季节, devastating hurricane 破坏性飓风
ieltsWords.example: The hurricane caused widespread damage to coastal areas. ||| Residents were evacuated before the hurricane hit. ||| Scientists are studying how climate change affects hurricane intensity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 飓风对沿海地区造成了广泛的破坏。 ||| 居民在飓风来袭前被疏散。 ||| 科学家正在研究气候变化如何影响飓风强度。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 卫生保健, 卫生学, 保健法
[医] 卫生, 卫生学
ieltsWords.collocations: personal hygiene 个人卫生, food hygiene 食品卫生, dental hygiene 口腔卫生
ieltsWords.example: Good personal hygiene helps prevent the spread of diseases. ||| The restaurant was closed due to poor food hygiene standards. ||| Children should be taught about hygiene from an early age.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 良好的个人卫生有助于预防疾病传播。 ||| 这家餐厅因食品卫生标准差而被关闭。 ||| 应该从小教育孩子卫生知识。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 歇斯底里的, 异常兴奋的
[医] 癔病的, 歇斯底里的
ieltsWords.collocations: hysterical laughter 狂笑, hysterical crying 嚎啕大哭, become hysterical 变得歇斯底里
ieltsWords.example: The crowd became hysterical when their team won the championship. ||| She burst into hysterical laughter at the joke. ||| The mother was hysterical when she couldn't find her child.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 当他们的球队赢得冠军时，人群变得歇斯底里。 ||| 她听到笑话后爆发出狂笑。 ||| 母亲找不到孩子时变得歇斯底里。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 冰, 冰淇淋, 糖衣, 冷若冰霜, 矜持, 贿赂
vt. 使结冰, 冰镇, 覆以糖衣
vi. 结冰
ieltsWords.collocations: ice cube 冰块, ice cream 冰淇淋, break the ice 打破僵局
ieltsWords.example: The lake was covered with a thick layer of ice. ||| She added some ice cubes to her drink. ||| A simple joke can help break the ice in a conversation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 湖面上覆盖着一层厚厚的冰。 ||| 她在饮料里加了些冰块。 ||| 一个简单的笑话有助于打破谈话的僵局。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 主意, 办法, 理想, 思想, 概念, 意见
[医] 观念, 思想
ieltsWords.collocations: have an idea 有个主意, good idea 好主意, no idea 不知道
ieltsWords.example: She came up with a brilliant idea for the project. ||| I have no idea what he is talking about. ||| The idea of renewable energy is gaining popularity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她为这个项目想出了一个绝妙的主意。 ||| 我不知道他在说什么。 ||| 可再生能源的概念越来越受欢迎。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 理想, 典范, 观念, 思想, 最后目标
a. 理想的, 完美的, 空想的, 观念的, 唯心论的
ieltsWords.collocations: ideal candidate 理想候选人, ideal solution 理想解决方案, ideal world 理想世界
ieltsWords.example: This house is ideal for a large family. ||| He is the ideal candidate for the job. ||| In an ideal world, everyone would have access to education.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这栋房子非常适合大家庭。 ||| 他是这份工作的理想候选人。 ||| 在理想世界中，每个人都应有受教育的机会。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 识别, 身份证明, 认同
[化] 鉴定; 鉴别; 鉴别法; 认证
ieltsWords.collocations: identification card 身份证, identification number 识别号码, identification process 识别过程
ieltsWords.example: You need to show identification to enter the building. ||| The identification of the victim took several days. ||| Fingerprint identification is used in criminal investigations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你需要出示身份证明才能进入大楼。 ||| 受害者的身份鉴定花了几天时间。 ||| 指纹识别用于刑事调查。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 身份, 相同, 一致, 特性, 恒等式
[计] (打)标记, 标识
ieltsWords.collocations: identity theft 身份盗窃, cultural identity 文化认同, sense of identity 身份感
ieltsWords.example: He had his identity stolen and lost a lot of money. ||| Many immigrants struggle to maintain their cultural identity. ||| Adolescence is a time when people develop their sense of identity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他的身份被盗，损失了很多钱。 ||| 许多移民努力保持自己的文化认同。 ||| 青春期是人们发展身份感的时期。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 思想体系, 意识形态, 观念学, 空论
[医] 观念学, 观念形态
ieltsWords.collocations: political ideology 政治意识形态, dominant ideology 主流意识形态, ideological differences 意识形态差异
ieltsWords.example: The two parties have very different political ideologies. ||| His ideology influenced many young people. ||| Ideological conflicts can lead to social unrest.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这两个政党有非常不同的政治意识形态。 ||| 他的意识形态影响了许多年轻人。 ||| 意识形态冲突可能导致社会动荡。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 习语, 成语, 惯用语法, 方言
ieltsWords.collocations: English idiom 英语习语, idiomatic expression 习惯表达, learn idioms 学习习语
ieltsWords.example: The idiom 'break a leg' means good luck. ||| Learning idioms is important for mastering a language. ||| This idiom is commonly used in everyday conversation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 习语'break a leg'意思是祝好运。 ||| 学习习语对于掌握一门语言很重要。 ||| 这个习语在日常对话中常用。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 白痴, 极蠢之人
[医] 白痴者, 痴子
ieltsWords.collocations: complete idiot 十足的傻瓜, act like an idiot 像白痴一样行事, call someone an idiot 叫某人白痴
ieltsWords.example: Only an idiot would drive without a seatbelt. ||| He felt like an idiot after making that mistake. ||| Don't call him an idiot; it's not nice.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 只有白痴才会不系安全带开车。 ||| 犯了那个错误后，他觉得自己像个白痴。 ||| 别叫他白痴，这样不好。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 懒惰的, 闲散的, 停顿的, 空闲的, 无用的
vi. 无所事事, 闲散, 浪费, 空转
vt. 虚度, 使闲散, 使空转
n. 空转, 空闲时间
[计] 空闲时间
ieltsWords.collocations: idle time 空闲时间, idle away 虚度, idle chatter 闲聊
ieltsWords.example: The factory has been idle for months due to the strike. ||| He idled away the afternoon watching TV. ||| Idle gossip can damage people's reputations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于罢工，工厂已经闲置数月。 ||| 他看电视虚度了一个下午。 ||| 无聊的闲话会损害人们的声誉。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 点燃, 使灼热, 使兴奋
ieltsWords.collocations: ignite a fire 点火, ignite a debate 引发辩论, ignite passion 激发热情
ieltsWords.example: A spark can ignite a forest fire. ||| His speech ignited a heated debate among the audience. ||| The teacher's encouragement ignited a passion for learning in the students.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一个火花就能引发森林火灾。 ||| 他的演讲在观众中引发了激烈的辩论。 ||| 老师的鼓励激发了学生们的学习热情。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 违法的, 不合规定的
[经] 非法的, 犯规的
ieltsWords.collocations: illegal activity 非法活动, illegal immigration 非法移民, illegal drugs 非法毒品
ieltsWords.example: It is illegal to park here. ||| The government is cracking down on illegal logging. ||| He was arrested for carrying illegal weapons.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在这里停车是违法的。 ||| 政府正在打击非法伐木。 ||| 他因携带非法武器被捕。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 疾病, 恶意
[医] 病
ieltsWords.collocations: serious illness 重病, mental illness 精神疾病, suffer from an illness 患病
ieltsWords.example: She missed work due to a sudden illness. ||| Mental illness is often misunderstood by society. ||| Regular exercise can help prevent many illnesses.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她因突发疾病而缺勤。 ||| 精神疾病常常被社会误解。 ||| 定期锻炼有助于预防许多疾病。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 照明, 用灯装饰, 阐明, 说明, 使灿烂
vi. 照亮, 用灯装饰
ieltsWords.collocations: illuminate the room 照亮房间, illuminate a point 阐明观点, illuminate the way 照亮道路
ieltsWords.example: The candles illuminated the dark room. ||| The professor's explanation illuminated the complex theory. ||| Streetlights illuminate the way for pedestrians at night.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 蜡烛照亮了黑暗的房间。 ||| 教授的解释阐明了这个复杂的理论。 ||| 路灯在夜晚为行人照亮道路。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 幻影, 错觉, 幻想
[医] 错觉
ieltsWords.collocations: optical illusion 视错觉, have no illusion about 对…不抱幻想, create an illusion 制造幻觉
ieltsWords.example: The mirror creates an optical illusion that makes the room look larger. ||| He has no illusion about his chances of winning the election. ||| The idea of a perfect society is just an illusion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 镜子制造了一种视错觉，让房间看起来更大。 ||| 他对赢得选举的机会不抱幻想。 ||| 完美社会的想法只是一种幻觉。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 想像的, 虚构的
ieltsWords.collocations: imaginative thinking 富有想象力的思维, imaginative solution 创新的解决方案, imaginative writing 虚构写作
ieltsWords.example: The architect proposed an imaginative design for the new museum. ||| Children are often more imaginative than adults. ||| The novel is praised for its imaginative plot.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 建筑师为新博物馆提出了一个富有想象力的设计。 ||| 孩子通常比成年人更有想象力。 ||| 这部小说因其虚构的情节而受到赞扬。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 模仿, 效法, 冒充, 仿造
ieltsWords.collocations: imitate someone's behavior 模仿某人的行为, imitate a sound 模仿声音, imitate a style 模仿风格
ieltsWords.example: Young children often imitate their parents' gestures. ||| The software can imitate human speech patterns. ||| He tried to imitate the artist's painting technique.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 小孩子经常模仿父母的手势。 ||| 这个软件可以模拟人类的语言模式。 ||| 他试图模仿那位艺术家的绘画技巧。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 模仿, 效法, 冒充, 赝品
[医] 模仿, 仿制, 仿制品
ieltsWords.collocations: in imitation of 模仿, imitation leather 仿皮, imitation jewelry 仿制珠宝
ieltsWords.example: The painting is a poor imitation of the original. ||| She wore a necklace made of imitation pearls. ||| Children learn by imitation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这幅画是对原作的拙劣模仿。 ||| 她戴了一条仿珍珠项链。 ||| 孩子通过模仿学习。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 沉浸, 使陷入
[医] 浸[入]
ieltsWords.collocations: immerse oneself in 沉浸于, immerse in water 浸入水中, be immersed in thought 陷入沉思
ieltsWords.example: She immersed herself in her studies to prepare for the exam. ||| The fabric should be immersed in dye for at least an hour. ||| He was completely immersed in the virtual reality game.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她埋头学习，为考试做准备。 ||| 布料应在染料中浸泡至少一小时。 ||| 他完全沉浸在虚拟现实游戏中。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 即将来临的, 逼近的
ieltsWords.collocations: imminent danger 迫在眉睫的危险, imminent threat 即将到来的威胁, imminent arrival 即将到来
ieltsWords.example: The storm is imminent, so we should seek shelter. ||| The company faced imminent bankruptcy due to poor management. ||| The scientist warned of an imminent environmental disaster.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 暴风雨即将来临，我们应该找地方躲避。 ||| 由于管理不善，公司面临即将破产的危机。 ||| 科学家警告一场迫在眉睫的环境灾难。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 免疫的, 免除的, 不受影响的
n. 免疫者
ieltsWords.collocations: immune system 免疫系统, immune to criticism 不受批评影响, immune from prosecution 免于起诉
ieltsWords.example: A healthy diet can boost your immune system. ||| He seems immune to the stress of his job. ||| Diplomats are immune from prosecution in some countries.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 健康的饮食可以增强你的免疫系统。 ||| 他似乎不受工作压力的影响。 ||| 在某些国家，外交官免于起诉。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 损害, 减少, 削弱
[法] 损害, 伤害, 减少
ieltsWords.collocations: impair vision 损害视力, impair judgment 削弱判断力, impair performance 影响表现
ieltsWords.example: Lack of sleep can impair your ability to concentrate. ||| The accident impaired his hearing permanently. ||| Excessive alcohol consumption impairs liver function.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 睡眠不足会损害你的注意力。 ||| 那次事故永久性地损害了他的听力。 ||| 过量饮酒会损害肝功能。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 给予, 传授, 告知
ieltsWords.collocations: impart knowledge 传授知识, impart wisdom 传授智慧, impart information 告知信息
ieltsWords.example: Teachers impart knowledge to their students. ||| The spice imparts a unique flavor to the dish. ||| She imparted the news to her family with great care.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师向学生传授知识。 ||| 这种香料赋予菜肴独特的风味。 ||| 她小心翼翼地告知家人这个消息。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 妨碍, 阻碍, 阻止
ieltsWords.collocations: impede progress 阻碍进步, impede development 妨碍发展, impede traffic 阻碍交通
ieltsWords.example: The heavy snow impeded the rescue efforts. ||| Lack of funding impeded the research project. ||| The construction work impeded the flow of traffic.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 大雪阻碍了救援工作。 ||| 资金不足妨碍了研究项目。 ||| 施工阻碍了交通流量。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 命令, 必要的事, 规则, 祈使语气
a. 命令式的, 急需的, 势在必行的, 强制的
ieltsWords.collocations: imperative need 迫切需求, imperative duty 不可推卸的责任, imperative mood 祈使语气
ieltsWords.example: It is imperative that we address climate change now. ||| The doctor gave imperative instructions to the patient. ||| In grammar, the imperative mood is used for commands.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们现在必须应对气候变化。 ||| 医生给病人下了必须遵守的指示。 ||| 在语法中，祈使语气用于命令。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 帝王的, 宗主国的, 至尊的, 壮丽的
n. 特等品
ieltsWords.collocations: imperial power 帝国权力, imperial palace 皇宫, imperial system 英制单位
ieltsWords.example: The imperial palace is a major tourist attraction. ||| Britain's imperial past is still evident in many former colonies. ||| The imperial system of measurement is used in the United States.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 皇宫是一个主要的旅游景点。 ||| 英国的帝国历史在许多前殖民地仍然显而易见。 ||| 美国使用英制测量系统。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 动力, 推动力, 动量
[医] 冲动, 动能, 起始(病)
ieltsWords.collocations: provide impetus 提供动力, gain impetus 获得动力, main impetus 主要推动力
ieltsWords.example: The new policy gave impetus to economic growth. ||| The discovery of oil provided the impetus for industrial development. ||| The project gained impetus after receiving government funding.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新政策为经济增长提供了动力。 ||| 石油的发现为工业发展提供了推动力。 ||| 该项目在获得政府资助后获得了动力。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 暗示的, 含蓄的, 固有的, 绝对的
[经] 不讲明的, 含蓄的
ieltsWords.collocations: implicit trust 绝对信任, implicit meaning 隐含意义, implicit bias 隐性偏见
ieltsWords.example: There was an implicit agreement between the two parties. ||| Her silence gave implicit consent to the plan. ||| The study examined implicit racial biases in hiring.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 双方之间有一个默契。 ||| 她的沉默表示默许了这个计划。 ||| 这项研究考察了招聘中的隐性种族偏见。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 重要的, 有地位的, 大量的, 显要的, 自负的
[计] 要点
ieltsWords.collocations: important role 重要作用, important factor 重要因素, important decision 重要决定
ieltsWords.example: Education plays an important role in personal development. ||| It is important to maintain a healthy lifestyle. ||| She is an important figure in the field of medicine.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 教育在个人发展中起着重要作用。 ||| 保持健康的生活方式很重要。 ||| 她是医学领域的重要人物。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 不可能的, 难以置信的, 令人无法忍受的
ieltsWords.collocations: impossible task 不可能完成的任务, impossible dream 不可能实现的梦想, make it impossible 使不可能
ieltsWords.example: It is impossible to please everyone. ||| The traffic made it impossible to arrive on time. ||| He faced an impossible choice between his career and his family.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 取悦所有人是不可能的。 ||| 交通堵塞使我们不可能准时到达。 ||| 他在事业和家庭之间面临一个不可能的选择。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 进步, 改善, 利用
[医] 改善, 好转, 进步
ieltsWords.collocations: continuous improvement 持续改进, significant improvement 显著改善, room for improvement 改进空间
ieltsWords.example: There has been a significant improvement in her health. ||| The company is committed to continuous improvement. ||| There is still room for improvement in the education system.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她的健康状况有了显著改善。 ||| 公司致力于持续改进。 ||| 教育体系仍有改进空间。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 冲动, 驱使, 刺激, 推动, 冲力, 建议, 脉冲
vt. 推动
ieltsWords.collocations: impulse buy 冲动购买, on impulse 一时冲动, nerve impulse 神经冲动
ieltsWords.example: She bought the dress on impulse without thinking. ||| The nerve impulse travels along the neuron. ||| He felt an impulse to laugh at the serious moment.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她一时冲动买了那条裙子，没多想。 ||| 神经冲动沿着神经元传递。 ||| 他有一种在严肃时刻想笑的冲动。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 无能, 无力
ieltsWords.collocations: inability to do something 无法做某事, physical inability 身体上的无能, financial inability 经济上的无力
ieltsWords.example: His inability to speak English hindered his job search. ||| The patient's inability to walk required a wheelchair. ||| The company's inability to adapt led to its downfall.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他不会说英语妨碍了他找工作。 ||| 病人无法行走，需要轮椅。 ||| 公司无法适应导致了它的倒闭。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 错误的, 不准确的
[化] 不精确
ieltsWords.collocations: inaccurate information 不准确的信息, inaccurate measurement 不精确的测量, inaccurate report 错误的报告
ieltsWords.example: The weather forecast proved to be inaccurate. ||| Inaccurate data can lead to wrong conclusions. ||| The witness gave an inaccurate account of the accident.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 天气预报被证明是不准确的。 ||| 不准确的数据可能导致错误的结论。 ||| 目击者对事故的描述不准确。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 不充分的, 不适当的
[法] 不充分的, 不适当的
ieltsWords.collocations: inadequate funding 资金不足, inadequate preparation 准备不充分, inadequate response 回应不足
ieltsWords.example: The government's response to the crisis was inadequate. ||| Her inadequate preparation led to a poor performance in the exam. ||| The report highlighted the inadequate funding for public schools.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府对危机的回应不足。 ||| 她准备不充分导致考试成绩不佳。 ||| 报告强调了公立学校资金不足的问题。

ieltsWords.definition: vt. 开始, 举行...就职典礼
ieltsWords.collocations: inaugurate a new policy 推行新政策, inaugurate a president 为总统举行就职典礼, inaugurate a festival 为节日举行开幕式
ieltsWords.example: The new president will be inaugurated in January. ||| The company inaugurated a new training program for employees. ||| The museum was inaugurated with a grand ceremony.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新总统将于一月就职。 ||| 公司启动了新的员工培训计划。 ||| 博物馆在盛大的仪式中开幕。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 发生, 发生率, 影响, 负担者, 入射, 倾角
[医] 入射, 发生率, 发生数
ieltsWords.collocations: high incidence of disease 疾病高发率, incidence of crime 犯罪发生率, incidence of poverty 贫困发生率
ieltsWords.example: There is a high incidence of heart disease in this region. ||| The incidence of crime has decreased due to better policing. ||| The study examined the incidence of poverty among single mothers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个地区心脏病发病率很高。 ||| 由于治安改善，犯罪率下降了。 ||| 该研究调查了单身母亲中的贫困发生率。

ieltsWords.definition: adv. 伴随地, 偶然, 顺便
ieltsWords.collocations: incidentally mentioned 顺便提到, incidentally related 偶然相关, incidentally discovered 偶然发现
ieltsWords.example: Incidentally, I saw your brother at the mall yesterday. ||| The two events are only incidentally connected. ||| He incidentally discovered the solution while working on another problem.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 顺便提一句，我昨天在商场看到你哥哥了。 ||| 这两个事件只是偶然相关。 ||| 他在处理另一个问题时偶然发现了解决方案。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 倾向, 趋向, 倾斜度, 点头
[化] 倾角
ieltsWords.collocations: natural inclination 自然倾向, strong inclination 强烈意愿, inclination to do sth 做某事的倾向
ieltsWords.example: She has a natural inclination towards music. ||| He showed no inclination to change his mind. ||| The road has a steep inclination.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她天生对音乐有倾向。 ||| 他没有改变主意的意愿。 ||| 这条路有一个陡坡。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 倾斜, 斜坡, 斜面
vt. 使倾向于, 使倾斜
vi. 倾向, 倾斜, 爱好, 易于
ieltsWords.collocations: incline to believe 倾向于相信, incline towards 倾向于, incline one's head 点头
ieltsWords.example: I incline to believe that he is telling the truth. ||| The roof inclines at a steep angle. ||| His arguments incline me to change my opinion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我倾向于相信他说的是实话。 ||| 屋顶倾斜角度很大。 ||| 他的论点使我倾向于改变看法。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 包含的, 包括的
ieltsWords.collocations: inclusive education 包容性教育, inclusive of tax 含税, all-inclusive package 全包套餐
ieltsWords.example: The price is inclusive of all taxes and fees. ||| The school promotes an inclusive environment for all students. ||| We offer an all-inclusive holiday package.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 价格包含所有税费。 ||| 学校为所有学生营造包容的环境。 ||| 我们提供全包度假套餐。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 进来的, 刚开始的, 新来的
n. 进来
ieltsWords.collocations: incoming call 来电, incoming mail 来信, incoming president 新任总统
ieltsWords.example: The incoming president will face many challenges. ||| Please check your incoming emails regularly. ||| The airport handles all incoming flights.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 新任总统将面临许多挑战。 ||| 请定期查看你的收件箱。 ||| 机场处理所有进港航班。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 不协调的, 不一致的, 不合适的
ieltsWords.collocations: incongruous with 与…不协调, incongruous sight 不协调的景象, incongruous elements 不协调的元素
ieltsWords.example: The modern building looked incongruous in the historic town. ||| His casual clothes were incongruous with the formal occasion. ||| The painting contained incongruous elements from different styles.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这座现代建筑在历史古镇中显得不协调。 ||| 他的休闲服装与正式场合不协调。 ||| 这幅画包含了不同风格的不协调元素。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 难以置信的
ieltsWords.collocations: incredible story 难以置信的故事, incredible achievement 了不起的成就, incredible speed 极快的速度
ieltsWords.example: She told an incredible story about her travels. ||| The athlete achieved an incredible world record. ||| The car was traveling at an incredible speed.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她讲了一个关于她旅行的难以置信的故事。 ||| 这位运动员取得了了不起的世界纪录。 ||| 那辆车以极快的速度行驶。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 增加, 增值, 盈余
[计] 增量
ieltsWords.collocations: annual increment 年度增长, salary increment 加薪, incremental increase 逐步增加
ieltsWords.example: Employees receive an annual increment based on performance. ||| The software updates are released in small increments. ||| The company reported a steady increment in profits.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 员工根据绩效获得年度加薪。 ||| 软件更新以小增量发布。 ||| 公司报告利润稳步增长。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 招致, 蒙受, 遭遇
[经] 招致, 蒙受, 担负
ieltsWords.collocations: incur debt 负债, incur expenses 产生费用, incur wrath 招致愤怒
ieltsWords.example: He incurred a lot of debt to start his business. ||| The project incurred unexpected expenses. ||| His careless remarks incurred the manager's wrath.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他为了创业欠了很多债。 ||| 这个项目产生了意外费用。 ||| 他粗心的言论招致了经理的愤怒。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 模糊的, 不确定的, 无限的
[法] 不确定的, 无限制的
ieltsWords.collocations: indefinite period 不确定的时期, indefinite article 不定冠词, indefinite delay 无限期延迟
ieltsWords.example: The meeting has been postponed for an indefinite period. ||| She gave an indefinite answer to my question. ||| The indefinite article 'a' is used before consonant sounds.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 会议被无限期推迟。 ||| 她对我的问题给出了模糊的回答。 ||| 不定冠词'a'用于辅音音素前。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 独立, 自立, 自主
[医] 自主性, 独立性
ieltsWords.collocations: gain independence 获得独立, financial independence 经济独立, independence from 从…独立
ieltsWords.example: The country gained independence in 1960. ||| She values her financial independence. ||| Teenagers often strive for independence from their parents.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个国家于1960年获得独立。 ||| 她重视经济独立。 ||| 青少年常常争取脱离父母独立。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 索引, 指针, 指数, 指标
vt. 编入索引中, 指出
vi. 做索引
[计] 下标; 附标; 变址; 索引; 编索引
ieltsWords.collocations: stock market index 股票市场指数, index finger 食指, index of economic growth 经济增长指标
ieltsWords.example: The book has a comprehensive index at the back. ||| The Dow Jones index fell sharply yesterday. ||| The consumer price index is a measure of inflation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这本书后面有全面的索引。 ||| 道琼斯指数昨天大幅下跌。 ||| 消费者价格指数是衡量通货膨胀的指标。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 指示的, 象征的, 表示...的
[经] 指标的
ieltsWords.collocations: be indicative of 表明, indicative mood 陈述语气, indicative sign 指示标志
ieltsWords.example: His silence is indicative of his disapproval. ||| The results are indicative of a larger trend. ||| In English, the indicative mood is used for facts.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他的沉默表明他不赞成。 ||| 这些结果表明了一个更大的趋势。 ||| 英语中，陈述语气用于陈述事实。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 指示器, 指示剂, 指标
[计] 指示器
ieltsWords.collocations: economic indicator 经济指标, performance indicator 绩效指标, indicator light 指示灯
ieltsWords.example: GDP is a key economic indicator. ||| The indicator light shows when the machine is running. ||| Student test scores are an indicator of school quality.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: GDP是一个关键的经济指标。 ||| 指示灯显示机器何时运行。 ||| 学生考试成绩是学校质量的指标。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 漠不关心的, 无重要性的, 中立的
[医] 中性的, 无作用的, 无亲和力的, 淡漠的
ieltsWords.collocations: indifferent to 对…冷漠, indifferent attitude 冷漠的态度, indifferent quality 质量一般
ieltsWords.example: He was indifferent to the suffering of others. ||| She gave an indifferent shrug when asked about the issue. ||| The food was of indifferent quality.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他对别人的痛苦漠不关心。 ||| 当被问及这个问题时，她冷漠地耸了耸肩。 ||| 食物质量一般。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 本土的, 国产的, 固有的
[医] 原产的, 本土的
ieltsWords.collocations: indigenous people 土著人民, indigenous species 本地物种, indigenous culture 本土文化
ieltsWords.example: The indigenous people have lived here for centuries. ||| Many indigenous species are threatened by habitat loss. ||| The government is working to preserve indigenous cultures.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 土著人民在这里生活了几个世纪。 ||| 许多本地物种因栖息地丧失而受到威胁。 ||| 政府正在努力保护本土文化。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 愤怒的, 愤慨的
ieltsWords.collocations: indignant at 对…愤慨, indignant response 愤怒的反应, feel indignant 感到愤慨
ieltsWords.example: She was indignant at the unfair treatment. ||| The public was indignant about the corruption scandal. ||| He gave an indignant reply to the accusation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对不公正的待遇感到愤慨。 ||| 公众对腐败丑闻感到愤怒。 ||| 他对指控做出了愤怒的回应。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 不可缺少之物
a. 不可缺少的, 责无旁贷的, 绝对必要的
ieltsWords.collocations: indispensable to/for 对…必不可少, indispensable part 不可或缺的部分, play an indispensable role 发挥不可或缺的作用
ieltsWords.example: A good dictionary is indispensable for learning a foreign language. ||| The Internet has become an indispensable part of modern life. ||| Teamwork plays an indispensable role in achieving success.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 一本好词典对于学习外语是必不可少的。 ||| 互联网已成为现代生活中不可或缺的一部分。 ||| 团队合作在取得成功中发挥着不可或缺的作用。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 引诱, 招致, 归纳出, 感应
[医] 诱导, 感应
ieltsWords.collocations: induce sleep 诱导睡眠, induce labor 引产, induce sb to do sth 诱导某人做某事
ieltsWords.example: The medication may induce drowsiness, so avoid driving. ||| Advertising often induces people to buy products they don't need. ||| Stress can induce a variety of health problems.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这种药物可能引起嗜睡，所以避免开车。 ||| 广告常常诱导人们购买他们不需要的产品。 ||| 压力可以引起各种健康问题。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 纵情于, 使高兴, 放任, 迁就
vi. 沉溺
ieltsWords.collocations: indulge in 沉溺于, indulge oneself 放纵自己, indulge a hobby 沉迷于爱好
ieltsWords.example: He tends to indulge in excessive eating when stressed. ||| Parents should not indulge their children too much. ||| On weekends, I like to indulge in reading novels.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他压力大时往往会暴饮暴食。 ||| 父母不应过分纵容孩子。 ||| 周末我喜欢沉浸于读小说。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 工业的, 供工业用的, 工业高度发展的, 产业的
n. 工业工人, 工业股票
ieltsWords.collocations: industrial revolution 工业革命, industrial area 工业区, industrial production 工业生产
ieltsWords.example: The Industrial Revolution transformed society in the 18th century. ||| Many industrial areas have been converted into residential zones. ||| Industrial production has increased significantly this year.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 工业革命在18世纪改变了社会。 ||| 许多工业区已被改造成住宅区。 ||| 今年工业生产显著增长。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 勤劳, 工业, 企业, 产业, 有组织的劳动
[经] 工业, 实业
ieltsWords.collocations: heavy industry 重工业, service industry 服务业, manufacturing industry 制造业
ieltsWords.example: The country's economy relies heavily on the manufacturing industry. ||| The tourism industry has been booming in recent years. ||| His success is due to hard work and industry.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该国经济严重依赖制造业。 ||| 旅游业近年来蓬勃发展。 ||| 他的成功归功于勤奋努力。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 惯性, 惰性, 迟钝
[化] 惯性
ieltsWords.collocations: inertia force 惯性力, inertia of motion 运动惯性, overcome inertia 克服惰性
ieltsWords.example: The car continued moving due to inertia after the engine stopped. ||| Many people suffer from inertia and fail to exercise regularly. ||| The government must overcome bureaucratic inertia to implement reforms.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 发动机停止后，汽车由于惯性继续前进。 ||| 许多人因惰性而无法定期锻炼。 ||| 政府必须克服官僚惰性来实施改革。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 婴儿, 儿童, 初学者
a. 婴儿的, 幼稚的
ieltsWords.collocations: infant mortality 婴儿死亡率, infant formula 婴儿配方奶粉, infant care 婴儿护理
ieltsWords.example: Infant mortality has declined dramatically due to better healthcare. ||| The mother carefully prepared the infant formula. ||| Proper infant care is crucial for healthy development.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 由于医疗保健改善，婴儿死亡率大幅下降。 ||| 母亲仔细准备了婴儿配方奶粉。 ||| 适当的婴儿护理对健康成长至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 传染, 感染
[医] 传染, 感染
ieltsWords.collocations: infect with 感染…, become infected 被感染, infect others 传染他人
ieltsWords.example: The virus can infect people through respiratory droplets. ||| He became infected after touching a contaminated surface. ||| Infected individuals should isolate to avoid infecting others.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 病毒可通过呼吸道飞沫感染人。 ||| 他接触受污染表面后被感染。 ||| 感染者应隔离以避免传染他人。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 传染, 影响, 传染病
[医] 传染, 感染
ieltsWords.collocations: bacterial infection 细菌感染, viral infection 病毒感染, prevent infection 预防感染
ieltsWords.example: The patient developed a severe bacterial infection after surgery. ||| Viral infections often cause fever and fatigue. ||| Washing hands regularly helps prevent infection.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 患者术后出现严重细菌感染。 ||| 病毒感染常引起发烧和疲劳。 ||| 经常洗手有助于预防感染。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 有传染性的, 易传染的
[医] 传染性的
ieltsWords.collocations: infectious disease 传染病, infectious laughter 有感染力的笑声, infectious enthusiasm 有感染力的热情
ieltsWords.example: Measles is a highly infectious disease. ||| Her infectious laughter filled the room. ||| The speaker's infectious enthusiasm motivated the audience.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 麻疹是一种高度传染性疾病。 ||| 她富有感染力的笑声充满了房间。 ||| 演讲者富有感染力的热情激励了观众。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 推论
[法] 推论, 推理, 推断
ieltsWords.collocations: draw an inference 做出推断, logical inference 逻辑推理, by inference 通过推理
ieltsWords.example: We can draw an inference from the data that sales will increase. ||| Logical inference is a key skill in critical thinking. ||| By inference, he must have known about the plan.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们可以从数据推断出销售额将增长。 ||| 逻辑推理是批判性思维的关键技能。 ||| 通过推断，他一定知道这个计划。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 次等的, 较差的, 下方的, 下级的
n. 部下, 次品, 下标(符号)
ieltsWords.collocations: inferior to 次于, inferior quality 劣质, inferior goods 劣质商品
ieltsWords.example: This product is inferior to the one we bought last time. ||| The company was criticized for selling inferior quality goods. ||| He felt inferior to his more successful colleagues.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个产品比我们上次买的差。 ||| 该公司因销售劣质商品而受到批评。 ||| 他觉得自己不如更成功的同事。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 无限, 神
a. 无穷的, 无限的, 极大的
ieltsWords.collocations: infinite number 无限数量, infinite space 无限空间, infinite patience 无限耐心
ieltsWords.example: The universe is believed to be infinite in size. ||| She has infinite patience with her students. ||| There are an infinite number of possibilities.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 宇宙被认为是无限大的。 ||| 她对她的学生有无限的耐心。 ||| 有无限的可能性。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 胀大, 夸张, 通货膨胀
[化] 充气吹胀; 膨胀
ieltsWords.collocations: high inflation 高通胀, inflation rate 通胀率, control inflation 控制通胀
ieltsWords.example: High inflation erodes the purchasing power of money. ||| The central bank raised interest rates to control inflation. ||| Inflation rate has been stable for the past year.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 高通胀侵蚀了货币的购买力。 ||| 中央银行提高利率以控制通胀。 ||| 过去一年通胀率一直稳定。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 施以, 加害, 使承受
[法] 处, 加, 予以
ieltsWords.collocations: inflict pain 施加痛苦, inflict damage 造成损害, inflict on/upon 使…遭受
ieltsWords.example: The storm inflicted severe damage on the coastal areas. ||| He inflicted a heavy defeat on his opponent. ||| The dictator inflicted great suffering upon the people.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 风暴给沿海地区造成了严重破坏。 ||| 他使对手遭受惨败。 ||| 独裁者给人民带来了巨大痛苦。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 流入, 河口, 汇集
[医] 注入, 流入
ieltsWords.collocations: influx of tourists 游客涌入, influx of capital 资本流入, massive influx 大量涌入
ieltsWords.example: The city experienced a massive influx of tourists during the holiday. ||| The influx of foreign capital boosted the local economy. ||| The sudden influx of refugees strained the resources.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 节日期间该市经历了大量游客涌入。 ||| 外国资本的流入促进了当地经济。 ||| 难民的突然涌入使资源紧张。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 消息, 知识, 通知, 情报, 信息, 问讯处, 起诉
[计] 信息
ieltsWords.collocations: information technology 信息技术, gather information 收集信息, provide information 提供信息
ieltsWords.example: Information technology has revolutionized the way we work. ||| We need to gather more information before making a decision. ||| The website provides useful information for travelers.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 信息技术彻底改变了我们的工作方式。 ||| 在做决定之前我们需要收集更多信息。 ||| 该网站为旅行者提供有用的信息。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 提供消息的, 见闻广博的
ieltsWords.collocations: informative speech 信息丰富的演讲, highly informative 信息量大的, informative article 有教育意义的文章
ieltsWords.example: The lecture was highly informative and well-organized. ||| I found the documentary very informative about climate change. ||| The book is both entertaining and informative.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这次讲座信息量很大且组织得很好。 ||| 我发现这部纪录片关于气候变化的信息非常丰富。 ||| 这本书既有趣又有教育意义。

ieltsWords.definition: v. 破坏, 侵犯, 违反
ieltsWords.collocations: infringe on/upon 侵犯, infringe copyright 侵犯版权, infringe rights 侵犯权利
ieltsWords.example: Using the image without permission may infringe copyright. ||| The new law infringes on citizens' privacy rights. ||| The company was sued for infringing a patent.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 未经许可使用该图片可能侵犯版权。 ||| 新法律侵犯了公民的隐私权。 ||| 该公司因侵犯专利而被起诉。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 灵敏的, 精巧的, 聪明的
ieltsWords.collocations: ingenious idea 巧妙的想法, ingenious solution 巧妙的解决方案, ingenious device 精巧的装置
ieltsWords.example: She came up with an ingenious idea to solve the problem. ||| The engineer designed an ingenious device for saving energy. ||| His ingenious solution impressed the entire team.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她想出了一个巧妙的主意来解决这个问题。 ||| 工程师设计了一种节能的精巧装置。 ||| 他巧妙的解决方案给整个团队留下了深刻印象。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 居民, 居住者
[医] 居民
ieltsWords.collocations: local inhabitant 当地居民, original inhabitant 原始居民, inhabitant of a city 城市居民
ieltsWords.example: The island's inhabitants rely on fishing for their livelihood. ||| The census showed a decline in the number of urban inhabitants. ||| The cave was once home to prehistoric inhabitants.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 岛上的居民以捕鱼为生。 ||| 人口普查显示城市居民数量有所下降。 ||| 这个洞穴曾是史前居民的住所。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 固有的, 与生俱来的
[医] 固有的, 生来的
ieltsWords.collocations: inherent risk 固有风险, inherent characteristic 固有特征, inherent in 存在于…中
ieltsWords.example: There are inherent risks in any investment. ||| The inherent beauty of the landscape attracted many tourists. ||| These problems are inherent in the system itself.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 任何投资都有固有的风险。 ||| 风景的内在美吸引了许多游客。 ||| 这些问题源于系统本身。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 继承, 遗传
vi. 接受遗产
ieltsWords.collocations: inherit property 继承财产, inherit a trait 遗传特征, inherit from 从…继承
ieltsWords.example: She inherited a large fortune from her grandfather. ||| Children inherit certain genes from their parents. ||| He inherited the responsibility of running the family business.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她从祖父那里继承了一大笔财产。 ||| 孩子从父母那里遗传某些基因。 ||| 他继承了经营家族企业的责任。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 禁止, 抑制
vi. 起抑制作用
ieltsWords.collocations: inhibit growth 抑制生长, inhibit progress 阻碍进步, inhibit from 阻止做
ieltsWords.example: The drug inhibits the spread of cancer cells. ||| Lack of funding may inhibit the development of new technologies. ||| His shyness inhibited him from speaking in public.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这种药物抑制癌细胞的扩散。 ||| 资金不足可能阻碍新技术的发展。 ||| 他的害羞使他在公共场合不敢发言。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 主动行动, 首创精神, 主动权
a. 自发的, 起始的
ieltsWords.collocations: take the initiative 采取主动, launch an initiative 发起倡议, individual initiative 个人主动性
ieltsWords.example: The government launched a new initiative to reduce pollution. ||| She showed great initiative in solving the problem. ||| The team lost the initiative after the opponent scored.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 政府发起了一项减少污染的新倡议。 ||| 她在解决问题时表现出极大的主动性。 ||| 对手得分后，该队失去了主动权。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 注射, 注入, 使入轨
[医] 注射
ieltsWords.collocations: inject a drug 注射药物, inject money into 注入资金, inject enthusiasm 注入热情
ieltsWords.example: The doctor injected the vaccine into his arm. ||| The government plans to inject more funds into the healthcare system. ||| Her speech injected new life into the campaign.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 医生将疫苗注射进他的手臂。 ||| 政府计划向医疗系统注入更多资金。 ||| 她的演讲为竞选注入了新的活力。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 注射, 注射剂
[化] 注入; 注射
ieltsWords.collocations: give an injection 打针, injection of capital 资本注入, fuel injection 燃油喷射
ieltsWords.example: The patient received an injection of insulin. ||| The company needed an injection of cash to survive. ||| The car's engine uses direct fuel injection.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 病人接受了一针胰岛素注射。 ||| 公司需要现金注入才能生存。 ||| 这辆车的发动机使用直接燃油喷射。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 伤害, 侮辱
[医] 伤, 损伤
ieltsWords.collocations: serious injury 重伤, personal injury 人身伤害, injury to 对…的伤害
ieltsWords.example: He suffered a serious injury in the car accident. ||| The athlete missed the game due to a knee injury. ||| Excessive exercise can cause injury to your muscles.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他在车祸中受了重伤。 ||| 这名运动员因膝盖受伤错过了比赛。 ||| 过度运动可能对你的肌肉造成伤害。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 无罪的, 不懂事的, 无知的
n. 天真的人, 笨蛋
ieltsWords.collocations: innocent victim 无辜受害者, innocent of 无罪的, innocent child 天真的孩子
ieltsWords.example: The court found him innocent of all charges. ||| Many innocent civilians were killed in the conflict. ||| She gave an innocent smile that charmed everyone.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 法庭认定他所有罪名不成立。 ||| 许多无辜平民在冲突中丧生。 ||| 她露出了天真的微笑，迷住了所有人。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 无数的, 数不清的
ieltsWords.collocations: innumerable times 无数次, innumerable stars 无数星星, innumerable benefits 无数好处
ieltsWords.example: There are innumerable stars in the night sky. ||| He has made innumerable contributions to the field. ||| The project faced innumerable challenges from the start.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 夜空中有无数的星星。 ||| 他对该领域做出了无数贡献。 ||| 这个项目从一开始就面临无数挑战。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 患精神病的, 极愚蠢的
[医] 神经错乱的
ieltsWords.collocations: insane behavior 疯狂行为, drive someone insane 逼疯某人, insane idea 疯狂的想法
ieltsWords.example: The noise from the construction site is driving me insane. ||| It would be insane to attempt the climb in this weather. ||| He was declared insane and sent to a mental hospital.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 建筑工地的噪音快把我逼疯了。 ||| 在这种天气尝试攀登简直是疯了。 ||| 他被宣布精神错乱，送进了精神病院。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 昆虫, 卑鄙的人
[医] 昆虫
ieltsWords.collocations: insect species 昆虫种类, insect bite 昆虫叮咬, insect repellent 驱虫剂
ieltsWords.example: Bees are social insects that live in colonies. ||| The insect population has declined due to pesticide use. ||| She screamed when she saw a large insect crawling on the wall.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 蜜蜂是群居昆虫，生活在蜂群中。 ||| 由于使用杀虫剂，昆虫数量减少了。 ||| 她看到一只大昆虫在墙上爬时尖叫起来。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 插入物
vt. 插入, 把(人造卫星)射入(轨道), 添写
vi. 附着
[计] 插入
ieltsWords.collocations: insert a coin 投币, insert into 插入到, insert a comment 添加评论
ieltsWords.example: Please insert your card into the slot. ||| The editor inserted a new paragraph into the article. ||| You need to insert the key to start the car.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请将您的卡插入插槽。 ||| 编辑在文章中插入了一个新段落。 ||| 你需要插入钥匙才能启动汽车。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 察看, 洞察力, 见识
[医] 自知力, 洞察, 顿悟
ieltsWords.collocations: gain insight 获得洞察, provide insight 提供见解, valuable insight 宝贵见解
ieltsWords.example: The book provides valuable insights into human behavior. ||| She has a great insight into the problems of the poor. ||| His speech gave us an insight into his political views.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这本书对人类行为提供了宝贵的见解。 ||| 她对穷人的问题有深刻的洞察力。 ||| 他的演讲让我们了解了他的政治观点。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 检验, 检查, 视察
[医] 检查, 视察, 监督, 望诊
ieltsWords.collocations: carry out an inspection 进行检查, pass inspection 通过检查, inspection report 检查报告
ieltsWords.example: The building failed the fire safety inspection. ||| Regular inspection of equipment is essential for safety. ||| The inspector made a thorough inspection of the factory.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该建筑未通过消防安全检查。 ||| 定期检查设备对安全至关重要。 ||| 检查员对工厂进行了彻底检查。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使感动, 激发, 启示, 吸入, 鼓舞, 产生, 使生灵感
vi. 吸入, 赋予灵感
ieltsWords.collocations: inspire someone to do 激励某人做, inspire confidence 激发信心, inspire by 受…启发
ieltsWords.example: The teacher's words inspired the students to work harder. ||| His courage inspired admiration in everyone. ||| The beautiful scenery inspired her to write a poem.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师的话激励学生们更加努力。 ||| 他的勇气赢得了大家的钦佩。 ||| 美丽的景色启发她写了一首诗。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 鼓舞人心的
ieltsWords.collocations: inspiring story 鼓舞人心的故事, inspiring leader 鼓舞人心的领袖, inspiring speech 鼓舞人心的演讲
ieltsWords.example: Her inspiring speech moved the audience to tears. ||| The documentary tells an inspiring story of survival. ||| He is an inspiring teacher who motivates his students.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她那鼓舞人心的演讲让观众感动落泪。 ||| 这部纪录片讲述了一个鼓舞人心的生存故事。 ||| 他是一位鼓舞人心的老师，能激励学生。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 安装, 安置, 使就职
[计] 安装, 安装程序; DOS内部命令:安装常驻程序
ieltsWords.collocations: install software 安装软件, install equipment 安装设备, install a system 安装系统
ieltsWords.example: We need to install a new air conditioning unit. ||| The technician installed the software on my computer. ||| The new president was installed in office last week.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我们需要安装一台新的空调。 ||| 技术员在我的电脑上安装了软件。 ||| 新总统上周就职。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 即时的, 瞬间的, 猝发的
[机] 瞬时的
ieltsWords.collocations: instantaneous response 即时响应, instantaneous reaction 瞬间反应, almost instantaneous 几乎瞬间的
ieltsWords.example: The internet provides instantaneous access to information. ||| The explosion was followed by an instantaneous flash of light. ||| Modern communication allows for instantaneous contact across the globe.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 互联网提供即时的信息访问。 ||| 爆炸之后是一道瞬间的闪光。 ||| 现代通信使得全球即时联系成为可能。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 本能, 直觉
a. 充满着的
ieltsWords.collocations: natural instinct 自然本能, maternal instinct 母性本能, by instinct 凭本能
ieltsWords.example: Birds have an instinct to build nests. ||| Her first instinct was to run away from danger. ||| He followed his instinct and made the right decision.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 鸟类有筑巢的本能。 ||| 她的第一本能是逃离危险。 ||| 他凭直觉做出了正确的决定。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 指令, 教导, 命令
[计] 指令
ieltsWords.collocations: follow instructions 遵循指示, give instructions 给出指示, instruction manual 使用手册
ieltsWords.example: The teacher gave clear instructions for the assignment. ||| Please read the instruction manual before using the device. ||| The soldiers followed the instructions without question.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师对作业给出了明确的指示。 ||| 使用设备前请阅读说明书。 ||| 士兵们毫无质疑地执行指令。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 仪器的, 器具的, 可作为手段的
[医] 器械的
ieltsWords.collocations: instrumental in 在…中起重要作用, instrumental music 器乐, instrumental variable 工具变量
ieltsWords.example: Her research was instrumental in developing the new vaccine. ||| The band played an instrumental piece during the intermission. ||| He was instrumental in organizing the charity event.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她的研究对新疫苗的开发起到了重要作用。 ||| 乐队在幕间演奏了一首器乐曲。 ||| 他在组织慈善活动中起了关键作用。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 使绝缘, 隔离
[医] 绝缘
ieltsWords.collocations: insulate from 使免受…影响, insulate against 防止, insulate with 用…绝缘
ieltsWords.example: The walls are insulated with foam to keep the house warm. ||| They tried to insulate the children from the violent news. ||| The government took measures to insulate the economy from external shocks.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 墙壁用泡沫隔热以保持房屋温暖。 ||| 他们试图让孩子们远离暴力新闻。 ||| 政府采取措施使经济免受外部冲击。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 侮辱, 无礼, 损害
vt. 损害, 侮辱, 攻击
ieltsWords.collocations: insult someone 侮辱某人, take it as an insult 视为侮辱, add insult to injury 雪上加霜
ieltsWords.example: He insulted her by calling her a liar. ||| She felt that his comment was a personal insult. ||| To add insult to injury, he lost his wallet after being fired.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他骂她是骗子，侮辱了她。 ||| 她觉得他的评论是对她个人的侮辱。 ||| 雪上加霜的是，他被解雇后还丢了钱包。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 保险, 保险业, 保险费
[医] 保险
ieltsWords.collocations: health insurance 健康保险, life insurance 人寿保险, insurance policy 保险单
ieltsWords.example: It is wise to have health insurance in case of emergencies. ||| The insurance company refused to pay for the damage. ||| He took out a life insurance policy to protect his family.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 购买健康保险以防紧急情况是明智的。 ||| 保险公司拒绝赔偿损失。 ||| 他购买了一份人寿保险单来保护家人。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 保险, 确保
vi. 投保
ieltsWords.collocations: insure against 投保以防, insure one's life 投保人寿, insure for 投保金额
ieltsWords.example: You should insure your car against theft. ||| The company insured its building for $10 million. ||| Please insure that all doors are locked before leaving.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 你应该为你的汽车投保防盗险。 ||| 公司为其大楼投保了1000万美元。 ||| 请确保离开前所有门都锁好。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 尚未被人碰过的, 原封不动的, 完整的
[医] 完整的, 无伤的
ieltsWords.collocations: remain intact 保持完整, keep intact 保持完好, leave intact 使保持原样
ieltsWords.example: The ancient vase was found intact after the earthquake. ||| Despite the storm, the roof remained intact. ||| He managed to keep his reputation intact throughout the scandal.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 地震后发现那个古代花瓶完好无损。 ||| 尽管有暴风雨，屋顶仍然完好无损。 ||| 他在丑闻中设法保住了自己的声誉。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 整体, 积分, 整数
a. 固有的, 整体的, 整数的, 积分的
[计] 积分
ieltsWords.collocations: integral part 组成部分, integral to 对…不可或缺, integral calculus 积分学
ieltsWords.example: Teamwork is an integral part of the project's success. ||| The new system is integral to the company's expansion plan. ||| She played an integral role in the negotiations.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 团队合作是项目成功不可或缺的一部分。 ||| 新系统对公司扩张计划至关重要。 ||| 她在谈判中发挥了不可或缺的作用。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 正直, 廉正, 完整
[计] 完整性
ieltsWords.collocations: moral integrity 道德正直, academic integrity 学术诚信, structural integrity 结构完整性
ieltsWords.example: He is a man of great integrity and honesty. ||| The integrity of the data must be maintained throughout the experiment. ||| The scandal damaged the politician's integrity.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他是一个非常正直诚实的人。 ||| 实验过程中必须保持数据的完整性。 ||| 丑闻损害了那位政治家的正直形象。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 智力, 情报, 信息
[医] 智力
ieltsWords.collocations: artificial intelligence 人工智能, intelligence test 智力测试, intelligence agency 情报机构
ieltsWords.example: Her intelligence and hard work led to her success. ||| The government relies on intelligence to prevent terrorist attacks. ||| Artificial intelligence is transforming many industries.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她的智慧和勤奋带来了成功。 ||| 政府依靠情报来防止恐怖袭击。 ||| 人工智能正在改变许多行业。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 可理解的, 易理解的, 纯概念性的
ieltsWords.collocations: intelligible speech 清晰的讲话, barely intelligible 几乎无法理解, make intelligible 使易懂
ieltsWords.example: The professor's explanation was clear and intelligible. ||| His accent made his English barely intelligible. ||| The report was written in an intelligible manner for the general public.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 教授的解释清晰易懂。 ||| 他的口音使他的英语几乎无法理解。 ||| 报告以公众易懂的方式撰写。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 加强
vi. 强化
ieltsWords.collocations: intensify efforts 加大努力, intensify competition 加剧竞争, intensify the conflict 激化冲突
ieltsWords.example: The storm intensified as it approached the coast. ||| The government intensified its efforts to combat corruption. ||| The debate intensified after the new evidence was presented.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 风暴在接近海岸时加剧了。 ||| 政府加大了打击腐败的力度。 ||| 新证据提出后，辩论更加激烈。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 加强的, 内涵的, 集中的
n. 加强器
ieltsWords.collocations: intensive care 重症监护, intensive training 强化训练, labor-intensive 劳动密集型的
ieltsWords.example: The patient was moved to the intensive care unit. ||| She took an intensive language course before moving abroad. ||| Agriculture in this region is highly intensive.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 病人被转移到重症监护室。 ||| 她在出国前参加了强化语言课程。 ||| 这个地区的农业高度集约化。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 意图, 含义, 故意
a. 专心的, 决心的, 热心的
ieltsWords.collocations: with intent 故意地, intent on 专心于, original intent 初衷
ieltsWords.example: He entered the building with intent to steal. ||| She was intent on finishing the project on time. ||| The law punishes those who act with criminal intent.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他进入大楼意图偷窃。 ||| 她一心要按时完成项目。 ||| 法律惩罚那些有犯罪意图行事的人。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 兴趣, 嗜好, 利息, 利益, 爱好, 趣味, 势力
vt. 使感兴趣, 与...有关系
ieltsWords.collocations: interest rate 利率, take interest in 对…感兴趣, conflict of interest 利益冲突
ieltsWords.example: She has a keen interest in environmental issues. ||| The bank offers a high interest rate on savings accounts. ||| The politician was accused of a conflict of interest.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她对环境问题有浓厚的兴趣。 ||| 这家银行提供高储蓄利率。 ||| 那位政治家被指控有利益冲突。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 暂时的, 临时的, 间歇的
n. 过渡时期
ieltsWords.collocations: interim government 临时政府, interim report 中期报告, in the interim 在此期间
ieltsWords.example: An interim manager was appointed until a permanent one is found. ||| The company released its interim financial results. ||| In the interim, we will continue with the current plan.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在找到正式经理之前，任命了一位临时经理。 ||| 公司发布了中期财务业绩。 ||| 在此期间，我们将继续执行当前计划。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 内部, 内政
a. 内部的, 心灵的, 内地的, 内政的
ieltsWords.collocations: interior design 室内设计, interior of a building 建筑内部, interior ministry 内政部
ieltsWords.example: The interior of the house was beautifully decorated. ||| She studied interior design at university. ||| The interior minister announced new security measures.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 房子内部装饰得很漂亮。 ||| 她在大学学习室内设计。 ||| 内政部长宣布了新的安全措施。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 间歇的, 断断续续的
[化] 间歇的; 间断的
ieltsWords.collocations: intermittent rain 间歇雨, intermittent fasting 间歇性禁食, intermittent signal 间歇信号
ieltsWords.example: The weather forecast predicts intermittent showers throughout the day. ||| He suffers from intermittent back pain. ||| The internet connection has been intermittent all morning.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 天气预报预测全天有间歇性阵雨。 ||| 他患有间歇性背痛。 ||| 整个上午网络连接时断时续。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 国际的
n. 国别设定
[计] 国别设定
ieltsWords.collocations: international trade 国际贸易, international relations 国际关系, international student 国际学生
ieltsWords.example: The company expanded its international operations. ||| She works for an international organization. ||| International cooperation is essential to solve global problems.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 公司扩大了国际业务。 ||| 她在一家国际组织工作。 ||| 国际合作对解决全球问题至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 质问, 讯问, 审问
vi. 质问, 讯问
ieltsWords.collocations: interrogate a suspect 审问嫌疑人, interrogate a witness 询问证人, interrogate data 查询数据
ieltsWords.example: The police interrogated the suspect for hours. ||| The lawyer interrogated the witness about the events. ||| The system can interrogate the database to find relevant information.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方审问了嫌疑人几个小时。 ||| 律师就事件询问了证人。 ||| 该系统可以查询数据库以找到相关信息。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 交集, 十字路口, 交叉点
[计] 逻辑乘; 与
ieltsWords.collocations: traffic intersection 交通十字路口, intersection of cultures 文化交汇, at the intersection 在交叉点
ieltsWords.example: The accident occurred at a busy intersection. ||| The intersection of art and technology creates new possibilities. ||| We need to find the intersection of these two sets of data.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 事故发生在繁忙的十字路口。 ||| 艺术与技术的交汇创造了新的可能性。 ||| 我们需要找到这两组数据的交集。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 插入, 介入, 调停
[经] 干预
ieltsWords.collocations: government intervention 政府干预, early intervention 早期干预, military intervention 军事干预
ieltsWords.example: The teacher's intervention helped resolve the conflict. ||| Early intervention can prevent the disease from worsening. ||| The UN called for intervention in the humanitarian crisis.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 老师的干预帮助解决了冲突。 ||| 早期干预可以防止疾病恶化。 ||| 联合国呼吁对人道主义危机进行干预。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 面谈, 访问, 接见, 面试
vt. 接见, 对...进行面谈(试)
ieltsWords.collocations: job interview 求职面试, conduct an interview 进行采访, interview skills 面试技巧
ieltsWords.example: She prepared thoroughly for the job interview. ||| The journalist interviewed the prime minister. ||| The interview lasted for about an hour.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她为求职面试做了充分准备。 ||| 记者采访了首相。 ||| 采访持续了大约一个小时。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 被接见者, 被采访者, 被面试者
ieltsWords.collocations: interviewee response 受访者回答, nervous interviewee 紧张的面试者, potential interviewee 潜在受访者
ieltsWords.example: The interviewee answered all questions confidently. ||| Each interviewee was given ten minutes to speak. ||| The interviewee's background was impressive.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 被面试者自信地回答了所有问题。 ||| 每位受访者有十分钟发言时间。 ||| 被采访者的背景令人印象深刻。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 会见者, 面谈者, 进行面试者
ieltsWords.collocations: experienced interviewer 经验丰富的面试官, interviewer bias 面试官偏见, interviewer's question 面试官的问题
ieltsWords.example: The interviewer asked about her previous work experience. ||| A good interviewer listens carefully to the answers. ||| The interviewer made a note of the key points.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 面试官询问了她之前的工作经历。 ||| 好的采访者会仔细倾听回答。 ||| 面试官记下了关键点。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 亲密的, 私人的, 秘密的
vt. 暗示, 通知, 告诉
n. 至交
ieltsWords.collocations: intimate relationship 亲密关系, intimate knowledge 深入了解, intimate atmosphere 私密氛围
ieltsWords.example: They shared an intimate conversation by the fireplace. ||| She has an intimate knowledge of the local culture. ||| The restaurant has an intimate atmosphere.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们在壁炉旁进行了一次亲密的谈话。 ||| 她对当地文化有深入了解。 ||| 这家餐厅氛围私密。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 威胁, 恐吓
[法] 恐吓, 威胁, 使恐惧
ieltsWords.collocations: intimidate someone 恐吓某人, feel intimidated 感到害怕, intimidate into doing 胁迫做某事
ieltsWords.example: The bully tried to intimidate the younger students. ||| She felt intimidated by the large audience. ||| They were intimidated into signing the contract.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 那个恶霸试图恐吓低年级学生。 ||| 她被众多观众吓到了。 ||| 他们被胁迫签署了合同。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 复杂的, 错综的, 缠结的, 难懂的
ieltsWords.collocations: intricate design 复杂的设计, intricate pattern 精细的图案, intricate relationship 错综复杂的关系
ieltsWords.example: The watch has an intricate mechanism. ||| The artist created an intricate pattern on the vase. ||| The novel has an intricate plot.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这块手表有复杂的机械装置。 ||| 艺术家在花瓶上创作了精细的图案。 ||| 这部小说情节错综复杂。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 阴谋, 复杂的事
vi. 密谋, 私通
vt. 激起...的兴趣, 用诡计取得
ieltsWords.collocations: political intrigue 政治阴谋, intrigue someone 引起某人兴趣, be intrigued by 被…吸引
ieltsWords.example: The story is full of political intrigue. ||| The mystery novel intrigued me from the first page. ||| She was intrigued by his unusual proposal.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个故事充满了政治阴谋。 ||| 这本悬疑小说从第一页就吸引了我。 ||| 她对他不寻常的提议感到好奇。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 介绍, 传入, 采用, 初步
ieltsWords.collocations: introduction to 介绍, brief introduction 简要介绍, product introduction 产品介绍
ieltsWords.example: The book begins with an introduction to the topic. ||| She made the introductions at the meeting. ||| The introduction of new technology improved efficiency.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这本书以主题介绍开头。 ||| 她在会议上做了介绍。 ||| 新技术的引入提高了效率。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 直觉, 直觉的知识
ieltsWords.collocations: trust one's intuition 相信直觉, gut intuition 直觉, intuition tells 直觉告诉
ieltsWords.example: She followed her intuition and made the right decision. ||| Intuition often plays a role in scientific discovery. ||| His intuition told him something was wrong.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她凭直觉做出了正确的决定。 ||| 直觉在科学发现中常常起作用。 ||| 他的直觉告诉他出问题了。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 侵入, 拥入, 侵略, 侵袭
[法] 强入, 侵犯, 侵略
ieltsWords.collocations: invade a country 入侵一个国家, invade privacy 侵犯隐私, invade the market 涌入市场
ieltsWords.example: The army invaded the neighboring country. ||| The paparazzi invaded her privacy. ||| New companies are invading the market.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 军队入侵了邻国。 ||| 狗仔队侵犯了她的隐私。 ||| 新公司正涌入市场。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 详细目录, 存货清单
vt. 列入详细目录, 清点存货
[计] 存货清单
ieltsWords.collocations: inventory management 库存管理, take inventory 盘点, inventory list 库存清单
