ieltsWords.example: The store conducts an inventory check every month. ||| We need to update the inventory list. ||| Inventory management is crucial for retail businesses.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这家商店每月进行一次库存盘点。 ||| 我们需要更新库存清单。 ||| 库存管理对零售企业至关重要。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 转化的
vt. 使反转, 使颠倒, 使转化
n. 颠倒的事物
[计] 倒置; 反转
ieltsWords.collocations: invert the order 颠倒顺序, invert the image 反转图像, invert the colors 反转颜色
ieltsWords.example: If you invert the triangle, it looks different. ||| The experiment requires you to invert the test tube. ||| The graph inverts the relationship between the variables.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 如果你把三角形倒过来，它看起来就不一样了。 ||| 实验要求你把试管倒置。 ||| 这个图表颠倒了变量之间的关系。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 投资, 花费, 笼罩, 授予
vi. 投资, 利用
ieltsWords.collocations: invest in 投资于, invest money 投资金钱, invest time 投入时间
ieltsWords.example: Many people invest in the stock market. ||| She invested a lot of time in learning English. ||| The company plans to invest in new technology.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 许多人投资股票市场。 ||| 她投入了大量时间学习英语。 ||| 公司计划投资新技术。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 调查, 审查
[医] 调查, 调查研究
ieltsWords.collocations: criminal investigation 刑事调查, under investigation 正在调查中, conduct an investigation 进行调查
ieltsWords.example: The police launched an investigation into the crime. ||| The matter is still under investigation. ||| The investigation revealed new evidence.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 警方对犯罪展开了调查。 ||| 此事仍在调查中。 ||| 调查揭示了新证据。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 看不见的, 无形的
[经] 无形的, 表面上看不见的, 未列在公开帐目的
ieltsWords.collocations: invisible to the naked eye 肉眼看不见, invisible hand 无形之手, invisible barrier 无形障碍
ieltsWords.example: Germs are invisible to the naked eye. ||| The invisible hand of the market influences prices. ||| She felt an invisible barrier between them.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 细菌是肉眼看不见的。 ||| 市场的无形之手影响价格。 ||| 她感到他们之间有一道无形的障碍。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 发票, 发货单
v. 开发票, 记清单
ieltsWords.collocations: invoice number 发票号码, pay an invoice 支付账单, issue an invoice 开具发票
ieltsWords.example: Please send the invoice by email. ||| The company invoices its clients monthly. ||| The invoice amount is due within 30 days.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请通过电子邮件发送发票。 ||| 公司每月给客户开具发票。 ||| 发票金额应在30天内支付。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 包括, 使陷于, 潜心于, 包围
[医] 累及, 牵涉, 包含
ieltsWords.collocations: involve in 参与, involve with 与…有关, involve doing 涉及做某事
ieltsWords.example: The project involves a lot of teamwork. ||| She was involved in the decision-making process. ||| The job involves traveling frequently.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个项目涉及大量的团队合作。 ||| 她参与了决策过程。 ||| 这份工作需要经常出差。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 反语, 讽刺, 具有讽刺意味的事
ieltsWords.collocations: dramatic irony 戏剧性讽刺, sense of irony 讽刺感, ironic twist 讽刺的转折
ieltsWords.example: The irony is that he became rich by losing his job. ||| She spoke with a hint of irony in her voice. ||| The play is full of dramatic irony.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 讽刺的是，他因为失业而变得富有。 ||| 她说话时带着一丝讽刺。 ||| 这部戏剧充满了戏剧性讽刺。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 不规则物, 不合规格之物
a. 不规则的, 不整齐的, 不合法的
ieltsWords.collocations: irregular heartbeat 心律不齐, irregular verbs 不规则动词, irregular pattern 不规则图案
ieltsWords.example: The patient was diagnosed with an irregular heartbeat. ||| English has many irregular verbs that do not follow standard conjugation rules. ||| The irregular pattern on the fabric made it unique.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 病人被诊断出心律不齐。 ||| 英语中有许多不规则动词，它们不遵循标准的变位规则。 ||| 布料上的不规则图案使其独一无二。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 不顾的, 无关的, 没关系的
ieltsWords.collocations: irrespective of age 不论年龄, irrespective of gender 不论性别, irrespective of cost 不计成本
ieltsWords.example: The scholarship is awarded to students irrespective of their financial background. ||| Everyone is entitled to a fair trial, irrespective of their social status. ||| The company offers equal opportunities irrespective of race or religion.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 该奖学金颁发给学生，不论其经济背景如何。 ||| 每个人都有权获得公平审判，不论其社会地位如何。 ||| 公司提供平等机会，不论种族或宗教。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 灌溉, 冲洗
[医] 冲洗法, 灌溉
ieltsWords.collocations: irrigation system 灌溉系统, drip irrigation 滴灌, irrigation canal 灌溉渠
ieltsWords.example: Modern irrigation techniques have significantly increased crop yields. ||| The government invested in a new irrigation project to support agriculture. ||| Drip irrigation is an efficient method that conserves water.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 现代灌溉技术显著提高了作物产量。 ||| 政府投资了一个新的灌溉项目以支持农业。 ||| 滴灌是一种节约用水的有效方法。

ieltsWords.definition:
vt. 激怒, 使发怒, 使兴奋, 使发炎
vi. 引起不快
ieltsWords.collocations: irritate someone 激怒某人, irritate the skin 刺激皮肤, easily irritated 易怒的
ieltsWords.example: His constant complaining began to irritate his colleagues. ||| Some chemicals can irritate the skin if not handled properly. ||| She is easily irritated by loud noises.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他不断的抱怨开始激怒他的同事。 ||| 某些化学品如果处理不当会刺激皮肤。 ||| 她很容易被噪音激怒。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 孤立的, 孤零零的
[计] 隔离的, 绝缘的
ieltsWords.collocations: isolated incident 孤立事件, isolated area 偏远地区, feel isolated 感到孤立
ieltsWords.example: The village is located in an isolated area with no access to public transport. ||| This was not an isolated incident; similar cases have been reported before. ||| Living abroad can make some people feel isolated from their culture.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这个村庄位于一个偏远地区，没有公共交通。 ||| 这不是孤立事件，之前也有类似案例报道。 ||| 生活在国外可能会让一些人感到与自己的文化隔绝。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 隔绝, 孤立, 隔离
[化] 分离; 生物分离
ieltsWords.collocations: social isolation 社交孤立, isolation ward 隔离病房, in isolation 孤立地
ieltsWords.example: Prolonged social isolation can have negative effects on mental health. ||| The patient was placed in an isolation ward to prevent the spread of infection. ||| The problem cannot be viewed in isolation from its context.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 长期的社交孤立可能对心理健康产生负面影响。 ||| 病人被安置在隔离病房以防止感染传播。 ||| 这个问题不能脱离其背景孤立地看待。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 项目, 条款, 一则, 项
[计] 项
ieltsWords.collocations: item on the agenda 议程项目, luxury item 奢侈品, news item 新闻条目
ieltsWords.example: The first item on the agenda is the budget proposal. ||| She bought several luxury items during her trip abroad. ||| This news item has attracted widespread attention.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 议程上的第一项是预算提案。 ||| 她在国外旅行时购买了几件奢侈品。 ||| 这条新闻条目引起了广泛关注。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 旅程, 旅行指南, 游记
a. 巡回的, 旅程的
ieltsWords.collocations: travel itinerary 旅行行程, detailed itinerary 详细行程, plan an itinerary 制定行程
ieltsWords.example: We need to finalize our travel itinerary before booking flights. ||| The tour guide provided a detailed itinerary of the trip. ||| She spent hours planning the itinerary for her European vacation.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 在预订机票前，我们需要确定旅行行程。 ||| 导游提供了详细的行程安排。 ||| 她花了几个小时规划欧洲假期的行程。

ieltsWords.definition: a. 嫉妒的, 羡慕的, 留心的, 戒备的
ieltsWords.collocations: jealous of someone 嫉妒某人, jealous husband 吃醋的丈夫, make someone jealous 让某人嫉妒
ieltsWords.example: She was jealous of her friend's success. ||| He became jealous when he saw his girlfriend talking to another man. ||| Don't let jealousy ruin your relationship.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她嫉妒朋友的成功。 ||| 他看到女友和另一个男人说话时变得吃醋。 ||| 不要让嫉妒毁了你们的关系。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 工装裤, 牛仔裤
ieltsWords.collocations: pair of jeans 一条牛仔裤, blue jeans 蓝色牛仔裤, designer jeans 名牌牛仔裤
ieltsWords.example: She wore a pair of blue jeans and a white T-shirt. ||| Jeans are a versatile item of clothing suitable for many occasions. ||| He bought a new pair of designer jeans on sale.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她穿着一条蓝色牛仔裤和一件白色T恤。 ||| 牛仔裤是一种适合多种场合的多功能服装。 ||| 他打折时买了一条新的名牌牛仔裤。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 性情古怪的人, 急拉, 肌肉抽搐, 牛肉干
vi. 痉挛, 急拉, 急推
vt. 猛拉
ieltsWords.collocations: jerk reaction 突然反应, jerk chicken 烤鸡（加勒比风味）, jerk someone around 耍弄某人
ieltsWords.example: He gave the rope a sudden jerk and it came loose. ||| Don't be such a jerk; apologize to her. ||| The car jerked forward when the driver stepped on the accelerator.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他突然猛拉绳子，绳子松了。 ||| 别那么混蛋，向她道歉。 ||| 司机踩下油门时，汽车猛地向前一冲。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 珠宝, 珠宝类
ieltsWords.collocations: piece of jewelry 一件珠宝, fine jewelry 精美珠宝, costume jewelry 人造珠宝
ieltsWords.example: She inherited a valuable piece of jewelry from her grandmother. ||| The store sells both fine jewelry and costume jewelry. ||| She wore a stunning diamond necklace, her favorite piece of jewelry.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她从祖母那里继承了一件珍贵的珠宝。 ||| 这家店既卖精美珠宝也卖人造珠宝。 ||| 她戴着一条令人惊艳的钻石项链，那是她最喜欢的首饰。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 工作, 零活, 职业, 事情
vi. 做零工, 打杂, 做股票经纪, 假公济私
vt. 代客买卖, 批发, 承包, 欺骗
[计] 作业
ieltsWords.collocations: apply for a job 申请工作, job interview 工作面试, job market 就业市场
ieltsWords.example: She applied for a job at a multinational company. ||| He has a job interview tomorrow morning. ||| The job market is becoming increasingly competitive.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 她申请了一家跨国公司的工作。 ||| 他明天上午有一个工作面试。 ||| 就业市场变得越来越有竞争力。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 轻推, 轻撞, 慢跑
v. 轻推, (使)蹒跚行进, (使)慢跑
ieltsWords.collocations: go for a jog 去慢跑, jog someone's memory 唤起某人的记忆, jog along 缓慢前进
ieltsWords.example: I go for a jog in the park every morning. ||| Seeing that photo jogged my memory of our vacation. ||| The old car jogged along the bumpy road.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 我每天早上在公园慢跑。 ||| 看到那张照片唤起了我对假期的记忆。 ||| 那辆旧车在崎岖的路上缓慢前行。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 新闻记者, 从事新闻杂志业的人
ieltsWords.collocations: investigative journalist 调查记者, freelance journalist 自由记者, journalist covering politics 报道政治的记者
ieltsWords.example: The journalist wrote an article about climate change. ||| She works as a freelance journalist for several magazines. ||| Investigative journalists often risk their safety to uncover the truth.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 这位记者写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。 ||| 她为几家杂志社做自由记者。 ||| 调查记者常常冒着生命危险揭露真相。

ieltsWords.definition:
a. 法庭的, 公正的, 审判上的, 司法的
[法] 司法的, 审判上的, 法官的
ieltsWords.collocations: judicial system 司法系统, judicial review 司法审查, judicial decision 司法判决
ieltsWords.example: The judicial system is independent of the executive branch. ||| The Supreme Court has the power of judicial review. ||| The judicial decision was based on the evidence presented.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 司法系统独立于行政部门。 ||| 最高法院拥有司法审查权。 ||| 司法判决基于所呈证据。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 汁, 活力, 体液
vt. 挤出汁来, 加汁
ieltsWords.collocations: orange juice 橙汁, fruit juice 果汁, juice extractor 榨汁机
ieltsWords.example: I would like a glass of orange juice, please. ||| Fresh fruit juice is rich in vitamins. ||| She used a juice extractor to make carrot juice.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 请给我一杯橙汁。 ||| 新鲜果汁富含维生素。 ||| 她用榨汁机做了胡萝卜汁。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 连接, 会合处, 交叉点
[医] 接[合]处, 接点.[接]界
ieltsWords.collocations: road junction 道路交叉口, railway junction 铁路枢纽, junction box 接线盒
ieltsWords.example: The accident happened at a busy road junction. ||| The city is an important railway junction connecting several major lines. ||| The electrician checked the junction box for any loose wires.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 事故发生在繁忙的道路交叉口。 ||| 这个城市是连接几条主要线路的重要铁路枢纽。 ||| 电工检查了接线盒是否有松动的电线。

ieltsWords.definition: n. 丛林, 杂乱的一堆, 弱肉强食的地方
ieltsWords.collocations: dense jungle 茂密的丛林, jungle trek 丛林徒步, law of the jungle 丛林法则
ieltsWords.example: They trekked through the dense jungle for days. ||| Many exotic animals live in the jungle. ||| In the business world, it's often the law of the jungle.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他们在茂密的丛林中徒步走了好几天。 ||| 许多珍奇动物生活在丛林中。 ||| 在商界，常常是弱肉强食的丛林法则。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 年少者, 地位较低者, 大学三年级学生
a. 年少的, 下级的, 后进的
ieltsWords.collocations: junior high school 初中, junior employee 初级员工, junior year 大三
ieltsWords.example: He is a junior employee in the company. ||| She is in her junior year at university. ||| The junior high school students went on a field trip.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 他是公司的一名初级员工。 ||| 她正在上大学三年级。 ||| 初中生们去实地考察了。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 垃圾, 乌七八糟的东西, 舢板
[计] 清除
ieltsWords.collocations: junk food 垃圾食品, junk mail 垃圾邮件, junk shop 旧货店
ieltsWords.example: Eating too much junk food can lead to health problems. ||| I need to clear out all the junk from my garage. ||| My email inbox is full of junk mail.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 吃太多垃圾食品会导致健康问题。 ||| 我需要清理车库里的所有废旧杂物。 ||| 我的电子邮箱里塞满了垃圾邮件。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 陪审团, 评判委员会
a. 应急的
ieltsWords.collocations: trial by jury 陪审团审判, jury duty 陪审义务, jury system 陪审制度
ieltsWords.example: The jury found the defendant guilty of theft. ||| She was selected for jury duty last month. ||| The jury is still out on whether the policy is effective.
ieltsWords.exampleZh: 陪审团判定被告犯有盗窃罪。 ||| 她上个月被选为陪审员。 ||| 关于这项政策是否有效，尚无定论。

ieltsWords.definition:
n. 辩护, 证明正当, 释罪
[计] 调整
ieltsWords.collocations: provide justification 提供理由, without justification 毫无理由, justification for 为…辩护
